title: Scrum Master - CB2
description:
Scrum Master \- Data \& MuleSoft Integration
   

  

 Location: Bangalore, India
   

  

 Employment Type: Full\-Time
   

  

 Company: Bridgestone
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 Bridgestone Cortex APIs are a global Marketing capability that provides trusted, scalable access
   

  

 to core business data across Bridgestone. Supporting teams in Europe, North America, and
   

  

 Latin America, Cortex APIs enable access to product, location, inventory, fitment, pricing, and
   

  

 services data that powers digital experiences, commercial operations, and customer\-focused
   

  

 solutions.
   

  

 As Bridgestone evolves its data strategy for the age of AI, Cortex APIs will play a critical role in
   

  

 making high\-quality, connected data accessible across the enterprise. This team contributes to
   

  

 strategically important initiatives that strengthen data\-driven decision\-making, accelerate
   

  

 innovation, and support Bridgestone's ambition to become the world's number\-one tire
   

  

 manufacturer.
   

  

 Bridgestone is seeking an experienced, proactive Scrum Master to support Agile delivery for
   

  

 Data and MuleSoft integration teams. This role will enable teams to deliver high\-quality
   

  

 integration and data solutions with improved predictability, flow, and sustainable velocity.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be more than a facilitator of Scrum ceremonies. They will actively
   

  

 identify delivery risks, remove or escalate impediments, manage cross\-team dependencies,
   

  

 coach Agile ways of working, and help the team continuously improve its ability to deliver value.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Scrum Leadership and Agile Coaching
   

  

* Coach one or more cross\-functional teams in Scrum and Agile principles,


 practices, and behaviors.
   

  

* Facilitate effective Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Backlog Refinement, Sprint


 Review, and Retrospective sessions.
   

  

* Help teams establish clear Sprint Goals, realistic commitments, and actionable


 Definition of Ready and Definition of Done practices.
   

  

* Foster a culture of transparency, ownership, collaboration, continuous learning,


 and accountability.
   

  

* Coach Product Owners and team members on effective backlog management,


 prioritization, estimation, and stakeholder engagement.
   

  

* Assess Agile maturity and introduce practical improvements tailored to the


 team's needs.
   

  

 Proactive Impediment and Dependency Management
   

  

* Proactively identify blockers, delivery risks, bottlenecks, and dependencies


 before they impact sprint commitments.
   

  

* Own the process for documenting, tracking, escalating, and driving resolution of


 impediments.
   

  

* Partner with engineering leaders, platform teams, product owners, architects,


 and external stakeholders to resolve issues related to environments, access,
   

  

 integration dependencies, release readiness, and resource constraints.
   

  

* Challenge inefficient ways of working and facilitate solutions that reduce


 recurring blockers.
   

  

* Support the team in managing dependencies across Data, MuleSoft,


 application, infrastructure, security, QA, and DevOps teams.
   

  

 Delivery Flow and Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Use Agile delivery metrics to identify improvement opportunities and promote


 sustainable team performance.
   

  

* Monitor and help improve measures such as sprint\-goal achievement, carryover


 work, cycle time, throughput, blocker aging, defect trends, and delivery
   

  

 predictability.
   

  

* Facilitate retrospectives that result in clear improvement actions, with


 ownership and follow\-through.
   

  

* Help teams reduce handoffs, waiting time, rework, and unnecessary process


 overhead.
   

  

* Support adoption of engineering practices that enable reliable delivery, including


 automation, CI/CD, DevOps collaboration, and quality practices.
   

  

 Stakeholder Alignment and Communication
   

  

* Serve as an effective facilitator between delivery teams, Product Owners,


 business stakeholders, architects, and leadership.
   

  

* Communicate delivery status, risks, dependencies, decisions, and improvement


 opportunities clearly and transparently.
   

  

* Ensure stakeholders understand team capacity, priorities, dependencies, and


 realistic delivery timelines.
   

  

* Facilitate planning and alignment across multiple teams where integration


 dependencies exist.
   

  

 Data and MuleSoft Delivery Support
   

  

* Develop sufficient understanding of Data and MuleSoft integration delivery to


 anticipate common delivery constraints and support effective team planning.
   

  

* Support teams delivering API\-led integrations, data pipelines, data services, and


 related platform capabilities.
   

  

* Work with technical leads and architects to ensure technical dependencies,


 environment readiness, test data, security reviews, and release activities are
   

  

 visible and managed.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of experience working in Agile delivery environments, including 3\+ years


 as a Scrum Master, Agile Coach, or similar role.
   

  

* Demonstrated experience proactively removing impediments and improving


 team delivery flow.
   

  

* Experience supporting software, data, API, integration, or platform engineering


 teams.
   

  

* Strong practical knowledge of Scrum, Kanban, and Agile delivery principles.
* Experience facilitating Agile ceremonies and coaching teams toward greater


 autonomy and maturity.
   

  

* Experience using Agile delivery tools such as Azure DevOps (ADO), Jira, or


 equivalent.
   

  

* Strong ability to manage cross\-team dependencies, risks, and stakeholder


 expectations.
   

  

* Excellent facilitation, communication, conflict\-resolution, and problem\-solving


 skills.
   

  

* Ability to influence without direct authority and work effectively with technical


 and business stakeholders.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting MuleSoft, API integration, enterprise data, cloud, or


 middleware delivery teams.
   

  

* Familiarity with DevOps, CI/CD, automated testing, release management, and


 environment management practices.
   

  

* Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), SAFe Scrum


 Master, or equivalent certification.
   

  

* Experience working in scaled Agile environments, including SAFe or multi\-team


 delivery models.
   

  

* Familiarity with Agile flow metrics and evidence\-based approaches to


 continuous improvement.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

* The team consistently meets Sprint Goals and delivers commitments with


 greater predictability.
   

  

* Impediments and dependencies are identified early, visibly tracked, and


 resolved quickly.
   

  

* Carryover work, avoidable delays, and recurring blockers are reduced.
* Team members increasingly own their delivery process and continuousimprovement


 actions.
   

  

* Stakeholders have clear visibility into priorities, risks, dependencies, and


 delivery progress.
   

  

* The team improves sustainable velocity while maintaining quality and avoiding


 burnout.

title: Scrum Master Lead Analyst - Cigna Healthcare
description:
bout Cigna
   

  

 Cigna is a global health insurance company, dedicated to its mission of helping improve the health, well\-being, and peace of mind of those we serve by making health care simple, affordable, and predictable.
   

  

 Together with colleagues located across Europe, Asia Pacific, the Middle East, Africa, and India, you will support Cigna's International Health business. As part of Cigna Healthcare, International Health provides global and local health insurance solutions for internationally mobile individuals, multinational organizations, government entities, IGOs, NGOs, and local customers worldwide.
   

  

 We are going through a global Agile transformation. As a result, we are expanding our teams and are looking for experienced Scrum Masters / Agile Team Coaches to join our team.
   

  

 Purpose of the Role
   

  

 The purpose of the Scrum Master / Agile Team Coach role is to maximize value delivery through collaboration, impediment removal, visibility, learning, and evidence\-based improvement.
   

  

 This role supports high\-performing team dynamics, sustainable delivery, continuous flow, and self\-managed teams that are shaping and maturing Agile ways of working across International Health.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Scrum Master / Agile Team Coach is a team coach and servant leader who facilitates change through the adoption and application of Agile principles, practices, and frameworks.
   

  

 The role enables teams to self\-organize, improve flow, embrace effective ways of working, and consistently deliver value outcomes to stakeholders. The role partners closely with Product Owners, team members, Release Train Engineers, Agile Product Managers, and other stakeholders to support predictable delivery and continuous improvement.
   

  

 This is a Band 3 Contributor Career Track Role.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Team Coaching and Agile Enablement
   

  

* Provide coaching and guidance to Agile Teams and support the adoption and application of Agile values, principles, and practices.
* Act as a servant leader, facilitator, mentor, and coach for individuals and teams.
* Enable teams to improve collaboration, transparency, psychological safety, accountability, and self\-management.
* Use effective communication and listening skills to teach, coach, mentor, and support healthy team interactions.
* Foster a healthy working culture, build strong relationships, and strengthen key interactions across teams and stakeholders.


 Delivery Flow and Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Support teams in improving flow, reducing bottlenecks, managing impediments, and operating at a sustainable pace.
* Help teams establish realistic and achievable delivery commitments based on capacity, clarity, dependencies, and delivery risks.
* Maintain metrics and data necessary to provide visibility into maturity, progress, quality, flow, predictability, and value delivery.
* Facilitate evidence\-based improvement through retrospectives, improvement actions, and follow\-through on agreed outcomes.
* Encourage Built\-In Quality, continuous learning, and relentless improvement as part of day\-to\-day team working practices.


 Facilitation and Cadence Events
   

  

* Support and facilitate team ceremonies and cadence events that drive progress toward value delivery and business outcomes.
* Facilitate team events such as planning, team syncs, backlog refinement, reviews, retrospectives, and improvement workshops, as applicable to the team context.
* Participate in Sync events, Scrum Master / Team Coach forums, and internal Agile communities of practice.
* Support ART\-level alignment events, including PI Planning, ART Sync, Coach Sync, System Demo, and Inspect \& Adapt, as applicable.


 ART Alignment, Dependencies, and Impediments
   

  

* Provide support that helps Agile Teams improve overall ART performance through collaboration and alignment between team objectives, vision, and strategic themes.
* Facilitate and support dependency management to ensure alignment of delivery across teams.
* Support removal of impediments that hinder achievement of team goals and objectives.
* Protect the team from unnecessary disruptions and external distractions while escalating systemic impediments in a timely manner.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, RTEs, Agile Product Managers, business stakeholders, and technology partners to maintain transparency and alignment.


 Success in this Role
   

  

* Teams demonstrate stronger self\-management, collaboration, and ownership of delivery outcomes.
* Impediments, blockers, dependencies, and delivery risks are made visible and addressed promptly.
* Team ceremonies and cadence events are purposeful, outcome\-focused, and continuously improved.
* Metrics and qualitative insights are used to improve flow, predictability, quality, and stakeholder transparency.
* Teams operate at a sustainable pace while maintaining alignment with ART priorities and International Health business outcomes.
* Continuous improvement becomes embedded in the team culture.


**Required Qualifications / Skills / Experience**
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM), SAFe Scrum Master, SAFe Advanced Scrum Master, Professional Scrum Master, or equivalent Agile certification.
* At least 6 years of proven experience as a Scrum Master/Agile Team Coach role.
* Experience facilitating team development and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Strong knowledge of Lean\-Agile principles, Scrum practices, Kanban practices, and team\-level Agile delivery.
* Experience with Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) and understanding of its principles and practices.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, coaching, mentoring, and conflict resolution skills.
* Ability to work effectively with cross\-functional and geographically distributed teams.
* Strong problem\-solving, decision\-making, and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage priorities in a changing environment and support teams working under delivery deadlines.
* Ability to interact with Subject matter experts, Product Owners, Agile Product Managers, and stakeholders in a matrix structure.
* Knowledge of IT concepts, software delivery lifecycle, delivery methodologies, architecture considerations, and technical standards.


**Desired Qualifications / Skills / Experience**
* Working knowledge of Jira, Confluence, Mural, or similar collaboration tools.
* Experience supporting product, platform, operational, or service\-based delivery teams.
* Experience facilitating organizational change and Agile transformation initiatives.
* Experience in software development lifecycle, IT delivery, product delivery, or project management.


**About The Cigna Group**
 Cigna Healthcare, a division of The Cigna Group, is an advocate for better health through every stage of life. We guide our customers through the health care system, empowering them with the information and insight they need to make the best choices for improving their health and vitality. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

title: Delivery Manager
description:
Please note that we will only be able to accept candidates who have the appropriate rights and documentation for employment in India.
   

  

**Who We Are.**
 Axi is a leading global provider of margin and deliverable Foreign Exchange, Contracts for Difference (CFDs), and Financial Spread betting. Our business has evolved into a world\-class, multifaceted brokerage with offices in six regions. With heavy investment in the latest trading technology, Axi seeks to offer the most comprehensive end\-to\-end trading experience available, servicing traders of all levels from beginners to institutional\-level clients.
   

  

**Let's talk about the cool stuff you will do at Axi!**
 We are looking for an experienced
 **Delivery Manager** 
 to drive the successful delivery of strategic technology initiatives across our global engineering teams. You will be responsible for owning the delivery lifecycle from planning through execution, ensuring projects are delivered on time, at the highest quality, and with predictable outcomes. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast\-growing fintech organization where you'll lead transformation initiatives, partner with cross\-functional stakeholders across global regions, and leverage modern technologies and AI\-driven tools to continuously improve delivery excellence.
   

  

**Your EDGE Assignment / You Will**
**Delivery Cadence**
* Define, document, and continuously improve the team's delivery cadence — sprint/iteration length, ceremony schedule (planning, refinement, review, retro), and reporting rhythm.
* Ensure the cadence is followed: ceremonies happen on schedule, with the right people, producing real decisions.
* Adapt cadence to the needs of different workstreams (e.g., a fast\-moving feature team vs. a compliance\-heavy workstream) without fragmenting the organisation into inconsistent processes.


**Stage Gate Ownership**
* Own the criteria for moving work between stages (e.g., Discovery → Ready for Build → In Progress → Review → Release) and enforce them consistently.
* Act as the checkpoint before work advances: confirm acceptance criteria are met, dependencies are cleared, risk/compliance sign\-offs are in hand, and Definition of Done is completed.
* Act when something is not ready and explain exactly what is missing and what is needed to pass the gate.
* Track and report exceptions/waivers when a gate is bypassed and ensure it is a deliberate decision.


**Delivery Planning**
* Build delivery plans grounded in real data: backlog sizing (story points/estimates), team velocity history, known dependencies, and risk.
* Convert scope and velocity into realistic timelines and communicate them as ranges with clear assumptions and confidence levels.
* Re\-forecast the plan on a regular cadence (e.g., every sprint) as scope, velocity, or risk changes, and proactively flag slippage.
* Maintain visibility tools (burnup/burndown, roadmap views, RAID logs) that let stakeholders self\-serve status.


**Cross\-Team Coordination \& Reporting**
* Be the primary point of contact for delivery status to leadership and stakeholders — translating team\-level detail into a clear picture of progress, risk, and trade\-offs.
* Identify and actively manage cross\-team dependencies, blockers, and resourcing conflicts before they hit the critical path.
* Facilitate trade\-off conversations (scope vs. time vs. quality) with data.


**Process Ownership \& Continuous Improvement**
* Own the delivery process documentation (workflow stages, gate criteria, estimation method, ceremony structure) and keep it current, e.g. in Confluence.
* Run retrospectives that produce real process changes.
* Balance rigor with pragmatism — add process where it removes risk or ambiguity and remove process if not needed.


**Are you the one?**
* 8\+ years in a Delivery Manager, Scrum Master, Program Manager, or Technical Project Manager role, ideally spanning multiple teams or workstreams.
* Demonstrated experience running Agile/Scrum (or Kanban/hybrid) delivery cadences end\-to\-end — not just attending ceremonies but designing and improving them.
* Hands\-on experience with story\-point estimation, velocity tracking, and forecasting delivery timelines from that data.
* Proven ability to hold a line on process/quality gates under deadline pressure, with the communication skill to do so without becoming a bottleneck or being seen as purely a blocker.
* Strong stakeholder management — comfortable presenting status, risk, and trade\-offs to senior leadership.
* Fluency with delivery tooling (Jira, Confluence, or equivalent) and building reporting views (burnup/burndown, roadmaps, dashboards) that reduce manual status\-chasing.
* Hands\-on exposure to tools such as Postman and Datadog, with an interest in leveraging AI to improve delivery and operational efficiency.
* Proven experience delivering technology transformation initiatives, including system migrations, process transitions, or Global Capability Centre (GCC) setup and transition projects.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; able to turn ambiguous, fast\-moving work into a clear plan and a clear narrative.


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience in \[industry — e.g., fintech, trading platforms, regulated environments], particularly where compliance/risk sign\-off is part of the stage\-gate process.
* Certification such as CSM, PSM, SAFe, or PMP (useful signal, not a substitute for hands\-on experience).
* Experience introducing or maturing a delivery process in an organization that didn't previously have one.


**Axi's bag of delights**
* Competitive and attractive compensation.
* Extensive learning opportunities including professional certifications and soft\-skills development.
* 18 annual leave days and 12 sick leave days per year.
* Public holidays as declared by local government.
* Maternity leave as per law.
* Health insurance coverage.


**Axi's interview journey**
* Talent Acquisition Round – 45 Minutes
* Hiring Manager Interview – 1 Hour
* Final Interview – 1 Hour


 Please note that our organization works with recruitment agencies on a pre\-approved basis only. A recruitment agency that wishes to submit candidate profiles or resumes for consideration must obtain prior written consent from our talent acquisition team. We do not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies, and we will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Should we receive an unsolicited resume from a recruitment agency that does not have prior written consent, we will not be responsible for the payment of any fees related to the recruitment of the candidate represented in the unsolicited resume.
   

  

 At Axi, we prioritize creating a workplace that upholds fairness and respect for all. We encourage every individual within our community to contribute towards a culture where everyone feels a sense of belonging and is treated with the dignity they deserve. We make all employment\-related decisions—whether in hiring, compensation, training, performance reviews, or termination—based on merit and without bias, ensuring equal opportunities for everyone. We consciously work to identify and overcome any unconscious biases, with a commitment to fostering an inclusive environment where every employee and candidate feels genuinely welcomed and valued.

title: Integrated-Strategy & Operations-Senior Associate-Bangalore
description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As an Integrated\-Strategy \& Operations\-Senior Associate, you will play a pivotal role in enhancing customer experiences by analyzing client needs and developing customer\-centric solutions. Within our Commercial \& Service Excellence network, you will focus on creating seamless and personalized experiences that drive satisfaction and loyalty. As a Senior Associate, you will build meaningful client connections and learn how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate complex situations, grow your personal brand, and deepen your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality solutions even when the path forward is unclear.

 We are seeking a highly collaborative and experienced Lead Business Systems Analyst to support and evolve Dolby’s Atlassian ecosystem as we transition from Data Center to Cloud.  You will work across Jira Software, Jira Service Management, Confluence, and related marketplace apps to enable agile delivery, knowledge management, incident/service workflows, and reporting. Experience with Atlassian Cloud features, app rationalization, and macro remediation is strongly preferred.

* Support rationalization decisions around marketplace add\-ons (e.g., Reporting, Table Filter, Scaffolding, Comala, ScriptRunner).
* Work closely with vendors on migration planning, macro remediation strategies, and security/compliance impact assessments.
* Lead and manage projects end\-to\-end, ensuring successful delivery with ownership and accountability.
* Assist in building communication and adoption plans for phased Cloud rollout.
* Design and document Jira workflows, request types, SLAs, forms, and automation rules aligned to operational needs.
* Configure Confluence spaces, templates, permission models, and lifecycle policies.
* Identify opportunities to streamline processes using native Cloud automation and integrations.
* Support integration patterns between Atlassian products and platforms like Salesforce, Miro, GitLab, and Microsoft Teams.
* Author FRDs, functional specs, configuration guides, and runbooks.
* Support user acceptance testing and manage hyper\-care post\-migration.
* Provide recommendations on permission schemes, groups, project roles, issue security, and Confluence space governance.
* Troubleshoot platform issues and work with Atlassian Support to resolve.
* Analyze usage patterns and recommend improvements for adoption and performance.
* Provide training, office hours, and knowledge articles for end users and space/project admins.


**Required**
**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field.
* 8\+ years hands\-on experience with Atlassian platforms (Jira Software, Jira Service Management, Confluence).
* Experience with marketplace apps such as:
+ ScriptRunner
+ Comala
+ Table Filter \& Charts
+ Scaffolding
+ Aura

* Exposure to migration from Data Center to Cloud (assessment, planning, testing).
* Strong knowledge of Jira workflows, schemes (permissions, issue type, notification), automations, and SLAs.
* Strong functional understanding of Confluence structuring, macros, templates, and permissions.
* Experience documenting requirements, process flows, user stories, test plans, and runbooks.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills across global teams.
* Atlassian certifications ACP\-620 and ACP\-120\.
* Understanding of ITSM frameworks.


**Preferred**
* Prior experience rationalizing or replacing legacy macros.
* Familiarity with API\-based integrations (REST).
* Atlassian certifications ACP\-420\.
* Experience with license optimization and cost containment.

 Establish and improve project management processes and best practices
   

  

 Manage multiple high\-impact, complex projects (e.g., system integrations, global programs) simultaneously
   

  

 Drive delivery excellence in fast\-paced environments with a strong focus on quality, timelines, and outcomes
   

  

 Develop and implement operational processes to improve efficiency and meet evolving business needs
   

  

 Ensure compliance with organizational policies, standards, and ethical practices
   

  

 Lead and mentor project managers, ensuring continuous development and high performance
   

  

 What You’ll Bring
   

  

 Experienced Senior Technical Project Manager responsible for leading complex, large\-scale programs across eCommerce and technology domains in Information Security. Drives execution excellence, stakeholder alignment, and delivery of high\-impact business solutions while managing cross\-functional and distributed teams.
   

  

 8–12 years of experience in project/program management or related fields
   

  

 Proven experience managing large\-scale, complex, cross\-functional programs
   

  

 Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
   

  

 Ability to drive technical discussions and translate business requirements into execution plans
   

  

 Experience working in fast\-paced environments with strong problem\-solving and ownership mindset
   

  

 3\+ years of software development experience building and launching consumer applications (web, mobile, or desktop)
   

  

 Demonstrated creative problem\-solving ability, strong analytical skills, and a proactive, can\-do attitude
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business, or related field
   

  

 7\+ years of full lifecycle program/project management experience
   

  

 Experience managing programs across Product, Engineering, QA, UX, Business teams, and Third\-Party partners
   

  

 Strong organizational, multitasking, and coordination skills in fast\-paced environments
   

  

 Excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills
   

  

 Certified Scrum Master (CSM)
   

  

 Experience in large\-scale Technical Program Management within product organizations
   

  

 Familiarity with mobile application development lifecycle
   

  

 Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, and other project management platforms
   

  

 Strong collaboration and teamwork capabilities
   

  

 Ability to independently drive initiatives
   

  

 Flexibility in dynamic environments
   

  

 Ability to simplify technical concepts for business stakeholders
   

  

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills
   

  

**About Walmart Global Tech**
 Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people\-led and tech\-empowered.
   

  

 We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.
   

  

 We’re back to office
   

  

 Walmart’s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our Bangalore office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives.
   

  

**Benefits**
 Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best\-in\-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more.
   

  

 Belonging
   

  

 We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone.
   

  

 At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included." By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is—and feels—included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we’re able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.

title: Asset & Wealth Management - AM Digital Product Management - Associate -Bengaluru
description:
**Job Description**
**What We Do**
 At Goldman Sachs, we connect people, capital and ideas to help solve problems for our clients. We are a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities and investment management services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments and individuals.
   

  

 A career with Goldman Sachs Asset \& Wealth Management is an opportunity to help clients across the globe realize their potential, while you discover your own. As part of one of the world’s leading asset managers with over $3\.14 trillion in assets under supervision globally, you can expect to participate in exciting investment opportunities while collaborating with talented colleagues from all asset classes and regions and building meaningful relationships with your clients. Working in a culture that values integrity and transparency, you will be part of a diverse team that is passionate about our craft, our clients, and building sustainable success. Bringing together traditional and alternative investments, Goldman Sachs Asset \& Wealth Management provides clients around the world with a dedicated partnership and focus on long\-term performance. As the primary investment area within Goldman Sachs, we provide investment and advisory services for pension plans, sovereign wealth funds, insurance companies, endowments, foundations, financial advisors and individuals.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking an Associate Product Manager to help shape the vision, strategy, and roadmap for our marketing website. This role is ideal for someone passionate about creating engaging and informative online experiences that attract and convert potential clients. You will be responsible for ensuring the
 **Goldman Sachs website effectively communicates our firm's value proposition and supports our marketing goals.**
 As part of the Product Management team, key responsibilities will include conducting user research to understand website visitor behavior and needs, defining website requirements based on marketing objectives, prioritizing website features and content updates, managing the website backlog, and collaborating closely with marketing, design, and development teams to ensure successful and timely website enhancements. This includes improving user engagement metrics, and ensuring a seamless user experience across all devices.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Supporting the Roadmap
+ Work with business stakeholders and end\-clients to gather key requirements
+ Ruthlessly prioritize potential initiatives by understanding alignment with business strategy and value generated for current and future clients

* Working with Product Development/Engineering:
+ Work with dev, architect, UX teams and business stakeholders to shape the core modules of the Institutional Portal
+ Work with UX team to ensure consistency and incorporation of client feedback
+ Balance new functionality, bugs, and client requests
+ Assign commercial opportunities to work queue
+ Prioritize potential initiatives by understanding alignment with business strategy and value generated for current and future users

* Establish Metrics of Usage and track OKRs
+ Track client usage, production issues, system stability
+ Establish usage metrics and production monitoring system KPIs to improve end user experience
+ Track OKRs

* Build Platform Collateral
+ Support demos and trainings on the product
+ Manage internal communication, updates, trainings for new feature releases
+ Develop, communicate and continuously refine product roadmaps that deliver innovative and engaging products


**Required Experience**
* 3 to 5 years of experience in product management, consulting, business analytics, or a related field
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related fields
* Proven experience in, and a passion for, building and shipping cutting edge financial and/or data products
* Exceptional communication skills
* Experience in agile product management methodologies
* Capability to apply a blend of strategic and tactical approaches to problems
* Creative design thinking, strong business acumen and technical know\-how
* Comfort with working in a rapidly evolving environment
* Ability to navigate and influence the organization with ease
* Tenacity. Someone who is willing to go beyond their comfort zone and be proactive, as neede


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in building and executing digital roadmaps within a financial context
* Experience working with data and API products, platforms and capabilities


**Why Join Us**
* Opportunity to work at the intersection of finance, data, and technology
* Exposure to product management best practices in a growing team
* A collaborative, fast\-moving environment where your ideas will be heard


**Goldman Sachs Engineering Culture**
 At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.
   

  

 We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. Learn more about our culture, benefits, and people at GS.com/careers.

title: Project Coordinator
description:
**Bring order to complexity. Help deliver technology solutions that make an impact.**
 At The Missing Link, we don't just deliver technology solutions, we help organisations achieve meaningful business outcomes. As one of Australia's most awarded IT and Cyber Security providers, and now part of the Infosys family, we are continuing to grow our Cyber Security Penetration Testing team and are looking for a talented Project Coordinator to join us.
   

  

 With over 28 years of experience, 200\+ team members, and a culture built on inclusion, innovation and impact, we create an environment where skilled professionals can do meaningful work, sharpen their craft and grow their careers.
   

  

***We are The Missing Link between where you are and where you want to be.***
**The Opportunity**
 We are looking for an organised and customer\-focused Project Coordinator to join our Security Consulting team.
   

  

 This role serves as a key interface between clients, sales teams, technical specialists, vendors and delivery teams. You will be responsible for coordinating the successful delivery of small to medium\-scale security and technology projects, ensuring agreed scope, quality, timelines and budget objectives are achieved.
   

  

 You will work closely with internal and external stakeholders to coordinate resources, manage project administration activities, support billing processes and help deliver an exceptional customer experience from project initiation through to completion.
   

  

**What You'll Be Working On**
 Depending on project requirements, your typically date will include:
   

  

* Coordinating the delivery of small to medium\-scale security and technology projects, ensuring scope, timelines, budget, and quality objectives are achieved
* Working closely with clients, technical specialists, vendors, and internal stakeholders to manage project schedules, resources, risks, and deliverables
* Maintaining project plans, documentation, reporting, and administration activities through ConnectWise and other project management tools
* Facilitating project meetings and providing regular updates to ensure stakeholders remain informed and aligned throughout the project lifecycle
* Reviewing project deliverables, supporting project billing activities, and ensuring successful project handover and closure


 You'll play a key role in keeping projects on track, supporting delivery teams, and ensuring clients receive an exceptional experience from project commencement through to completion.
   

  

**Requirements**
* 1\+ year of experience within the IT industry, ideally in a Project Coordinator, Project Administrator, or similar role
* Tertiary qualification in Business, Information Technology, Project Management, or a related discipline
* Experience supporting the successful delivery of multiple technology projects in a fast\-paced environment
* Experience in preparing and reviewing project reports, resource allocation and scheduling resources
* Strong organisational, communication, and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to manage competing priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail
* Customer\-focused mindset with a proactive approach to problem solving and continuous improvement
* Advanced Microsoft Word skills and intermediate Microsoft Excel skills
* Experience using Microsoft Project and ConnectWise, or similar project and service management platforms


**Benefits**
 A great company culture is very important to The Missing Link. Keeping everyone happy is one of our top priorities.
   

  

 Here are some of the best bits about working at The Missing Link and some of the ways we try and maintain our staff happiness levels:
   

  

* Supportive, collaborative and respectful environment
* Company culture that fosters learning and development through training and mentoring programs
* Opportunities for professional development and career advancement
* Learn from experienced professionals who actively share knowledge and mentor others
* Training and company paid certifications supported
* Exposure to diverse clients and industries
* Challenging, varied work that keeps you engaged and continuously learning


 If you are passionate about delivering exceptional client experiences, enjoy working in a fast\-paced environment, and want to be surrounded by people who genuinely care about quality and growth, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Software Staff Engineer
description:
Come join our passionate team! Barracuda is a leading cybersecurity company providing complete protection against complex threats. Our platform protects email, data, applications, and networks with innovative solutions, and a managed XDR service, to strengthen cyber resilience. Hundreds of thousands of IT professionals and managed service providers worldwide trust us to protect and support them with solutions that are easy to buy, deploy, and use.
   

  

 We know a diverse workforce adds to our collective value and strength as an organization. Barracuda Networks is proud to be an employer that complies with all applicable national, state and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity regardless of race, gender, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, or disability.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Working On**
* Serve as the lead front\-end engineer and core architect for the Data Inspector team.
* Drive technical design and architecture decisions for front\-end applications and platforms.
* Design, develop, and maintain scalable, high\-performance web applications using modern front\-end technologies.
* Lead the implementation of reusable UI components, shared libraries, and design systems across products.
* Collaborate closely with the Design and UX teams to deliver intuitive, accessible, and high\-quality user experiences.
* Work with product management and cross\-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Contribute to and enhance shared design components and frameworks used across the organisation.
* Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and backend services in collaboration with platform and backend teams.
* Ensure application performance, security, reliability, and responsiveness across browsers and devices.
* Drive code reviews, establish engineering standards, and champion best practices in software development.
* Mentor team members and promote engineering best practices, code quality, maintainability, and technical excellence.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues and provide long\-term architectural solutions.
* Participate in technical roadmap planning and contribute to strategic technology decisions


**What You Bring To The Role**
* React.js,
* Redux,
* Node.js,
* Material UI,
* Chart.js,
* C\#.NET,
* HTML5,
* CSS3,
* JavaScript / TypeScript,
* JSON,
* REST APIs,
* Web Technologies and Web Application Architecture,
* Responsive UI Development,
* Cross\-browser Compatibility,
* Performance Optimisation, Git and CI/CD Practices


**What You’ll Get From Us**
 A team where you can voice your opinion, make an impact, and where you and your experience are valued. Internal mobility – there are opportunities for cross training and the ability to attain your next career step within Barracuda. In addition, you will receive equity, in the form of non\-qualifying options.

title: Product Operations Associate
description:
**WHAT YOU WILL DO** 




**Replication launches \& platform setup** 



* Own end to end setup of new program launches across our messaging and IVR stack such as RapidPro, Turn, Exotel, Motor Admin and our internal Orchestrator.
* Validate and consolidate requirements from medical, film and translation teams before setup; manage template approvals and campaign creation, including code based configuration.
* Set up project specific journey logic (e.g., conditional acknowledgments, response handling) based on program requirements.
* Ensure every launch is delivered on time, thoroughly tested and fully functional before going live.



**IVR \& onboarding** 



* Build complete IVR journeys in Exotel such as onboarding flows, campaign journeys and user friendly navigation.
* Set up QR and IVR based onboarding, including QR configuration, Motor Admin flows, and Turn journeys, ensuring users are routed to the right campaigns.



**Data management** 



* Track incoming program data, maintain data trackers, monitor ingestion and identify and flag data errors on the dashboards.



**Platform quality \& troubleshooting** 



* Independently investigate and resolve technical issues across platforms where needed (e.g., language mapping, user profile updates, template approval scripts).
* Support platform transitions and migrations (e.g., moving flows, campaigns and media between messaging platforms).



**Documentation \& research tooling** 



* Write and maintain PRDs, launch runbooks, dashboard requirements, and other product documentation.
* Build survey flows in SurveyCTO for research and training projects, working with research teams on implementation and refinement, including IRB approval processes where required.



**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 



* 1\-3 years of experience in product management, program operations or technical implementation, ideally in digital health, social impact or messaging platforms.
* Comfort working hands on with no code/low code platforms (e.g., RapidPro, Turn, Exotel, SurveyCTO)
* Strong execution and coordination skills, able to run multiple concurrent launches with cross functional teams and hit deadlines without dropping quality.
* Clear written communication, can turn messy requirements into PRDs, runbooks, and documentation others actually use.
* A user first, detail oriented mindset: you test everything before launch and care about the experience of caregivers on the other end.



**Good to have** 



* Experience with IVR systems, audio content management or multilingual content operations.
* Familiarity with public health programs (MCH, TB, NCD) or working with government health systems.
* Experience with Figma

 Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. title: Engineer III, Software Test
description:
**Work Schedule**
 Standard (Mon\-Fri)
   

  

**Environmental Conditions**
 Office
   

  

**Job Description**
 Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with an annual revenue of approximately $40 billion. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Whether our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving sophisticated analytical challenges, growing efficiency in their laboratories, improving patient health through diagnostics or the development and manufacture of life\-changing therapies, we are here to support them. Our distributed team of more than 130,000 colleagues delivers an unrivalled combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience and pharmaceutical services through our industry\-leading brands, including Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, Unity Lab Services, Patheon and PPD.
   

  

 For more information, please visit www.thermofisher.com.
   

  

 As a Software Developer, you will actively engage in comprehending software requirements thoroughly, ensuring end\-to\-end understanding, and delivering high quality code to fulfill these requirements. Your focus extends to optimizing system performance while prioritizing the long\-term maintainability of the codebase.
   

  

**What will you do?**
* Perform scenario\-based manual testing of software applications to identify defects and ensure adherence to quality standards.
* Analyze requirements and develop comprehensive test scenarios and test cases covering positive, negative, boundary, edge, exception, and end\-to\-end business scenarios.
* Apply strong software testing techniques Decision Table Testing, State Transition Testing, Error Guessing, and Exploratory Testing.
* Develop comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on project requirements.
* Conduct verification and validation activities to confirm that software meets specified requirements and user expectations.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand system requirements, identify requirement gaps, and validate software functionality.
* Perform functional, integration, regression, system, exploratory, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Analyze test results, identify issues, and report defects in a clear and timely manner.
* Work closely with developers to troubleshoot issues, verify fixes, and ensure the integrity of the software.
* Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Playwright with Python, where applicable, to improve regression coverage and testing efficiency.
* Execute and maintain automated test scripts as part of the overall testing process.
* Perform mobile device testing across applicable devices, operating systems, screen sizes, and configurations, where required.
* Participate in sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, and retrospective meetings to provide input on testing activities and contribute to process improvement initiatives.


**Minimum Requirements Or Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 6\-9 years of experience in software testing, verification, and validation.
* Strong proficiency in scenario\-based manual testing methodologies and techniques.
* Strong knowledge and hands\-on experience in test design techniques such as Boundary Value Analysis, Equivalence Partitioning, Decision Table Testing, State Transition Testing, Error Guessing, and Exploratory Testing.
* Strong ability to derive comprehensive test scenarios from requirements, business workflows, and user behavior, including positive, negative, boundary, edge, and exception scenarios.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with keen attention to detail.
* Experience in functional, integration, regression, system, exploratory, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Experience with Playwright automation using Python is an added advantage.
* Experience with Python and pytest is an added advantage.
* Experience in mobile device testing is an added advantage.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
* Proven ability to prioritize tasks, manage workload efficiently, and meet project deadlines.
* Knowledge of software development lifecycle (SDLC), software testing lifecycle (STLC), and Agile methodologies.
* Exposure to ISO 13485 and IEC 62304 standards for medical device development.
* ISTQB or similar certification is a plus.

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
**Who we are** 






 DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI\-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, choose DigiCert to stop today’s threats and prepare for a quantum\-safe future at www.digicert.com
 




  
 




**Job summary** 






 The Engineering Manager is responsible for leading a single engineering team to deliver reliable, scalable, and secure software solutions. This role focuses on day‑to‑day technical leadership, people management, and delivery execution within a defined product or platform area. The Engineering Manager works closely with Product, Architecture, and Operations to ensure the team delivers high‑quality outcomes aligned to roadmap and business goals.
 




  
 




**What you will do** 




* Technical Leadership 
 
	+ Lead technical execution for a specific product, service, or platform area.
	+ Ensure designs and implementations follow established architecture, security, and reliability standards.
	+ Promote best practices in coding, code review, testing, CI/CD, observability, and performance tuning.
	+ Partner with senior engineers and architects to plan and implement refactoring, modernization, and tech‑debt reduction.
* People \& Team Management
 
	+ Manage, coach, and develop a team of software engineers and senior engineers.
	+ Set clear goals and performance expectations; provide regular feedback and run effective1:1s.
	+ Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning.
	+ Support hiring, onboarding, and skill development to build a strong, diverse team.
* Delivery \& Execution
 
	+ Collaborate with Product Management to refine scope, priorities, and release timelines for the team.
	+ Own sprint planning, execution, and delivery for the team’s backlog.
	+ Ensure high quality through testing, code reviews, and adherence to SDLC and compliance standards.
	+ Identify risks and blockers early and drive resolution through coordination with partner teams.
* Operational Excellence
 
	+ Monitor and improve the health of the services owned by the team (reliability, latency, errors, cost).
	+ Participate in incident management, on‑call rotations, and RCAs; ensure follow‑through on action items.
	+ Drive incremental improvements in stability, automation, and operational efficiency for the team's services.
* Cross‑Functional Collaboration
 
	+ Work closely with Product, Architecture, SRE/DevOps, Security, and QA to ensure alignment from design to release.
	+ Represent the team in project discussions, status updates, and stakeholder reviews.
	+ Translate product and business requirements into clear, actionable work for the team.



  
 




**What you will have** 




* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 7\+ years of software engineering experience, including 2–4 years in a people‑leading role.
* Hands‑on experience building and operating services on modern cloud platforms(AWS/GCP/Azure) and frameworks (e.g., Java/Spring Boot, Node.js, or similar).
* Strong understanding of agile development, CI/CD, and DevOps practices.
* Proven ability to lead a team to deliver high‑quality software on time.



  
 




**Nice to have** 




* Experience working with distributed systems, APIs, and microservices.
* Exposure to platform engineering, SRE, or infrastructure/observability tooling.
* Experience collaborating with or leading cross‑geo or remote teams.
* Familiarity with security, compliance, or regulated SaaS environments.
* Interest or exposure to AI/ML or data‑driven product development.



  
 




**Benefits** 




* Generous time off policies
* Top shelf benefits
* Education, wellness and lifestyle support

title: Technical Product Owner - Salesforce Projects
description:
**India T\&M Special Bonus:**
 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
   

  

 We are currently seeking a Technical Product Owner to join our team in Bangalore, Karnataka, India.
   

  

**Scope of Services**
* Own and communicate the delivery vision, product goals, roadmap, release priorities, and measurable business outcomes for assigned Salesforce initiatives.
* Translate business needs into a well\-structured product backlog containing epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and nonfunctional requirements.
* Prioritize the backlog based on customer value, risk, regulatory needs, technical dependencies, capacity, and delivery commitments.
* Act as Scrum Master for one or more delivery teams and facilitate sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, release planning, and other Agile ceremonies.
* Coordinate the day\-to\-day work of Salesforce developers, QA engineers, architects, analysts, and integration partners without replacing their technical accountability.
* Establish sprint goals, confirm story readiness, remove delivery impediments, monitor progress, manage scope, and support timely decision\-making.
* Partner with QA engineers to define acceptance strategy, test coverage, defect priorities, quality gates, release readiness, and production validation.
* Manage project plans, milestones, resource needs, RAID logs, dependencies, budgets or forecasts where applicable, and executive delivery reporting.
* Identify, assess, communicate, and mitigate delivery, technical, security, compliance, vendor, schedule, resource, and operational risks.
* Lead cross\-functional stakeholder discussions, resolve competing priorities, document decisions, and maintain alignment between business and technology teams.
* Coordinate release planning, change management, cutover readiness, production support, lessons learned, and transition to ongoing operations.


**Required Experience And Qualifications**
* Five or more years of experience in technical product ownership, Agile delivery leadership, project management, Scrum leadership, or a comparable role.
* Demonstrated experience managing software developers, QA engineers, and cross\-functional technology teams through complex enterprise delivery.
* Strong understanding of Agile and Scrum practices, backlog management, estimation, capacity planning, velocity, release planning, and continuous improvement.
* Proven project\-management experience across scope, schedule, resources, dependencies, status reporting, stakeholder expectations, and delivery governance.
* Strong people\-management and team\-leadership skills, including coaching, delegation, conflict resolution, accountability, performance feedback, and team development.
* Strong risk\-management experience, including maintaining RAID logs, quantifying impact and probability, establishing owners and mitigation plans, and escalating decisions appropriately.
* Ability to create clear user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, product documentation, executive summaries, and decision materials.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, negotiation, problem\-solving, and stakeholder\-management skills.


**Scrum Master and Team Leadership Expectations**
* Facilitate effective, time\-boxed Scrum ceremonies and ensure each ceremony produces clear decisions, actions, and accountable owners.
* Protect the team from unnecessary disruption while maintaining transparency and productive engagement with stakeholders.
* Use delivery metrics such as velocity, predictability, cycle time, throughput, escaped defects, blocked work, and burn trends to identify improvement opportunities.
* Promote healthy collaboration between product, engineering, QA, architecture, security, operations, and business teams.
* Coach team members on story quality, estimation, definition of ready, definition of done, quality ownership, and sustainable delivery practices.
* Escalate material risks and impediments early, with options, impact analysis, and recommended decisions.


**Salesforce Experience: Preferred**
* Experience delivering Salesforce projects involving Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, digital engagement, Einstein Bots, Agentforce, or integrated enterprise applications.
* Understanding of Salesforce release planning, environments, sandboxes, metadata deployment, data migration, security, profiles, permission sets, and platform limits.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with Salesforce architects, administrators, Apex and LWC developers, integration engineers, and Salesforce QA automation engineers.
* Experience coordinating Salesforce DevOps and release processes using tools such as Salesforce DX, Azure DevOps, Gearset, Git, Copado, or comparable platforms.
* Knowledge of API integrations, middleware, data synchronization, production support, and cross\-system dependency management.


**Preferred Tools And Delivery Practices**
* Azure DevOps Boards, Jira, Rally, or an equivalent Agile planning and work\-management platform.
* Confluence, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, Miro, or comparable collaboration and documentation tools.
* Roadmap, dependency, resource, and portfolio\-management tools appropriate for enterprise delivery.
* Experience with hybrid Agile delivery, vendor coordination, distributed teams, and globally aligned release plans.
* Experience working in regulated environments with security, privacy, compliance, audit, and change\-management requirements.


**Preferred Certifications**
* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO), or equivalent product\-owner certification.
* Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or equivalent Scrum Master certification.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent project\-management certification.
* SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, SAFe Scrum Master, or comparable scaled\-Agile certification.
* Salesforce Certified Administrator, Salesforce Certified Business Analyst, Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder, or Salesforce Certified Service Cloud Consultant.


**AI\-Assisted Product and Delivery Management**
* Use approved AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or Cursor to accelerate backlog analysis, epic decomposition, user\-story drafting, acceptance\-criteria creation, refinement preparation, dependency identification, and delivery documentation.
* Use AI assistance to summarize stakeholder input, meetings, risks, decisions, defects, and technical discussions into actionable backlog and project\-management artifacts.
* Use AI to identify ambiguity, missing edge cases, nonfunctional requirements, duplicate work, dependencies, and potential delivery risks while retaining human ownership of prioritization and decisions.
* Validate AI\-generated stories and acceptance criteria with business, architecture, development, and QA stakeholders to ensure clarity, feasibility, testability, security, compliance, and business value.
* Follow enterprise policies for approved tools, confidential information, prompt handling, intellectual property, auditability, and responsible AI use.


**Expected Deliverables and Outcomes**
* Prioritized and delivery\-ready product backlog aligned with roadmap, business value, architecture, quality, and release objectives.
* Well\-run Scrum ceremonies with documented goals, decisions, actions, risks, dependencies, and accountable owners.
* Realistic delivery plans, sprint and release forecasts, milestone tracking, and transparent status reporting.
* Current RAID log with effective mitigation, contingency, escalation, and decision management.
* Coordinated development and QA execution with clear acceptance criteria, quality gates, defect priorities, and release\-readiness evidence.
* Stakeholder alignment, timely decision\-making, controlled scope, and measurable continuous improvement in team delivery.
* Release, cutover, production\-validation, knowledge\-transfer, and operational\-readiness documentation.
* AI\-assisted backlog, user\-story, acceptance\-criteria, risk, and delivery artifacts that are reviewed, traceable, testable, and aligned with approved outcomes.

description:

 Wells Fargo is seeking an experienced Product Owner (individual contributor) for the build of a new Repo and Securities Lending trading platform, including collateral optimization and allocation capabilities. The role will be responsible for shaping and delivering the product roadmap, tracking delivery schedules, timelines and derailers, and highlighting potential scope creep, bottlenecks and challenges to stakeholders.
   

  

 The individual is expected to independently manage and execute end\-to\-end delivery, partnering closely with Repo and Securities Lending trading, middle office, operations, collateral, risk, finance and technology stakeholders. The candidate will lead product change through the Agile delivery lifecycle, run respective scrums, and actively participate in global team discussions, projects and process enhancement plans.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Own the product roadmap and execution for the new Repo and Securities Lending trading platform, with particular focus on collateral optimization, collateral allocation, inventory management and inventory utilization.
* Translate front office and middle office needs into clear target\-state capabilities, features, user stories, acceptance criteria and delivery priorities.
* Bring strong understanding of the end\-to\-end Securities Finance trade lifecycle across Repo Trading and Securities Lending, including trade capture, inventory management, matching, confirmation, settlement, lifecycle events, margin, segregation, collateral management, optimization, accounting, reporting and close\-out.
* Drive enhancements in trading capabilities, electronic execution and risk management tools across the Repo and Securities Lending product lifecycle.

 Executive Communication
   

  

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage credibly with traders, product specialists, technology teams and senior leaders across global businesses.

* Translate complex markets, platform and operational issues into clear, outcome\-oriented conversations.
* Build strong communication channels and trusted relationships across business, operations, control and technology partners.
* Use AI\-supported summaries and narratives judiciously for executive communication, ensuring accuracy, context and appropriate review.

**Job Title:** 
 Senior Salesforce Business Analyst – Access, Security \& Platform Rationalization
 



**Exp.:** 
 8\+ Yrs
 



**Location:** 
 Bengaluru/Noida/Jaipur \- Hybrid
 




  





**Skills:** 
 Sr SF BA – Access, Security \& Platform Rationalization
 



  





**Job Description:** 




 We are seeking a Lead / Senior Salesforce Business Analyst with approximately 8 years of professional experience, specializing in enterprise access management, security rationalization, and Salesforce platform architecture. In this role, you will lead the end\-to\-end business analysis for a large\-scale access and security transformation initiative.
 



 You will bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technical architects by conducting current\-state security audits, facilitating cross\-functional persona workshops, mitigating access risks, and designing streamlined, scalable Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC) models.
 



 A strong understanding of modern Salesforce security constructs, Agentic AI/Agentforce, Flow orchestration, and enterprise governance standards is required to ensure sustainable, future\-ready implementations.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 




 Professional Experience: 8–10 years of total experience as a Business Analyst, with 5\+ years dedicated to Salesforce enterprise implementations and security/data governance projects.
 



 Salesforce Security Mastery: Deep functional understanding of Salesforce’s sharing architecture (Org\-Wide Defaults, Role Hierarchy, Sharing Rules, Permission Sets, Field\-Level Security, Restriction/Scoping Rules).
 



 Identity \& Access Management (IAM): Knowledge of SSO, MFA, OAuth flows, Connected Apps, Integration User patterns, and Segregation of Duties (SoD) frameworks.
 



 Methodologies \& Deliverables: Demonstrated ability to craft BRDs, functional specs, current\-to\-future state mapping matrices, process flowcharts (Lucidchart/Visio), and Jira/ADO user stories.
 



 Communication \& Leadership: Exceptional facilitation skills to lead workshops with business leaders, compliance officers, and technical architects.
 



  





**Preferred Certifications** 




 Salesforce Certified Business Analyst
 



 Salesforce Certified Administrator / Advanced Administrator
 



 Salesforce Certified Identity and Access Management Architect
 



 PMI\-PBA or CBAP (Bonus)
 








**Key Responsibilities** 




 Persona Workshops \& Requirements Elicitation: Facilitate discovery workshops across global business units to define user personas, map core business processes, and establish least\-privilege access models.
 



 Current\-State Audit \& Inventory Assessment: Oversee the extraction, mapping, and audit of legacy Salesforce security assets—including Profiles, Permission Sets, Permission Set Groups, Roles, Queues, Licenses, and Integration/System Users.
 



 Access Risk, SoD \& Compliance Analysis: Identify operational risks linked to over\-privileged access, orphaned accounts, Segregation of Duties (SoD) violations, and license bloat; produce actionable risk remediation matrixes and impact analyses.
 



 Permission Model Rationalization: Design target\-state RBAC and ABAC architectures utilizing Permission Set Groups, Muting Permission Sets, Restriction Rules, and Public Groups to reduce technical debt and enforce modern governance.
 



 AI \& Automation Governance: Evaluate and define access boundaries for advanced platform capabilities—including Agentforce/Agentic AI, Einstein features, and automated Flows—ensuring AI agents and automation execute within strictly defined security guardrails.
 



 Stakeholder Management \& Documentation: Translate complex security concepts into executive\-ready reports, user stories, traceabilities matrices, and change management documentation to secure buy\-in from business and IT leadership

We enable your best to power our future.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
 Serves as the connective tissue for our most strategic product launches. In this newly created role, you will be the central orchestrator responsible for managing the end\-to\-end lifecycle of bringing new Gracenote products and features to market.
   

  

 You will not just manage a schedule; you will bridge the gap between technical execution and commercial readiness in partnership with Product, Engineering, Legal, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the comprehensive New Product Introduction (NPI) / Go\-To\-Market (GTM) process from ideation and development through to launch and post\-launch evaluation.
* Serve as the primary liaison connecting diverse teams. Ensure alignment across:
+ Product \& Design: Tracking feature readiness, user experience milestones, and beta testing.
+ Engineering: Monitoring development sprints, QA, and technical deployment schedules.
+ Legal \& Privacy: Ensuring new products meet all regulatory compliance, data privacy standards, and that necessary vendor/client contracts are updated.
+ Marketing: Aligning product delivery with messaging, positioning, and promotional launch campaigns.
+ Sales \& Enablement: Ensuring sales teams are trained, equipped with collateral, and ready to monetize the product on day one.
+ Customer Support/Operations: Ensuring support teams have the documentation and tools needed to assist clients post\-launch.

* Build and scale a standardized NPI playbook for Gracenote, defining clear phases, gates, deliverables, and ownership for all future launches.
* Proactively identify bottlenecks, dependencies, and risks across all workstreams. Develop mitigation plans and escalate critical issues to executive stakeholders with proposed solutions.
* Host regular cross\-functional syncs. Provide clear, concise executive reporting on program health, launch readiness, and post\-launch metrics.


**Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of program management, product operations, or GTM management experience, preferably within the B2B tech, SaaS, or data/entertainment industries.
* Proven ability to "speak the language" of diverse departments—from deeply technical engineering constraints to complex legal compliance and nuanced marketing strategies.

* Deep understanding of software development lifecycles (Agile/Scrum) and traditional project management frameworks. PMP, PgMP, or Agile certifications are a plus.
* Hyper\-organized with a keen eye for detail. Capable of managing multiple, complex product launches simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment.
* Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, capable of distilling complex program statuses into clear executive summaries.


**Additional Information**
 Please be aware that job\-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

title: Senior Software Engineer - IOS
description:
**Company Overview**
 Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

 Docusign's Mobile Engineering team is seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer (P4\) to build and scale our Intelligent Agreement Management platform on iOS. Docusign is moving beyond e\-signatures to make agreements smarter, faster, and more connected across their entire lifecycle. Our team supports complex enterprise use cases while maintaining the world\-class usability consumers expect from top App Store applications. As a Senior Engineer, you will lead the technical design of major mobile features and reusable SDK modules using your deep Swift expertise. In this role, you will collaborate with cross\-functional teams while mentoring mid\-level engineers to elevate the overall team.
   

  

 This position is an individual contributor role reporting to Senior Director, Engineering.
   

  

****Responsibility****
* Feature and SDK Development: Design, build, and maintain complex, high\-performance native iOS app features and modular SDK components using Swift
* Architecture and Design: Drive technical design discussions, author technical specification documents, and ensure codebase modularity, scalability, and maintainability.
* Engineering Excellence: Set high standards for code quality through rigorous code reviews, unit and UI testing, and continuous integration practices.
* Cross\-Functional Partnering: Collaborate with Product Managers, UX Designers, QA, and backend platform teams to translate product requirements into robust iOS solutions.
* Mentorship and Leadership: Guide and mentor mid\-level and junior engineers, fostering technical growth and sharing best practices across the team.
* Process and Pipeline Optimization: Identify bottlenecks in development workflows, build systems, or testing, and implement proactive solutions to improve velocity.
* Platform Evolution: Stay informed on Apple platform developments, Swift language updates, and iOS design trends, incorporating modern tools and frameworks where appropriate.


 Job Designation
   

  

**Hybrid:** 
 Employee divides their time between in\-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in\-office expectation)
   

  

 Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.
   

  

 What you bring
   

  

* B.S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience in cloud, SaaS, or enterprise software environments
* 5\+ years specifically building production native iOS applications and reusable libraries in Swift backed by cloud APIs
* Demonstrated experience applying modern iOS architecture patterns (such as MVVM or Clean Architecture) and writing comprehensive unit and functional tests
* Hands\-on experience with Xcode, CI/CD automation, dependency management, and publishing apps to the App Store
* Proven track record of delivering complex technical initiatives iteratively within an Agile team environment


**Preferred**
* Experience developing, packaging, and distributing developer\-facing iOS apps, SDKs or binary frameworks (XCFrameworks)
* Strong proficiency with modern Swift paradigms (such as Async/Await and Combine) alongside deep experience in both SwiftUI and UIKit
* Working knowledge of Objective\-C for maintaining and modernizing existing framework components
* Experience with enterprise mobile security standards, including OAuth/SSO integration, secure storage, and data encryption
* Active involvement in the iOS community, such as tech blogging, open\-source contributions, or conference speaking


 Life at Docusign
   

  

**Working here**
 Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.
   

  

 We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.
   

  

**Accommodation**
 Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.
