title: Product Intern
description:
**Title :** 
 Product Intern
   

  

**Location :** 
 Mumbai
   

  

**Internship Duration:** 
 6 Months
   

  

**Work arrangement:** 
 5 days in the office
   

  

**About Upstox**
 At Upstox, we’re building the future of investing simple, powerful, and for everyone. We’re one of India’s fastest\-growing fintech platforms, backed by the best in the business, including Mr. Ratan Tata and Tiger Global, and on a mission to make wealth creation accessible to every Indian. From first\-time investors to seasoned traders, millions trust us to power their financial journeys. We’re not just moving fast, we're moving with purpose. If you thrive in a high\-energy, high\-impact environment, you’re in the right place.
   

  

 The Role: Product Intern
   

  

 You’ll join the Product team and work closely with Product Managers on building and improving products across the investing journey, with a focus on the Mutual Funds and Advisory space.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on product \+ data role where you’ll work across product requirements, analytics, customer behaviour, competitive intelligence, and execution. You’ll use SQL and product analytics tools to understand how users interact with our products, identify opportunities, and turn data into actionable insights.
   

  

 You’ll work closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Analytics, and other stakeholders to turn ideas and insights into products that customers can use. You won’t just look at the numbers you’ll help understand what they mean for the product and what we should do next.
   

  

 What You’ll Own
   

  

* Write and refine PRDs and help drive features from idea to launch — defining requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and keeping documentation updated as features evolve.
* Work with the product backlog — help groom, prioritise, and organise requirements so the team stays focused on what matters.
* Own product analytics — build and analyse dashboards, funnels, and key product metrics to understand user behaviour and feature performance.
* Use SQL to answer product questions — write basic queries using filters, joins, and aggregations to retrieve and analyse data without always depending on the data team.
* Analyse user behaviour through tools such as Mixpanel or Amplitude — build funnels, retention reports, and cohorts and understand what the numbers mean for the product.
* Turn data into insights — identify trends, drop\-offs, and opportunities and translate them into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Run competitive intelligence across investing, wealth\-tech, and broader fintech platforms. Track product launches, UX changes, features, and pricing.
* Conduct structured product teardowns of competitor products and customer journeys to understand gaps and identify opportunities relevant to our roadmap.
* Research the investing ecosystem and understand customer needs, market trends, product offerings, and user behaviour.
* Work closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Analytics, and other stakeholders to translate product requirements and insights into execution.
* Roll up your sleeves on the groundwork: research, SQL analysis, documentation, dashboarding, testing, competitive analysis, and the detailed work that turns product questions into real improvements.


 What We’re Looking For
   

  

* Strong analytical thinking. You enjoy working with numbers, breaking down problems, and finding meaningful patterns in data.
* Comfortable with SQL. You can write basic queries using SELECT, filters, joins, and aggregations to retrieve and analyse data. Deep SQL expertise is not required.
* Sharp product sense and genuine curiosity about how users interact with financial products.
* Strong ownership. You take a problem and run with it end to end, without needing constant hand\-holding.
* A figure\-it\-out instinct. When you don’t know something, you find the answer yourself instead of waiting to be told.
* Genuine interest in fintech, investing, or financial products is a strong plus.
* Strong written communication. You can take a messy problem or a set of data and turn it into a clear, structured insight.
* High comfort with ambiguity and a strong bias for action.


 Why This Role Rocks
   

  

 You’ll be part of a fast\-moving
 **Product team** 
 , working on real product problems across the investing journey, with exposure to the
 **Mutual Funds and Advisory** 
 space.
   

  

 You’ll get hands\-on exposure to
 **product management, SQL, product analytics, customer behaviour, competitive intelligence, and data\-driven decision\-making** 
 while working on real problems and seeing how your insights translate into product improvements.
   

  

 You’ll learn how to connect
 **data → insights → product decisions** 
 and get direct exposure to the full product lifecycle in a fast\-moving fintech environment.
   

  

 By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have reviewed our
 **Prospective Employee Privacy Notice** 
 , which outlines how Upstox collects, uses, and protects your Personal Information ("PI").
   

  

**I accept Upstox's Prospective Employee Privacy Notice.**
 Upstox is an Equal Opportunity Employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin

title: Java Tech Lead
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Reconciliation Java Technical Lead
   

  

**Department** 
 : CEFS\-Reconciliation
   

  

**About Business Line/Function**
 The IT Reconciliations Department is managing the reconciliations (Financial, Referential, Systems to Systems, ...) for a number of BNP Paribas's domains (Global Markets, Global Banking, Security Services, Wealth Management, ...) via specialized expert systems (FIS DIM/Intellimatch, Pega PCM, Socrates).
   

  

 Our internal clients are working 24/7 at a worldwide level with a high level of reliability. IT systems are integral to the business and are a key part of the value proposition to clients. These IT systems range from industry standard products for standard process automation to internally developed, often, market leading IT applications. The IT teams owning these IT systems are made up of functions that include Technical and Application production support, Business Analysis \& Project Management, Development \& Maintenance and Quality Control. BNP Paribas India Solutions is the key partner in all IT functions and has interactions with colleagues in other locations including Paris, London, New York, Tokyo, Singapore \& Hong Kong. This partnership ranges from sharing the IT workload, executing global strategy to owning global applications offshore. The technology and engineering landscape is wide, encompassing almost all techniques and platforms. It continues to evolve and transform with the market with the business continuing to invest in it. To ensure our efficiency and alignment with the market expectations, we have to ensure that both our architecture and our technologies are up to date and aligned with the most efficient and reliable standards.
   

  

**Position Purpose**
 The Reconciliation Java Technical Lead will lead the transformation of the CEFS Recon platform into a technically robust, cloud‑native platform. The position is vital for shaping up the technical vision, strategy and execution of the Recon initiatives. The role is expected to define the Java micro‑service landscape, streaming pipelines, persistence strategy, CI/CD and cloud‑deployment model (Kubernetes/Docker), guaranteeing high availability, scalability, performance and security. Keep the platform reliable, future ready and aligned with client service standards.
   

  

 The position has a strong focus on stability, flexibility, and expertise to always guarantee the proper Clients’ expectations. Working in an international Clients base environment but also as part of an Offshore organization, the capacity to interact in a respectful and easy way with both his/her Clients, Management, and team to find compromises while guaranteeing the proper organization and seamless relations is a must.
   

  

 This position requires strong leadership, communication, and adaptability to navigate the complexities of working in a globally distributed environment.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Direct Responsibilities
   

  

* Ensure system reliability, scalability, stability and security by implementing appropriate design patterns and architectural principles.
* Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and recommend enhancements to optimize performance.
* Stay updated with emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices to drive innovation.
* Design the Java micro‑service landscape, CI/CD pipeline, container‑orchestration (Kubernetes/Docker) and infrastructure\-as\-code, and monitoring tools.
* Establish security‑by‑design patterns and embed them in all solutions.
* Ensure that all solutions are well\-documented and align with industry’s best practices.
* Own API and message‑schema contracts for all inbound/outbound feeds, manage versioning and backward compatibility.
* Define data‑lineage, master‑data‑management and data‑quality controls required for auditability
* Conduct architectural and code reviews, apply security controls, enforce best practices, and mentor junior engineers – all in line with the organization’s architectural standards.
* Champion DevOps automation (shift‑left testing, shift‑right monitoring) and drive an “automation‑first” mindset to reduce manual hand‑offs.
* Produce and maintain architectural documentation, user manuals, SOPs and materials.


 Contributing Responsibilities
   

  

* Proficiency in business analysis tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence, MS Visio)
* Familiarity with software development methodologies
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives: DevSecOps adoption, automated contract testing, observability
* Quick to learn and adapt
* Strong analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams and manage multiple priorities.
* Good Team player
* Someone who could have long\-term commitment with the team and organization


**Specific Qualifications**
* 8\-10 years total experience, minimum 5 years in the Banking/Financial Reconciliation domain and 5 years in Java architecture roles.
* A proven experience in multi\-expertise team management in an international environment,
* An experience in an Onshore/Offshore would be a key factor,
* A very good English level is mandatory,


 Qualification
   

  

 :
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Business or a related field; Master’s degree or certifications such as TOGAF are a plus.
   

  

**Skills Referential (Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities)**
 Technical \& Soft Skills:
   

  

* Strong expertise in Java, microservices architecture, RESTful APIs, and event\-driven architecture
* Hands on experience in software development using Java/J2EE technologies, frameworks (e.g. Spring, Hibernate), messaging (e.g. MQ)
* Deep understanding of software design patterns, principles, and best practices.
* Strong understanding of cloud platforms and cloud\-native architectures.
* Expertise in designing and developing RESTful APIs and integrating with external systems.
* Proficiency in working with databases: SQL (Oracle, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB).
* Hands\-on experience with containerization tools like Docker and orchestration platforms like Kubernetes.
* Experience with DevOps tools and practices, including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure\-as\-code, and monitoring tools.
* Knowledge of security principles and best practices for securing applications and data.
* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills with a focus on performance optimization.
* Capacity to structure, synthesize and summarize concepts,
* Resilience in a strong pressure environment,
* Strong track record in successful interactions with peers in a non\-hierarchical framework.


**Behavioral Skills**
* Proven ability to lead and mentor technical teams across multiple projects.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Excellent analytical and decision\-making abilities.
* Ability to balance technical requirements with business needs.
* Self\-motivated with a proactive approach to identifying and solving challenges.
* Organized and delivery\-focused, with attention to detail.
* Solid work ethic, high level of motivation and resilience.
* Comfortable operating with a strong level of autonomy, self\-driven
* Showing strong leadership and assertiveness
* Strong empathy and people care.
* Coaching \& mentoring techniques
* Strong communication and reporting skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and negotiation skills.
* Capacity to interact with senior members of the organization.
* Strong capacity to motivate his/her team for upskilling


**Location:** 
 Mumbai
   

  

**About BNP Paribas Group**
 BNP Paribas is a top\-ranking bank in Europe with an international profile. It operates in 71 countries and has almost 199 000 employees. The Group ranks highly in its three core areas of activity: Domestic Markets and International Financial Services (whose retail banking networks and financial services are grouped together under Retail Banking \& Services) and Corporate \& Institutional Banking, centered on corporate and institutional clients. The Group helps all its clients (retail, associations, businesses, SMEs, large corporate and institutional) to implement their projects by providing them with services in financing, investment, savings and protection. In its Corporate \& Institutional Banking and International Financial Services activities, BNP Paribas enjoys leading positions in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas and has a solid and fast\-growing network in the Asia/Pacific region.
   

  

**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
 Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 6000 employees, to provide support and develop best\-in\-class solutions.
   

  

**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
 At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind, and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, color, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in. title: Team Lead, UX Design
description:
**About the Role and Team:**
 The Team Lead, UX Design is responsible for leading a small team of UX Designers while actively contributing to product design delivery. This role ensures that high\-quality, user\-centered design solutions are delivered across assigned product areas, while continuously improving design practices, team capabilities, and collaboration with cross\-functional stakeholders. In addition to hands\-on design responsibilities, this role focuses on developing team members, fostering a high\-performance culture, and ensuring alignment between UX design activities, product goals, and business objectives.
   

  

**We hope you are ready to change the game! Be ready to:**
* Team Leadership and Development: Lead, mentor, and develop a team of UX Designers by setting clear expectations, providing continuous feedback, and supporting professional growth. Foster a collaborative, high\-performance culture with strong ownership and accountability.
* UX Design Delivery: Contribute to and lead the design thinking cycle by proactively identifying user problems and opportunities and delivering UX design solutions across all phases of the Product Development Process (discovery, scope analysis, development, and validation).
* Design Quality and Consistency: Ensure high standards of UX design quality across the team by applying and evolving the UX design framework, design system, and best practices. Promote consistency and scalability of design solutions. Designs are web / desktop focused.
* Work Planning and Prioritization: Plan and prioritize UX design activities across the team, ensuring alignment with Product Development Process phases, product priorities, and delivery timelines to maximize impact.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate closely with Product Management, UX Research, UX Writing, Engineering, and stakeholders, providing UX design consultations during product definition and scope analysis, and acting as a subject matter expert within product domain teams.
* User\-Centered Design Advocacy: Advocate for user\-centered design principles by proactively identifying user needs and ensuring that design decisions are guided by user insights, while acting as a trusted UX expert in balancing user, business, and technical perspectives.
* Process Improvement and Best Practices: Contribute to the evolution of UX ways of working, frameworks, and internal processes. Identify improvement opportunities and help scale successful practices across teams.
* Recruitment and Talent Growth: Support recruitment, onboarding, and retention of UX Designers. Participate in hiring processes and contribute to building a strong design organization.
* Stakeholder Alignment: Ensure alignment between UX design outcomes and broader product and business objectives. Communicate design decisions clearly and influence stakeholders effectively.


**Attitude First. Everything else will follow. We can grow together faster if you have:**
* Strong experience in UX / product design with a proven track record of delivering user\-centered solutions for complex digital products.
* 7\+ years of experience in UX design or related disciplines, with demonstrable impact on product quality and user experience.

**Process Overview\***
 Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting \& Reconciliations, Management Reporting \& Analysis, Research \& Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support \& Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
   

  

 The CFOC (CFO Change) team, which is part of the COO \& Governance organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications. The CFO Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1\) understanding the Change, (2\) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3\) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams \& Users until implementation of the Change. * Understanding the Regulatory Change and documenting detailed requirements. This includes functional capabilities, workflow needs, business rules, reporting requirements and timelines, etc. Collaborate with the Users \& procure all required sign offs.

* Understanding the in\-house GRIFFIN \& AXIOM design and documenting functional specifications in conjunction to the business requirements
* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.
* Collaborating with the test teams to clearly set the expectations from a Quality or User Acceptance Testing perspective.
* Regression before every code release into production.
* Facilitate review sessions with Business, Technology \& Testing Teams where relevant.

**Education\***

* Extremely strong Knowledge of EMEA regulatory reports (COREP, Finrep, AnaCredit, ESG etc..) and Strong knowledge of financial concepts

description:
**Company Overview**
 We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
   

  

**Overview**
 The Digital and Technology (D\&T) India, is seeking a Lead Analyst, to join the AI and Automation team. The AIA Activation team serves as the bridge between identifying AI use cases to enabling value through business adoption. The AI \& Automation team is seeking a Lead AIA Analyst to shepherd General Mills’ AI journey into agent\-based (agentic) capabilities — planning, delivering, and governing our enterprise AI platforms, custom AI agents, and the processes that support them. This highly visible role will partner with business and D\&T stakeholders to identify and execute high‑value AI use cases, then create, manage, and sustain the expansion of generative and agent\-based capabilities across the enterprise, working closely with other D\&T AI initiatives to shape the overall AI user experience
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Partner with functional domain stakeholders to identify, assess, and prioritize high\-value AI and agentic AI use cases.
* Lead discovery and opportunity assessment efforts to determine where AI can improve decision\-making, process efficiency, service levels, productivity, and user experience.
* Translate business problems into clear analytical, technical, and delivery requirements for AI solutions, agents, and supporting workflows.
* Lead planning and implementation of AI and automation initiatives, including pilots, proofs of value, and scaled deployments.
* Collaborate with business teams, product teams, data scientists, engineers, and platform partners to design and deliver Supply Chain AI capabilities.
* Support development of domain\-specific agents and workflows that augment functional domain processes and enable better human decision\-making.
* Evaluate existing functional domain processes, data, and pain points to determine where agentic AI can be responsibly and effectively applied.
* Facilitate workshops and working sessions with stakeholders to educate teams on AI possibilities, assess readiness, and define business value.
* Help establish and sustain governance processes for functional domain AI use cases, including risk management, user acceptance, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure activation work follows established responsible AI, governance, risk, and documentation practices in partnership with the relevant teams.
* Contribute to development of best practices, playbooks, enablement assets, KPIs, and operating processes that strengthen activation capabilities across the Agentic AI office.
* Translate the learnings from the engagement to reusable consumable form for other areas to benefit from it.
* Support the intake, build, publish of the agents are in accordance to the defined frameworks by the AI Office.
* Monitor solution performance, user feedback, and business outcomes, then make recommendations for optimization and broader adoption.
* Analyze, present, and report on key performance indicators, value realization, and overall initiative progress to business and D\&T leaders.
* Partner to evaluate the technological releases including platform, services, models etc. within the Agentic AI space and document the recommendations.
* Work closely with the vendor partners as required to influence the prioritization of required features / fixes.
* Monitor feedback and insights, collaborating with Agent Authors to assess program effectiveness and make recommendations for optimization and improvement.
* Manage the agent publishing lifecycle, including user acceptance testing and acting as the first line of triage for agents.
* Monitor adoption, usage, performance, and user feedback for deployed capabilities, and help drive iterations that improve business impact and user experience over time.
* Foster a culture of experimentation, practical learning, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the team.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's in technology /engineering/science in a related field is required.

description:

At the core of this commitment is our investment in cutting\-edge information technology. This supports our innovation and collaboration on a global scale, enabling our diverse teams to optimize both efficiency and success. As part of our IT team, your expertise and commitment will help facilitate our patient\-focused mission by developing and enhancing technological solutions.
   

  

 The Anaplan Center of Excellence (CoE) owns a portfolio of 50\+ connected planning applications used across Finance, Commercial, and Operations. As Sr. Project Manager, you will orchestrate the delivery of new applications and the continuous enhancement of the existing portfolio, working with a globally distributed team of developers and administrators and with business partners across multiple functions and time zones.
   

  

**How you'll make an impact:**
* Orchestrate a portfolio of concurrent Anaplan initiatives – new application builds and enhancement/update releases – across multiple use case families (e.g., financial planning \& analysis, commercial and sales planning, operational planning), balancing priorities, dependencies, and shared resources across 50\+ applications.
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery: intake and business case, detailed requirements definition, scoping, planning, build coordination, testing/UAT, deployment, and hypercare, using a hybrid delivery methodology (Agile sprints for build, stage\-gate/Waterfall controls for planning and release).
* Coordinate day\-to\-day delivery of a distributed CoE team – 8–11 Anaplan developers in Pune and administrator resources in Prague and the US – without direct people\-management responsibility: plan sprints and releases, remove blockers, manage capacity and sequencing across projects.
* Partner with the enterprise data team on data integration requirements, source availability, and interface timelines; align delivery plans with data pipeline readiness.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with finance partners, commercial stakeholders, and other business functions; manage expectations, translate business priorities into a realistic delivery roadmap, and communicate status, risks, and trade\-offs transparently.
* Maintain the CoE delivery roadmap and release calendar; manage changes to scope, schedule, and cost so plans remain accurate and reflect authorized changes.
* Actively manage project risks and issues; monitor performance, identify and quantify variances, and drive corrective actions.
* Facilitate creation and approval of business cases and prioritization decisions, using historical data and expert judgment to understand constraints.
* Strengthen CoE delivery governance: standardize intake, estimation, status reporting, and release management practices; lead continuous improvement of PM processes within the CoE.
* Manage project closure activities, including lessons learned, and drive resulting improvements into future releases.
* Serve as a project management subject matter expert within the CoE; guide and mentor team members on delivery practices.
* Other incidental duties.


**What you'll need (Required):**
* Bachelor's Degree in a related field.
* A minimum of eight years of hands\-on experience managing software delivery projects of increasing complexity, or equivalent work experience based on Edwards criteria.
* Project Management Professional (PMP); if not, Green Belt, Black Belt, or Scrum Master certification.
* Demonstrated experience managing delivery with globally distributed teams and cross\-functional business stakeholders.
* Experience running hybrid delivery models (Agile/Scrum combined with Waterfall/stage\-gate governance).
* This role is not a remote position. It requires onsite presence at the Edwards IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India, working second shift with overlap to European (CET) and partial US working hours.


**What else we look for (Preferred):**
* Experience delivering Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) / connected planning implementations on any platform (e.g., Anaplan, Oracle Hyperion/EPM Cloud, SAP Analytics Cloud/BPC, OneStream, Workday Adaptive Planning, Pigment).
* Understanding of planning processes in finance (budgeting, forecasting, long\-range planning) and/or commercial functions (sales forecasting, quota and territory planning).
* Experience working alongside data engineering teams on integrations (ETL/ELT, APIs, data hubs).
* Demonstrated experience with SDLC project management methodologies (Waterfall, Agile, DevOps) and tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, Smartsheet).
* Proven expertise in MS Office Suite and related project management systems.
* Excellent documentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, including negotiation and relationship management, with the ability to drive achievement of objectives.
* Excellent problem\-solving, organizational, analytical, and critical thinking skills.
* Excellent understanding of and work experience with project budgets and financial management.
* Experience in life sciences, medical devices, or another regulated industry.

**Job Description:**
**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
   

  

 We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
   

  

 Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
   

  

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting \& Reconciliations, Management Reporting \& Analysis, Research \& Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support \& Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
   

  

 The FCPS (Finance Change and Production Services) team, which is part of the (GFC) Global Financial Control organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications. The Finance Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities. The Production Services function ensures all financial accounting \& regulatory reporting systems and applications are operating smoothly from a functional perspective.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1\) understanding the Change, (2\) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3\) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams \& Users until implementation of the Change. It requires working closely with the Business Lead/Product Owner, including upstream / downstream Stakeholders and Technology to ensure all aspects of the change are being considered and prioritized when documenting the requirements. The business requirements are the foundation for the design, build, test, operational / organizational readiness, and deployment activities in the life cycle of a project.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Understanding the Regulatory Change and documenting detailed requirements. This includes functional capabilities, workflow needs, business rules, reporting requirements and timelines, etc. Collaborate with the Users \& procure all required sign offs.
* Identifying current state processes and the target state scope, objective and business outcomes of the Program/Project
* Identifying any data sourcing requirements, documenting them and coordinating with relevant Teams
* Understanding the in\-house GRIFFIN \& AXIOM design and documenting functional specifications in conjunction to the business requirements
* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.

* 5\+ years of Java and Spring Boot experience covering REST APIs, dependency injection, persistence, exception handling and service design.
* 2\+ years of Python experience for APIs, services, integration, automation or data\-processing use cases.
* Experience leading or mentoring a team of approximately five or more developers.
* Strong knowledge of secure API and microservices design, validation, versioning, failure handling and distributed\-system fundamentals.
* Working knowledge of SQL, relational databases, data modeling and transaction management.
* Experience with Azure, AWS or OCI; Git workflows; CI/CD; automated deployment; and environment\-based configuration.
* Experience with unit, integration and end\-to\-end testing, quality gates, code scanning and security scanning.
* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot production issues across browser, API, application, database and integration layers.
* Strong estimation, planning, risk\-management, stakeholder and technical\-communication skills.
* Docker and Kubernetes or equivalent managed container platforms.
* Event\-driven architecture and messaging technologies such as Kafka.
* Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask or Django; JPA or Hibernate for Java persistence.
* OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, enterprise identity providers and role\-based access control.
* Web accessibility, internationalization, caching, content delivery and front\-end performance optimization.

* Coordinate with security and compliance teams to embed regulatory and industry standards into mobile architectures for cards and payments ensuring that authentication flows data storage patterns and audit trails support safe and compliant transactions
* Optimize hybrid work collaboration processes by documenting architectural decisions patterns and reference implementations enabling distributed teams to follow consistent structures and accelerate delivery of new features for card and payment services

title: Software Engineering Manager — Funded Development
description:
* Permanent \- Full Time
* Ahmedabad/GiftCity
* Posted 17 hours ago


 Website
 **Trading Technologies**
 Multi\-asset platform for capital markets
   

  

 We are looking for a hands\-on Software Engineering Manager to lead the Funded Development (Services / NRR) POD — the cross\-functional team accountable for delivering customer\-funded enhancements and bespoke solutions on top of our trading platform. The role sits at the intersection of engineering delivery and commercial commitment and is measured on how predictably the POD ships committed customer work on time, at the quality bar our clients expect, across multiple concurrent engagements.
   

  

 This is a working manager role: you are expected to stay close to the code — reviewing designs, code and stepping in on the hardest problems — while primarily driving delivery for the POD. The POD’s core surface is Order Routing and the Market Data ecosystem, with regular contributions into Risk, FIX services, trading UI enhancements and other backend systems as customer commitments require.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Delivery \& stakeholder ownership — Own end\-to\-end delivery of customer\-funded projects across multiple concurrent engagements. Run the daily cadence (standups, sprint reviews, hand\-offs) and act as the primary engineering point of contact for Product and Project Management on requirements, estimation, capacity planning, project tracking, CR workflows, and risk. Surface schedule and scope of risk early with credible mitigations, and provide honest, timely status to Client Services, Sales, Platform, Release Engineering, and senior leadership.
* Hands\-on technical leadership \& design — Stay close to one or more components across the TT platform (Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, trading UI). Author tech design documents for non\-trivial customer\-funded features and review designs produced by the team — ensuring correctness, performance, blast radius on shared components, rollout / rollback, observability, and long\-term supportability. Set the quality bar through architecture, design, and code reviews in modern C\+\+, and be the escalation\-of\-last\-resort on hard issues.
* Cross\-component versatility \& engineering excellence — Deliver across a broad surface — Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, and trading UI enhancements — as customer commitments evolve. Drive engineering best practices across the POD: modern C\+\+ standards, multithreading and concurrency correctness, performance tuning, automated testing, and CI hygiene. Treat customer\-funded work as first\-class product code, not throwaway one\-offs, and build a POD that can flex across components without becoming shallow on any of them.
* AI\-assisted engineering — Champion the adoption of AI coding assistants and agentic tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, and internal AI tooling) across the POD to accelerate delivery, code review, test authoring, design exploration, and production diagnostics. Set the bar for responsible use — quality, security, IP protection, and human accountability for shipped code — and share patterns that work back into the wider engineering org.
* SE \+ SQE leadership — Lead a cross\-functional POD of Software Engineers and Software Quality Engineers. Foster a shared ownership model where quality is designed in, not bolted on, and where SQEs are equal partners in scoping, automation, and release readiness.
* People management \& culture — Line\-manage the POD: 1:1s, feedback, growth plans, hiring, and calibration. Build a fair, sustainable delivery culture that can absorb context switching and shifting priorities without burning people out or letting quality slip.


 Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
   

  

**Essential Skills \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience), with 10 to 12 years of software engineering experience and 2\+ years managing a mid\-sized engineering team, including line management of engineers.
* Expert\-level hands\-on proficiency in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+11 through C\+\+20\) — able to review and write production\-grade code, and to lead deep technical discussions on architecture, multithreading, concurrency, and performance.
* Deep experience delivering software for electronic trading, capital markets, or other high\-performance, mission\-critical, low\-latency systems, with strong working knowledge of trading\-system fundamentals: order lifecycle, exchange gateways, FIX / exchange protocols, market data, price generation, and risk checks.
* Proven track record delivering complex, customer\-committed software projects in an Agile environment — working closely with Product and Project Management on estimation, planning, and CR workflows — and managing multiple concurrent engagements with changing priorities, aggressive timelines, and frequent context switching, while still meeting commitments.
* Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants and/or agentic developer tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or equivalents) in real delivery — with a clear point of view on where they add leverage, where they don’t, and how to keep quality, security, and IP under control.
* Proficient with Linux, production diagnostics, and debugging / profiling tools (GDB, Address Sanitizer, perf, and similar).
* Demonstrated success as a people manager — growing engineers and SQEs, hiring, calibrating, and handling difficult conversations — with excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills across engineering, Product, Project Management, Client Services, and customers.


**Desirable Skills \& Experience**
* Prior experience leading customer\-funded, professional services, or bespoke\-delivery engineering teams in a financial\-technology context, ideally on a major OMS/EMS/trading platform with exposure to Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, or trading UI.
* Familiarity with major exchange connectivity stacks (CME, ICE, Eurex, LSE, NSE, etc.) and with vendor certification / conformance testing, plus experience with formal CR / change\-management workflows in a regulated financial environment (Jira / Confluence for delivery tracking and design documentation).
* Working knowledge of Python for tooling, automation, and test scaffolding; familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps practices, containerisation, and cloud technologies as applied to trading\-system delivery; background in kernel\-bypass / low\-latency networking (Solarflare, Onload) or lock\-free data structures.
* Track record of driving measurable productivity gains through AI adoption in an engineering team — e.g., accelerating design, code generation, code review, test coverage, or production triage — including establishing guardrails, prompts/skills libraries, and adoption metrics.


**Benefits**
**Compensation:**
***Competitive Benefits \& Perks in India***
*We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well\-being, growth, and work\-life balance.*
* Health \& Financial Security:
+ Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage

* Time Off \& Flexibility:
+ Enjoy the best of both worlds: the energy and collaboration of in\-person work, combined with the convenience and focus of remote days. This is a hybrid position requiring three days of in\-office collaboration per week, with the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining two days. Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in\-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands\-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture.
+ 21 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, with the option to roll over unused days.
+ One dedicated day per year for volunteering.
+ Two professional development days per year to allow uninterrupted professional development.
+ An additional PTO day is added during milestone anniversary years.
+ Robust paid holiday schedule with early dismissal.
+ Generous parental leave for all parents (including adoptive parents).

* Work\-Life Support \& Resources:
+ Budget for tech accessories, including monitors, headphones, keyboards, and other office equipment.
+ Milestone anniversary bonuses.

* Wellness \& Lifestyle Perks:
+ Subsidy contributions toward gym memberships and health/wellness initiatives.

* Our Culture:
+ Forward\-thinking, culture\-based organization with collaborative teams that promote diversity and inclusion.

* Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to mentor and guide team members.

title: Product Designer
description:
**About the company:** 




 Cradlewise is a San\-Francisco, Bangalore and Pune based sleep tech company. We build innovative solutions for parents. Our products are designed to take the stress out of parenthood.
 



 Our first product \- the award winning Cradlewise smart crib comes with an integrated baby monitor that senses early signs of wakeup, learns from the baby’s sleep patterns and starts to bounce along with music to soothe the baby back to sleep—just like a parent! → See how our smart crib works
 



  





 We are working to reimagine the baby nursery to make it smart, intuitive and delightful. We’re passionate about our people, our customers, our values, and our culture!
 



  





**About the Cradlewise Design Team** 




 Cradlewise Design is a close\-knit team of User\-Experience Designers, Visual Designers and Video editors from all over India. We create experiences to help every family sleep and live better, through science\-driven solutions, and it's the role of the team to humanize and create every touchpoint with empathy and support.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Cradlewise solved sleep for babies. Now we're going after what comes next: a brand\-new software product in the kids category, starting from a blank page. We're hiring a Product Designer to own the design from zero to one: the research, the flows, the visual language, the first shipped version. You'll sit in on parent interviews happening right now, sketch the same week, and watch your work decide what we build. You'll also shape the Cradlewise app and web portal that thousands of families already use daily.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 



* Design a 0\-to\-1 product in the kids category: from discovery and user research through flows, prototypes, and the first release.
* Create a visual language that works for two audiences at once: kids and their parents.
* Design and improve the Cradlewise app and web portal, including our subscriptions experience, funnels, and retention experiments.
* Prototype fast, test with real families, and iterate. Speed matters more than polish at this stage.
* Contribute to our design system for consistency across products.
* Work directly with founders, product, tech, content, and marketing to take designs live.
* Keep designs accessible and grounded in human\-factors principles.



  





**What you’ll bring to the role:** 



* 4–5 years of experience in product/UI/UX design.
* A portfolio that can demonstrate your ability to work on modern digital interfaces.
* Craft beautiful experiences that visually present the user interface so information is easy to read, understand and find.
* Thorough understanding of the design process to perform research, build workflows and user journeys, execute design with high quality prototypes and test mock\-ups for feedback.
* Understanding and implementation of best practices including accessibility standards and human factors.
* A positive attitude and enthusiasm, willingness to iterate quickly and strong bias for action.
* Passion for design and simplifying complex problems, and a hunger to experiment with new and innovative solutions.
* A humble team player who is a great partner to work with for cross\-functional teams.
* Ability to learn from your mistakes and absorb feedback.
* Great communication skills, product thinking (why’s) and comfort with presenting and discussing designs.
* High proficiency in design tools like Figma and AI tooling to intelligently design creative experiences.
* Ability to learn and use analytics tools such as GA4, Mixpanel, and Microsoft Clarity to understand user behavior and make informed design decisions.



  





**Academic qualifications** 



* Bachelors or MA/MS degree (or higher) in Design (interaction, graphic or visual communication) or equivalent practical experience.



  





**What We Offer:** 



* A founding\-designer seat on a 0\-to\-1 product: blank canvas, full ownership.
* Direct access to founders and daily collaboration with product and engineering.
* Autonomy to ideate, experiment, and execute, with regular reviews to accelerate your growth.
* A close\-knit, learning\-oriented design team and a hybrid working setup.
* Competitive salary.



  





**Location:** 




 Bangalore, Work from office.
 



  





 Follow us on LinkedIn.
 



 Sounds like a good fit for you? :
 



 Are you excited to work collaboratively with design, product, and engineering?
 



 Do you thrive in fast\-paced, unstructured environments that require you to wear many hats and think on your feet?
 



 Are you an independent thinker, a fast learner, and you're hungry to be a part of a high\-performing team?
 



 Come join us!
 



  





 Say 👋 : careers@cradlewise.com

title: Integrated CX BA & Strategy -Senior Associate
description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As an Integrated CX BA \& Strategy \- Senior Associate, you will engage in customer consulting, specializing in strategies and initiatives that enhance customer experiences and drive business growth. Within our Commercial \& Service Excellence practice, you will analyze client needs, develop customer\-centric solutions, and provide guidance to help clients improve their customer interactions. This role involves designing customer journey maps and offering support to create seamless and personalized experiences that foster customer satisfaction and loyalty.
   

  

 As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality work. Embracing ambiguity, you will use these moments as opportunities to grow, asking questions when the path forward isn’t clear. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will leverage a broad range of tools and methodologies to generate new ideas and solve problems, while upholding professional and technical standards.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 We are looking for customer\-focused, business\-first professionals who can operate across strategy, design, operations, product, and technology. This is a hands\-on consulting role for individuals who can structure ambiguous problems, facilitate stakeholder alignment, and convert experience opportunities into implementation\-ready business and functional requirements. Ideal candidates will have:
   

  

 Relevant experience in customer experience strategy, service design, digital transformation, product delivery, or business analysis within consulting or a global delivery environment.
   

  

 Understanding customer experience frameworks, human\-centered design, journey mapping, service blueprinting, operating models, governance, and experience measurement.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience conducting discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, qualitative or quantitative research, and current\-state assessments.
   

  

 Strong business analysis capabilities, including requirements of elicitation, process decomposition, functional analysis, traceability, prioritization, and solution validation.
   

  

 Experience translating research, business objectives, operational needs, and technology constraints into clear experience concepts and actionable requirements.
   

  

 Familiarity with digital experience ecosystems, including CRM, customer portals, commerce, marketing technology, contact centers, service management, identity, data, analytics, and integration platforms.
   

  

 Working knowledge of Agile delivery practices, including epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications, backlog refinement, sprint readiness, and release prioritization.
   

  

 Ability to connect frontstage customer interactions with backstage processes, roles, systems, data, controls, and organizational capabilities.
   

  

 Strong analytical thinking, synthesis, problem\-solving, facilitation, and executive communication skills.
   

  

 Exposure to clients and stakeholders in a cross\-functional and global environment.
   

  

 What You Must Have
   

  

* Bachelor's and/or MBA in Sales / Marketing / Strategy/ Analytics from a premier B\-School
* 5 \- 8 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required
* Lead CX strategy and/or business analysis workstreams, from discovery and experience definition through requirements, prioritization, implementation support, and business readiness.
* Structure complex customer and business problems into clear insights, strategic recommendations, experience concepts, requirements, process models, and implementation priorities.
* Facilitate senior stakeholder discussions, workshops, and decision\-making sessions.
* Own the quality, completeness, and consistency of key client deliverables.
* Drive requirements clarification, prioritization, scope, and MVP decisions.
* Identify and manage risks, dependencies, assumptions, and cross\-functional issues.
* Coordinate effectively across business, product, design, architecture, data, technology, and delivery teams.
* Guide implementation and business\-readiness activities through testing, release, adoption, and optimization.
* Guide Associates and peers in strategy methods and deliverables, providing direction and review across research, synthesis, journey mapping, service blueprinting, strategic frameworks, and storytelling.
* Maintain accountability for workstream outcomes, stakeholder alignment, and delivery quality.
* Lead defined CX strategy workstreams, independently planning and driving research, current\-state assessment, persona and journey development, service blueprinting, market analysis, future\-state experience definition, and opportunity identification.
* Structure ambiguous customer and business problems into a clear strategic approach, determining the questions to answer, inputs required, analyses needed, and experience frameworks to apply.
* Synthesize customer research, market insights, business priorities, operational realities, and data into a clear point of view, identifying the implications and recommendations that matter most to the client.
* Shape future\-state experience strategies and transformation roadmaps, connecting customer needs and experience opportunities to business value, capabilities, operating model implications, technology needs, and implementation priorities.
* Lead CX\-focused client workshops and working sessions, including discovery, journey mapping, co\-creation, prioritization, and future\-state visioning, and drive stakeholders toward decisions and alignment.
* Own the strategic storyline and quality of CX deliverables, translating complex findings into clear executive\-level narratives and confidently presenting recommendations to client stakeholders.


**Skills Preferred**
 Candidates should be able to demonstrate customer transformation consulting capabilities across the following areas:
   

  

**CX Strategy, Research \& Experience Design**
* Plan and conduct stakeholder interviews, discovery workshops, customer research, and co\-creation sessions to understand customer expectations, pain points, business priorities, and operational constraints.
* Synthesize research and workshop outputs into insights, personas, journey maps, experience principles, opportunity areas, and measurable experience outcomes.
* Define future\-state customer and employee experiences across web, mobile, portals, contact centers, sales, service, marketing, and other assisted or digital channels.
* Create journey maps, service blueprints, experience blueprints, ecosystem maps, and future\-state experience visions.
* Develop CX strategies, capability roadmaps, MVP recommendations, and phased transformation plans that balance customer value, business impact, feasibility, and delivery risk.
* Apply market research, customer insights, analytics, and emerging experience trends to identify opportunities and shape strategic recommendations.

**What We Do**
 At Goldman Sachs, we connect people, capital and ideas to help solve problems for our clients. We are a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities and investment management services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments and individuals.
   

  

 A career with Goldman Sachs Asset \& Wealth Management is an opportunity to help clients across the globe realize their potential, while you discover your own. As part of one of the world’s leading asset managers with over $3\.14 trillion in assets under supervision globally, you can expect to participate in exciting investment opportunities while collaborating with talented colleagues from all asset classes and regions and building meaningful relationships with your clients. Working in a culture that values integrity and transparency, you will be part of a diverse team that is passionate about our craft, our clients, and building sustainable success. Bringing together traditional and alternative investments, Goldman Sachs Asset \& Wealth Management provides clients around the world with a dedicated partnership and focus on long\-term performance. As the primary investment area within Goldman Sachs, we provide investment and advisory services for pension plans, sovereign wealth funds, insurance companies, endowments, foundations, financial advisors and individuals.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking an Associate Product Manager to help shape the vision, strategy, and roadmap for our marketing website. This role is ideal for someone passionate about creating engaging and informative online experiences that attract and convert potential clients. You will be responsible for ensuring the
 **Goldman Sachs website effectively communicates our firm's value proposition and supports our marketing goals.**
 As part of the Product Management team, key responsibilities will include conducting user research to understand website visitor behavior and needs, defining website requirements based on marketing objectives, prioritizing website features and content updates, managing the website backlog, and collaborating closely with marketing, design, and development teams to ensure successful and timely website enhancements. + Manage internal communication, updates, trainings for new feature releases

* Proven experience in, and a passion for, building and shipping cutting edge financial and/or data products
* Exceptional communication skills
* Experience in agile product management methodologies
* Capability to apply a blend of strategic and tactical approaches to problems
* Creative design thinking, strong business acumen and technical know\-how
* Comfort with working in a rapidly evolving environment
* Ability to navigate and influence the organization with ease
* Tenacity. Someone who is willing to go beyond their comfort zone and be proactive, as neede

* Experience in building and executing digital roadmaps within a financial context

* A collaborative, fast\-moving environment where your ideas will be heard

 At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.

title: Technical Creative Specialist
description:
A Day in Your Life at MKS:
   

  

 At MKS, the Technical Creative Specialist – Photonics plays a critical role in bringing complex technologies to life through compelling visual storytelling. In this role, you will partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and Corporate Marketing to create visually engaging, technically accurate content that showcases our photonics solutions and supports customer engagement across the buyer journey. You will translate sophisticated technical concepts into high\-quality 2D and 3D visuals, animations, and multimedia experiences that clearly communicate product performance, differentiation, and real\-world applications. This onsite role is based at our India facility and reports to the Senior Manager, Technical Content Marketing based at our US facility within the Strategic Marketing organization.
   

  

**You Will Make an Impact By:**
* Create visually engaging technical and marketing multimedia assets including 2D/3D animations, videos, motion graphics, technical illustrations, infographics, and digital campaign content.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with engineers, scientists, product managers, and marketing teams to develop visual narratives that support product positioning and storytelling.
* Support product launches, integrated marketing campaigns, customer acquisition initiatives, and digital programs with high\-quality multimedia and creative content across multiple channels.
* Develop and maintain visual standards, templates, and design systems that align with brand guidelines while ensuring technical accuracy and consistency.
* Manage creative assets, workflows, and version control processes to ensure accessibility, consistency, and efficient cross\-functional collaboration.
* Use analytics, stakeholder feedback, and performance metrics to continuously improve creative effectiveness, and audience engagement.


**Skills You Bring:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Multimedia Design, Animation, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field.
* 2–5 years of experience in motion graphics, animation, or multimedia content creation, ideally in a high\-tech or B2B environment.
* Expert proficiency with creative and multimedia tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Blender, Cinema 4D, or similar platforms.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating technical animations, motion graphics, product and application videos, and digital marketing assets.
* Proven ability to communicate complex technical concepts through compelling visual storytelling and multimedia content.
* Excellent visual design skills with keen attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills to work effectively across cross\-functional and global teams.


**Preferred Skills:**
* Advanced degree or specialized training in Multimedia Design, Animation, Visual Communications, Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
* Understanding of branding, UX/UI principles, digital marketing, and content engagement best practices.
* Experience supporting global product launches, trade shows, or integrated marketing campaigns.
* Familiarity with web content development, and social/digital media platforms.
* Strong organizational, creative direction, and project management skills within a matrixed organization.

title: Requirements Engineer
description:
Position Summary
   

  

 As a Requirements Analyst II and a member of a dynamic and multi\-functional Agile development team, you will be responsible for developing user requirements for the purpose of creating software products that support efficient workflows and laboratory best practices. You will help build the vision of the product to meet customer needs, strategic direction, expected delivery dates, and exceptional quality standards. To be successful in this role you need a real passion for quality software, dedication to customer satisfaction, and an ability to work effectively in a matrix organization. You will need a positive attitude, persistence, a love of problem solving, and the ability to communicate with people at all levels of a product development organization.
   

  

**Clinisys' AI Philosophy**
 Building an
 **AI‑first organisation** 
 is central to Clinisys’ purpose and the impact we deliver. As a global provider of intelligent diagnostic informatics solutions, we build AI‑enabled, cloud‑based platforms to enhance diagnostic workflows across healthcare, life sciences, and public health. By applying intelligent technology thoughtfully and responsibly, we help laboratories and testing environments operate more effectively, generate meaningful insights at scale, and ultimately support healthier and safer communities. Operating across more than 42 countries, Clinisys expects all colleagues—regardless of role or function—to work confidently with AI‑enabled tools, apply digital and analytical thinking, and continuously adapt as technologies evolve. We
 **must drive an AI\-first sense of purpose and urgency.**
**Essential Functions**
* Applies knowledge of industry, domain, workflows, and personas to develop requirements aligned with user needs, strategic direction, and project scope.
* Engages with product team members and relevant client personas to validate deliverables and confirm that requirements meet the intended objectives.
* Prioritizes the requirements backlog to address both functional and non\-functional needs, supporting accurate and predictable delivery.
* Understands data structures and how data flows between systems.
* Represents product workflows and requirements using suitable visual or graphical formats (such as process flow diagrams, data flowcharts, wireframes, low fidelity prototypes, etc.).
* Presents product enhancements to internal and external stakeholders.
* Acquires comprehensive product knowledge and understanding of the laboratory market, client business drivers, and user personas.
* Builds relationships with external clients, internal partners, and leadership.
* All other duties and responsibilities as assigned


**Skills Needed To Be Successful**
* Clear, effective, and persuasive verbal and written communication and presentations skills
* Ability to assist internal and external customers by focusing on actions/decisions that meet their needs
* Ability to understand and explain the functionality, workflows, interactions, and client usage for the assigned product
* Understanding of approaches used to identify, prioritize, and mitigate risks to reduce or eliminate potential threats to patient safety or the business
* Ability to represent product workflows as a graphical overview of the flow of data, tasks, or user actions
* Confidence to explain the business drivers, user personas, etc. for the assigned product area
* Accountability and commitment to quality
* Drive and persistence to seek information and take actions necessary to accomplish a goal.
* Ability to work across teams and understand impacts of integration points during the software development lifecycle
* Experience with a variety of AI tools and the ability to utilize them in the requirements gathering and documentation process


**Required Experience \& Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in software engineering, computer science, mathematics, or laboratory testing related discipline, or equivalent relevant work experience
* 2\-4 years’ experience with the following:
+ Communicating with technical and subject matter experts
+ Software development life cycle
+ Working in a commercial software engineering environment


**Preferred Experience \& Education**
* Knowledge of scientific data software, medical devices, or healthcare software
* Experience designing commercial software


**Supervisory Responsibilities**
* None

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
Candescent is a forward\-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in\-person channels.
   

  

 Our Experience\-Led, Intelligence\-Driven approach combines human\-centered design with data, automation, and cloud\-based innovation. Built on an API\-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.
   

  

**Job Summary**
*Role Purpose*
 Candescent is seeking a thoughtful, detail\-oriented UI/UX Designer to shape the look, feel, and usability of our website and digital experiences from one of our India office locations. You will design intuitive, on\-brand experiences from wireframe through high\-fidelity mockup, working closely with web, marketing, and product marketing teams to bring ideas to life.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on design role for someone who enjoys solving user problems through clean, purposeful design and who wants to see their work built and shipped quickly. You will work closely with the web development team to ensure designs are implemented accurately and responsively.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities And Deliverables**
*What you will be responsible for and what you will do*
**Design \& Delivery**
* Design wireframes, mockups, and high\-fidelity UI for web pages, landing pages, and digital experiences in Figma.
* Translate business goals and user needs into intuitive user flows and information architecture.
* Design and iterate on landing pages and campaign assets in support of marketing and demand generation initiatives.
* Support A/B testing initiatives by designing test variants for key pages and conversion flows.


**Design Systems \& Consistency**
* Create and maintain a design system and component library to ensure visual consistency across the site.
* Apply Candescent brand standards consistently across all digital work, including typography, colour, iconography, and imagery.
* Ensure designs follow accessibility best practices (WCAG) and are optimised for performance.


**Research \& Validation**
* Conduct or contribute to user research and usability testing, and gather feedback to inform design decisions.
* Use analytics and test results to identify usability problems and prioritise improvements.
* Stay current on design trends, tools, and best practices, and bring fresh ideas to the team.


**Collaboration \& Ways of Working**
* Collaborate closely with the web development team to ensure designs are implemented accurately and responsively, and support a clean handoff.
* Partner with stakeholders across marketing, product marketing, and sales to gather requirements and present design concepts.
* Present and explain design decisions clearly, and incorporate feedback constructively.
* Maintain a working schedule with sufficient overlap with US business hours on at least a few days each week to enable live collaboration, reviews, and handoffs.


**Experience**
*Demonstrated skills, competencies, and required experience*
* 3–5 years of experience in UI/UX design, preferably for web or digital marketing.
* Strong proficiency in Figma, including components, auto layout, and prototyping.
* Solid portfolio demonstrating strong visual design, typography, and layout skills.
* Understanding of responsive design principles and designing for multiple breakpoints and devices.
* Working knowledge of UX best practices, user flows, and information architecture.
* Ability to translate business and marketing goals into clear, user\-centred design solutions.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to present and explain design decisions to stakeholders.
* Detail\-oriented, with a strong sense of visual polish and consistency.


**Qualifications \& Preferred Distinctions**
*Additional accomplishments*
* Bachelor’s degree in Design, Interaction Design, Visual Communication, or a related field; equivalent professional experience and a strong portfolio will be considered.
* Hands\-on experience building or editing sites in Webflow is preferred.
* Basic understanding of HTML and CSS and how designs translate to code is preferred.
* Experience with user research or usability testing methods is a plus.
* Familiarity with A/B testing and conversion rate optimisation principles is a plus.
* Experience designing for SEO\-friendly page structures is a plus.
* Experience supporting financial services, technology, B2B, SaaS, or enterprise software brands is preferred.
* Experience collaborating across geographies and time zones is helpful.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Designs are intuitive, on\-brand, and elevate the overall user experience.
* Design\-to\-development handoff is smooth, with minimal rework needed.
* A well\-maintained, scalable design system that speeds up future work.
* Measurable improvements in usability and conversion on redesigned pages.
* Stakeholders receive clear rationale for design decisions, not just deliverables.


**What Will Make You Successful**
* Genuine curiosity about how users behave, and willingness to let evidence change the design.
* Comfort designing within an established brand system rather than starting from a blank page.
* Strong attention to detail and a high standard of craft and quality.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and shifting priorities without losing momentum.
* Clear, proactive communication with stakeholders across geographies and time zones.
* A collaborative, low\-ego working style and a genuine willingness to give and receive feedback.
* Strong organisation, follow\-through, and accountability in a global, fast\-paced environment.


**Portfolio Submission**
*Required with every application*
 A portfolio is mandatory for consideration. Applications submitted without a portfolio link or PDF will not be reviewed.
