description:
**About Bazaarvoice**
 At Bazaarvoice, we create smart shopping experiences. Through our expansive global network, product\-passionate community \& enterprise technology, we connect thousands of brands and retailers with billions of consumers. Our solutions enable brands to connect with consumers and collect valuable user\-generated content, at an unprecedented scale. This content achieves global reach by leveraging our extensive and ever\-expanding retail, social \& search syndication network. And we make it easy for brands \& retailers to gain valuable business insights from real\-time consumer feedback with intuitive tools and dashboards. The result is smarter shopping: loyal customers, increased sales, and improved products.
   

  

 The problem we are trying to solve : Brands and retailers struggle to make real connections with consumers. It's a challenge to deliver trustworthy and inspiring content in the moments that matter most during the discovery and purchase cycle. The result? Time and money spent on content that doesn't attract new consumers, convert them, or earn their long\-term loyalty.
   

  

 Our brand promise : closing the gap between brands and consumers.
   

  

 Founded in 2005, Bazaarvoice is headquartered in Austin, Texas with offices in North America, Europe, Asia and Australia.
   

  

 It’s official: Bazaarvoice is a Great Place to Work in the US , Australia, India, Lithuania, France, Germany and the UK!
   

  

**Job Description**
 At Bazaarvoice, we create smart shopping experiences. Our mission is to build smarter shopper experiences across the entire customer journey — from discovery on social to conversion on the product page. Whether it's optimizing a shoppable gallery experience on a retailer PDP or scaling visual content distribution across a global brand\-retailer network, we're here to be a true strategic partner for businesses.
   

  

 As the Senior Product Manager responsible for Bazaarvoice Social Galleries and Visual Syndication Network, you will play a critical role in shaping how brands and retailers display and distribute visual user\-generated content at scale. Your primary focus will be on understanding the needs of brand marketers, retailer merchandising teams, and end shoppers — then building products that drive trust, engagement, and conversion through authentic visual experiences at every point of sale.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Defining a strategy and creating a 1–2 year roadmap for Social Galleries and Visual Syndication Network, balancing the needs of both sides of Bazaarvoice's brand\-retailer network.
* Knowing the pulse of the market: social commerce trends, visual UGC consumption behavior, and the competitive landscape of shoppable gallery and content syndication solutions.
* Serve as a product advocate for brands and retailers in discussions with clients, articulating how visual content display and distribution drive measurable lift in conversion and engagement.
* Discover and validate problems — from gallery rendering performance and shoppability on PDPs to syndication match rate gaps across the retailer network — through research, data analysis, and experimentation.
* Lead Product Discovery and Early Adopter Programs to validate display and distribution features iteratively with high\-value brand and retailer clients.
* Partner with Marketing and Sales to define product positioning, competitive differentiation, and pricing strategy for visual UGC display and syndication capabilities.
* Make prioritization decisions that balance syndication infrastructure reliability with shopper\-facing experience improvements — gallery rendering, shoppability, personalization, and placement flexibility.
* Own the full product lifecycle — from build through market testing, GTM launch, success narrative, and iterative enhancement. Evangelize product releases with data\-driven narratives connecting visual syndication volume and gallery engagement metrics to client ROI.
* Work with Technical Services and Product Knowledge teams to build internal training and external documentation for gallery and syndication capabilities. Communicate across teams to ensure consistent backlog alignment and that engineering has everything needed to size, accept, and execute on work.


**Essential Criteria**
* 5\+ years of product management experience, ideally with exposure to content distribution networks, syndication platforms, or visual commerce display surfaces
* Strategic thinking with the ability to develop a roadmap that serves both brand and retailer stakeholders across a global visual syndication network
* Ability to prioritize across competing investments — syndication infrastructure reliability, retailer integration scalability, and shopper\-facing gallery experience improvements
* Understanding of content delivery, retailer API integrations, and the technical nuances of rendering visual assets at scale across heterogeneous retail environments
* Ability to define and track metrics like Syndication Match Rate, Visual Content Volume, Gallery Engagement Rate, and shoppability conversion lift
* Experience conducting market research, competitive analysis, and customer interviews in a B2B2C context
* Adaptable and comfortable with ambiguity — retailer integration requirements vary widely and visual commerce display standards continue to evolve
* Familiarity with front\-end display performance considerations (Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, responsive media) as they relate to gallery experience on retailer PDPs

* Work with cutting\-edge technology in a collaborative, global team

title: Lead Designer
description:
**Job Description:**

**Our journey**

Based in London, with roots in India, e9 has developed highly motivated talent into productive teams across continents. At e9, new ideas have a way of becoming phenomenal products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. We are ambitious with a pace to match, and as part of a fast\-growing company, the opportunity and ability to push forward are greater than ever before. Bring passion and dedication to your job, and there is no telling what you could accomplish.

**Who you will work with**

We foster a culture of continuous improvement in a diverse and inclusive workplace where people feel valued and included. Accountability matters. At e9, we bring together remarkable people and enable them to be themselves as part of a collaborative team that is helping to innovate.

Do you have a passionate desire to produce great designs? Are you looking for an environment where you can push your work and yourself? Are you a team player? Does your passion for design border on the absurd? Are you naturally caffeinated? Ridiculously positive and upbeat? If so, e9 may be the place for you.

**Job Title: Lead Brand \& Product Designer Role Overview**

We are looking for a **Lead Designer** to take ownership of our brand identity and visual systems, with the support of our current in\-house Graphic Designer. In this role, you will define, evolve, and execute our brand across every touchpoint \- from high\-impact marketing campaigns to our digital product ecosystem. Splitting your time between our **Marketing** and **Product** teams, you will act as the guardian of our visual language, ensuring seamless brand consistency, exceptional user experiences, and high\-quality creative output across both physical and digital media.

**What You Will Be Doing**

* **Brand Strategy \& Visual Identity:** Define, evolve, and maintain our overall brand strategy, guidelines, and visual identity systems across physical assets (print, packaging, event collateral) and digital touchpoints.
* **Cross\-Functional Design Execution:** Work closely with our Marketing Lead and Product Team to conceptualise, prototype, and deliver high\-level creative solutions from brief through final production.
* **Product \& Digital Experience:** Translate brand identity into user\-centred product experiences by creating wireframes, interactive prototypes, user interface (UI) components, and polished assets ready for front\-end development.
* **Marketing \& Campaign Collateral:** Lead the visual design for marketing campaigns, website banners, landing pages, email templates, social media graphics, and printed materials.
* **Design Systems \& Asset Management:** Build and maintain a scalable design system (UI kit, typography scale, iconography, component libraries) that aligns both marketing collateral and digital product UI.
* **End\-to\-End Ownership:** Oversee design workflows from early\-stage conceptualisation and mood boards to pre\-flight print checks and digital asset handoffs for developers.

**What You’ll Need to Make the Most of the Role**

* **5 \- 6\+ years of experience** in a design role (agency, in\-house, or high\-level freelance) with a strong portfolio demonstrating leadership in both brand identity development and digital product design (UI/UX).
* **A deep passion for brand identity and brand development**, with a proven track record of creating cohesive visual systems across physical and digital mediums.
* **Strong affinity for UX/UI design**, including a firm grasp of standard UX best practices, design thinking, visual hierarchy, and web/app design fundamentals.
* **End\-to\-end production skills:** Ability to produce high\-level design solutions at every stage \- from wireframing and interactive prototyping to delivering polished, development\-ready assets.
* **Expert proficiency in industry\-standard tools:** Figma (for product/UI design systems) and Adobe Creative Cloud (*Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign*).
* **Cross\-functional leadership \& communication:** Ability to collaborate seamlessly with marketing leads, developers, and creative peers, clearly presenting design rationale and incorporating feedback effectively.
* **Resourcefulness under deadline:** Ability to manage multiple priorities independently and deliver high\-quality work in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.
* **Positive, upbeat, happy approach** to creative collaboration, work, and life.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with **animation and motion design** for web and product UI (*After Effects, Lottie, Rive*).
* Basic understanding of **front\-end development** (*HTML, CSS, JavaScript*) to facilitate smoother handoffs with engineering teams.
* Experience using **3D software** (*Blender, Cinema 4D*) to create unique brand or product visuals.
* Experience managing external vendors, printers, and packaging suppliers for physical brand assets.

**Submission Requirements:**

* Portfolio of work
* Successful second\-round applicants will be required to submit a company\-related at\-home task.

title: UI/UX Design Intern
description:
**About us** 




 Softknack is an AI\-first software company based in Sholinganallur, Chennai. We build an integrated product suite — SK Voice (voice AI for SMBs), SK Chat, SK CRM, and a core suite covering billing, inventory, scheduling, ticketing and more. About 20 of us, product and engineering under one roof.
 



**Why we're hiring** 




 We'll be blunt: our engineering is strong and our design isn't. We've shipped a lot of product fast, and the interface hasn't kept up. We want someone who finds that exciting rather than discouraging — there's a real suite here with real users, and a lot of surface area to fix.
 



**What you'll do** 



* Redesign existing screens across SK Voice, SK Chat and SK CRM — starting with the flows users hit most
* Build and maintain a design system (components, tokens, states) so the suite stops looking like five different products
* Turn feature requirements into wireframes, flows and high\-fidelity screens in Figma
* Sit with the dev team through implementation and review what actually ships against what you designed
* Run informal usability checks with real users and act on what you learn



**What we're looking for** 



* Final\-year student or recent graduate — any discipline; we care about the portfolio, not the degree
* Working knowledge of Figma (components, auto\-layout, prototyping)
* A portfolio with at least one end\-to\-end case study: the problem, your process, the screens, what you'd change
* Basic grasp of layout, type and colour fundamentals — and the vocabulary to explain your choices
* Comfortable receiving direct feedback and iterating quickly



**Bonus** 



* Familiarity with HTML/CSS or React (you don't need to code, but it helps to know what's cheap and what's expensive to build)
* Exposure to B2B/SaaS dashboards
* Motion or illustration skills



**What you get** 



* ₹10,000/month stipend
* Breakfast, lunch and dinner on us, every working day
* Ownership of design across a full product suite, not one screen in a queue
* Direct access to the founder and engineering leads — short feedback loops, fast shipping
* Mentorship on product thinking, not just visual polish
* A full\-time offer if it works out — we've converted every intern cohort so far

 Hit Apply on this post. Make sure your portfolio link is on your profile or CV — applications without one won't be shortlisted.

title: Shopify CRO Manager
description:
We are seeking a highly analytical and commercially minded Shopify CRO Manager to own our end\-to\-end conversion rate optimisation programme.
 



 The role is responsible for the complete process from insight and hypothesis through experiment design, tracking QA, launch, statistical evaluation, winner rollout and measurable CVR/revenue impact.
 



 This position is not limited to marketplace listing optimisation, paid advertising or campaign execution. The successful candidate will improve the Shopify customer journey by working closely with dedicated Data Analyst, UI/UX, development, content and merchandising teams.
 


 Key responsibilities
 * Own the Shopify CRO roadmap across product pages, category/collection pages, search, navigation, cart and checkout.
* Analyse customer behaviour, funnel performance, device performance, engagement data and commercial results to identify conversion opportunities.
* Create structured hypotheses supported by evidence and prioritise experiments based on expected impact, confidence and effort.
* Define primary KPIs, secondary metrics, guardrail metrics, target audience, test duration and success criteria before each experiment.
* Partner with the Data Analyst to ensure accurate event tracking, dashboards, data quality and reliable post\-test analysis.
* Brief UI/UX, content and development teams with clear experiment requirements and expected customer/business outcomes.
* Conduct pre\-launch QA including tracking validation, mobile/desktop review, browser testing, localisation, merchandising checks and rollback readiness.
* Launch and monitor A/B tests and other controlled experiments without disrupting customer experience or trading performance.
* Evaluate test outcomes using appropriate statistical methods; distinguish meaningful uplift from inconclusive or false\-positive results.
* Roll out confirmed winners, document learning, and ensure results are incorporated into future product and page templates.
* Maintain an experiment backlog, prioritisation framework, testing calendar, QA checklist and executive reporting.
* Present clear recommendations and revenue/CVR impact to senior stakeholders.


 Required qualifications and experience
 * 4\+ years of experience in conversion rate optimisation, e\-commerce growth, digital analytics, product experimentation or a related role.
* Proven experience personally owning website experiments from hypothesis to successful rollout.
* Hands\-on experience with Shopify and a strong understanding of D2C e\-commerce journeys.
* Strong knowledge of A/B testing, control/variant design, sample size, statistical significance, confidence levels and incremental impact.
* Experience using GA4, Google Tag Manager, Shopify Analytics and reporting tools such as Looker Studio, Power BI or Tableau.
* Ability to work effectively with Data, UI/UX, developers, content, merchandising and commercial stakeholders.
* Strong analytical thinking, structured communication and project\-management skills.
* Ability to prioritise high\-impact initiatives in a fast\-moving e\-commerce environment.


 Preferred qualifications
 * Experience with experimentation platforms such as VWO, Optimizely, Convert, AB Tasty or similar.
* SQL knowledge and experience working with product, customer or web\-behaviour datasets.
* Experience with heatmaps/session\-replay tools such as Hotjar, Contentsquare, Microsoft Clarity or similar.
* Experience improving international e\-commerce stores, localised content or multi\-market Shopify storefronts.
* Experience in fitness, consumer goods, retail or high\-consideration D2C products.


 How success will be measured
 * Conversion\-rate uplift across key Shopify journeys.
* Incremental revenue and profitability generated through experiments.
* Quality and speed of the hypothesis\-to\-launch process.
* Accuracy of tracking, QA and statistical evaluation.
* Number and impact of winning experiments successfully rolled out.
* Clear documentation and adoption of learnings across teams.


 Application requirement
 
 Candidates should share 2\-3 examples of experiments they personally owned, including:
 


* The hypothesis and business problem
* Primary KPI and test setup
* Test duration/sample size approach
* Result and statistical conclusion
* Final rollout decision and measurable business impact

title: Senior Visual Designer
description:
**Senior Visual Designer** 




*Location: (On\-site) Hyderabad, India* 




 Deccan AI is a Bay Area\-based data infrastructure company. We help frontier labs and enterprises with model training, fine\-tuning, and reliable AI deployment.
 



 We've raised a $25M Series A, and our customers include Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Snowflake, and several of the world's leading frontier labs and enterprises.
 



  





**The role:** 




 We're looking for a Senior Visual Designer to own Deccan AI's visual identity across web, pitch/sales decks, event collaterals, social media and more.
 



  





 This isn't a product design role.
 



  





 Our work is technically dense (ICP includes researchers, applied AI engineers and enterprise business transformation leaders). We’re looking for someone who enjoys turning technically complex ideas into visuals that can engage and convert.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Own Deccan AI's visual identity across web, social media, and pitch decks
* Turn technical concepts into context\-rich, easy\-to\-grasp illustrations
* Shape rough positioning and product content into polished one\-pagers and case studies
* Work in tandem with product and event marketing teams to design campaigns and collaterals.
* Own launch/brand videos from start to finish: storyboard, animations, editing, and the final cut
* Work within and expand our design system and brand identity
* Move fast across Figma, Illustrator, PowerPoint, or code\-based tools
* Brief and manage 1–2 freelancers who provide extra hands on smaller campaigns
* Deliver files and set up processes that let marketers edit on the go
* Own Deccan AI's visual identity across web, social media, and pitch decks.
* Turn technical concepts into context\-rich, easy\-to\-grasp illustrations.
* Shape rough positioning and product content into polished one\-pagers and case studies.
* Design launch and campaign visuals alongside product marketing
* Storyboard motion assets and art\-direct animations and illustrations.
* Work within and expand our design system and brand identity
* Treat AI as a core part of your workflow including ideation, concepting, and faster drafts
* Deliver files and set up processes that enable marketers in the team to edit on the go.



  





**You should apply if** 



* You have 3–5 years of experience in visual, brand, or graphic design.
* You've closely worked with product marketers or extended marketing teams, converting dense technical content pieces into easy to grasp visual architectures.
* You hold strong opinions about your designs, yet can take feedback, and come up with new options if necessary that are in\-line with the requirements.
* You've owned launch or brand videos before, from storyboard through to a finished edit.
* You can prioritize ruthlessly and switch between tasks fast without losing quality. You'll be moving between web, decks, campaigns, and video at any given point.
* You've run or contributed to a branding exercise before, helping finalize an illustration style, a visual language, or a design system.
* You're proficient in Figma, Illustrator, and Google Slides, and you can hand off files in a form that’s editable for dependent functions.
* You treat AI as a daily collaborator. It's already part of how you brainstorm, wireframe and polish.



  





**You'll be a great fit if you** 



* Obsess over details.
* Have worked closely with product marketing, event marketing and sales enablement teams before. Brownie points if you’ve worked with leading AI/SaaS companies.
* Have owned information design end to end (1\-pagers, pitch decks, social posts, email, etc.) and have a portfolio that clearly shows how you decided which piece of content or visual fits where.
* Have designed web/landing pages before and understand how visual hierarchy affects CRO.



  





**Why Deccan AI?** 



* **High ownership:** 
 You'll own how Deccan AI looks and communicates across web, decks, and campaigns.
* **Flat hierarchy:** 
 We act with urgency and clarity, and we're a small, collaborative team where good ideas move fast regardless of title.
* **A culture of learning:** 
 We treat mistakes as stepping stones. There's real room to try things, and get better from what didn't work.
* **Genuinely AI forward: You'll have real room to experiment with different AI tools in your own workflow. You'll never hear anyone tell you to stick to the old way of doing things.**

title: Entrepreneur in Residence - Product (Travel)
description:
**Why are we building Nuclei?**
 Before we started Nuclei, we listed down a few guiding principles. These were essentially our learning from previous startups/companies:
   

  

* Think big, think global, and not limit ourselves only to India.
* Build a company. We wanted to be sustainable from day 1 and build a profitable business. This does not mean that we compromise on growth, but we most definitely avoid unsustainable growth.
* Build for the long term, not flip it in a few years.
* And most importantly, we wanted to change the perception about India, from being a back\-office/outsourcing destination, to a product destination.


 All the above points came together to form Nuclei's vision — "To build a well respected global product company." At Nuclei, we are building innovative products that help enterprises increase customer engagement and build deeper relationships with their customers, by offering value\-added services like travel and gifting ecosystems.
   

  

**About This Role**
 As part of this vision, we're building a full travel ecosystem including Flights, Hotels, and Experiences, for one of the largest telecom operators in Europe, and expanding this proposition across multiple markets in Europe. This particular EIR seat sits within that travel team. You'll take ownership of category features and initiatives from first identifying the problem through to launch and iteration, working closely with the rest of the product, design, and engineering team.
   

  

**Please note: This is a remote job.**
**Who should apply?**
* Someone with 3 to 5 years of product building experience
* We're looking for product builders who can go 0→1 as well as 1→10 — building something new, and then scaling it through product\-led growth, journey optimization, and continuous iteration. It's not just build and forget.
* Prior experience in a startup would be preferred
* Founder or entrepreneurial experience is strongly preferred for this role — whether that's starting a company, being an early team member somewhere, or building a meaningful project of your own from scratch
* We have a strong preference for candidates with prior experience in travel, marketplace, or high\-volume consumer products


**Who are Product Builders?**
* Product Builders don't get hassled by chaos and constant change, they actually enjoy it and thrive in it. They understand that this is necessary for success.
* Product Builders work on building products from scratch (0 to 1\).
* Product Builders have a high bias for action.
* Product Builders think from first principles.


**What will you do?**
* Own category features and initiatives within our Flights, Hotels, and Experiences, product from problem definition through to launch and iteration.
* Translate customer problems and business inputs into clear requirements and prototypes. Scope and prioritize your own work based on customer and business impact.
* Work closely with the engineers, designers, and analysts who care deeply about their product. Should be able to quickly build rapport with them.
* Understand the tech that goes behind the product like data flow among systems, tech bottlenecks, and RCAs when things break.
* Analyze user behavior, funnel metrics, and feedback to identify opportunities for improvement, and drive product\-led growth initiatives \- journey optimization, activation, retention \- to keep pushing your category forward.
* Plan your features in smaller sprints while staying aware of the larger vision for the travel product and hold a high bar for quality. We're building a world\-class consumer product, so both the customer journey and the underlying tech need to be top\-notch.

description:
**Company Description** 
 Opus Bloc Pvt. Ltd. is a fractional real estate platform in India that enables individuals to invest in premium properties through fractional ownership units called blocs, starting at accessible entry points. The company uses dedicated Special Purpose Vehicles registered as LLPs to hold each property, ensuring that ownership is structured, legally independent from the platform, and verifiable through public Ministry of Corporate Affairs records. Through the Opus Bloc mobile app, users can complete the entire ownership journey digitally, including onboarding, KYC, documentation, portfolio tracking, and voting. Professional teams manage the underlying properties, and a secondary market for reselling holdings is being developed to support liquidity. Guided by the principles of Accessibility, Control, Transparency, and Ease (ACTE), Opus Bloc aims to make premium property ownership simpler and more inclusive for investors across India.

 The Frontend Intern will support the design and development of user interfaces for the Opus Bloc web and mobile applications, focusing on responsive layouts, usability, and performance. The intern will be encouraged to participate in code reviews, learn best practices in frontend development, and contribute ideas to improve the overall product experience.

* Foundational frontend development skills, such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with familiarity in at least one modern framework Next.js and React.js.

* Exposure to UI/UX concepts, including working with design tools or implementing designs from wireframes and mockups.
* Ability to use version control systems (preferably Git) and collaborate in a structured development workflow.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and willingness to learn in a fast\-paced product environment.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively in an on\-site, team\-oriented setting.
* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Interest in fintech, real estate technology, or digital investment platforms is a plus.

title: Visual Designer (Brand & Performance Creatives)
description:
**Visual Designer (Brand \& Performance Creatives) – Full\-time, On\-site, Mumbai** 




  





**About Ravel** 




 Ravel is a BSE\-listed, performance\-driven haircare brand. We don't run ad campaigns and hope. Every creative we ship is measured on ROAS, CAC, and thumb\-stop rate. If a static doesn't convert, we kill it and design a better one. That's the job.
 



  





**The Role** 




 You will design the static ads that run our Meta account. Not brand posts, not moodboards, not one hero image a week. High\-volume, high\-quality ad creatives built for testing: multiple variations per concept, shipped fast, measured on real spend. Your design decisions get judged by CTR and ROAS, not by how they look in a portfolio. If you find that exciting, keep reading.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Design static ads for Meta: product statics, offer creatives, review/testimonial ads, comparison formats, advertorial\-style images
* Produce variant grids, not single files: 3\-5 versions of every winning concept with different hooks, layouts, and visual anchors for structured A/B testing
* Turn copy and customer insights into scroll\-stopping visuals. The copywriter gives you the words; you make them impossible to scroll past
* Design for the feed, not the brand book: readable at thumbnail size, message visible in the first half second, offer never buried
* Read performance data on your own creatives (thumb\-stop rate, CTR) and iterate based on numbers, not taste
* Maintain speed: brief on Monday, creatives live by Wednesday, data by end of week
* Support adjacent needs when required: Amazon A\+ creatives, landing page sections, WhatsApp broadcast creatives



  





**Who Should Apply** 



* You've designed static ads that ran with real money behind them and you know how they performed
* You work fluently in Photoshop or Figma. Canva\-only won't survive the volume and precision this role needs
* You think in variations. Your instinct on a winning ad is "what are 4 more ways to say this," not "next project"
* You can defend every design choice with a conversion reason, not an aesthetic one
* You're comfortable being wrong fast. Half your creatives will fail. The winners will more than pay for them



  





**Why This Role** 



* Your work runs on meaningful budgets from day one, with full visibility into results
* Fast feedback loops: you'll know within days whether your creative won, and why
* You'll learn performance marketing from the inside, sitting next to media buying data most designers never see
* Competitive pay, with growth tied to the performance you drive



  





**How to Apply** 




 Send your resume and portfolio to ayush@ravelcare.com with 3\-5 static ads that actually went live, one line each on the objective and result. Include at least one example of multiple variations of the same concept. Applications without live ad work won't be considered.

title: Manager - UX Design
description:
**UX Manager \- ZAIDYN Platform**
**About ZS**
 ZS is a management consulting and technology firm focused on transforming global healthcare and beyond through data, science, technology, and human ingenuity. We partner with leading organizations to solve complex business challenges, accelerate innovation, and create measurable impact through advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and digital transformation.
   

  

**About The Role**
 ZS seeks a User Experience (UX) Design Manager to join our ZAIDYN UX team in our Pune office. The ZAIDYN UX team is a diverse, collaborative and talented group with offices in India and the United States. The UX team within this group owns the user\-centered strategy, research and design in support of the ZAIDYN platform of commercial, clinical, and medical products. The ideal candidate is a strong UX/UI designer with experience leading and working in cross\-functional digital product teams.
   

  

 The UX Manager is a player\-coach leader accountable for the end\-to\-end user experience of a ZAIDYN product area while building and developing a high\-performing design team. The role blends hands\-on design leadership, strategic ownership, and people management in equal measure. We are looking for someone who has 10\+ years experience as a UX Designer with at least 3 years in UX Design leadership/management. A bachelor’s degree in a relevant field is required.
   

  

 ZAIDYN is a complex, enterprise\-grade, data\-dense B2B platform. You will set the bar for design quality through direct involvement, grow the designers around you, and connect product\-level UX work to platform\-wide standards. Modern UX leadership means designing for interconnected systems spanning users, agents, data, and workflows, applying AI fluently in day\-to\-day design work, and tying design decisions to measurable adoption, retention, and growth.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the experience. Drive end\-to\-end UX outcomes for your product area, including usability, adoption, quality, and feasibility, with an explicit success metric and baseline for every initiative.
* Lead hands\-on. Contribute directly to strategy, problem framing, complex workflows, and data\-dense UI, stepping in personally on ambiguous, high\-risk, or agentic design challenges.
* Develop the team. Hire, coach, and grow UX designers and Leads; maintain development plans, run performance cycles, and foster an accountable, high\-performing critique culture.
* Enable delivery. Set team operating rhythms, ensure resourcing and prioritization, remove roadblocks, and improve productivity and delivery predictability.
* Influence cross\-functionally. Keep Product, Engineering, Data, and Customer Success aligned on scope and tradeoffs; turn disagreement into documented decisions and advocate for UX with clear, evidence\-based rationale.
* Align to the platform. Connect your area's work to broader ZAIDYN efforts, collaborate with peer UX Managers on shared standards, and uphold design\-system governance and accessibility as non\-negotiable.
* Contribute to cross\-platform UX initiatives. Including our AI Pattern library and design system, UX metric collection, UX/UI process improvements, and other approaches to grow our team’s impact and delivery of successful product experiences.


**What You'll Bring**
* People leadership. Proven experience managing and developing UX designers, including hiring, coaching, and performance management.
* Enterprise craft. Demonstrated success delivering UX for complex, enterprise\-grade products, operating at both strategic and execution levels on ambiguous, cross\-functional initiatives.
* Complex domains. Experience in domains such as finance, banking, insurance, or healthcare, including data\-heavy workflows and logic\-based systems (formulas, rules, algorithms).
* AI\-driven design. Active, advanced use of AI design tools in daily work, with the ability to show how AI accelerates workflows and improves quality, speed, or decision\-making, beyond basic concept or prototype generation.
* Agentic experiences. Experience designing interfaces for systems that act on users' behalf, making intent, autonomy, transparency, and control clear, safe, and trustworthy.
* Demonstrated UX/UI skills. Candidate will have a strong portfolio showcasing impactful, best\-practice based UX and UI design.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Measurable improvements in product experience, usability, and adoption (e.g., CSAT, SUS, design\-system adherence, accessibility).
* A strong, engaged UX team with clear growth, accountability, and healthy retention.
* Effective operation as both a strategic leader and a hands\-on contributor.
* Strong alignment across product teams, with design decisions consistently grounded in evidence and tied to business and customer outcomes.

title: Product Designer
description:
**Company Description** 




  





 Spur (https://spur.so) is an agentic CRM for businesses that sell to consumers over chat. 600\+ businesses across 50\+ countries run on Spur, around 5 million conversations a month: ecommerce brands first, and increasingly anyone whose customers message them on WhatsApp and Instagram, from real estate and travel to education, clinics and services. Every WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, email and live chat message lands in one inbox with AI handling most of it, and the same platform runs their campaigns, lead follow\-up, abandoned cart recovery and website conversion.
 



  





 We're bootstrapped and profitable. Zero external funding, zero marketing spend. We're 12 people: 2 founders, 3 engineers, 5 in customer success, 1 founding marketer, 1 AE.
 



  





**Role Description** 




  





 Three engineers, two founders, 600\+ brands running their entire customer conversation on what we've built, and nobody whose job is how it works. That's what we're fixing.
 



  





 You'll build our design system and then make it stick, which is the harder half: the components, the patterns, the rules, and the conversations with engineers about why a rule exists. A system nobody follows is a Figma file, not a system.
 



  





 The rest of the job is design decisions, end to end, and at Spur that means more than screens. When Meta ships something new on WhatsApp, you're the person who reads the documentation, talks to the engineers about what it costs to build, talks to merchants about whether they'd use it, and comes back with what we should build and how it should work. You'll sit with customer success, who hear every complaint, and with the AE, who hears every objection, and neither of them will have to chase you for it.
 



  





**You'll probably be a fit if you** 




  




* Have built a design system that other people actually used, and can tell us how you got them to use it
* Talk to customers yourself instead of receiving their opinions secondhand
* Read platform and API documentation without being thrown by it
* Have shipped in a small team with no PM layer and no handoff ceremony
* Use AI daily and have built something with it, even a no\-code automation, to kill a repetitive task



  





**Bonus points** 




  




* You've designed for messaging, commerce, or anything with a real\-time inbox in it
* You've worked on a Shopify app, or with Shopify merchants
* You write front end code well enough to prototype, or to argue with an engineer in their own terms
* You know the WhatsApp Business API or Meta's business tools from the inside



  





**Logistics** 




  




* Five days a week in our Green Park, Delhi office
* You'll be the first designer here, working directly with both founders and all three engineers
* Appraisals every 12 months. Our motto: if Spur grows, the team should be the first to benefit



  





 We read every response ourselves, and you'll hear back either way.

Customers found it difficult to avail quality services in a convenient manner, and service professionals were struggling to make ends meet, having to rely upon several middlemen, contractors, and local aggregators. The founders felt that the industry was ripe for disruption, and launched Urban Company, with three key principles in mind:
 



  





 ● Customer love: Build a platform that offers truly delightful and differentiated services

 **AI graphic des** 
 igner who lives at the intersection of design, social media and generative tools. This is not a ‘take brief, wait for feedback, make rounds’ role. title: UI Architect
description:
Location: Noida Berger Tower, India
   

  

 Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
   

  

 Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India \- one in Noida focused on Cyber \& Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
   

  

**Job Title:** 
 UI Architect (Frontend Platform \& Micro\-frontends)
   

  

**Location:** 
 India
   

  

**Experience:** 
 15\+ Years
   

  

**Reports To:** 
 Engineering Manager
   

  

**About the Role \& the Team** 
 We are building a foundational Core UI Platform Team to own, scale, and govern the frontend ecosystem for our enterprise product suite.
   

  

 As the UI Architect, you will set the technical direction for our frontend platform and guide engineering teams in building scalable, secure, and maintainable user experiences. This is a hands\-on leadership role that combines architecture, platform ownership, technical governance, and active contribution to core platform capabilities.
   

  

 Your mission is to evolve a robust frontend platform through reusable components, shared libraries, developer tooling, and CI/CD practices that help product teams deliver high\-quality software faster and more consistently.
   

  

**Success in this Role** 
 Success will be measured by:
   

  

* Adoption of shared platform capabilities.
* Reuse of common components.
* Improved engineering productivity.
* Reduced technical debt.
* Consistent architecture across teams.
* Platform reliability and performance.
* Faster onboarding of frontend engineers.
* Successful framework and dependency upgrades.


**What You Will Do (Responsibilities)**
* Frontend Platform Architecture: Own the technical vision and architectural integrity of the micro\-frontend ecosystem, including routing, shared state, configuration, and integration patterns.
* Design Systems \& Shared Libraries: Lead component\-driven architecture by evolving shared UI components, design\-system packages, and non\-visual utilities that are performant, well documented, and strongly typed.
* Hands\-on Execution: Write high\-quality, production\-ready code. Tackle the most complex technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and core feature implementations alongside your Technical Lead and UI Developers.
* Tooling \& CI/CD: Own frontend build systems and GitLab CI/CD pipelines. Improve dependency management, container builds, and code\-quality gates to support fast, reliable deployments.
* Governance \& Standards: Establish and enforce standards for code quality, automated testing (Jest, Playwright), accessibility, and security. Introduce formal processes like Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) to document technical choices.
* AI\-Assisted Engineering: Define practical standards for using AI coding assistants and agentic workflows to improve frontend engineering productivity, code quality, and developer experience.
* Mentorship: Act as a force multiplier. Mentor Technical Leads and Senior UI Engineers, conduct rigorous code reviews, and elevate the overall engineering culture.


**What You Bring (Must\-Have Qualifications)**
* 15\+ years of software engineering experience, including architectural ownership of enterprise\-grade frontend platforms or large\-scale UI products.
* Expert\-level React, JavaScript \& TypeScript: Deep knowledge of React architecture, rendering optimization, modern JavaScript, and advanced TypeScript patterns.
* Frontend Architecture: Proven experience designing and delivering component\-driven, micro\-frontend, or platform\-based frontend architectures. Experience with single\-spa or similar orchestration frameworks is preferred.
* SaaS \& Multi\-Tenant Architecture: Strong understanding of designing secure enterprise SaaS applications, including authentication, authorization, Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA), and multi\-tenant architectures.
* State, Data \& API Management: Strong expertise in client\-side state management, data\-fetching strategies, and type\-safe client\-server API contracts across distributed UI modules.
* Build \& DevOps Expertise: Strong understanding of modern frontend build tools (Webpack, Vite) and experience writing/managing CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/CD highly preferred).
* Quality Engineering: Strong understanding of frontend testing strategies, including unit, integration, and end\-to\-end testing with tools such as Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright, or Cypress.
* Communication: Exceptional interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders, Product Managers, and Backend Architects.
* Platform Engineering Experience: Experience with monorepos, internal package publishing, design systems, Storybook, and reusable developer tooling.
* Frontend Governance: Ability to define and drive standards for theming, accessibility, linting, formatting, dependency management, and architectural consistency across multiple teams.

title: Manager, Product Design
description:

 Ontic provides software that helps corporate and government security teams identify threats, assess risk, and respond faster to keep people and organizations safe. Its AI\-powered Connected Intelligence Platform unifies security operations and data into a centralized system of record, enabling organizations to conduct risk assessments, protect against workplace violence, and manage threats and incidents more efficiently. Fortune 500 companies and federal agencies rely on Ontic to support security programs such as executive protection, threat intelligence, and corporate investigations. Learn more at ontic.ai or follow us on LinkedIn.
 



  





 As Design Manager, you'll lead a team of 5–6 product designers, owning both the day\-to\-day coordination of design work and the people management of your team. You'll be the connective tissue between planning, execution, and individual support; and you’ll be the person your designers rely on for feedback, growth, and career development.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Work allocation: Assign design work based on priorities, skills, and availability.
* Day\-to\-day operations: Keep projects moving and be the person designers go to when they're blocked.
* Engineering partnership: Be the main design counterpart for Engineering and Product leads on planning and delivery.
* Team health: Track how each designer is doing: who's thriving, who needs support and build plans to help each grow.
* Escalation point: Resolve blockers and cross\-team friction.
* Design operations support: Keep shared tools and processes current and followed. Help shape the evolving role of Design at Ontic, including the working agreements between Engineering, Product, and Design.
* Process Improvement: Identify and improve processes that slow progress or contribute to team frustration.
* Evolve our use of AI: Set high standards for how our team uses AI for design work; keep pushing that standard forward as the tools change.
* Hands\-on design work: While it’s not a core expectation of this role, you may pick up design work occasionally as team capacity requires.



  





**People Management** 



* Career growth: Build and maintain individual growth plans for each designer, tied to clear expectations for their level.
* Performance reviews: Own the performance review cycle, including calibration, ratings, and written feedback.Ensure you are providing feedback regularly, not just during review cycles.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Experience improving design team processes or workflows, especially using AI tools.

title: Integrated CX Strategy - Experienced Associate
description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As an Integrated CX Strategy \- Experienced Associate, you will engage in providing consulting services focused on customer\-related strategies and initiatives. You will analyze client needs, develop customer\-centric solutions, and offer guidance to help clients enhance their customer experience and drive business growth. As an Associate, you will focus on learning and contributing to client engagement and projects while developing your skills and knowledge to deliver quality work. You will be exposed to clients to learn how to build meaningful client connections, manage and inspire others, and grow your personal brand by deepening your technical knowledge of firm services and technology resources.
   

  

 In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will specialize in enhancing the overall customer experience within our Commercial \& Service Excellence practice. You will analyze customer touchpoints, design customer journey maps, and offer guidance to help clients create seamless and personalized experiences that drive customer satisfaction, loyalty, and advocacy. This position offers a dynamic environment where you will be encouraged to take ownership and consistently deliver work that drives value for clients and success for the team. Embrace the opportunity to build your brand and open doors to more opportunities as you navigate through the firm.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 We are looking for customer\-focused, business\-first professionals who can operate across strategy, design, operations, product, and technology. This is a hands\-on consulting role for individuals who can structure ambiguous problems, facilitate stakeholder alignment, and convert experience opportunities into implementation\-ready business and functional requirements. Ideal candidates will have:
   

  

 Relevant experience in customer experience strategy, service design, digital transformation, product delivery, or business analysis within consulting or a global delivery environment.
   

  

 Understanding customer experience frameworks, human\-centered design, journey mapping, service blueprinting, operating models, governance, and experience measurement.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience conducting discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, qualitative or quantitative research, and current\-state assessments.
   

  

 Strong business analysis capabilities, including requirements of elicitation, process decomposition, functional analysis, traceability, prioritization, and solution validation.
   

  

 Experience translating research, business objectives, operational needs, and technology constraints into clear experience concepts and actionable requirements.
   

  

 Familiarity with digital experience ecosystems, including CRM, customer portals, commerce, marketing technology, contact centers, service management, identity, data, analytics, and integration platforms.
   

  

 Working knowledge of Agile delivery practices, including epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications, backlog refinement, sprint readiness, and release prioritization.
   

  

 Ability to connect frontstage customer interactions with backstage processes, roles, systems, data, controls, and organizational capabilities.
   

  

 Strong analytical thinking, synthesis, problem\-solving, facilitation, and executive communication skills.
   

  

 What You Must Have
   

  

* Bachelor's and/or MBA in Sales / Marketing / Strategy/ Analytics from a premier B\-School
* At least 2 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required
* Lead CX strategy and/or business analysis workstreams, from discovery and experience definition through requirements, prioritization, implementation support, and business readiness.
* Structure complex customer and business problems into clear insights, strategic recommendations, experience concepts, requirements, process models, and implementation priorities.
* Facilitate senior stakeholder discussions, workshops, and decision\-making sessions.
* Own the quality, completeness, and consistency of key client deliverables.
* Drive requirements clarification, prioritization, scope, and MVP decisions.
* Identify and manage risks, dependencies, assumptions, and cross\-functional issues.
* Coordinate effectively across business, product, design, architecture, data, technology, and delivery teams.
* Guide implementation and business\-readiness activities through testing, release, adoption, and optimization.
* Guide Associates and peers in strategy methods and deliverables, providing direction and review across research, synthesis, journey mapping, service blueprinting, strategic frameworks, and storytelling.
* Maintain accountability for workstream outcomes, stakeholder alignment, and delivery quality.
* Lead defined CX strategy workstreams, independently planning and driving research, current\-state assessment, persona and journey development, service blueprinting, market analysis, future\-state experience definition, and opportunity identification.
* Structure ambiguous customer and business problems into a clear strategic approach, determining the questions to answer, inputs required, analyses needed, and experience frameworks to apply.
* Synthesize customer research, market insights, business priorities, operational realities, and data into a clear point of view, identifying the implications and recommendations that matter most to the client.
* Shape future\-state experience strategies and transformation roadmaps, connecting customer needs and experience opportunities to business value, capabilities, operating model implications, technology needs, and implementation priorities.
* Lead CX\-focused client workshops and working sessions, including discovery, journey mapping, co\-creation, prioritization, and future\-state visioning, and drive stakeholders toward decisions and alignment.
* Own the strategic storyline and quality of CX deliverables, translating complex findings into clear executive\-level narratives and confidently presenting recommendations to client stakeholders.


**Skills Preferred**
 Candidates should be able to demonstrate customer transformation consulting capabilities across the following areas:
   

  

**CX Strategy, Research \& Experience Design**
* Plan and conduct stakeholder interviews, discovery workshops, customer research, and co\-creation sessions to understand customer expectations, pain points, business priorities, and operational constraints.
* Synthesize research and workshop outputs into insights, personas, journey maps, experience principles, opportunity areas, and measurable experience outcomes.
* Define future\-state customer and employee experiences across web, mobile, portals, contact centers, sales, service, marketing, and other assisted or digital channels.
* Create journey maps, service blueprints, experience blueprints, ecosystem maps, and future\-state experience visions.
* Develop CX strategies, capability roadmaps, MVP recommendations, and phased transformation plans that balance customer value, business impact, feasibility, and delivery risk.
* Apply market research, customer insights, analytics, and emerging experience trends to identify opportunities and shape strategic recommendations.
* Ability to work with clients to understand detailed requirements define end\-to\-end CX strategies that meet client needs and vision.
* Extensive experience in using UX design best practices to design solutions, and a deep understanding of mobile\-first and responsive design.
* A solid grasp of user\-centered design (UCD), planning and conducting design research, user testing.
* Experience in qualitative and quantitative research methodologies, including interviews, surveys, journey mapping \& workshops.
* Strong analytical and synthesis skills: ability to translate complex, ambiguous research data into clear strategic frameworks, insights, and recommendations.
* Experience creating service blueprints, ecosystem maps, and future\-state experience visions that connect frontstage customer interactions with backstage operations and systems.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively in fast\-paced, cross\-functional, and client\-facing environments.
* Passion for customer experience strategy, innovation, and solving complex user and business challenges.
* Be passionate about all things CX Strategy, experience innovation. UX and other areas of design and innovation.
* Research and showcase knowledge in the industry’s latest trends and technologies.
* Ability to communicate ideas visually through low\-fidelity wireframes, workflows, sketches, or conceptual prototypes.
* Ability to leverage generative AI tools to accelerate research synthesis, insight generation, persona development, and strategic storytelling.
* Familiar with AI\-assisted workflows to optimize strategic and design outputs.


**Business Process, Experience \& Requirements Design**
* Lead engagement with senior client stakeholders across business, product, customer experience, design, architecture, data, operations, and technology teams to understand strategic objectives, customer needs, operational challenges, and solution requirements.
* Lead discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, requirements elicitation sessions, process walkthroughs, and collaborative design sessions.
* Conduct current\-state assessments across people, process, technology, data, and governance, and define future\-state processes, operating models, experience improvements, and capability roadmaps.
* Develop customer journeys, service blueprints, experience flows, process maps, ecosystem maps, use cases, personas, and other artifacts that connect customer interactions with supporting business processes and systems.
* Document business processes, business rules, functional requirements, non\-functional considerations, data needs, assumptions, dependencies, risks, controls, and decision points.
* Translate customer insights, experience concepts, and business needs into structured epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications, and solution notes.
* Lead fit\-gap analysis, impact assessments, option analysis, and prioritization exercises to support solution decisions, MVP definition, roadmap development, and scope management.
* Define success measures, KPIs, and reporting requirements to evaluate customer experience, process performance, adoption, and business outcomes.
* Maintain traceability from customer insights and business objectives through requirements, design, development, testing, and release.
* Create reusable documentation, frameworks, playbooks, templates, and quality standards to promote consistency, scalability, and effective knowledge transfer.


**Implementation \& Business Delivery Support**
* Perform Business Analyst, Functional Consultant, Product Owner, or Project Management responsibilities across customer experience, CRM, service, commerce, portal, and digital transformation implementations.
* Collaborate with product owners, UX designers, architects, developers, data teams, platform specialists, testing teams, and delivery leads to translate approved requirements into implementation\-ready deliverables.
* Review wireframes, prototypes, workflows, data requirements, integration considerations, and functional designs to confirm alignment with customer journeys, business requirements, accessibility expectations, and operational processes.
* Refine and prioritize product backlogs, clarify requirements, resolve ambiguity, define MVP boundaries, and prepare user stories for sprint execution.
* Facilitate backlog refinement, sprint planning, solution walkthroughs, requirements validation, and stakeholder review sessions within Agile delivery environments.
* Support the implementation of customer\-facing platforms and enterprise applications, including Salesforce, Adobe Experience Cloud, Oracle, CRM, customer service, commerce, content management, data, and analytics solutions.
* Identify cross\-functional dependencies, integrations, data requirements, risks, controls, and change impacts early in the implementation lifecycle.
* Support data mapping, data quality, access, governance, migration, integration, and reporting requirements across platforms and supporting systems.
* Define expected outcomes and business scenarios for system integration testing and user acceptance testing.
* Review test results and defects, support defect triage, clarify expected system behavior, and validate that delivered functionality meets agreed business and customer needs.
* Use generative AI responsibly to accelerate requirements elicitation, process analysis, documentation, traceability, test\-scenario development, quality reviews, and stakeholder communications.
* Support adoption of AI\-enabled capabilities by translating new functionality into process changes, role impacts, training needs, operating procedures, and change\-management requirements.
* Support release readiness, business validation, training, stakeholder communications, adoption planning, and post\-implementation optimization.


**Client, Change \& Practice Contribution**
* Contribute to customer experience and business transformation engagements, including implementation roadmaps, operating model changes, adoption planning, and change management.
* Develop stakeholder communications, training materials, process guidance, and enablement content to support solution adoption.
* Coordinate across business, product, design, technology, and delivery teams to manage dependencies, risks, decisions, and implementation readiness.
* Develop high\-quality client\-facing presentations, executive summaries, proposals, and recommendations.
* Participate in business development activities, including proposal development, solution design, capability demonstrations, and creation of reusable assets.


**Tools \& System**
* Proficiency in Microsoft Suite and strategic storytelling tools is a must. Working knowledge of Miro or equivalent workshop facilitation tools is required. Familiarity with UX tools like Figma, Guidewire is a must.
* Experience with AI\-assisted research and design tools.
* Business Analyst \- Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Adobe Experience Cloud, Google Analytics, and other leading tools.


 What Sets You Apart
   

  

* Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Computer Engineering, Information CyberSecurity, Computer and Information Science, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, Computer Applications
* Demonstrating intellectual curiosity and adaptability in fast\-paced environments
* Utilizing customer journey analysis to enhance client engagement strategies
* Applying customer experience (CX) design principles to drive value propositions
* Excelling in communication and active listening to foster client relationships
* Developing business process improvement strategies for customer satisfaction
* Leveraging customer segmentation techniques to optimize service delivery

 Relevant experience in customer experience strategy, service design, digital transformation, product delivery, or business analysis within consulting or a global delivery environment.
   

  

 Understanding customer experience frameworks, human\-centered design, journey mapping, service blueprinting, operating models, governance, and experience measurement.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience conducting discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, qualitative or quantitative research, and current\-state assessments.
   

  

 Strong business analysis capabilities, including requirements of elicitation, process decomposition, functional analysis, traceability, prioritization, and solution validation.
   

  

 Experience translating research, business objectives, operational needs, and technology constraints into clear experience concepts and actionable requirements.
   

  

 Familiarity with digital experience ecosystems, including CRM, customer portals, commerce, marketing technology, contact centers, service management, identity, data, analytics, and integration platforms.
   

  

 Working knowledge of Agile delivery practices, including epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications, backlog refinement, sprint readiness, and release prioritization.
   

  

 Ability to connect frontstage customer interactions with backstage processes, roles, systems, data, controls, and organizational capabilities.
   

  

 Strong analytical thinking, synthesis, problem\-solving, facilitation, and executive communication skills.
   

  

 Exposure to clients and stakeholders in a cross\-functional and global environment.
   

  

 What You Must Have
   

  

* Bachelor's and/or MBA in Sales / Marketing / Strategy/ Analytics from a premier B\-School
* 5 \- 8 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required
* Lead CX strategy and/or business analysis workstreams, from discovery and experience definition through requirements, prioritization, implementation support, and business readiness.
* Structure complex customer and business problems into clear insights, strategic recommendations, experience concepts, requirements, process models, and implementation priorities.
* Facilitate senior stakeholder discussions, workshops, and decision\-making sessions.
* Own the quality, completeness, and consistency of key client deliverables.
* Drive requirements clarification, prioritization, scope, and MVP decisions.
* Identify and manage risks, dependencies, assumptions, and cross\-functional issues.
* Coordinate effectively across business, product, design, architecture, data, technology, and delivery teams.
* Guide implementation and business\-readiness activities through testing, release, adoption, and optimization.
* Guide Associates and peers in strategy methods and deliverables, providing direction and review across research, synthesis, journey mapping, service blueprinting, strategic frameworks, and storytelling.
* Maintain accountability for workstream outcomes, stakeholder alignment, and delivery quality.
* Lead defined CX strategy workstreams, independently planning and driving research, current\-state assessment, persona and journey development, service blueprinting, market analysis, future\-state experience definition, and opportunity identification.
* Structure ambiguous customer and business problems into a clear strategic approach, determining the questions to answer, inputs required, analyses needed, and experience frameworks to apply.
* Synthesize customer research, market insights, business priorities, operational realities, and data into a clear point of view, identifying the implications and recommendations that matter most to the client.
* Shape future\-state experience strategies and transformation roadmaps, connecting customer needs and experience opportunities to business value, capabilities, operating model implications, technology needs, and implementation priorities.
* Lead CX\-focused client workshops and working sessions, including discovery, journey mapping, co\-creation, prioritization, and future\-state visioning, and drive stakeholders toward decisions and alignment.
* Own the strategic storyline and quality of CX deliverables, translating complex findings into clear executive\-level narratives and confidently presenting recommendations to client stakeholders.


**Skills Preferred**
 Candidates should be able to demonstrate customer transformation consulting capabilities across the following areas:
   

  

**CX Strategy, Research \& Experience Design**
* Plan and conduct stakeholder interviews, discovery workshops, customer research, and co\-creation sessions to understand customer expectations, pain points, business priorities, and operational constraints.
* Synthesize research and workshop outputs into insights, personas, journey maps, experience principles, opportunity areas, and measurable experience outcomes.
* Define future\-state customer and employee experiences across web, mobile, portals, contact centers, sales, service, marketing, and other assisted or digital channels.
* Create journey maps, service blueprints, experience blueprints, ecosystem maps, and future\-state experience visions.
* Develop CX strategies, capability roadmaps, MVP recommendations, and phased transformation plans that balance customer value, business impact, feasibility, and delivery risk.
* Apply market research, customer insights, analytics, and emerging experience trends to identify opportunities and shape strategic recommendations.
* Ability to work with clients to understand detailed requirements define end\-to\-end CX strategies that meet client needs and vision.
* Extensive experience in using UX design best practices to design solutions, and a deep understanding of mobile\-first and responsive design.
* A solid grasp of user\-centered design (UCD), planning and conducting design research, user testing.
* Experience in qualitative and quantitative research methodologies, including interviews, surveys, journey mapping \& workshops.
* Strong analytical and synthesis skills: ability to translate complex, ambiguous research data into clear strategic frameworks, insights, and recommendations.
* Experience creating service blueprints, ecosystem maps, and future\-state experience visions that connect frontstage customer interactions with backstage operations and systems.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively in fast\-paced, cross\-functional, and client\-facing environments.
* Passion for customer experience strategy, innovation, and solving complex user and business challenges.
* Be passionate about all things CX Strategy, experience innovation. UX and other areas of design and innovation.
* Research and showcase knowledge in the industry’s latest trends and technologies.
* Ability to communicate ideas visually through low\-fidelity wireframes, workflows, sketches, or conceptual prototypes.
* Ability to leverage generative AI tools to accelerate research synthesis, insight generation, persona development, and strategic storytelling.
* Familiar with AI\-assisted workflows to optimize strategic and design outputs.


**Business Process, Experience \& Requirements Design**
* Lead engagement with senior client stakeholders across business, product, customer experience, design, architecture, data, operations, and technology teams to understand strategic objectives, customer needs, operational challenges, and solution requirements.
* Lead discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, requirements elicitation sessions, process walkthroughs, and collaborative design sessions.
* Conduct current\-state assessments across people, process, technology, data, and governance, and define future\-state processes, operating models, experience improvements, and capability roadmaps.
* Develop customer journeys, service blueprints, experience flows, process maps, ecosystem maps, use cases, personas, and other artifacts that connect customer interactions with supporting business processes and systems.
* Document business processes, business rules, functional requirements, non\-functional considerations, data needs, assumptions, dependencies, risks, controls, and decision points.
* Translate customer insights, experience concepts, and business needs into structured epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications, and solution notes.
* Lead fit\-gap analysis, impact assessments, option analysis, and prioritization exercises to support solution decisions, MVP definition, roadmap development, and scope management.
* Define success measures, KPIs, and reporting requirements to evaluate customer experience, process performance, adoption, and business outcomes.
* Maintain traceability from customer insights and business objectives through requirements, design, development, testing, and release.
* Create reusable documentation, frameworks, playbooks, templates, and quality standards to promote consistency, scalability, and effective knowledge transfer.


**Implementation \& Business Delivery Support**
* Perform Business Analyst, Functional Consultant, Product Owner, or Project Management responsibilities across customer experience, CRM, service, commerce, portal, and digital transformation implementations.
* Collaborate with product owners, UX designers, architects, developers, data teams, platform specialists, testing teams, and delivery leads to translate approved requirements into implementation\-ready deliverables.
* Review wireframes, prototypes, workflows, data requirements, integration considerations, and functional designs to confirm alignment with customer journeys, business requirements, accessibility expectations, and operational processes.
* Refine and prioritize product backlogs, clarify requirements, resolve ambiguity, define MVP boundaries, and prepare user stories for sprint execution.
* Facilitate backlog refinement, sprint planning, solution walkthroughs, requirements validation, and stakeholder review sessions within Agile delivery environments.
* Support the implementation of customer\-facing platforms and enterprise applications, including Salesforce, Adobe Experience Cloud, Oracle, CRM, customer service, commerce, content management, data, and analytics solutions.
* Identify cross\-functional dependencies, integrations, data requirements, risks, controls, and change impacts early in the implementation lifecycle.
* Support data mapping, data quality, access, governance, migration, integration, and reporting requirements across platforms and supporting systems.
* Define expected outcomes and business scenarios for system integration testing and user acceptance testing.
* Review test results and defects, support defect triage, clarify expected system behavior, and validate that delivered functionality meets agreed business and customer needs.
* Use generative AI responsibly to accelerate requirements elicitation, process analysis, documentation, traceability, test\-scenario development, quality reviews, and stakeholder communications.
* Support adoption of AI\-enabled capabilities by translating new functionality into process changes, role impacts, training needs, operating procedures, and change\-management requirements.
* Support release readiness, business validation, training, stakeholder communications, adoption planning, and post\-implementation optimization.


**Client, Change \& Practice Contribution**
* Contribute to customer experience and business transformation engagements, including implementation roadmaps, operating model changes, adoption planning, and change management.

* Coordinate across business, product, design, technology, and delivery teams to manage dependencies, risks, decisions, and implementation readiness.
* Develop high\-quality client\-facing presentations, executive summaries, proposals, and recommendations.

**Tools \& System**
* Proficiency in Microsoft Suite and strategic storytelling tools is a must. Working knowledge of Miro or equivalent workshop facilitation tools is required. Familiarity with UX tools like Figma, Guidewire is a must.

 What Sets You Apart

* Demonstrating analytical thinking and business process improvement

description:
