title: Intern – Venture Development - EdTech
description:
**Full\-time internship for 3 months based in Bengaluru in the Healthcare\-EdTech space** 




**Job Description**




 In the newly formed Mount Judi Incubation setup, we are looking for a dynamic and creative Intern to work directly with a Pre\-Seed startup in its "Founder's Office". The intern will work directly alongside the entrepreneur on whatever moves the needle across functional areas of Product, Market Analysis and Funding – building the concept from idea to reality. This will be typically an on\-site position working full\-time 5 days of the week working with the woman entrepreneur in Bengaluru.
 **This is a limited duration 3 month opportunity (October to December 2026\) which could develop into a long\-term role based on the performance of the individual and the outcome of the efforts.** 
 From this internship, the candidate will walk away with integrated and comprehensive experience including MVP testing, platform setup, and operational model building translating an EdTech concept into a fully functional start\-up.
 



**Scope of Work** 




**1\. Market Analysis (Strategy \& Pilot Pipeline)**




**Market Intelligence:** 
 Benchmark \~Indian Healthcare EdTech models — map their content formats, pricing (B2B vs. B2C), and learner engagement tactics. Build a TAM\-SAM\-SOM model with a bottom\-up view of allied healthcare colleges and hospital chains.
 



**Pilot Lead Generation:** 
 Identify and prioritize 10\+ potential pilot clients; Draft personalized cold outreach scripts and manage follow\-ups to secure \~3 signed MoUs for MVP testing.
 



**Feedback Synthesis:** 
 Design standardized feedback forms for students/ faculty, conduct post\-pilot interviews, and synthesize qualitative/ quantitative insights into a short "Pivot\-or\-Persevere" recommendation for the founder.
 



**2\. Learning Platform \& Product Execution (MVP Setup \& Pedagogy)**




**Platform Configuration:** 
 Assist in defining user journeys and features for 4 user cohorts (students, faculty, institution, product admin), oversee content uploads (videos /PDFs / quizzes), manage learner enrolments via batch imports, and conduct UAT (User Acceptance Testing) to flag bugs before launch.
 



**Product Roadmap Inputs:** 
 Research trending healthcare skills and 2–3 gamification/ pedagogical frameworks; translate findings into a prioritized feature backlog (using RICE scoring) for the post\-MVP sprint (Jan 2027 onwards).
 



**3\. Growth \& Community Building (Demand Generation)**




**Content \& Social Strategy:** 
 Design a monthly content calendar for LinkedIn/ Instagram/ YouTube — create engaging short\-form reels, case\-study snippets, and career\-hack posts targeting students and young professionals.
 



**Community Management:** 
 Set up and moderate dedicated WhatsApp/Telegram groups for pilot cohorts; host weekly doubt\-clearing or AMA sessions to boost retention. Design a simple "refer\-a\-friend" incentive to drive organic enrolments for the next cohort.
 



**Outreach Enablement:** 
 Build email/LinkedIn templates for B2B (Deans/HODs) and B2C (students) to maximize pilot registrations with minimal paid ad spend.
 



**4\. Fundraising \& Investor Relations (Capital Readiness)**




**Investor Deck \& Data Room:** 
 Refine the pitch deck—sourcing real pilot data, polishing financial estimates (CAC/ LTV assumptions), and creating clean, narrative\-driven layouts. Organize a virtual data room with legal, financial, and product folders for due diligence.
 



**Investor \& Grant Mapping:** 
 Build a ranked database of \~50 relevant incubators, accelerators, angel syndicates, and family offices active in Indian EdTech/HealthTech. Additionally, identify 3–5 government grants (e.g., BIRAC, Startup India) and draft application summaries for the founder.
 



**Competitive Benchmarking:** 
 Analyze 5 recent Seed\-stage funding rounds in the space to benchmark valuation ranges, ticket sizes, and dilution norms—supporting the founder's negotiation prep.
 



  





**Skills \& Qualifications** 




 ·        
 **Education** 
 : The candidate should be a graduate. A degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
 



 ·        
 **Oral and Writing Skills:** 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with an ability to write clear, concise, and engaging content.
 



 ·        
 **Analytical and Organizational Skills:** 
 Strong project management and coordination skills to manage multiple tasks and liaise with external partners.
 



 ·        
 **Prior experience and Interest in startups:** 
 Prior experience interning at a startup or working in a venture/incubator environment is a significant advantage.
 



 ·        
 **Domain Interest:** 
 A demonstrable passion for the EdTech, Healthcare, or AI space is crucial for sustained motivation and contextual understanding
 



**Valuable Attributes:** 




 ·        Extreme Ownership \& Adaptability (The "Founder's Mindset")
 



 ·        Operational Rigor \& Digital Tool Proficiency
 



 ·        User\-Centric Curiosity \& Growth Instinct
 



**Compensation:**




 ·        A fixed stipend of Rs 12,000 per month will be paid for the internship period.
 



 If you are keen in applying for this opening, apply through LinkedIn or send your brief resume to info@mountjudi.com with the subject “
 **Application for Venture Development Intern** 
 ” on or before
 **22\-Sep\-26**

title: Sr Product Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
 Role: Senior Product Analyst
   

  

 Location: Bengaluru
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 We’re MiQ, a global programmatic media partner for marketers and agencies. Our people are at the heart of everything we do, so you will be too. No matter the role or the location, we’re all united in the vision to lead the programmatic industry and make it better.
   

  

 As a Senior Product Analyst in our DnA Capabilities function, you’ll have the chance to:
   

  

* Be actively involved in and take ownership of critical aspects of product development, with a stronger emphasis on ambiguous problem\-framing, research, analysis, documentation, and end\-to\-end product execution for AI\-assisted and analytics\-heavy workflows.
* Partner closely with Product Managers and cross\-functional teams to shape roadmap decisions, define success metrics, influence prioritisation, and drive adoption through evidence\-led recommendations.
* Help design workflow and product experiences where AI is embedded meaningfully into the user journey, including AI\-assisted insight generation, narrative support, contextual recommendations, and quality\-controlled outputs.
* Work across structured and unstructured data sources to surface actionable signals, connect fragmented knowledge, and turn them into product features or analyst workflows that reduce manual effort and improve decision quality.
* Contribute to the design of robust handoffs, APIs, and system integrations that allow product workflows to move seamlessly across tools, users, and contexts.
* Ensure outputs are decision\-grade by applying analytical rigour, factchecking, confidence\-based thinking, experimentation, and human\-in\-the\-loop quality control where needed.
* Mentor junior analysts, raise the quality bar on analysis and product thinking, and contribute to a collaborative, growth\-oriented team environment.
* Stay close to emerging AI tooling, AI\-based IDEs, copilots, and knowledge/retrieval systems such as Cursor, VS Code Copilot, Replit, Claude, Retool, Claude Skills, and similar platforms, and identify where they can improve team productivity, product usability, or output quality.


**Who are your stakeholders?**
**The Senior Product Analyst’s Internal Customers/stakeholders Include**
* Product Managers / Consultants / Traders / Data Scientists / Analysts / Engineers: the Senior Product Analyst builds solutions and workflows used by these stakeholders and works with them to translate business needs into scalable product or workflow improvements.
* Product Management: the Senior Product Analyst works closely with Product to define impact frameworks, influence roadmap choices, monitor adoption, and recommend next steps for feature development.
* Cross\-functional platform and data teams: the role requires leading conversations across Data Engineering, Data Science, Product, Sales, and Trading to move product execution forward in ambiguous environments.


**What You’ll Bring**
* 2–4 years of experience in translating business problems into scalable and insightful products through descriptive and inquisitive analytics, with strong product\-thinking and execution ability.
* Strong experience in Python for analysis and prototyping, plus comfort working with large\-scale data environments such as Databricks, Spark, and AWS.
* Strong grounding in product analytics, experimentation, and causal thinking, including designing tests, defining guardrails, and translating readouts into product decisions.
* Ability to work with APIs, system integrations, and workflow orchestration patterns, with a practical understanding of authentication, data movement, and scalable product architecture, including familiarity with LLM and agent integrations such as OpenAI APIs, Claude APIs, and tool\-driven workflow patterns.
* Practical familiarity with AI\-enabled ways of working, including prompt\-based tooling and hands\-on exposure to tools such as Cursor, VS Code Copilot, Replit, Claude, Retool, Claude Skills, OpenAI APIs, and similar LLM\-assisted, retrieval\-augmented, and human\-review\-driven workflows.
* Ability to evaluate where AI adds value versus where deterministic logic, analytics, or human review should remain primary.
* Strong storytelling and visualisation skills, with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Proficiency in statistical modelling and advanced analytics, with the ability to uncover patterns, trends, and anomalies that shape strategy and product development.
* High degree of organisation and comfort managing multiple competing priorities across product, data, and stakeholder tracks.
* Experience mentoring junior analysts and contributing to a collaborative team culture.
* Curiosity, adaptability, and willingness to learn new tools, technologies, and working styles quickly, especially in fast\-evolving AI environments.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in any engineering discipline / MBA.


 We’ve highlighted some key skills, experience and requirements for this role. But please don’t worry if you don’t meet every single one. Our talent team strives to find the best people. They might see something in your background that’s a fit for this role or another opportunity at MiQ.
   

  

 If you have a passion for the role, please still apply.
   

  

**What impact will you create?**
* You will help scope, build, test, and improve data\-driven product capabilities that strengthen MiQ’s product and analytics advantage.
* You will work closely with cross\-functional teams to build generalised features and intelligent workflows that help internal stakeholders discover insights, make better decisions, and execute faster.
* You will play a key role in feature testing, adoption monitoring, feedback loops, and business impact measurement so that high\-quality products are released and improved iteratively.
* You will bring strong analytical judgment to product development, especially where AI, automation, knowledge retrieval, and quality control need to work together in a practical and trustworthy way.
* You will help build MiQ’s brand in data science and product innovation by contributing ideas, research, experimentation, and thought leadership internally and externally.


**What’s in it for you?**
 Our Center of Excellence is the very heart of MiQ, and it’s where the magic happens. It means everything you do and everything you create will have a huge impact on our entire global business.
   

  

 MiQ is incredibly proud to foster a welcoming culture. We do everything possible to make sure everyone feels valued for what they bring. With global teams committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, we’re always moving towards becoming an even better place to work.
   

  

**Values**
 Our values are so much more than statements
 **.** 
 They unite MiQers in every corner of the world. They shape the way we work and the decisions we make. And they inspire us to stay true to ourselves and to aim for better. Our values are there to be embraced by everyone so that we naturally live and breathe them. Just like inclusivity, our values flow through everything we do \- no matter how big or small.
   

  

* We do what we love \- Passion
* We figure it out \- Determination
* We anticipate the unexpected \- Agility
* We always unite \- Unite
* We dare to be unconventional \- Courage


**Benefits**
 Every region and office has specific perks and benefits, but every person joining MiQ can expect:
   

  

* A hybrid work environment
* New hire orientation with job\-specific onboarding and training
* Internal and global mobility opportunities
* Competitive healthcare benefits
* Bonus and performance incentives
* Generous annual PTO paid parental leave, with two additional paid days to acknowledge holidays, cultural events, or inclusion initiatives.
* Employee resource groups are designed to connect people across all MiQ regions, drive action, and support our communities.


*Apply today!*

title: Web Strategy Manager
description:
Candescent is a forward\-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in\-person channels.
   

  

 Our Experience\-Led, Intelligence\-Driven approach combines human\-centered design with data, automation, and cloud\-based innovation. Built on an API\-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.
   

  

**Job Summary**
*Role Purpose*
 Candescent is seeking a data\-driven Web Strategy Manager to own the performance, structure, and continuous improvement of our website from one of our India office locations. This role sits at the intersection of marketing, design, and technology, translating business goals into a web strategy that drives traffic, conversion, and pipeline.
   

  

 This is a strategy, prioritisation, and performance role rather than a primarily hands\-on build role. You will set the direction and the roadmap, run the experimentation programme, and work through the web development, design, and SEO members of the team to deliver. You will be expected to be technically fluent enough to scope work credibly, review quality, and troubleshoot alongside the team.
   

  

 This role also acts as a senior point of coordination for the India web team, partnering closely with the US\-based Digital Experience lead on priorities, delivery, and stakeholder communication.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities And Deliverables**
*What you will be responsible for and what you will do*
**Web Strategy \& Roadmap**
* Own the end\-to\-end web strategy, roadmap, and performance of the company website.
* Translate business and marketing objectives into a prioritised web roadmap, balancing impact, effort, and dependencies.
* Lead cross\-functional web projects from scoping through launch, coordinating with design, content, development, and external vendors.
* Manage project timelines, priorities, and delivery expectations, ensuring commitments are met and risks are surfaced early.


**Experimentation \& Conversion Optimisation**
* Design, execute, and analyse A/B and multivariate tests across landing pages, forms, CTAs, and key user flows to improve conversion.
* Build and maintain a testing roadmap prioritised by potential impact and effort, and report results to stakeholders.
* Apply sound experiment design, including hypothesis definition, sample sizing, and statistical significance.


**Search Visibility Direction**
* Set the direction and priorities for SEO and Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO), working through the SEO Specialist who owns hands\-on execution.
* Ensure organic search and AI\-driven answer experiences are factored into site structure, content planning, and page launches.
* Hold the team to search best practices across new builds and site changes.


**Measurement \& Reporting**
* Monitor and report on site performance using Google Analytics (GA4\), building dashboards and surfacing actionable insight for leadership.
* Establish and track the KPIs that define web performance, including traffic, engagement, conversion, and pipeline contribution.
* Monitor site health including page speed, mobile experience, accessibility, and broken links, and drive resolution.


**Collaboration \& Ways of Working**
* Partner with SEO, content, demand generation, product marketing, and sales teams to align web strategy with broader business objectives.
* Coordinate closely with the US\-based Digital Experience lead on priorities, intake, status, escalations, and stakeholder communication.
* Provide direction, review, and quality oversight to the web development, design, and SEO members of the India team.
* Maintain a working schedule with sufficient overlap with US business hours on at least a few days each week to enable live collaboration, reviews, and handoffs.


**Experience**
*Demonstrated skills, competencies, and required experience*
* 6–9 years of experience in web strategy, digital marketing, growth marketing, or a related discipline, including experience setting direction rather than only executing.
* Proven, hands\-on experience with A/B testing and conversion rate optimisation, including experiment design and interpreting statistical significance.
* Strong working knowledge of SEO fundamentals across technical, on\-page, and content, and familiarity with emerging AEO practices.
* Proficiency with Google Analytics (GA4\), including custom reports, funnels, and attribution.
* Working knowledge of Webflow, sufficient to scope work, review builds, and troubleshoot with developers.
* Experience with Marketo or a comparable marketing automation platform for forms, landing pages, and lead flow.
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to run multiple concurrent projects and keep cross\-functional teams on track.
* Experience guiding, reviewing, or coordinating the work of other specialists such as developers, designers, or analysts.
* Excellent analytical skills and the ability to turn data into clear recommendations, with strong written and verbal communication.


**Qualifications \& Preferred Distinctions**
*Additional accomplishments*
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Computer Science, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
* Experience with testing and optimisation platforms such as Optimizely or VWO is preferred.
* Basic HTML and CSS knowledge for troubleshooting Webflow builds is preferred.
* Familiarity with project management tools such as Smartsheet, Jira, or Asana is a plus.
* Experience supporting financial services, technology, B2B, SaaS, or enterprise software brands is preferred.
* Experience collaborating across geographies and time zones is helpful.


**What Success Looks Like**
* A prioritised, consistently executed testing roadmap that improves key conversion metrics quarter over quarter.
* Measurable growth in organic search traffic and visibility, including AI\-driven search surfaces.
* A well\-maintained, fast, and reliable website with minimal downtime or technical debt.
* Web projects delivered on time, with clear scope and predictable quality.
* Clear, regular reporting that informs marketing and business decisions.
* The India web team operates with clear priorities and consistent standards.


**What Will Make You Successful**
* Comfort making prioritisation calls and defending them with data.
* Technical fluency sufficient to earn credibility with developers and designers.
* Strong attention to detail and a high standard of craft and quality.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and shifting priorities without losing momentum.
* Clear, proactive communication with stakeholders across geographies and time zones.
* A collaborative, low\-ego working style and a genuine willingness to give and receive feedback.


 Strong organisation, follow\-through, and accountability in a global, fast\-paced environment.

Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.

title: Shopify CRO Manager
description:
We are seeking a highly analytical and commercially minded Shopify CRO Manager to own our end\-to\-end conversion rate optimisation programme.
 



 The role is responsible for the complete process from insight and hypothesis through experiment design, tracking QA, launch, statistical evaluation, winner rollout and measurable CVR/revenue impact.
 



 This position is not limited to marketplace listing optimisation, paid advertising or campaign execution. The successful candidate will improve the Shopify customer journey by working closely with dedicated Data Analyst, UI/UX, development, content and merchandising teams.
 


 Key responsibilities
 * Own the Shopify CRO roadmap across product pages, category/collection pages, search, navigation, cart and checkout.
* Analyse customer behaviour, funnel performance, device performance, engagement data and commercial results to identify conversion opportunities.
* Create structured hypotheses supported by evidence and prioritise experiments based on expected impact, confidence and effort.
* Define primary KPIs, secondary metrics, guardrail metrics, target audience, test duration and success criteria before each experiment.
* Partner with the Data Analyst to ensure accurate event tracking, dashboards, data quality and reliable post\-test analysis.
* Brief UI/UX, content and development teams with clear experiment requirements and expected customer/business outcomes.
* Conduct pre\-launch QA including tracking validation, mobile/desktop review, browser testing, localisation, merchandising checks and rollback readiness.
* Launch and monitor A/B tests and other controlled experiments without disrupting customer experience or trading performance.
* Evaluate test outcomes using appropriate statistical methods; distinguish meaningful uplift from inconclusive or false\-positive results.
* Roll out confirmed winners, document learning, and ensure results are incorporated into future product and page templates.
* Maintain an experiment backlog, prioritisation framework, testing calendar, QA checklist and executive reporting.
* Present clear recommendations and revenue/CVR impact to senior stakeholders.


 Required qualifications and experience
 * 4\+ years of experience in conversion rate optimisation, e\-commerce growth, digital analytics, product experimentation or a related role.
* Proven experience personally owning website experiments from hypothesis to successful rollout.
* Hands\-on experience with Shopify and a strong understanding of D2C e\-commerce journeys.
* Strong knowledge of A/B testing, control/variant design, sample size, statistical significance, confidence levels and incremental impact.
* Experience using GA4, Google Tag Manager, Shopify Analytics and reporting tools such as Looker Studio, Power BI or Tableau.
* Ability to work effectively with Data, UI/UX, developers, content, merchandising and commercial stakeholders.
* Strong analytical thinking, structured communication and project\-management skills.
* Ability to prioritise high\-impact initiatives in a fast\-moving e\-commerce environment.


 Preferred qualifications
 * Experience with experimentation platforms such as VWO, Optimizely, Convert, AB Tasty or similar.
* SQL knowledge and experience working with product, customer or web\-behaviour datasets.
* Experience with heatmaps/session\-replay tools such as Hotjar, Contentsquare, Microsoft Clarity or similar.
* Experience improving international e\-commerce stores, localised content or multi\-market Shopify storefronts.
* Experience in fitness, consumer goods, retail or high\-consideration D2C products.


 How success will be measured
 * Conversion\-rate uplift across key Shopify journeys.
* Incremental revenue and profitability generated through experiments.
* Quality and speed of the hypothesis\-to\-launch process.
* Accuracy of tracking, QA and statistical evaluation.
* Number and impact of winning experiments successfully rolled out.
* Clear documentation and adoption of learnings across teams.


 Application requirement
 
 Candidates should share 2\-3 examples of experiments they personally owned, including:
 


* The hypothesis and business problem
* Primary KPI and test setup
* Test duration/sample size approach
* Result and statistical conclusion
* Final rollout decision and measurable business impact

**About Upstox**

We’re one of India’s fastest\-growing fintech platforms, backed by the best in the business, including Mr. Ratan Tata and Tiger Global, and on a mission to make wealth creation accessible to every Indian. If you thrive in a high\-energy, high\-impact environment, you’re in the right place.
   

  

 The Role: Product Intern
   

  

 You’ll join the Product team and work closely with Product Managers on building and improving products across the investing journey, with a focus on the Mutual Funds and Advisory space.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on product \+ data role where you’ll work across product requirements, analytics, customer behaviour, competitive intelligence, and execution. You’ll use SQL and product analytics tools to understand how users interact with our products, identify opportunities, and turn data into actionable insights.
   

  

 You’ll work closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Analytics, and other stakeholders to turn ideas and insights into products that customers can use. You won’t just look at the numbers you’ll help understand what they mean for the product and what we should do next.
   

  

 What You’ll Own
   

  

* Write and refine PRDs and help drive features from idea to launch — defining requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and keeping documentation updated as features evolve.
* Work with the product backlog — help groom, prioritise, and organise requirements so the team stays focused on what matters.
* Own product analytics — build and analyse dashboards, funnels, and key product metrics to understand user behaviour and feature performance.
* Use SQL to answer product questions — write basic queries using filters, joins, and aggregations to retrieve and analyse data without always depending on the data team.
* Analyse user behaviour through tools such as Mixpanel or Amplitude — build funnels, retention reports, and cohorts and understand what the numbers mean for the product.
* Turn data into insights — identify trends, drop\-offs, and opportunities and translate them into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Run competitive intelligence across investing, wealth\-tech, and broader fintech platforms. Track product launches, UX changes, features, and pricing.
* Conduct structured product teardowns of competitor products and customer journeys to understand gaps and identify opportunities relevant to our roadmap.
* Research the investing ecosystem and understand customer needs, market trends, product offerings, and user behaviour.
* Work closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Analytics, and other stakeholders to translate product requirements and insights into execution.
* Roll up your sleeves on the groundwork: research, SQL analysis, documentation, dashboarding, testing, competitive analysis, and the detailed work that turns product questions into real improvements.


 What We’re Looking For
   

  

* Strong analytical thinking. You enjoy working with numbers, breaking down problems, and finding meaningful patterns in data.
* Comfortable with SQL. You can write basic queries using SELECT, filters, joins, and aggregations to retrieve and analyse data. Deep SQL expertise is not required.
* Sharp product sense and genuine curiosity about how users interact with financial products.
* Strong ownership. You take a problem and run with it end to end, without needing constant hand\-holding.
* A figure\-it\-out instinct. When you don’t know something, you find the answer yourself instead of waiting to be told.
* Genuine interest in fintech, investing, or financial products is a strong plus.
* Strong written communication. You can take a messy problem or a set of data and turn it into a clear, structured insight.
* High comfort with ambiguity and a strong bias for action.


 Why This Role Rocks
   

  

 You’ll be part of a fast\-moving
 **Product team** 
 , working on real product problems across the investing journey, with exposure to the
 **Mutual Funds and Advisory** 
 space.
   

  

 You’ll get hands\-on exposure to
 **product management, SQL, product analytics, customer behaviour, competitive intelligence, and data\-driven decision\-making** 
 while working on real problems and seeing how your insights translate into product improvements.
   

  

 You’ll learn how to connect
 **data → insights → product decisions** 
 and get direct exposure to the full product lifecycle in a fast\-moving fintech environment.

 **Prospective Employee Privacy Notice**

title: Manager - UX Design
description:
**UX Manager \- ZAIDYN Platform**
**About ZS**
 ZS is a management consulting and technology firm focused on transforming global healthcare and beyond through data, science, technology, and human ingenuity. We partner with leading organizations to solve complex business challenges, accelerate innovation, and create measurable impact through advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and digital transformation.
   

  

**About The Role**
 ZS seeks a User Experience (UX) Design Manager to join our ZAIDYN UX team in our Pune office. The ZAIDYN UX team is a diverse, collaborative and talented group with offices in India and the United States. The UX team within this group owns the user\-centered strategy, research and design in support of the ZAIDYN platform of commercial, clinical, and medical products. The ideal candidate is a strong UX/UI designer with experience leading and working in cross\-functional digital product teams.
   

  

 The UX Manager is a player\-coach leader accountable for the end\-to\-end user experience of a ZAIDYN product area while building and developing a high\-performing design team. The role blends hands\-on design leadership, strategic ownership, and people management in equal measure. We are looking for someone who has 10\+ years experience as a UX Designer with at least 3 years in UX Design leadership/management. A bachelor’s degree in a relevant field is required.
   

  

 ZAIDYN is a complex, enterprise\-grade, data\-dense B2B platform. You will set the bar for design quality through direct involvement, grow the designers around you, and connect product\-level UX work to platform\-wide standards. Modern UX leadership means designing for interconnected systems spanning users, agents, data, and workflows, applying AI fluently in day\-to\-day design work, and tying design decisions to measurable adoption, retention, and growth.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the experience. Drive end\-to\-end UX outcomes for your product area, including usability, adoption, quality, and feasibility, with an explicit success metric and baseline for every initiative.
* Lead hands\-on. Contribute directly to strategy, problem framing, complex workflows, and data\-dense UI, stepping in personally on ambiguous, high\-risk, or agentic design challenges.
* Develop the team. Hire, coach, and grow UX designers and Leads; maintain development plans, run performance cycles, and foster an accountable, high\-performing critique culture.
* Enable delivery. Set team operating rhythms, ensure resourcing and prioritization, remove roadblocks, and improve productivity and delivery predictability.
* Influence cross\-functionally. Keep Product, Engineering, Data, and Customer Success aligned on scope and tradeoffs; turn disagreement into documented decisions and advocate for UX with clear, evidence\-based rationale.
* Align to the platform. Connect your area's work to broader ZAIDYN efforts, collaborate with peer UX Managers on shared standards, and uphold design\-system governance and accessibility as non\-negotiable.
* Contribute to cross\-platform UX initiatives. Including our AI Pattern library and design system, UX metric collection, UX/UI process improvements, and other approaches to grow our team’s impact and delivery of successful product experiences.


**What You'll Bring**
* People leadership. Proven experience managing and developing UX designers, including hiring, coaching, and performance management.
* Enterprise craft. Demonstrated success delivering UX for complex, enterprise\-grade products, operating at both strategic and execution levels on ambiguous, cross\-functional initiatives.
* Complex domains. Experience in domains such as finance, banking, insurance, or healthcare, including data\-heavy workflows and logic\-based systems (formulas, rules, algorithms).
* AI\-driven design. Active, advanced use of AI design tools in daily work, with the ability to show how AI accelerates workflows and improves quality, speed, or decision\-making, beyond basic concept or prototype generation.
* Agentic experiences. Experience designing interfaces for systems that act on users' behalf, making intent, autonomy, transparency, and control clear, safe, and trustworthy.
* Demonstrated UX/UI skills. Candidate will have a strong portfolio showcasing impactful, best\-practice based UX and UI design.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Measurable improvements in product experience, usability, and adoption (e.g., CSAT, SUS, design\-system adherence, accessibility).
* A strong, engaged UX team with clear growth, accountability, and healthy retention.
* Effective operation as both a strategic leader and a hands\-on contributor.
* Strong alignment across product teams, with design decisions consistently grounded in evidence and tied to business and customer outcomes.

title: Product Intelligence, Launch & Adoption Lead
description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
 QAD is building a world\-class SaaS company, and we are growing. We are looking for talented individuals who want to join us on our mission to help solve relevant real\-world problems in manufacturing and the supply chain.
   

  

**This hybrid position requires candidates to be based in Pune with 3\-4 days of in\-office collaboration per week.**
**Job Description**
 QAD is hiring a senior operator to own three connected things: how we measure whether our products are working, how we launch new products into the market, and how we keep them adopted once they're live.
   

  

 The role owns the metrics layer across our product portfolio — telemetry, adoption analytics, value realization — and runs the operational mechanics of every product launch. After launch, you're the person who notices when usage decays, diagnoses why, and routes the fix to the right team. You'll partner closely with the Customer Success organization, which executes the customer\-facing side of adoption work under your diagnostic direction.
   

  

 This is the most operationally demanding seat on the Product Operations team and the one with the most cross\-functional surface area. It reports to the Head of Product Operations.
   

  

 What you'll own
   

  

* Own KPI governance and the metrics layer: workflow telemetry, adoption analytics, product\-health dashboards, decision outcomes vs. baseline. Standardize dual success metrics across the portfolio (product outcomes and model metrics) so teams know what "good enough" means at each capability tier.
* Own value\-realization tracking: prove ROI per launched product at the customer level. This evidence does two jobs — it informs stage\-gate decisions, and it underwrites the case for continued investment in the new product portfolio.
* Run NPI launch mechanics: launch readiness, enablement materials, sales and customer success playbooks, pricing\-and\-packaging coordination per product, and the cross\-functional launch calendar.
* Own adoption health monitoring across the entire shipped portfolio. Maintain the leading\-indicator dashboard. When sustained usage decay is flagged (with thresholds defined per product), trigger the adoption response protocol within 48 hours: pull evaluation signals, value\-realization data, and field notes; diagnose the root cause; route to the right owner.
* Be the single accountable owner of root\-cause diagnosis when adoption drops. Route product gaps to the product team, enablement gaps to Customer Success, and customer\-fit issues to the field deployment team. Customer Success executes the human\-side fix; you stay accountable for the signal and the routing.
* Run PM enablement: AI\-native methodology, templates, the experimentation cadence, and the training that helps product managers evolve into operators of AI\-powered products. Partner closely with the AI Quality \& Evaluation Lead so PM training on evaluation\-writing is integrated, not bolted on.
* Standardize the intake process for user feedback, feature requests, and field signals, and own the core product\-ops tool stack.


**Qualifications**
 What we're looking for
   

  

* 5\-8 years in product ops, product launch/GTM operations, customer\-success operations, or product analytics — with demonstrated ownership of at least two of the three (launch, analytics, adoption).
* Hands\-on experience launching products in a multi\-SKU enterprise environment; bonus if you've owned a post\-launch adoption motion working with a separate Customer Success team.
* Strong analytics: dashboards, partnering with data teams to build self\-serve analytics for product managers, SQL and spreadsheet automation expected.
* Strong facilitator who can hold a cross\-functional diagnostic conversation. The job is calling the right meeting at the right time and making sure the right four humans are in it.
* Backbone, in a different flavor than the Head's. You will need to tell Customer Success leadership "this is not an enablement problem, please don't run that playbook" — and be right.
* Curiosity about the AI landscape; you don't need to build evaluations but you need to read them.


**Additional Information**
* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work\-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard\-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea\-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.
* Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set


**About QAD**
 QAD \| Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD \| Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.
   

  

 QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD’s DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work.
   

  

 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

description:

Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
****Title And Summary****
 Specialist Product Manager

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
   

  

 Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
   

  

**Overview**
 The Services team is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing cutting\-edge products and services that help our customers. Focused on thinking big and scaling quickly around the globe, this agile team is responsible for end\-to\-end solutions for a diverse global customer base including issuers, acquirers, and merchants. Centered on data\-driven technologies and innovation, these services include payments\-focused consulting, loyalty and marketing programs, business experimentation (Test \& Learn), and data\-driven information and risk management services.
   

  

 As a member of the Business Experimentation Product Management team, you will build industry\-leading experimentation software which brings sophisticated analytic techniques to businesses and users around the world. We are rapidly building new products, evolving products in the age of AI, and expanding the ways we deliver Test \& Learn to our clients. We are looking for AI native PMs who can execute and evolve our product strategy and help us build the AI enhanced version of Test \& Learn.
   

  

 Role
   

  

 Product Manager for Mastercard’s Test \& Learn product, an analytic platform used by the world's largest organizations to make multi\-million\-dollar decisions.
   

  

 Develop product strategy derived from user research, market trends, customer pain points, and commercial priorities.
   

  

 Translate a deep understanding of our users into an actionable roadmap. Leverage user research, market research, sales/marketing expertise, and usage data to inform priorities.
   

  

 Own end\-to\-end feature development. Identify and prioritize problems, define use cases, design solutions, write requirements, support development and testing, and measure impact to inform future decisions.
   

  

 Work as a part of a cross\-functional product team to bring ideas to life. Work together with UX designers, engineers, and other product managers to improve our products.
   

  

 Unlock the power of AI. Define how and where AI technology enhances the measurement and optimization of business initiatives.
   

  

**All About You**
 Can work closely with cross\-functional partners like engineers, designers, sales, marketing, and users.
   

  

 A quick learner with the ability to multi\-task in a team environment, not afraid to ask questions and make decisions. Enthusiastic, effective team member and mentor.
   

  

 Broad strategic thinking skills, adept in translating product vision/strategy into an actionable roadmap.
   

  

 Creative problem\-solver, can balance competing needs and prioritize thoughtfully.
   

  

 Strong professional presence. Excellent interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills.
   

  

 Experience building with AI or using AI to enhance an existing software application
   

  

 5\+ years of professional experience in a similar role, or equivalent.

title: Content & Style Research Intern
description:

**DotMyStyle**

title: Analyst - D2C Merchandising
description:
**Job Description \- Analyst \- D2C Merchandising** 




  





**You should apply if you have:** 



* A sharp analytical mind combined with a genuine feel for on\-site consumer experience — you notice when a layout, widget, or page just doesn't convert, and you can prove why with data
* Strong grounding in A/B testing methodology — designing hypotheses, sizing tests, and reading results correctly rather than eyeballing conversion bumps
* Comfort blending qualitative and quantitative research — you can watch session recordings on tools like Hotjar/Clarity and run user interviews, and translate what you see into a testable hypothesis
* Fluency with product/funnel analytics — you can dig into event\-level data to find exactly where the funnel is leaking and size the opportunity to fix it
* An ownership mindset over the D2C storefront as a whole — you think of every widget, PDP section, sale page, and search result as real estate to be optimized, not just decorated
* An AI\-first workflow — you use LLMs and vibe coding tools to prototype page changes, synthesize research, and move faster than a traditional analyst would
* Stakeholder management ability — you can take a merchandizing recommendation to the product and design teams and defend it with evidence



**You should not apply if you:** 



* Are looking to run merchandising operations day\-to\-day (inventory, pricing, catalog ops) — this is an analysis and optimization role, not a merch\-ops role
* Need a long ramp time — we expect you to understand our D2C storefront and start proposing tests within weeks
* Treat a page redesign or a new widget as the finish line rather than the start of a measurement cycle
* Are uncomfortable making a judgment call on a page layout without a perfectly clean dataset behind it



  





**Skills Required:** 




**Must\-Have** 



* A/B Testing \& Experimentation Design: framing hypotheses, calculating sample size and test duration, and reading out results correctly
* Session Recording \& Behavioural Research: hands\-on use of Hotjar and/or Microsoft Clarity to watch and synthesize real user sessions into friction points
* Product/Funnel Analytics: using event\-based analytics tools to identify exactly where the funnel is leaking and quantify the opportunity
* Qualitative Research: running and synthesizing session recordings and user interviews into actionable findings
* Merchandizing \& Storefront Analytics: reasoning about widget placement, PDP structure, sale page architecture, and on\-site search/discovery
* Analytics Tools: GA4 (or similar) for on\-site behaviour, a BI tool (Metabase/Power BI) for reporting, and Excel/Sheets for modelling
* AI\-Assisted Building: using LLMs and vibe coding tools to prototype pages, synthesize research, and speed up analysis



**Good to Have** 



* Familiarity with event\-based product analytics platforms such as Mixpanel or Amplitude
* Basic familiarity with Figma or similar to mock up widget/page changes
* Prior experience with PDP or CRO optimization in a D2C or e\-commerce business
* Python for basic scripting on data pulls or test analysis



  





**What will you do?** 




**Own the D2C Storefront Real Estate** 



* Decide how every widget on the homepage, category, and PDP pages should be placed and sequenced
* Plan and prioritize sale and campaign page layouts across major sale events
* Continuously audit the storefront for underperforming or redundant real estate



**Run A/B Testing \& Experimentation** 



* Design and run structured A/B tests on landing pages, PDPs, widgets, and on\-site promotions
* Define success metrics, calculate sample size, and read out results with statistical rigour
* Build and maintain a prioritized backlog of testing hypotheses



**Drive Consumer Insights** 



* Watch and synthesize session recordings on Hotjar/Clarity to uncover on\-site friction points
* Run user interviews to go deeper on the 'why' behind observed behaviour
* Convert qualitative signals into testable hypotheses and merchandizing recommendations



**Diagnose Funnel Leakages** 



* Use product analytics tools to trace the funnel step by step and pinpoint where users drop off
* Quantify the size of each leakage and prioritize fixes by potential impact
* Partner with product on instrumentation gaps when the data needed isn't already tracked



**Plan On\-Site Promotions \& Campaigns** 



* Plan how sale pages, campaign pages, and promotional widgets should look and be sequenced across the site
* Coordinate timing and placement of on\-site promotions with the marketing calendar



**Optimize PDPs and On\-Site Search** 



* Identify PDP\-level improvements — content, trust signals, cross\-sell, review placement — and validate them with data
* Monitor on\-site search and discovery performance and recommend improvements to relevance and merchandizing rules



  





**Translate Insights into Merchandising Recommendations** 



* Convert findings into clear, prioritized recommendations for the merchandising operations team to execute
* You own the analysis and the recommendation — the merchandising team owns execution — so follow\-through and clarity matter



  





**Work Experience:** 




 2–4 years of experience
 



  





**Working days:** 




 Monday – Friday
 



  





**Location:** 




 Golf Course Ext. Road, Gurugram, Haryana (Work from Office)
 



  





**Perks:** 



* Friendly atmosphere
* High learning \& personal growth opportunity
* Flexible timings
* Diverse work environment



  





**Why Nutrabay:** 




 We believe in an open, intellectually honest culture where everyone is given the autonomy to contribute and do their life's best work. As part of the dynamic team at Nutrabay, you will have a chance to learn new things, solve new problems, build your competence, and be a part of an innovative marketing\-and\-tech startup that's revolutionising the health industry.
 



 Working with Nutrabay can be fun and a place of unique growth opportunities. Here you will learn how to maximise the potential of your available resources. You will get the opportunity to do work that helps you master a variety of transferable skills, or skills that are relevant across roles and departments. You will feel appreciated and valued for the work you deliver. We are creating a unique company culture that embodies respect and honesty, which will create more loyal employees than a company that simply shells out cash. We trust our employees and their voice and ask for their opinions on important business issues.
 



  





**About Nutrabay:** 




 Nutrabay is the largest health \& nutrition store in India. Our vision is to keep growing, have a sustainable business model, and continue to be the market leader in this segment by launching many innovative products. We are proud to have served over 1 million customers until now, and our family is constantly growing.
 



 We have built a complex and high\-converting eCommerce system, and our monthly traffic has grown to a million. We are looking to build a visionary and agile team to help fuel our growth and contribute to further advancing the continuously evolving product.
 



  





**Funding:** 




 We raised $5 million in a Series A funding.

This is an excellent opportunity for a technology\-focused professional who is passionate about digital product development and enjoys working in a collaborative, cross\-functional environment.
 



 As part of the Digital Product Management team, you will play an important role in supporting the development, customization, release, and maintenance of digital products. You will work closely with colleagues across Editorial, Marketing, Customer Services, and external technology partners, helping to deliver high\-quality digital solutions that support OUP's mission of advancing knowledge and learning.
 



 The role offers exposure to product management, agile delivery, digital content management, quality assurance, customer\-focused product enhancements, and educational technology. It is ideal for someone who enjoys solving problems, building innovative solutions, and contributing to the ongoing growth of digital learning products.
 


   Opportunity
 
 As Analyst, DPM, you will support the delivery of digital products throughout their lifecycle, ensuring high\-quality user experiences and timely product releases.
 



 Key responsibilities include:
 


* Supporting the development of new products, product features, and innovative ideas, including building quick MVPs to help stakeholders visualize product concepts.

 This role is critical in ensuring OUP's digital products are delivered efficiently, maintained to high standards, and continually improved to meet customer needs. By supporting product development, content delivery, quality assurance, and stakeholder collaboration, you will help drive successful product launches, improved customer experiences, and operational excellence across OUP's digital portfolio.

description:
**Job Summary:** 




  





 We are looking for a GTM Analyst \- Market Research \& Insights (5 \- 10 years) to support our GTM, presales and bid teams with structured market, customer and competitive insights for RFPs, proactive proposals and go\-to\-market initiatives. The role sits within the presales team and works closely with Business Unit Heads, competency owners, solution architects, sales and senior management to sharpen GTM strategies and deal positioning.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




  





 \- Conduct secondary research on target accounts, industries and geographies to provide context, trends and benchmarks for RFPs, proposals and GTM plans.
 



  





 \- Build and maintain competitor profiles: offerings, positioning, pricing signals, win themes, differentiators and recent deals relevant to our GTM focus areas.
 



  





 \- Analyse RFPs/RFIs to extract business drivers, buying criteria and implicit needs, and map them to our GTM strategy and value propositions.
 



  





 \- Create insight packs for pursuits: market snapshots, customer landscape, stakeholder maps, SWOT, buyer personas, typical decision process and GTM implications.
 



  





 \- Support presales and sales with quantitative analysis: market sizing, opportunity assessment, TAM/SAM/SOM, basic financial and pricing analysis.
 



  





 \- Work with solution architects and sales to refine win themes, value propositions and proof points based on market and competitive intelligence.
 



  





 \- Draft data\-backed content for proposals, GTM presentations and sales collateral: industry trends, business case inputs, ROI models, benchmark data (using public sources or internal case studies).
 



  





 \- Maintain reusable GTM knowledge assets: sector playbooks, battle cards, case study libraries, standard statistics and reference data.
 



  





 \- Track and report on deal outcomes to derive patterns on why we win/lose; feed insights back into future bids and GTM strategies.
 



  





 \- Collaborate with marketing to align thought leadership, campaigns and sales collateral with deal\-level and GTM insights.
 



  





 \- Ensure all research follows compliance, confidentiality and citation standards.
 



  





**Requirements:** 




  





 \- 3 \- 6 years of experience in market research, consulting, business analysis, or strategy roles, preferably in IT/technology services or SaaS.
 



  





 \- Demonstrated experience in desk research, competitive analysis, and synthesising insights into executive\-ready outputs (slides, briefs, notes).
 



  





 \- Exposure to proposal processes; understanding of enterprise sales cycles and GTM motions is a strong plus.
 



  





 \- Experience working with cross\-functional teams (sales, presales, delivery, marketing, finance).
 



  





**Skills and competencies:** 




  





 \- Strong research and analytical skills; ability to work with both qualitative and quantitative data.
 



  





 \- Excellent business writing and storytelling skills; able to convert analysis into clear narratives and visuals.
 



  





 \- Good understanding of technology and digital/IT services landscape (cloud, data, apps, integrations, etc.) or willingness to ramp up quickly.
 



  





 \- Proficiency with Excel/Sheets (models, basic analytics) and PowerPoint/Slides (storyboarding, visualisation).
 



  





 \- Familiarity with research and intelligence tools (e.g., LinkedIn, company databases, industry reports); experience with any paid intel tools is a plus.
 



  





 \- High attention to detail, strong organisation and ability to support multiple bids and GTM initiatives in parallel under tight timelines.
 



  





 \- Stakeholder management skills; comfortable working closely with senior sales leaders and SMEs.
 



  





**Education:** 




  





 \- Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, IT, or related field.
 



  





 \- MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification is a plus but not mandatory.
 



  





**Why This Role Is Attractive:** 




  





 \- Direct impact on deal wins and business growth by shaping the insights, GTM narratives and positioning that influence our most strategic pursuits.
 



  





 \- Opportunity to build a foundational presales and GTM intelligence capability for TTN, including reusable assets, win\-loss insights, and data\-driven decision frameworks for leadership.
 



  





 \- Steep learning curve across diverse industries, technologies and GTM strategies, giving you broad exposure and accelerated professional growth.
 



  





 \- Strong visibility with sales leadership, Business Unit Heads, solution architects and marketing, opening up future paths into sales leadership, business consulting, account management or practice roles.

title: Senior Technical Writer
description:
**About Neo** 




 AI is the most significant shift in how work gets done since the advent of the Internet — yet most organizations fail to capture its value.
 **Neo** 
 is changing that.
 



 Founded by
 **Bhavin Turakhia** 
 — Co\-Founder of Zeta, Radix, and Titan —
 **Neo** 
 is building an integrated, AI\-first suite of products that capture work, centralize context, and make AI a first\-class participant in every workflow:
 


* **Friday** 
 — AI Assistant, co\-worker and agent platform, pre\-integrated into Tasket, Studio, Drive and 1000\+ SaaS platforms.
* **Tasket** 
 — A radically reimagined, AI\-native, work management platform that centralizes context and makes AI delegation seamless for all work.
* **Studio** 
 — AI\-native suite for co\-creating docs, spreadsheets and diagrams collaboratively with humans and agents.
* **Scribe** 
 — AI assistant for meetings that goes beyond note\-taking and actually does your work while on the call.



  





**About the role** 




 Neo is seeking a Senior Technical Writer to join our Product Documentation team and take ownership of how Neo's products explain themselves \- through feature docs, user guides, knowledge base articles, FAQs, release notes, and any other technical writing we publish for the outside world.
 



 At Neo, documentation isn't a support function bolted onto the product \- it's a product surface in its own right, and a community asset that accelerates adoption by helping people learn and trust Neo. We run docs\-as\-code and docs\-as\-a\-product: writing lives in Git, ships through review like any other product change, and is held to a real quality bar, built in close partnership with Product and Engineering.
 



 You read specs closely enough to catch what they leave out, understand what a user actually needs to know, and write it clearly. You don't stop at drafting one page at a time, you build the systems behind it: the skill files and prompt templates that let AI tools generate consistent first drafts from PRDs and tickets, grounded in a tone and style you've codified so every draft, human or AI, sounds like Neo.
 



 This is a hands\-on, build\-the\-system individual contributor role that calls for a combination of strong editorial judgment and an automation mindset.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  





**Write \& organize** 



* Read PRDs and engineering specs closely, and translate them into clear, concise documentation \- user guides, knowledge base articles \- organized with clean, findable information architecture



**Set the standard** 



* Define and maintain Neo's documentation style guide, voice, and tone; and hold every contributor to it
* Own end\-to\-end documentation quality (completeness, accuracy, consistency, tone) across every Neo product, and report on documentation health (coverage, freshness, usage) on an ongoing basis



**Partner \& advocate** 



* Flag issues with the underlying feature, not just the docs, when something won't serve users well or a spec lacks the detail needed for accurate documentation; partner closely with PMs and engineers to close those gaps and stay aligned with the release roadmap



**Build the system** 



* Set direction for Neo's AI\-powered documentation automation \- skill files, prompt templates, scripts \- deciding what to automate and how it should scale; maintain and evolve these systems as products and doc formats change



  





**Skills** 



* Technical fluency to read, question, and explain PRDs and API specifications directly with engineers and PMs, understand and document Neo's APIs and MCP tools, and ensure the accuracy of every customer\-facing doc that depends on them
* Strong written communication \- this is a writing\-first role requiring the editorial judgment to set the bar for others, plus experience defining or maintaining a style guide, voice/tone standard, or review process, and the instinct to know when something's ready to publish
* Strong project\-management instincts \- able to plan, prioritize, and carry a complex documentation project to an accurate, polished finish, with working knowledge of tools like Jira, Linear, or Notion
* Hands\-on experience with AI \- not just prompting in the moment, but building the reusable system behind it (skill files, prompt templates, context files) so AI can produce consistent, on\-brand first drafts without constant re\-prompting
* Systems\-thinking mindset \- with automation instincts, able to design processes that scale as the team and product surface grow



  





**Experience** 



* 5\+ years writing technical documentation, with a solid understanding of version control and experience managing documentation systems
* 1–2\+ years owning editorial standards or leading a documentation function for a team \- ideally at a B2B SaaS or product company
* Track record partnering with product and engineering teams to close documentation gaps and improve PRD quality
* Computer science/ background
* Nice to have: experience contributing to or maintaining an open source project
* Nice to have: a public writing track record on technical or documentation topics \- a blog, newsletter, or bylined guest posts

title: Technical Writer – Hardware Interface Compliance & Certification
description:
**Job Requirements**
 At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 We are looking for a
 **Technical Writer specializing in Hardware Compliance and Certification** 
 to document, structure, and drive the formal certification deliverables for our silicon and platform interfaces. In this role, you will work at the intersection of Hardware Engineering, Silicon Validation, and external standards bodies (such as the MIPI Alliance) to produce clear, audit\-ready compliance documentation.
   

  

 You will be responsible for translating complex electrical, timing, and protocol validation data for
 **I2C, SPI, QSPI, and MIPI (C\-PHY/D\-PHY, CSI/DSI)** 
 into rigorous Compliance Test Plans, Conformance Statements, Certification Filing Packages, Application Notes, and Hardware Errata.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Certification \& Compliance Documentation:
+ Author, curate, and maintain formal compliance test reports, Implementation Conformance Statements (ICS), and Test Assertion Sheets for I2C, SPI, QSPI, and MIPI (C\-PHY, D\-PHY, CSI\-2, DSI\-2\) interfaces.
+ Prepare and package end\-to\-end technical documentation required for formal certification submissions, interoperability workshops (e.g., MIPI Plugfests), and third\-party audit labs.
+ Maintain up\-to\-date compliance matrixes mapping internal validation test results directly to official standards specifications (MIPI Alliance specs, NXP I2C specifications, JEDEC/vendor QSPI norms).

* Engineering Collaboration \& Data Synthesis:
+ Partner closely with Silicon Validation, Signal Integrity (SI), PHY Design, and Embedded Firmware engineers to extract raw test data, oscilloscope captures, and protocol traces.
+ Synthesize raw test outputs into structured, clear documentation (including pass/fail criteria, electrical margins, setup/hold limits, eye\-diagram analyses, and timing diagrams).
+ Document protocol edge cases, hardware errata, and register\-level workarounds for customer integration manuals and Silicon Errata sheets.

* Developer \& Customer Enablement Collateral:
+ Draft technical application notes, hardware integration guidelines, and pinout/routing compliance checklists for customer reference designs.
+ Create precise, high\-quality timing diagrams, state machine charts, and interface connection schematics using tools like Visio, Draw.io, or WaveDrom.

* Process \& Document Lifecycle Management:
+ Own the document review and release lifecycle via Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems, ensuring all certification records meet traceability and version\-control requirements.
+ Track active specification changes within standards bodies (e.g., updates to MIPI CSI/DSI specs) and proactively identify required revisions in internal documentation.


**Qualifications \& Requirements**
**Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Technical Communication, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 3–6\+ years of technical writing experience within the semiconductor, consumer electronics, or embedded hardware industries, with a focus on hardware compliance, silicon validation, or interface specifications.


**Domain \& Technical Knowledge**
* Interface Literacy: Strong conceptual and functional understanding of serial and high\-speed I/O interfaces:
+ I2C \& SPI/QSPI: Bus topology, clock stretching, rise/fall times, multi\-IO modes (Single/Dual/Quad/Octal SPI), timing constraints.
+ MIPI Standards: Familiarity with PHY architectures (D\-PHY, C\-PHY) and upper\-layer protocols (CSI\-2, DSI\-2\), including High\-Speed (HS) vs. Low\-Power (LP) transitions and lane configuration guidelines.

* Interpretation of Hardware Data: Ability to read and accurately interpret:
+ Scope captures (eye diagrams, jitter metrics, rise/fall profiles).
+ Timing diagrams, bus state machines, and register bitfield maps.
+ Official industry conformance documents and test suites.

* Tooling Mastery:
+ Standard authoring platforms: Markdown, AsciiDoc, DITA/XML, MadCap Flare, FrameMaker, or Confluence.
+ Version control systems: Git, Perforce, or SVN.
+ Timing/diagramming tools: WaveDrom, timing diagram editors, Visio, or Illustrator.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Prior experience writing formal certification filings or conformance test plans for standards consortiums (MIPI Alliance, USB\-IF, PCI\-SIG, or VESA).
* Basic understanding of automated test logs (e.g., Python test runner logs, SCPI/VISA test report outputs).


 We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard.
   

  

 We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. title: Automotive Functional Safety Staff Engineer - Digital DesignWare IP
description:
**Job Title**
* Automotive Functional Safety Staff Engineer \- Digital DesignWare IP


**We Are**
 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
   

  

**You Are**
 You have spent years in the automotive safety world and you know that a well\-written safety case is not just paperwork, it is the difference between a chip that ships and one that sits in legal review for six months. You understand ISO 26262 not as a checklist but as a framework for making defensible engineering decisions under uncertainty.
   

  

 You are comfortable translating a vague customer requirement into a Technical Safety Concept that actually works, and you can explain to a hardware team why their design choice affects ASIL classification without making it feel like a lecture. You do not wait for complete specs to start safety planning. You work with what you have, ask the right questions, and build a safety argument that holds up under scrutiny. At Synopsys, you will work on automotive IP that powers the next generation of vehicles, and the safety work you do will matter.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Develop and maintain ISO 26262 work products including Technical Safety Concept, FMEDA, FTA, DFMEA, DFA, Safety Plan, and Safety Case for Digital DesignWare IP
* Collaborate with IP development teams and automotive customers to align functional safety deliverables with project timelines and ASIL requirements
* Evaluate customer quality, functional safety, and reliability requirements, translating them into actionable engineering guidance
* Design and implement automation scripts to streamline safety analysis workflows, including FMEDA and fault injection reporting
* Lead quality and functional safety reviews, generating detailed reports with findings and recommendations for design improvements


**The Impact You Will Have**
* Ensure Synopsys Automotive IP meets ISO 26262 compliance and achieves ASIL B, C, and D certification for safety\-critical automotive applications
* Accelerate customer time to market by delivering complete, audit\-ready safety documentation that reduces integration risk
* Drive measurable improvements in safety process efficiency through automation, reducing manual analysis time across IP families
* Support development of differentiated automotive IP solutions that meet stringent safety demands of ADAS, autonomous driving, and electrification platforms
* Elevate Synopsys' reputation as a trusted partner in automotive safety, strengthening customer confidence and market share


**What You'll Need**
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering with 8\+ years of relevant experience, or Master's degree with 5\+ years
* Formal training and hands\-on expertise in ISO 26262 functional safety standards, including direct experience developing safety work products for ASIL B, C, or D applications
* Demonstrated experience with semiconductor development flows and digital design at the IP or SoC level
* Proficiency in English for technical writing and cross\-functional collaboration with global teams
* Proven track record qualifying embedded hardware or hardware/software systems to ISO 26262 ASIL levels, including ASIL D
* Experience with ISO 26262 Part 5, hardware description languages like Verilog or VHDL, AEC Q100, or scripting languages such as Python is a plus


**Who You Are**
* You can take a 200\-page customer safety requirement document and pull out the three things that actually affect your IP architecture, then explain them to a design lead in a 10\-minute conversation
* Organized and detail\-oriented, you manage multiple safety deliverables across product lines without losing track of dependencies or deadlines
* You push back constructively when a safety plan is missing critical information or a design decision creates an unmitigated safety risk
* Comfortable working across time zones, you build trust with customers and colleagues through clear communication and follow\-through


**The Team You'll Be Part Of**
 You will join a high\-performing, globally distributed IP team that is at the forefront of automotive safety and reliability innovation. The team collaborates closely with product development, quality assurance, and customer engineering groups to deliver world\-class automotive IP solutions. Together, you will champion functional safety standards, drive continuous improvement, and support customers in deploying safe, reliable automotive products.
   

  

**Rewards And Benefits**
 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

**Job title:**
 Senior Specialist – Functional Safety
   

  

**Job Introduction**
 As a
 **System Safety Engineer** 
 (Senior Specialist), you will be responsible for ensuring compliance with ISO 26262 across the complete system development lifecycle. Your role will involve performing system safety analysis (HARA, FSC, TSC), defining safety concepts, deriving safety requirements, and collaborating with cross\-functional teams to ensure that safety goals are met. You will also perform FMEDA/FTA/FMEA activities, safety validation, and confirm compliance through reviews, audits, and safety case documentation.
   

  

**Major Responsibilities**
* Define and manage system requirements and specifications with a strong focus on ISO 26262 functional safety compliance.
* Perform safety analyses such as FMEA, FTA, DFA, and FMEDA for eDrive, Transfer case and all\-wheel drive systems.
* Support Functional Safety Management activities, including safety planning, safety case creation, and progress tracking.
* Assist project safety managers in preparing for and conducting functional safety audits and assessments.
* Define and manage system requirements and specifications with a strong focus on ISO 26262 functional safety compliance.
* Perform safety analyses such as FMEA, FTA, DFA, and FMEDA for eDrive, Transfer case and all\-wheel drive systems.
* Support Functional Safety Management activities, including safety planning, safety case creation, and progress tracking.
* Assist project safety managers in preparing for and conducting functional safety audits and assessments.


**Knowledge And Education**
* A bachelor’s degree or master’s degree in electrical/electronics, or a related technical field is mandatory.


**Work Experience**
* 10–12 years of experience in defining and specifying system safety requirements and concepts for eDrive or comparable products.
* Proven experience in customer requirement elicitation and direct interaction with customers.
* Hands\-on experience in safety analysis and functional safety management activities.
* Knowledge of risk assessment in system testing is desirable.
* Background in automotive industry is mandatory.


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Proven experience in deriving Functional Safety Concept (FSC), Functional Safety Requirements (FSR), Technical Safety Concept (TSC), and Technical Safety Requirements (TSR).
* Strong understanding of Functional Safety Analysis and its critical role in achieving compliance with ISO 26262\.
* Extensive experience performing HARA using the HAZOP method to derive safety goals.
* In\-depth knowledge of the E\-GAS three\-level monitoring concept.
* Solid expertise in ASIL Decomposition and ASIL Reduction techniques.
* Basic understanding of hardware circuits and schematic is mandatory.
* Strong understanding of eDrive functional safety concepts, including subcomponents such as inverter, electric motor (PMSM/ASM), and clutch unit.
* Basic understanding of system testing, software testing, and unit testing is highly desirable.
* Experience in developing Safety Element out of Context (SEooC) is desirable.
* Comprehensive understanding of eDrive units and electric vehicle architectures.
* Good working knowledge of PMSM and ASM operation.
* Familiarity with ASPICE processes and ISO 26262 standards.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills for working with cross\-functional teams and customers.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical thinking skills under pressure.
* Experience with Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) tools such as PTC/DOORs/Codebeamer is preferred.
