title: Pega Business Architect / Analyst - VOIS
description:
**Who We Are**
 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
   

  

 As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
   

  

 We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
   

  

 \#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture
   

  

**About This Role**
 We are seeking an experienced Pega Business Architect / Business Analyst to lead requirements discovery, process design, and delivery governance for Pega Business Process Management (BPM) and Case Management implementations. Based in Pune with a hybrid working model requiring office attendance two days per week, this role will act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical delivery teams, translating operational transformation objectives into scalable Pega workflow solutions. The position is ideally suited to professionals with strong expertise in Pega BPM, process modelling, stakeholder engagement, and Agile delivery environments.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Lead requirements workshops with business stakeholders and delivery teams to capture and document current and future\-state process flows for Pega BPM initiatives.
   

  

 Model and document end\-to\-end business processes using BPMN, case lifecycles, and workflow diagrams to support solution delivery.
   

  

 Design case types, stages, processes, flows, and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) within the Pega Platform, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
   

  

 Collaborate with Pega architects and developers to ensure workflow designs align with platform best practices, case management capabilities, and enterprise architecture standards.
   

  

 Conduct fit\-gap assessments between business requirements and Pega platform capabilities, recommending configuration\-led solutions where appropriate.
   

  

 Define and govern business rules, decision tables, decision trees, routing logic, and escalation workflows.
   

  

 Maintain end\-to\-end traceability from business requirements through design, testing, and deployment.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 Experience of 5\+ years in enterprise IT and business analysis, including 4\+ years focused on Pega implementations.
   

  

 Strong functional expertise in Pega BPM and Case Management, including case design, stages, processes, SLAs, work parties, and routing.
   

  

 Proficiency in BPMN process modelling and translating business processes into effective Pega case designs.
   

  

 Working knowledge of Pega decisioning capabilities including decision tables, decision trees, and when rules.
   

  

 Experience working within Agile delivery methodologies, ideally SAFe, with exposure to Scrum and Kanban practices.
   

  

 Ability to create high\-quality business requirements documents (BRDs), functional specifications, acceptance criteria, and user stories.
   

  

 Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate across business, architecture, engineering, testing, data, and integration teams.

**What's In It For You**
 Opportunity to shape enterprise\-wide business transformation programmes through Pega BPM and Case Management solutions.
   

  

 Exposure to multi\-market and global stakeholder environments.
   

  

 Hybrid working model based in Pune.
   

  

 Opportunity to collaborate with business leaders, architects, product teams, and technology specialists across complex programmes.
   

  

 Involvement in strategic process improvement, workflow automation, and digital transformation initiatives.
   

  

 Exposure to emerging technologies including low\-code platforms, automation, and AI\-enabled workflows.
   

  

**What Skills You Will Learn**
 Advanced Pega BPM and Case Management design practices.
   

  

 Enterprise\-scale process modelling and workflow transformation techniques.
   

  

 Fit\-gap analysis and business architecture methodologies.
   

  

 Agile and SAFe delivery governance approaches.
   

  

 End\-to\-end requirements traceability and business analysis best practices.
   

  

 Stakeholder engagement and executive\-level presentation capabilities.
   

  

 Automation strategy development and AI\-assisted workflow design concepts.

BMC does this in a simple and optimized way by connecting people, systems, and data that power the world’s largest organizations so they can seize a competitive advantage.
   

  

 Business Unit

This role supports two complementary priorities within SIGMA: AI\-enabled Market \& Competitive Intelligence and the operational execution of Digital Sales programs.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a strategic and execution\-oriented professional for a dual\-role position supporting Market \& Competitive Intelligence AI Enablement (50%) and Digital Sales PMO and Administration (50%).
   

  

 The successful candidate will help transform traditional market and competitive intelligence into an AI\-enabled function through Generative AI, Agentic AI, automation, intelligent research workflows, and Copilot\-based solutions. In parallel, the individual will provide PMO and operational support for Digital Sales programs, ensuring effective governance, coordination, reporting, process administration, and execution management.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines hands\-on AI implementation experience with strong program management, stakeholder coordination, business operations, and administrative capabilities. The individual must be comfortable building and scaling AI capabilities while delivering disciplined operational execution across the two workstreams.
   

  

 Indicative role allocation: 50% MCI AI Enablement \| 50% Digital Sales PMO and Administration
   

  

**Primary Roles And Responsibilities**
 Market \& Competitive Intelligence AI Enablement (50%)
   

  

* Lead the adoption and operationalization of Generative AI, Agentic AI, and intelligent automation solutions across the Market \& Competitive Intelligence function.
* Design, build, deploy, administer, and continuously improve AI\-powered intelligence agents that support competitive intelligence, customer intelligence, market research, executive briefings, and knowledge discovery.

 Digital Sales PMO and Administrative Support (50%)

* Support process administration, documentation, knowledge repositories, intake and prioritization workflows, access requests, and other recurring operational activities.
* Track program risks, issues, dependencies, and change\-management or adoption activities, escalating items that require leadership attention.
* Support the administration and operational governance of Digital Sales tools and platforms, including user access, vendor coordination, license or usage tracking, adoption reporting, and issue follow\-through.

* Experience establishing or applying AI governance, evaluation, responsible\-AI, quality\-assurance, and adoption practices in a business environment.
* At least 3 years of experience supporting enterprise programs, PMO activities, strategic initiatives, cross\-functional operations, or Digital Sales programs.
* Strong organizational and program\-coordination skills, including experience managing plans, schedules, actions, risks, dependencies, documentation, and recurring governance cadences.
* Experience creating executive reports, dashboards, presentations, operational metrics, and concise business communications.
* Experience coordinating senior stakeholders and global, cross\-functional teams across Sales, Digital Sales, Product Management, Pre\-Sales, Marketing, Strategy, or Technology functions.
* Ability to balance AI initiatives and operational workstreams, work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver consistently in a fast\-paced environment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 productivity and collaboration tools, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, and SharePoint.
* Strong attention to detail, data accuracy, confidentiality, and follow\-through.


**Preferred Qualifications**

* PMP, Agile, Scrum, or related program\-management certification.

* Assist in preparing presentation materials for client meetings and bid presentations.

* Attention to detail and a high level of accuracy in proposal preparation.

* Provide technical analysis, troubleshooting and solutions
* Establish and maintain effective working relationships with internal and external contacts.
* Maintain sensitive and confidential information regarding company information.
* Respond to change productively and handle other duties as required.
* Follow all company safety policies and procedures.


**Qualifications**
**EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE**
* University Degree in Engineering
* more than 7 years of experience in control systems engineering or related field or related experience and/or equivalent combination of education and experience


**Knowledge \& Skills**
* Have analytical skills to recognize patterns in data, information or events to draw logical conclusions and make recommendations for action.
* Ability to efficiently use all Microsoft Office products.
* Ability to operate test equipment and obtain measurements and data.
* To use established computer programs to input data, run queries and perform analysis.
* Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
* Provide limited technical knowledge in specific areas of engineering aspects.
* Demonstrated ability to continuously learn.
* Ability to read, speak, and write in English required.


**WORKING CONDITIONS**
 Work Environment: Proposal engineers typically work in an office setting, collaborating with various teams and departments within the organization. The work environment is professional and focused, with a mix of individual tasks and team meetings.
   

  

 Office Hours: The standard working hours for a Proposal Engineer are typically Monday to Friday (8 hours daily),. However, some flexibility in working hours may be required to accommodate client deadlines or project requirements.
   

  

 Travel: Proposal engineers may be required to travel occasionally to attend client meetings, pre\-bid discussions, industry conferences or to conduct site survey. The extent of travel may vary based on the nature of the projects and client locations.
   

  

 Deadlines: Proposal engineers often work under deadlines and face time\-sensitive fast track bids. This can lead to periods of high workload, especially when multiple proposals need to be prepared simultaneously. Effective time management and the ability to work well under pressure are essential skills for this role.
   

  

 Collaboration: Proposal engineers collaborate closely with sales teams, project managers, engineers, and other internal stakeholders. This involves effective communication, coordination, and the ability to work as part of a team.
   

  

**Additional Technical Knowledge \& Skills**
* Strong knowledge of Turbomachinery Control Systems, including compressor, gas turbine, and steam turbine control philosophies and operational requirements.
* Experience with Anti\-Surge Control (ASC) systems for centrifugal compressors, including surge curve interpretation, control valve sizing concepts, performance monitoring, and tuning methodologies.
* Knowledge of Gas Turbine Control Systems, including startup/shutdown sequences, fuel control, combustion management, load control, speed control, emissions control, and protection systems.
* Knowledge of Steam Turbine Control Systems, including governor control, speed/load control, extraction and admission control, overspeed protection, turbine supervision, and trip systems.
* Understanding of Compressor Control Applications, including capacity control, recycle control, performance optimization, and machinery protection integration.
* Familiarity with industry standards and practices related to turbomachinery control, machinery protection, and process automation.
* Knowledge of PLC systems, including system architecture, controller configuration, I/O design, redundancy concepts, and industrial automation applications.
* Experience with major automation platforms such as Allen\-Bradley (Rockwell), Siemens, Schneider Electric, GE, Honeywell, Yokogawa, Emerson DeltaV, and ABB is preferred.
* Knowledge of industrial communication protocols including Modbus RTU/TCP, OPC UA, OPC DA, Ethernet/IP, ProfiNet, ProfiBus, Foundation Fieldbus, HART, and Serial Communications.
* Understanding of control system networking, cybersecurity fundamentals, industrial Ethernet infrastructure, and remote monitoring solutions.
* Ability to analyze process dynamics and develop control strategies, perform control loop tuning, and support system troubleshooting and optimization activities.
* Ability to interpret P\&IDs and PFDs, control narratives, cause \& effect diagrams, instrument data sheets, and control system architecture drawings.
* Ability to perform technical evaluations of customer specifications and develop compliant automation and turbomachinery control system solutions.


**About Us**
 Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Associate Consultant – Sustainable Health
description:
Last date of application: 31st Oct 2026
   

  

**About Tarutium**
 Tarutium Global Consulting (pronounced as taru\-shee\-yum) delivers transformative insights, strategies, and solutions to drive sustainable, resilient, and inclusive global progress. Our mission is to \`bridge the Science\-Institutions\-Society interface with a core agenda of providing transformative solutions to the development challenges. Established in 1996 by eminent development professionals, it caters to a diverse range of bilateral and multi\-lateral agencies, government departments, corporations, and other development organizations through research, technology, solution innovations, and implementation support. Over the past two and a half decades, Tarutium has undertaken policy analysis, strategy development, action research, technical assistance, program design, project management support, assessments, and evaluations. We have addressed various institutional, financial, economic, social, and technical issues across diverse public systems, cultures, and corporate formations.
   

  

 Tarutium works in Africa, the Middle East, South Asia, and Southeast Asian countries like Afghanistan, Indonesia, Nepal, Bhutan, Maldives, UAE, Eswatini, Bangladesh, Tanzania, Myanmar and others. The organization is committed to quality, accuracy, and succinctness in its consulting and advisory services. Tarutium’s team of professionals has extensive national and international experience and a strong network of advisors, consultants, partner institutions, and associations worldwide. Our expertise spans critical sectors such as climate, disaster management, sustainability, infrastructure, urban services, social impact, economic growth, entrepreneurship, behaviour change, health, and more. By focusing on innovation and collaboration, we empower businesses, governments, foundations, and institutions with the knowledge, solutions, and tools they need to thrive in an ever\-changing global landscape.
   

  

 For more information, visit our website
 **www.tarutium.com**
**Duties And Responsibilities**
 Tarutium Global Consulting, through its Centre for Sustainable Health, is committed to advancing evidence\-based and equitable health solutions across India and globally. The organization works at the intersection of science, policy, and community systems, focusing on priority areas that address emerging and persistent health challenges. Tarutium’s key thematic areas include oral health; maternal and child health; and climate and health—covering disease surveillance, air quality, heat\-health, and climate\-sensitive diseases; occupational health; mental health; wellness and nutrition; senior health; and the integration of health and technology. These focus areas are approached through a systems thinking lens and implemented across both urban and rural contexts.
   

  

 In line with its strategic vision to scale and deepen impact, Tarutium is seeking to hire an Associate Consultant – Sustainable Health. This position will provide essential support to the organization’s growing portfolio in climate and health, wellness, and nutrition initiatives at the national, regional, and state levels. The Associate Consultant will work closely with cross\-functional teams and external stakeholders to drive program design, implementation, and evaluation while ensuring alignment with Tarutium’s core values of innovation, equity, and impact.
   

  

 The incumbent will play a critical role in leading and supporting diverse functions, including business development, proposal writing, project execution, stakeholder engagement, partnership cultivation, and client relations. Additionally, the role will contribute to knowledge management, team coordination, and the monitoring and reporting of activities. This is an exciting opportunity for a motivated and mission\-driven public health professional to contribute to transformative health initiatives and help shape Tarutium’s growing impact in sustainable public health systems.
   

  

**Key Functions**
 He/she will perform the following functions:
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
**Business Development**
* Support business development initiatives including concept note and proposal writing, and client relationship management.
* Support strategic partnership development with clients, donors, private sector entities, and other stakeholders.
* Develop innovative position papers, concept notes, and Terms of Reference aligned with the organization’s operational priorities.
* Strengthen the organization’s profile and visibility in the public health and development sector.


**Project Management**
* Design and implement impactful services and solutions within Tarutium’s core practice areas.
* Lead project implementation with a focus on technical delivery, reporting, budgeting, and monitoring \& evaluation.
* Manage relationships with clients, project teams, and stakeholders to ensure effective coordination and delivery.
* Undertake field visits to project locations, providing technical guidance and on\-ground support to improve performance.
* Collaborate with other practice areas and regional units to operationalize strategic plans, offering both logistical and technical inputs.
* Demonstrate accountability in decision\-making, efficient resource management, and adherence to organizational values.
* Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of ongoing projects across the organization to inform senior management effectively.
* Align work practices with Tarutium’s culture and leadership expectations.
* Undertake any additional responsibilities as assigned.


**Knowledge Works**
* Lead and support in knowledge creation and dissemination through articles, case studies, blogs, and technical papers in reputable platforms.
* Organize and actively participate in conferences, workshops, and seminars to connect with and contribute to academic and professional communities.


**Job Specification: Qualification \& Experience**
* Postgraduate or Professional degree in Public Health/BDS/Health Management or any other discipline relevant to this role from reputed institutes
* At least minimum 1\-3 years’ experience in the climate, health, and nutrition sector especially with national and international organizations.
* In\-depth knowledge of global and national climate, health, wellness, and nutrition issues reflected in articles, papers and technical documents published.
* Preference for technical skills in health system planning and management, health economics and financing; policy development, research, socio\-medical sciences, epidemiology, health education, health promotion and disease prevention, nutritional care, etc.
* Technical skills on data science tools including SPSS, Stata, NVivo, Biostatistics, Canva, etc.
* Proven experience in managing clients from government, private, and other sectors.
* Ability to conceptualize, innovate, plan, and execute ideas. Capacity to develop work plans, budgets, funding proposals.
* Proven skills in project management, quality assurance, setting standards, and monitoring.
* Demonstrated experience in actively participating in debates and influencing policies.
* High personal \& professional integrity. Team player and ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines. Problem solving attitude. Experience of managing teams and logistics
* Excellent networking and partnership building skills.
* Good analytical, knowledge management skills including writing, presentation skills and documentation.
* Excellent fluency in English. Able to communicate clearly and sensitively with internal and external stakeholders.

 : Attractive as per industry standards
   

  

**Location** 
 : Delhi, Hybrid
   

  

**Joining Date** 
 : Immediate

 **hr@tarutium.com** 
 with the subject “
 **CV for Associate Consultant\- Sustainable Health** 
 ”. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the interview

description:
**Company Description** 
 Amber Electrotech Ltd, founded in 1958 as an electrical contracting agency, has grown into a comprehensive turnkey solution provider for a wide range of electrical projects. The company delivers internal and external electrification and substation services, including high\-end and conventional solutions, and has expanded to a business of approximately $20 million. With a passionate team of engineers, Amber Electrotech focuses on providing best\-in\-class electrical services at competitive prices while consistently exceeding customer expectations. As a diversified turnkey provider, the company offers electrical techno\-commercial solutions and is equipped to manage stringent S.I.T.C requirements and related clearances from relevant electrical authorities.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site MEP Tendering role based in Okhla. The role involves preparing and reviewing tender documents, BOQs, and cost estimates for MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing) projects, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and alignment with client specifications. The MEP Tendering professional will coordinate with engineering, procurement, and project teams to gather technical inputs, clarify scope, and optimize pricing and solutions. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include analyzing drawings and specifications, obtaining vendor quotations, preparing techno\-commercial offers, and supporting negotiations and bid submissions. The role also includes maintaining tender documentation, tracking deadlines, and contributing to continuous improvement of tendering processes and templates.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong knowledge of MEP systems, including electrical distribution, HVAC, plumbing, and related building services.
* Experience in tendering, estimation, and BOQ preparation for MEP or electrical turnkey projects.
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, specifications, and standards.
* Proficiency with MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and familiarity with estimation or project management software.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Electrical, Mechanical, or related Engineering discipline.
* Excellent analytical, numerical, and problem\-solving skills, with attention to detail and accuracy.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills for working with cross\-functional teams, vendors, and clients.
* Prior experience in contracting or turnkey solution companies, especially in S.I.T.C projects, is an advantage.
* Ability to work on\-site in Okhla and manage multiple tenders and deadlines simultaneously.

title: Computer Engineering
description:
**Computer Engineering — AI Data Trainer**
**About The Role**
 We're looking for computer engineering experts to help train and improve the next generation of AI models. At Alignerr, we partner with the world's leading AI research labs — and your deep technical knowledge is exactly what's needed to make these systems smarter, more accurate, and more reliable.
   

  

 You'll stress\-test advanced language models on complex hardware and systems topics, expose their failure modes, and help build the ground\-truth solutions that shape how AI reasons about computer engineering.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Design Challenging Problems — Create advanced computer engineering scenarios spanning RISC\-V/ARM architecture, FPGA development, memory management, hardware\-software co\-design, embedded systems, and more
* Author Gold\-Standard Solutions — Write rigorous, step\-by\-step technical solutions including assembly code, HDL snippets, and architectural diagrams that serve as benchmarks for AI training
* Audit AI Outputs — Evaluate AI\-generated code (C/C\+\+, Verilog, VHDL), logic gate designs, and OS kernel implementations for technical accuracy, efficiency, and standards compliance
* Improve AI Reasoning — Identify flaws in AI\-generated reasoning — such as race conditions, memory leaks, or timing constraint violations — and provide structured feedback to improve model performance


**Who You Are**
* Pursuing or holding a Master's or PhD in Computer Engineering, Computer Science (hardware focus), or a closely related field
* Strong foundational knowledge in one or more of: Computer Architecture, Embedded Systems, Digital Logic Design, or Operating Systems
* Able to communicate complex hardware concepts and low\-level software logic clearly in writing
* Highly detail\-oriented — comfortable working at the level of bit operations, clock cycles, and technical documentation
* No prior AI experience required


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with data annotation, data quality, or AI evaluation workflows
* Proficiency in engineering tools such as MATLAB, ANSYS, or similar platforms
* Familiarity with IoT, networking, distributed systems, or hardware security domains


**Why Join Us**
* Work on cutting\-edge AI projects alongside top research labs and institutions
* Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule, from anywhere
* Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and collaboration with experts worldwide
* Gain rare, firsthand exposure to how advanced LLMs are built and trained
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

title: Manager
description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. Responsible Growth is how we run our company and how we deliver for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 One of the keys to driving Responsible Growth is being a great place to work for our teammates around the world. We’re devoted to being a diverse and inclusive workplace for everyone. We hire individuals with a broad range of backgrounds and experiences and invest heavily in our teammates and their families by offering competitive benefits to support their physical, emotional, and financial well\-being.
   

  

 Bank of America believes both in the importance of working together and offering flexibility to our employees. We use a multi\-faceted approach for flexibility, depending on the various roles in our organization.
   

  

 Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting \& Reconciliations, Management Reporting \& Analysis, Research \& Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support \& Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
   

  

 The CFOC (CFO Change) team, which is part of the COO \& Governance organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications. The CFO Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1\) understanding the Change, (2\) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3\) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams \& Users until implementation of the Change. It requires working closely with the Business Lead/Product Owner, including upstream / downstream Stakeholders and Technology to ensure all aspects of the change are being considered and prioritized when documenting the requirements. The business requirements are the foundation for the design, build, test, operational / organizational readiness, and deployment activities in the life cycle of a project.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Understanding the Regulatory Change and documenting detailed requirements. This includes functional capabilities, workflow needs, business rules, reporting requirements and timelines, etc. Collaborate with the Users \& procure all required sign offs.
* Identifying current state processes and the target state scope, objective and business outcomes of the Program/Project
* Identifying any data sourcing requirements, documenting them and coordinating with relevant Teams
* Understanding the in\-house GRIFFIN \& AXIOM design and documenting functional specifications in conjunction to the business requirements
* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.
* Collaborating with the test teams to clearly set the expectations from a Quality or User Acceptance Testing perspective.
* Regression before every code release into production.
* Facilitate review sessions with Business, Technology \& Testing Teams where relevant.


**Requirements\***
**Education\***
 Graduate degree in Commerce, Business or Technology.
   

  

 Certifications If Any \- AXIOM / Business Analysis etc.
   

  

**Experience Range\***
 7 to 10 years
   

  

**Foundational skills\***
* Experience as a Functional Business Analyst in technology implementation projects, having written Business requirement documents (BRDs)
* Extremely strong Knowledge of EMEA regulatory reports (COREP, Finrep, AnaCredit, ESG etc..) and Strong knowledge of financial concepts
* Ability to understand complex business processes and breakdown to process components.
* Demonstrate ability to work in a fast\-paced, every\-changing, highly collaborative environment.
* Strong knowledge of creating process maps
* Strong relationship management and interpersonal skills, ability to build strong rapport, respect and trust with key stakeholders and constituents.
* Professional written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent analytical skills and ability to identify/raise questions, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, and good with numbers
* Proficient with Microsoft Office products (particularly MS Excel, Word, Visio, PowerPoint)


**Desired Skills**
* Exposure to projects in Financial Accounting and reporting (in Financial Control / Product Control/Treasury), and/or in Risk Regulatory reporting (Market or Counterparty risk) in financial services industry
* Expertise in Axiom Regulatory platform (if possible, AXIOM certified)
* Knowledge of Banking and Capital market products
* Understanding of automation tools like Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI
* Knowledge/ Experience with Copilot/ Other AI tools usage in day\-to\-day BAU processes
* SQL, Database knowledge \& ability to analyze data and related flows
* Knowledge of Agile methodology and tools (i.e., JIRA)


**Work Timings\***
 11:30 am to 8:30 pm
   

  

**Job Location\***
 Gurugram/Mumbai

description:
**Job Description**
**Job Overview:**
 The JDE Finance Functional Consultant provides functional leadership and hands\-on support for JD Edwards EnterpriseOne financial processes. The role partners with Accounting, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Treasury, Tax, Project Controls and technical teams to sustain reliable transaction processing, period close, financial integrity and compliant change. The consultant combines strong accounting\-process knowledge with expert JDE configuration and troubleshooting capability.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Key Tasks and Responsibilities:**
* Provide Level 2 and Level 3 functional support for JDE EnterpriseOne financial modules and related integrations.
* Support General Accounting, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, cash or banking, allocations, multicurrency, tax and financial reporting processes based on assigned scope.
* Analyze posting, balancing, batch, voucher, invoice, receipt, payment and close issues; determine root cause and corrective action.
* Maintain and advise on financial configuration including companies, business units, object/subsidiary accounts, automatic accounting instructions, ledger types, document types, payment setup and period controls.
* Trace transactions from originating modules through account determination, batches and general ledger posting.
* Facilitate requirements workshops and develop functional designs, configuration workbooks, process flows, test scenarios and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with Supply Chain, Projects, Payroll, Tax and integration teams to manage cross\-module accounting impacts.
* Coordinate with JDE development and CNC/technical teams on reports, interfaces, batch jobs, custom applications, orchestrations and performance issues.
* Plan and execute unit, integration, regression and user acceptance testing with complete evidence and reconciliation.
* Support month\-end and year\-end close, releases, patches, upgrades, cutovers and post\-production stabilization.
* Assess application\-control and segregation\-of\-duties impacts for finance changes; support audit evidence and remediation.
* Create and maintain functional specifications, configuration documents, knowledge articles, runbooks and user guidance.


**Qualifications**
**Essential Qualifications and Education:**
* Degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Business Administration or a related field.
* 8\+ years of hands\-on JD Edwards EnterpriseOne Finance functional experience.
* Deep experience in General Accounting plus at least two of the following: Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Job Costing, cash/banking, multicurrency, tax or financial reporting.
* Strong understanding of accounting entries, subledger\-to\-ledger integration, reconciliations and period\-end processing.
* Hands\-on knowledge of JDE financial setup, processing options, versions, user\-defined codes, automatic accounting instructions and batch posting.
* Ability to analyze JDE tables, reports, batches and integrations to resolve complex production issues.
* Experience with JDE EnterpriseOne 9\.2 and modern UX or orchestration capabilities.
* Experience with requirements, functional specifications, testing, change management and support documentation.
* Exposure to banking interfaces, tax engines, consolidation, EPM and payroll integrations.
* Experience in a global, multi\-company and multicurrency environment.


 \#DICE
   

  

**About Us**
 Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.
   

  

 For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.

 We are a US\-based technology advisory team that runs IT integration for private equity acquisitions \- standing up network, security, identity, applications, and connectivity for newly acquired companies. We are looking for an Integration Support Coordinator based in India to work alongside us as a true team member.
   

  

 This role turns call transcripts, notes, and open action items into clean trackers, decks, and follow\-ups. Time zone overlap with the US team is limited, so you will work mostly from recordings and written context rather than live calls \- and you will be trusted to keep the plan moving without needing to be on every call.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role \- we need someone who catches issues early, keeps every workstream up to date, and makes sure open action items get closed.
   

  

 What You Will Own
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Integration Plan and Workstream Tracking**
* Maintain the master integration tracker across workstreams (network, cybersecurity, identity/devices, applications/email, connectivity, procurement)
* Update workstream status, dates, and owners after each call
* Track budget vs. actual hours by workstream and flag variances


**Call Follow\-Up and Action Items**
* Review call transcripts and recordings, extract action items, owners, and deadlines
* Log action items in the tracker and escalate stale ones
* Draft follow\-up emails and status recaps from template


**Deliverable and Deck Support**
* Build and update integration status slides for client and internal steering committee updates
* Assemble Day 1 and Day 100 plans, cutover checklists, and workstream trackers
* Maintain version control across decks for concurrent deals


**Program Management Support**
* Support running the same integration playbook across multiple concurrent acquisitions
* Track due diligence pipeline status for deals not yet in active integration
* Maintain the Context Index and file organization for integration artifacts


 What Great Looks Like:
   

  

* Turns transcripts and notes into accurate deliverables, no live call context needed
* Keeps trackers and decks current across every active deal \- no stale data
* Flags variances, blockers, and stale action items before they become problems
* Learns the playbook well enough to run it cleanly across multiple deals at once
* Communicates clearly and flags blockers or delays as soon as they come up


 What You Bring:
   

  

* 2\+ years in project/program coordination, PMO, or consulting support role \- ideally at a consulting, advisory, or professional services firm
* Comfort working from meeting transcripts and written notes rather than live call attendance
* Strong PowerPoint skills
* Comfort building and maintaining trackers, dashboards, and structured data views
* Excellent written English \- you'll be drafting emails and updates that go straight to clients
* Strong attention to detail and a low tolerance for stale or broken data
* Comfortable working independently on recurring tasks without much oversight
* Some overlap with US Eastern or Central time is preferred but not required
* Bonus: background in M\&A, IT integration, or program management


 Tools You Will Use
   

  

 Notion, SharePoint, Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel), call transcript tools (Fireflies or similar), AI (Copilot, Claude, etc.) and internal communication tools. You do not need to be an expert in all of these on day one, but you should be able to come up to speed quickly.
   

  

 We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.
   

  

**Our Benefits:**
 At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!
   

  

**How You Can Grow:**
 We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!
   

  

**More about Crowe:**
 Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.
   

  

 Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third\-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre\-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.

title: Document Controller & Platform Administrator (2-4 Years Experience)
description:
**Company Description** 





 Inkers Technology is based in Bengaluru with offices in USA and UAE. We specialise in designing and
 





 developing deep large\-scale AI and ML solutions for the Construction Industry. With a focus on AI,
 





 computer vision, and deep neural networks, we have extended our capabilities into the construction
 





 industry with our innovative AI\-powered construction management solution,
 
**“Kael”** 

 — an AI project manager that predicts delays, flags risks, automates reporting, and prevents cost overruns with
 





 real\-time construction intelligence. Our hardware platform,
 
**“Observance”** 

 , uses LiDAR scanning,
 





 thermal imaging, and AI\-powered analysis to deliver BIM Models, deviation detection, and as\-built
 





 intelligence. We are committed to pushing the boundaries of technology across diverse sectors.
 





  





**Role Description** 





 We are looking for a technically strong
 
**Document Controller \& Platform Administrator** 

 to manage the complete documentation lifecycle on our construction projects and to serve as the primary interface between the project team and our AI\-powered project management platform. This role is critical: nearly all other team members come from construction backgrounds, and this person will be relied upon to support, guide, and troubleshoot their interactions with the platform — ensuring all project data is accurate, timely, and enabling AI\-driven project intelligence. This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Ahmedabad.
 









**Responsibilities** 




**Platform Administration \& Team Enablement** 



* Act as the primary platform interface for all team members — civil, MEP, quality, safety, and design coordinators — supporting and guiding their day\-to\-day interactions with the platform.
* Ensure all relevant project documents are uploaded accurately and on time to enable AI validation, compliance checks, and document tracking.
* Configure and maintain document workflows, approval routing, and submission trackers within the platform.
* Monitor the completeness and accuracy of data entered by team members; flag gaps or inconsistencies to the Project Manager.
* Support onboarding and ongoing training of team members on platform workflows and document management procedures.
* Troubleshoot data entry issues and guide team members in correctly using the platform for their respective functions.



**Document Management \& Control** 



* Establish and maintain the project document management system (DMS), ensuring documents are correctly named, versioned, and archived.
* Control the receipt, registration, distribution, and archiving of all project documents including drawings, specifications, RFIs, submittals, contracts, and correspondence.
* Manage drawing revision control to ensure all site teams are working from the current approved revision at all times.
* Coordinate document review and approval cycles with clients, consultants, and contractors; track submission and response deadlines.
* Issue document transmittals and maintain a comprehensive transmittal register.



**Compliance, Reporting \& Handover** 



* Support RERA documentation workflows, ensuring project records remain audit\-ready for regulatory filings, milestone disclosures, and delivery commitments.
* Compile and maintain statutory document registers including permits, NOCs, authority approvals, and inspection certificates.
* Prepare documentation packages for client handover, third\-party audits, and RERA compliance reviews.
* Produce periodic document status and platform activity reports for the Project Manager and client.



  





**Qualifications** 



* 2–4 years of experience in document control, IT support, enterprise platform administration, or a closely related role. Experience on construction or infrastructure projects is an advantage but not mandatory.
* Degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
* Strong proficiency with digital document management systems (Aconex, Procore, ProjectWise, SharePoint, or equivalent).
* Comfortable learning and administering new SaaS or agentic platforms; prior experience with AI\-powered project tools is a plus.
* Ability to communicate technical platform concepts clearly to non\-technical construction professionals.
* Understanding of construction documentation workflows — drawing registers, RFI processes, submittal cycles — is preferred.
* Highly organised, detail\-oriented, and reliable with strong MS Office skills.



  





**Work Location : Ahmedabad (On\-site)**

* Generate reports and metrics related to document status, revisions, configuration baselines, and archive health.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives for document control, configuration management, and archival processes.

title: Business Consultant
description:
**About the Role** 




  





 We're looking for Franchise Business Consultant to join our franchise consulting team and take independent ownership of client engagements — from financial modeling and investor presentations to franchise development strategy.
 



  





 This is not an entry\-level or trainee position: we need someone who can walk into a client meeting, understand their business, and come back with a franchise model that holds up under scrutiny.
 



  





 If you have an MBA, a commerce background, sharp written English, and Minimum 3 years of experience in consulting, business analysis, or franchise development — this role is built for you.
 



  





 What You'll Own
 



  




1. **Franchise Business Modeling \& Financials** 
 – Independently build financial models, ROI projections, and cash flow forecasts for clients looking to franchise their business.
2. **Investor \& Client Presentations** 
 – Design and deliver polished pitch decks and investor presentations that clients can take straight to franchisees or investors.
3. **Client\-Facing Consulting** 
 – Lead client discovery sessions, break\-out meetings, and discovery day programs — explaining strategy and franchise structuring directly to business owners, not just supporting senior consultants.
4. **Report Writing \& Research** 
 – Own end\-to\-end market research, feasibility studies, and franchise structure reports across retail, F\&B, education, and services sectors.
5. **Franchise Documentation** 
 – Build and finalize franchise offering documents, operating manuals, and SOPs for franchisor clients.
6. **Proposal \& Sales Support** 
 – Write client proposals and collaborate with the sales team on documentation and deal requirements.
7. **Relationship Management** 
 – Independently manage ongoing client relationships and deliverables without requiring day\-to\-day oversight.
8. **Team Guidance** 
 – Mentor and review the work of Business Consultant Interns supporting your engagements.



  





**Who We're Looking For** 




  




* 3 years of relevant experience in business consulting, franchise development, market research, or financial analysis. Freshers with exceptional internship track records in this exact domain may be considered.
* MBA graduate with a BCom/BBA/commerce undergraduate background (strongly preferred over engineering/science/arts backgrounds, given the financial modeling core to this role).
* Excellent written and spoken English — this role requires representing the company directly in front of clients and investors.
* Strong command of Excel, PowerPoint, and Word; demonstrated ability to build financial models and investor\-ready decks independently.
* Working knowledge of business laws and procedures relevant to franchising (preferred).
* Based in Bangalore or willing to relocate immediately; must be comfortable working from our Race Course Road office, 6 days a week (Monday–Saturday).



  





**Not a Fit If:** 



* You're looking for an IT/ITES analyst role — this is unrelated to that domain.
* You don't have a commerce/finance foundation and haven't worked with financial models before.
* You're not comfortable owning client relationships independently.



  





 Compensation
 



 Competitive, commensurate with experience — to be discussed based on your consulting/analyst background.
 



  





 To Apply
 



 Interested candidates should send a detailed email explaining why this role fits their profile, along with their CV, to
 **human.resources@franchisebazar.com** 
 .
 



  





 Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for a discussion.

description:

 We believe in incentives, love to travel and are a happy bunch of passionate people working towards delivering some of the most exciting B2B events around the world. We are looking for a conference producer to work on our existing events and curate new events that can grow and become strong brands. **Key job responsibilities include:** 




  





*Research:* 
 Carry out in\-depth research with key stakeholders in the industry and interpreting results into commercially compelling conference programs.
 



  





*Sales and Marketing:* 
 Putting the sales and marketing brief together in a visually attractive presentation and sharing key insights for sales team to drive revenue targets. Your event should be differentiated from competition.

 Identifying, profiling, and inviting C level executives and decision\-makers from the community (government, corporates, association, and media) and maintain long term relationships. Identifying right media partners and associations for the event and ensuring fruitful partnership that result in growth and credibility of events.
 



  





*Agenda Management:* 
 Write a highly compelling strategic and commercially driven agenda based on both primary and secondary research.
 



  





*Content development:* 
 Write promotional copy in the form of website copy, weekly email campaigns, press releases, brochure content, newsletters, etc. to drive awareness and stimulate bookings.
 



  





*Teamwork:* 
 Work closely with sales, social media, operations, creative design, and events team to ensure timely updates are made and a constant buzz is created around the event with latest updates.
 



  





*Productivity management:* 
 Ensure all KPIs are met, and internal and external communication is timely and contributing to the company’s mission of driving excellence.
 



  





*Pre event coordination:* 
 Ensure all relevant information needed from speakers and media partners.
 



  





*Onsite delivery:* 
 Working with the onsite team to ensure flawless delivery of the event. This includes a lot of attention to details, time management and developing client relationships.
 



  





*Post show report:* 
 Managing the post event work: thank you letters, report, website updates, brochure, and email campaigns.

* *The candidate must have a minimum of 12 months experience in producing conferences.*
* *Strong research skills and ability to speak to C\-level executives and Government professionals over phone and in person meetings.*

title: Customer Success Executive – Client & Partner Operations
description:
Customer Success Executive – Client \& Partner Operations
   


**Bengaluru (HSR Layout) · On\-site, 5 days · Immediate joiners preferred** 
  




 About Finkraft
   


 Finkraft is a Bengaluru\-based travel\-fintech recovering money that large enterprises silently lose every year in their expense and compliance processes. We work with
 **1,250\+ enterprise clients** 
 , including
 **HCL, Philips, Volkswagen, Cipla, BCG, Tata Communications, JSW, Cleartrip and BCD** 
 — Fortune 500 manufacturers, global consulting firms and India's largest IT services and travel companies.
   





 For a single client this runs into crores a year. We've built the platform and the data engine. What turns it into recovered money is a network of partner businesses doing their part — and that is the function you'd be joining.
   




 Role \& responsibilities
   

* **Own a partner portfolio end to end.** 
 You're the single point of contact for your set of partner businesses — onboarding them, getting them transacting, and keeping the relationship warm enough that next month is easier than this one.
* **Drive high\-volume outbound follow\-ups.** 
 This is a phone\-first role: 60–90 conversations a day with operations staff, finance teams and business owners to close out pending documentation and commitments.
* **Escalate and unblock.** 
 When a partner who committed three weeks ago goes quiet, there's no escalation matrix handed to you. You work out who in that organisation can actually say yes, and you get to them — by phone, by WhatsApp, or by showing up.
* **Onboard new partners onto the platform,** 
 walking them through the process and getting them to first transaction quickly.
* **Conduct on\-ground visits across Bengaluru** 
 where a face across the table moves things faster than a call — to onboard, unblock, or repair a stalled relationship.
* **Resolve client escalations.** 
 When an enterprise client flags something missing, you're the person who chases it down, fixes it, and reports back.
* **Coordinate internally** 
 with data, product and operations teams to close cases that need more than a follow\-up.
* **Maintain accurate, current records.** 
 Every commitment, follow\-up and outcome logged — what we report to our clients is only as good as your tracker.


 Requirements
   

  

 Education \& eligibility
   

* **Any graduate.** 
 Stream and institution are not filters — we hire on capability, not credentials.
* **Fluent English and Hindi** 
 on the phone, with the confidence to hold a commercial conversation with a business owner or finance controller. Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi or Bengali is a genuine advantage and we weight it in selection.
* **Working comfort with Excel / Google Sheets** 
 — filters, lookups, and a tracker you keep clean without being asked.
* **Based in Bengaluru or willing to relocate,** 
 available to work 5 days a week from our HSR Layout office.
* **Immediate or 15\-day joiners preferred.**


 Preferred background
   


**1\+ year in an outbound, outcome\-owned role.** 
 Industry doesn't matter. What matters is that you were measured on whether the thing happened — not on how many calls you logged.
   





 Backgrounds that map well:
   




* Customer success or post\-sales, where renewals and adoption were yours to hit
* Collections and recovery — B2B, consumer, or NBFC
* Fee and payment recovery in edtech
* B2B inside sales or account management
* Client servicing in a role where you chased external stakeholders for deliverables


 Benefits
   

  

 Why this role is worth your time
   


 This isn't a support function sitting downstream of the business. It is one of our two largest revenue lines, and the difference between a portfolio worked well and one worked badly shows up directly in what we bill and what our clients get back. You'll deal with finance and operations leaders at Fortune 500 companies, and you'll see the outcome of your own work in a number every month.
   





 Growth from here runs into account ownership, partner management, and team leadership as the function scales. We'd rather promote from here than hire above it.

title: Senior Principal Presales Sol Architect - Hybrid Cloud
description:
**What success looks like in this role:**

We are seeking a Principal Presales Solution Architect to lead the design and sales strategy for enterprise hybrid cloud managed services. This role combines deep technical architecture with commercial acumen, cost modeling expertise, and hands\-on proficiency with Gen AI tools. You will design end\-to\-end solutions integrating on\-premises datacenters with public cloud platforms (Azure/AWS), author compelling technical proposals, build financial business cases, and influence enterprise deals worth $5–$20M\+. You'll partner closely with sales, delivery, and executive leadership to win transformational opportunities and establish the foundation for successful delivery.


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Solution Architecture \& Design**

* Lead enterprise discovery and requirements\-gathering sessions to understand hybrid cloud infrastructure, operational challenges, and strategic objectives
* Design comprehensive hybrid cloud managed services solutions spanning datacenter operations, infrastructure management (compute, storage, network, security), cloud migration, workload modernization, and operational transformation
* Develop detailed solution architecture documents, technical roadmaps, and implementation playbooks that align with customer maturity levels, budgets, and timelines
* Present solutions to CXO\-level and technical audiences, translating technical capabilities into quantifiable business outcomes (cost savings, operational efficiency, risk reduction, time\-to\-value)

**Cost Modeling \& Financial Analysis**

* Develop detailed cost models and ROI analyses for hybrid cloud solutions, including infrastructure, migration, operational, licensing, and transformation costs
* Build bottom\-up cost estimates from workload assessments, capacity planning, and service delivery models
* Create financial scenarios and sensitivity analyses demonstrating value across different investment horizons and business contexts
* Use cost modeling as a consultative tool to influence solution scope, platform selection, and service delivery approach
* Validate cost assumptions with delivery and finance teams to ensure proposals are realistic, defensible, and profitable post\-signature

**Technical Proposal Development**

* Develop executive summaries, solution architecture diagrams, implementation timelines, resource plans, risk mitigation strategies, and success metrics
* Articulate how our integrated delivery model, service maturity, and methodologies address customer technical and operational requirements
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders (delivery, engineering, security, finance) to validate assumptions and ensure delivery feasibility
* Use Gen AI tools (e.g. Microsoft Copilot) daily to accelerate documentation, refine technical language, synthesize complex requirements, and improve proposal quality and turnaround time
* Leverage AI\-assisted analysis to generate comparative assessments, identify solution gaps, and build persuasive narratives

**Delivery Partnership \& Post\-Sales Success**

* Partner with delivery leadership to ensure presales solutions are feasible, cost\-effective, and aligned with our integrated delivery model and service playbook
* Author transition documents, delivery roadmaps, and transformation playbooks that guide delivery teams and set customer expectations
* Participate in solution kickoffs and steering meetings to ensure alignment between promised outcomes and execution
* Gather post\-engagement feedback to refine solution approaches, cost models, and service maturity

\#LI\-SS1


**You will be successful in this role if you have:**

**Experience*** 8–12 years in IT architecture, systems integration, or presales solutions roles
* Minimum 5 years focused on hybrid cloud, infrastructure modernization, or managed services
* Demonstrated track record of winning enterprise deals or leading complex solution designs that influenced outcomes
* Proven expertise developing cost models, financial analyses, and ROI scenarios for infrastructure and cloud solutions
* Track record authoring technical RFP responses and proposals that have directly influenced deal wins or negotiations
* Experience designing or delivering integrated IT service models spanning infrastructure, cloud, applications, and operations

**Technical Expertise**

* Deep knowledge of hybrid cloud platforms: Azure (preferred) and/or AWS, including IaaS, PaaS, governance, and cost management
* Strong understanding of datacenter operations, infrastructure as code (IaC), automation, and modern operational practices (AIOps, observability)
* Hands\-on familiarity with infrastructure: virtualization, storage, networking, security, disaster recovery in on\-premises and cloud environments
* Experience with migration methodologies (6R framework), workload assessment, and modernization strategies
* Proficient use of Gen AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot) in daily architecture and proposal work as integrated productivity tools, not novelties
* Demonstrated ability to use AI tools for solution design iterations, requirement synthesis, proposal acceleration, and analysis

**Business \& Soft Skills**

* Exceptional communication and presentation skills; ability to translate complex technical concepts for C\-level executives and diverse stakeholders
* Strong consultative and discovery capabilities; ability to identify and quantify hidden customer pain points
* Results\-oriented; ability to manage multiple concurrent opportunities and prioritize for maximum impact
* Collaborative; comfortable influencing outcomes across sales, delivery, marketing, finance, and executive teams
* Strategic thinking; ability to align solutions to organizational transformation goals and business context
* Financial acumen and comfort with cost modeling, margin analysis, and understanding solution design's impact on profitability

**Certifications \& Nice\-to\-Haves**

* Cloud certifications: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Solutions Architect Professional, or equivalent
* ITIL, COBIT, or service management frameworks
* Experience in GTM strategy, services pricing models, or business development
* Familiarity with capability maturity models (CMM, CMMI) or service delivery frameworks
* Prior experience at MSP or system integrator
* Experience with cost modeling tools (Excel, Planful, ServiceNow, or similar)
* Published thought leadership or speaking on hybrid cloud strategy or Gen AI in architecture

Industry Solution Leaders combine deep industry and engineering expertise with end\-to\-end ownership of customer solutions. They are expected to understand a customer's operations deeply enough to challenge assumptions, identify and quantify the highest\-value opportunities, define the right technical solution, and lead cross\-functional teams through design, deployment, validation, and scale.

The ideal candidate brings significant hands\-on experience in engineering, manufacturing, operations, reliability, or maintenance and has the technical judgment, customer leadership, and delivery ownership required to lead complex enterprise AI solutions from problem definition through production.



The ISL, Oil, Gas \& Chemical \- Refining / Chemical Asset Performance should have **hands\-on experience working inside a refinery, chemical plant, or similar continuous\-process facility, including distillation, reactors, furnaces, compressors, heat exchangers, or utilities, with ownership of throughput, yield, energy, APC/process control, or reliability outcomes.**

title: Director, Technical Program Management
description:
**Job Description**  

As a Technical Project Manager, you will serve as the strategic connective tissue between product strategy and cross\-functional execution. This is a principal\-level, hands\-on leadership role. You are accountable for the delivery of the organization’s most complex, high\-revenue initiatives \- not for reporting on them \- and you carry the dates yourself.


You will guide a team responsible for architecting the Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC) framework and providing the operational infrastructure required to scale. You will be responsible for the integrity of the delivery process \- managing the interdependencies between Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Commercial teams. You ensure that the company’s most significant investments are delivered with transparency, alignment, and high impact.


Greenfield initiatives are where this role earns its keep. New programs receive dedicated senior ownership rather than shared program management capacity borrowed across unrelated engineering projects. On these builds you set the plan, hold the commitments, remove blockers directly where you can, and escalate with a recommendation and a recovery path where you cannot.


Your success in this role will be measured by the increased velocity, predictability, and transparency of our most critical product investments.

* Significant increase in the percentage of top initiatives delivered on time and within scope.
* Reduction in the "administrative tax" on Product Managers, as measured by time reclaimed from manual reporting and tool maintenance.
* Improved internal satisfaction scores from Engineering, Data Science, and Commercial leaders regarding the clarity and reliability of the delivery pipeline.
* Greenfield initiatives hitting their committed launch dates, with this role personally accountable for those commitments.


Level, Location, and Scope

* Level. Principal\-level. This is a senior individual leadership role, comparable in scope to an L7 Principal Technical Program Manager at a large technology company.
* Location. Bangalore\-based, most of the engineering, product and data science team are also based in India.
* Dedication. Fully dedicated to Product Operations and the greenfield portfolio. This is not a shared resource split across multiple engineering projects.

  

Key Responsibilities

* Update and maintain a scalable Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC) that bridges the gap between high\-level roadmaps and delivery.
* Establish standardized stage\-gates and "Definition of Ready/Done" criteria to ensure Engineering and Data Science receive high\-quality, actionable requirements.
* Conduct quarterly audits of the delivery pipeline to identify friction points, automate manual handoffs, and reduce lead time without over\-engineering the process.
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of the "Top 20" initiatives \- those involving 3\+ functional teams or multi\-million revenue impact \- from post\-PRD alignment through launch. You hold the timeline and are answerable when it moves.
* Actively unblock the work. Identify and resolve cross\-team resource conflicts and technical dependencies between Product, Tech, Data Science, and Operations, driving each issue to a decision rather than routing it onward.
* Stand up greenfield programs from zero: scope, sequencing, staffing needs, operating cadence, and launch criteria, with no existing process to inherit.
* Engage directly with Engineering and Data Science on architecture, data pipeline, and integration tradeoffs at enough depth to pressure\-test estimates and challenge plans credibly.
* Escalate to executive leadership with a recommendation and a recovery plan attached, not a status color.
* Serve as the primary operational point of contact for high\-value client steering committees and strategic data vendors (e.g., Netflix, Amazon) to ensure technical integrations stay on schedule.
* Design and own the executive dashboarding strategy, providing a "single source of truth" for product health (adoption, retention) and delivery health (predictability, throughput).
* Ensure Jira and Confluence are configured to provide clean, automated reporting, eliminating the need for Product Managers to manually aggregate status updates.
* Provide quarterly insights to the C\-suite on execution trends, highlighting areas where resource reallocation may be necessary to meet Op Plan goals.
* Oversee the administration and configuration of Jira, Confluence, and associated add\-ons to support a unified workflow across the department.
* Evaluate and implement emerging tools (AI\-assisted productivity, roadmap visualization) that enhance the productivity of the Product and Tech teams.
* Maintain the centralized repository of best practices, templates, and guidelines that standardize how the organization builds and launches products.
* Lead quarterly training sessions to ensure new hires and existing team members are proficient in the PDLC and operational tools, ensuring a consistent culture of execution.

 **Qualifications*** 15\+ years of experience in Product Operations, Technical Program Management, or Product Management, with at least 5 years operating at a principal or director level. For calibration: comparable in scope and seniority to an L7 Principal TPM at a company such as Amazon.
* Proven track record of managing "Top\-Tier" strategic initiatives that require the synchronization of cross\-functional areas (e.g., Engineering, Data Science, Operations, and Sales).
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing a Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC) in a growth\-stage or enterprise technology environment.
* Demonstrated ownership of greenfield, 0\-to\-1 programs where the plan, process, and cadence did not yet exist and had to be built.
* A track record of unblocking rather than tracking. Be ready to describe specific technical and organizational blockers you personally cleared, and launch dates you were held to.
* Technical fluency sufficient to hold a credible conversation with Engineering and Data Science leaders about architecture, data pipelines, and integration risk.
* Strong ability to translate raw delivery data into executive\-level insights. Experience building automated dashboards that track both business health (KPIs) and delivery health (velocity, lead time).
* Exceptional ability to build consensus and maintain high\-trust partnerships across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Customer Success and Commercial leadership.
* A passion for process as an enabler, not a hurdle. You should have a reputation for making the teams around you faster and more effective.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree is a plus.
* Professional certifications in Program Management (PMP, PgMP) are welcomed but secondary to proven real\-world results.

 **Additional Information**  

Please be aware that job\-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

title: Production Planning & Control

We are seeking a highly driven Production Planning \& Control (PPC) specialist with 5 to 6 years of core experience in Automobile, Aerospace, or High\-Reliability Electronics Manufacturing. In this role, you will lead end\-to\-end operational planning, from Material Requirement Planning (MRP) and Master Production Scheduling (MPS) down to shop\-floor execution. You will act as the operational nerve center, managing cross\-functional workflows across component sourcing, PCBA manufacturing, box\-build integration, and Environmental Stress Screening (ESS). Furthermore, you will serve as a key liaison aligning top management strategies, sales targets, and customer delivery commitments with real\-time manufacturing capacity.  

  

**Desired Experience:**  

  

* Industry Exposure: 5 to 6 years of hands\-on PPC experience in Aerospace \& Defence, Automotive, or EMS (Electronic Manufacturing Services) operating under AS9100D, IATF 16949, or ISO 9001 quality frameworks.
* Proven track record in managing high\-mix, low\-to\-medium volume manufacturing, PCBA manual assembly, wiring harness, System\-level mechanical integration \& Manufacturing, Supply chain.
* Direct exposure to testing workflows, acceptances, and Environmental Stress Screening (ESS) environments (thermal cycling, ESS, vibration, and functional testing).
* Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in ERP/MRP systems, advanced Excel macros/data analytics, BOM management, clear\-to\-build (CTB) tracking, and capacity planning.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

  

* Master Scheduling \& Shop\-Floor Planning: Develop, maintain, and execute Master Production Schedules (MPS) and Material Requirement Plans (MRP) for SMT/PCBA assembly, mechanical integration, and final testing to ensure 100% On\-Time Delivery (OTD).
* Cross\-Functional Operations Liaison:
* Manufacturing \& Assembly: Coordinate with production and engineering teams to optimize line balancing, eliminate shop\-floor bottlenecks, and track daily output against target routings.
* Supply Chain \& Materials Management: Partner with SCM, stores, and procurement to monitor component lead times, track critical active/passive electronic components, verify CTB readiness, and optimize store kitting processes.
* Testing \& ESS Integration: Plan and route assemblies through functional testing, screening, and ESS labs to prevent testing backlogs and maintain steady WIP throughput.
* Strategic \& Customer Interfacing:
* Top Management Engagement: Prepare daily/weekly progress dashboards, WIP reports, capacity utilization matrices, and delay analysis reports for executive reviews.
* Sales \& Customer Touchpoints: Serve as the primary operational contact for the sales team and clients to provide accurate Lead Time estimates (ATP/CTP), order tracking, and delivery timelines.
* Process \& Inventory Control: Control Work\-in\-Progress (WIP) levels, reduce inventory carrying costs, enforce strict engineering change order (ECO) controls, and drive continuous improvement through Lean and 5S initiatives on the shop floor.
