title: Senior Manager – Manufacturing & Service
description:
**Job Title:** Senior Manager – Manufacturing \& Service**Location:** Bangalore (On\-site)**About Us**
------------


At Teachmint, we believe that education moves the world forward and deserves the best technology in this pursuit. We are a global classroom technology company empowering educators and institutions in over 50 countries. At the forefront of classroom innovation, Teachmint is transforming how education is delivered through its proprietary solutions—Teachmint X, an AI\-powered digital board; EduAI, an intelligent AI companion that empowers educators and learners to become self\-reliant; and our interactive whiteboard technology, designed to blend intelligence with usability and elevate every moment of classroom interaction.
We are redefining education infrastructure. Whether you're architecting backend systems, designing intuitive front\-end experiences, improving deployment pipelines, driving business growth and brand visibility, or scaling user impact—your work here directly shapes the future of education.
If you’re excited by the idea of building smart, scalable, and meaningful solutions in education, come create with us. Learn more:http://teachmint.com/http://teachmint.com**About the Role**
------------------


The Senior Manager – Manufacturing \& Service will own end\-to\-end manufacturing quality, localisation, and after\-sales service operations for Teachmint's hardware products across partner factories and service centres. This role carries full ownership of workflows at partner sites — from factory qualification, BOM/SOP creation, and manufacturing quality, to service centre performance and field support. The Senior Manager will lead an internal team and own workflows at partner factories and service centres to drive continuous improvement across the manufacturing and service network.**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


**Manufacturing Quality \& Localization*** Audit and qualify supplier\-factory combinations against Teachmint's quality and capability standards
* Own creation and maintenance of SKU\-wise BOMs and SOPs across the product portfolio
* Own IQC, Line QC, OQC, and PDI processes end\-to\-end
* Identify localization opportunities and drive direct sourcing to grow Local BOM
* Lead RCAs for field failures and drive closure of factory\-level corrective actions


**Service Centre Ownership*** Own end\-to\-end workflows at partner service centres — intake, repair TAT, spares availability, and quality of repairs
* Set and monitor service SLAs and drive performance reviews with service partners
* Feed field/service data back into manufacturing RCAs and design improvements
* Build a scalable service operations framework as hardware volumes grow


**Team \& Stakeholder Management*** Manage \& upskill a team of 4\-6 across on\-ground services, manufacturing operations and service centre operations
* Partner with sourcing, product, and design teams to align on quality and localization roadmaps
* Represent manufacturing \& service in leadership reviews, owning metrics and improvement plans


**Continuous Improvement*** Drive structured quality improvement programs across factories and service centres
* Build Teachmint's independent quality capability, reducing reliance on supplier documentation and training

**Key Requirements**
--------------------

* 7–10 years of experience in EMS/electronics manufacturing quality, with prior exposure to service or after\-sales operations
* Proven experience managing teams and cross\-functional stakeholders in a manufacturing or hardware environment
* Strong track record in factory audits, line quality, and BOM/SOP ownership
* Experience setting up or managing service centre operations, SLAs, and partner performance
* Excellent data analysis, reporting, and executive communication skills
* Comfort operating with high ownership in a fast\-scaling, lean team environment

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience in localization or Make\-in\-India (MII) initiatives
* Exposure to both ODM and OEM manufacturing models
* Prior experience building or scaling a quality/service function from the ground up

**Travel Requirement**
----------------------


Frequent travel to Indian factories, suppliers, and service centres; occasional travel to Chinese suppliers.**Why Join Us**
---------------

* Own manufacturing and service outcomes end\-to\-end for Teachmint's hardware business
* Build and lead a team shaping Teachmint's independent quality, localization, and service capability
* Directly influence product reliability, margins, and customer satisfaction at scale
* High\-visibility role with a seat in leadership reviews and cross\-functional strategy

*Disclaimer: Kindly note that Teachmint Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. We are dedicated to providing equal opportunities in all aspects of employment, including recruitment, training, and development of employees, which encompasses promotions, transfers, assignments, and various benefits. Teachmint Technologies strictly prohibits discrimination in the workplace based on color, disability, marital status, nationality, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national or ethnic origins, religious beliefs, or age.*

title: SENIOR SALES/BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT (CREATIVE AGENCY )
description:
**Business Development Executive / Senior Business Development Executive (AGENCY SALES)**

**(BDE/Senior BDE) – Hashtag Inc**

**Experience:** 2–8 years ( Must have Agency's creative ecosystem)

**Location:** Bangalore

At Hashtag, the **BDE** is responsible for bringing the next wave of brands into the agency.

You don't just generate leads. You know where the opportunities are, who to speak to, how to open the conversation, and how to turn a business need into a pitch worth winning.

You'll own the new\-business pipeline \- from **prospecting and relationship\-building to discovery, pitching, negotiation and closure**. You'll work closely with our leadership, strategy, creative, content, design, production, web and performance teams to build solutions that make commercial sense and give clients a reason to choose Hashtag.

You understand that selling a creative agency is different from selling a product. You're selling **thinking, ideas, capability, trust and business outcomes**.

And once you build a relationship, you don't disappear after the deal. You help create a strong foundation for the account and look for opportunities to grow the relationship.

If you're someone who can **open doors, create demand, lead conversations and close business**, this is your role.

**What You'll Do**

**Own New Business**

* Own Hashtag's new\-business pipeline across relevant industries and categories.
* Identify high\-value prospects and build a targeted business development plan.
* Research brands, businesses, decision\-makers, marketing activity and competitive landscape.
* Proactively create opportunities rather than relying only on inbound leads.
* Build relationships with Founders, CMOs, Marketing Heads, Brand Heads and other senior decision\-makers.
* Develop a strong network within the brand, marketing and business ecosystem.

**Create Opportunities**

* Generate qualified leads through outbound prospecting, referrals, networking, LinkedIn, events and industry relationships.
* Identify businesses that could benefit from Hashtag's capabilities before a formal requirement comes in.
* Monitor new launches, business expansions, category movements and marketing activity to identify potential opportunities.
* Convert cold conversations into meaningful discovery meetings.
* Qualify opportunities based on business need, scope, budget, timelines and decision\-making structure.

**Lead the Sales Conversation**

* Lead discovery conversations and uncover the real business and marketing challenge behind a requirement.
* Understand where Hashtag can create value across **strategy, campaigns, content, social, film, design, digital, web and performance**.
* Develop the right approach with internal teams rather than simply forwarding a client brief.
* Bring strategic and commercial thinking into pitch opportunities.
* Present Hashtag's capabilities and solutions confidently to senior stakeholders.
* Own the conversation from **"Who are you?" to "Let's work together."**

**Win the Pitch**

* Lead the end\-to\-end business development process from opportunity identification to closure.
* Coordinate with Strategy, Creative, Content, Design, Production, Web and Performance teams for pitches.
* Ensure proposals, presentations and commercials are aligned with the client's business requirement.
* Present and defend the agency's thinking and value proposition.
* Handle commercial discussions, negotiations and objections.
* Build proposals that balance **client value, creative ambition and agency profitability**.
* Maintain momentum and ownership until the deal is closed.

**Build Senior\-Level Relationships**

* Develop long\-term relationships with key decision\-makers.
* Become a trusted point of contact even before an active requirement exists.
* Stay connected with prospects through regular, relevant conversations.
* Build relationships beyond a single opportunity or project.
* Generate referrals and introductions through existing relationships.
* Represent Hashtag at industry events, networking forums and relevant business communities.

**Grow the Business**

* Look beyond individual projects and identify opportunities for larger engagements and retainers.
* Identify cross\-sell opportunities across Hashtag's capabilities.
* Work with the Account Management / Brand Partner team to create a smooth transition after closure.
* Stay connected with key accounts where appropriate to identify future opportunities.
* Contribute ideas that strengthen Hashtag's overall new\-business strategy.

**Own the Numbers**

* Take ownership of business development targets and revenue contribution.
* Maintain a healthy pipeline across different stages of the sales funnel.
* Track leads, meetings, qualified opportunities, pitches, proposals, negotiations and closures.
* Maintain accurate CRM / business development trackers.
* Forecast potential closures and communicate pipeline movement to leadership.
* Analyse what is converting, what isn't and continuously improve the sales approach.

**What Success Looks Like**

* A strong, consistent pipeline of qualified new\-business opportunities.
* Regular conversations with relevant decision\-makers across target brands.
* Consistent conversion of prospects into qualified briefs and pitch opportunities.
* New clients and revenue brought into Hashtag.
* Strong relationships with senior marketing and business stakeholders.
* Successful pitches that demonstrate both creative value and commercial understanding.
* Healthy conversion rates across the sales funnel.
* A predictable pipeline rather than last\-minute dependence on opportunities.
* New relationships that continue beyond the first project.
* Hashtag is increasingly getting into conversations with brands that previously weren't on the agency's radar.

**Who You Are**

* **4–7 years of experience** in Business Development, Sales, Client Acquisition or Agency New Business.
* Strong experience in a **creative, advertising, digital, branding, media or marketing agency** is preferred.
* Proven experience in generating and closing new business.
* Comfortable selling creative and marketing solutions rather than standardised products.
* Strong understanding of brands, marketing and the agency ecosystem.
* Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Comfortable speaking with senior stakeholders and decision\-makers.
* Commercially sharp and comfortable discussing budgets, commercials and value.
* Strong relationship\-builder with an active professional network.
* Persistent, proactive and highly self\-driven.
* Able to understand a business problem and translate it into an opportunity for Hashtag.
* Strong follow\-through and excellent pipeline discipline.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, target\-driven creative environment.

**Nice\-to\-Haves**

* Existing relationships with CMOs, Marketing Heads, Brand Heads, Founders or business owners.
* Proven experience closing **retainer / AOR / integrated creative mandates**.
* Experience selling integrated agency solutions across creative, digital, social, content, film and performance.
* Experience managing large\-value pitches and negotiations.
* Strong industry network across FMCG, Automotive, Real Estate, BFSI, Hospitality, Technology, Healthcare or other major categories.
* Experience mentoring or guiding junior BDEs.
* Experience building a new\-business strategy or sales playbook.

**The Vibe**

* **Own the number. Own the relationship. Own the opportunity.**
* Work directly with leadership and the agency's creative ecosystem.
* Access the full power of Hashtag — strategy, content, creative, design, film, web and performance.
* Build relationships with ambitious brands across categories.
* Have the freedom to find opportunities and create conversations.
* Grow from Senior BDE into a **Business Development Manager / Business Head** role.

**This isn't a lead\-generation job.**

It's about knowing **where the business is, finding the right doors, getting them open and making Hashtag impossible to ignore.**

**Find the opportunity. Build the relationship. Lead the pitch. Win the business.**

**Come build with us.**

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹100,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Designer, Brand & Communications
description:
Candescent is a forward\-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in\-person channels.


Our Experience\-Led, Intelligence\-Driven approach combines human\-centered design with data, automation, and cloud\-based innovation. Built on an API\-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.


About Candescent


Candescent is the leading cloud\-based digital banking solutions provider for financial institutions. We are transforming digital banking with intelligent, cloud\-powered solutions that connect account opening, digital banking, and branch experiences for financial institutions. Our advanced technology and developer tools enable seamless, differentiated customer journeys that elevate trust, service, and innovation.


Success here requires flexibility in a fast\-paced environment, a client\-first mindset, and a commitment to delivering consistent, reliable results as part of a performance\-driven, value\-led team. With team members around the world, Candescent is an equal opportunity employer.

**Designer, Brand \& Communications**
=====================================

*A hands\-on design role supporting Candescent’s global Brand \& Communications team. Multiple openings.*

**Business Function:**


Brand \& Communications

**Location:**


India office \- Bengaluru\| Hybrid

**Type:**


Full\-time

**Job Summary**
---------------

*Role Purpose*


Candescent is seeking talented Designers to join our Brand \& Communications team from one of our India office locations. This role will help bring the Candescent brand to life across internal, client\-facing, executive, event, digital, social, and sales enablement materials. The ideal candidate combines strong design craft, production discipline, and brand stewardship with the ability to move quickly across a wide range of requests.


This is a hands\-on design role. You will personally create, refine, and finalize high\-quality work while partnering closely with brand, communications, marketing, product marketing, sales, and events stakeholders. Success requires strong typography and layout skills, comfort with content\-heavy materials, and the ability to maintain a consistent visual standard across every touchpoint.


We have several openings and welcome designers with a range of strengths across brand, presentation, digital, print, and video.

**Key Responsibilities and Deliverables**
-----------------------------------------

*What you will be responsible for and what you will do*

### **Brand Design \& Visual Execution**

* Create polished visual solutions across digital, print, presentation, event, social, sales enablement, and internal communications projects.
* Design a wide range of assets including presentations, sales and marketing decks, one\-pagers, ebooks, infographics, newsletters, social graphics, event materials, signage, and internal communications visuals.
* Translate complex, content\-heavy, or abstract information into clear, engaging, and visually compelling communications.
* Elevate layouts, typography, hierarchy, imagery, icons, charts, and data visualizations so materials are easy to understand and unmistakably on brand.

### **Brand Consistency \& Design Systems**

* Apply Candescent brand standards across all assigned work, including typography, colour, layout, iconography, imagery, motion, and data visualization.
* Use established templates and systems appropriately, while identifying opportunities to improve usability, scalability, and consistency.
* Spot and correct brand drift, formatting inconsistencies, visual clutter, and production issues before materials are delivered.

### **Production, Quality Control \& Delivery**

* Prepare accurate, production\-ready files for digital, print, presentation, video, large\-format, and event applications.
* Proof work carefully for alignment, spacing, hierarchy, accuracy, export settings, image and audio quality, and brand compliance.
* Manage multiple projects and deadlines at once while maintaining a high standard of craft and attention to detail.
* Respond quickly to feedback, incorporate revisions thoughtfully, and deliver final assets that require minimal rework.

### **Collaboration \& Ways of Working**

* Partner with team members and cross\-functional stakeholders to clarify objectives, understand audiences, and translate business needs into effective visual communications.
* Work closely with the senior design lead in India, who will set priorities, review work, and provide creative direction and coaching.
* Collaborate with US\-based stakeholders through clear communication, organised handoffs, and reliable follow\-through.
* Maintain a working schedule with sufficient overlap with US business hours on at least a few days each week to enable live collaboration, reviews, and handoffs.

**Experience**
--------------

*Demonstrated skills, competencies, and required experience*

* 4–6 years of professional graphic design experience, preferably within an in\-house creative team, agency, corporate brand team, B2B, fintech, SaaS, or enterprise environment.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating high\-quality design execution across presentations, digital, print, social, or brand storytelling materials.
* Strong proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, including InDesign, Illustrator, and Photoshop.
* Working proficiency in PowerPoint for presentation design, including slide systems, templates, charts, and diagrams.
* Strong typography, layout, composition, and information design skills, with a solid understanding of brand systems and how to apply them consistently across channels and formats.
* Proven ability to manage multiple projects, adapt to shifting priorities, and deliver high\-quality work on deadline.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain design decisions clearly and professionally.

**Qualifications \& Preferred Distinctions**
--------------------------------------------

*Additional accomplishments*

* Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Communication Design, Fine Arts, Film, Animation, or a related field; equivalent professional experience and a strong portfolio may be considered in lieu of a formal degree.
* Experience supporting financial services, technology, B2B, SaaS, or enterprise software brands is preferred.
* Experience designing for executive, client, partner, or sales audiences is preferred.
* Familiarity with Figma for digital and collaborative design work is preferred.
* Production knowledge including file preparation, print production, vendor coordination, and large\-format applications is a plus.
* Experience with illustration, photography, or audio editing is a plus.
* Experience collaborating across geographies and time zones is helpful.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Brand and communications materials are polished, consistent, accurate, and recognisably Candescent across every touchpoint.
* Executive, client\-facing, sales, and internal materials are visually clear, easy to follow, and delivered with a high level of craft.
* Work is delivered on time and to a high standard, with minimal rework required.
* Templates, systems, and recurring materials become easier to use, more consistent, and faster to produce over time.
* Stakeholders receive thoughtful design partnership, clear communication, and reliable delivery.

**What Will Make You Successful**
---------------------------------

* Strong visual judgment, meticulous attention to detail, and a commitment to design craftsmanship.
* Ability to produce polished, production\-ready work with moderate direction.
* Comfort moving quickly between projects and formats while maintaining a consistently high quality bar.
* Curiosity and willingness to develop new skills as the team’s needs evolve.
* A collaborative, low\-ego working style and a genuine willingness to give and receive feedback.
* Strong organisation, follow\-through, and accountability in a global, fast\-paced environment.

**Portfolio Submission**
------------------------

*Required with every application*


A portfolio is mandatory for consideration. Applications submitted without a portfolio link or PDF will not be reviewed. Please include a link to an online portfolio or an attached PDF, with access credentials if the work is password protected, along with three to five selected pieces that best demonstrate your design craft and a short note on your specific contribution to each.

**Statement to Third Party Agencies**  

To ALL recruitment agencies: Candescent only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.

title: RIS Service Desk Solution Architect Senior Manager
description:
Role Description
  
Overall Solution Ownership
  
Own Solution Development as the liaison between Sales and Delivery teams — serving as technical bridge between the sales team, clients, and delivery support up to and including contract negotiations.
  
Can lead solutioning of pursuits \>$40M TCV
  
Experience in Business Case Development, Deal Shaping, Negotiation, Offering Insight, Value Analysis, and Prioritisation.
  
Develop winnable and profitable solution proposals that meet client requirements while maintaining commercial integrity.
  
Excellent client relationship management at mid\-to\-senior executive level, with strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  
Automation \& Agentic AI
  
Architect end\-to\-end automation solutions on workflow orchestration covering ticket triage, intelligent routing, auto\-resolution, and closure using ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM platforms.
  
Design and position agentic AI capabilities — LLM\-powered virtual agents, autonomous remediation bots, and AI — integrated into service desk workflows.
  
Build self\-service and contact\-deflection strategies targeting measurable reductions in contact volume and mean\-time\-to\-resolve (MTTR).
  
Establish guardrails, audit trails, and feedback loops to ensure agentic solutions are safe, explainable, and continuously improving.
  
Ways of Working \& Operating Model
  
Champion shift\-left, knowledge\-centered service (KCS), and DevOps practices within service desk solution designs.
  
Define tiering, routing, and escalation models that balance cost\-to\-serve with user experience outcomes.
  
Establish SLA/XLA frameworks and a metrics hierarchy that connects team activities to measurable business outcomes.
  
Platform \& Tooling
  
Deep understanding of ITSM and ITAM tooling, and the integrations between the service desk platform and adjacent systems: CMDB, identity, endpoint management, observability, and enterprise applications.
  
Leadership \& Stakeholder Engagement
  
Serve as trusted advisor to client CxOs on service desk strategy, technology investment, and transformation direction.
  
Translate complex architecture concepts into compelling business narratives for senior executives and non\-technical sponsors.
  
Mentor and develop junior and mid\-level architects within the service desk practice
  
Qualifications \& Experience
  
Experience
  
15\+ years in IT service management \& service desk roles, in a solution or enterprise architecture capacity.
  
Proven track record designing and delivering large\-scale ITSM platform transformations in complex, multi\-geography organisations.
  
Demonstrable hands\-on experience architecting automation and AI solutions in live service desk environments
  
Exposure to managed service provider (MSP) models, outsourcing deal structures, and sourcing strategy is required.
  
Track record of senior client\-facing leadership — credibly engaging and influencing CxO, Board, and Procurement stakeholders in competitive pursuit scenarios.
  
Technical Depth
  
**ITSM platforms:** like ServiceNow (preferred), Jira Service Management
  
**Automation \& workflow:** like UiPath, Ansible, ServiceNow Flow Designer, Power Automate.
  
**Agentic \& AI:** LLM orchestration, RAG architecture
  
**Observability \& AIOps:** like Dynatrace, Datadog, Splunk — event correlation and intelligent alerting.
  
**Contact Centre:** like AWS Connect, Genesys — architecture and integration into ITSM workflows.
  
**Language \& communication tooling:** like Krisp\+ and equivalent real\-time translation/transcription platforms
  
Frameworks \& Certifications
  
ITIL 4 Foundation or higher.
  
**Architecture certifications:** AWS / Microsoft / GCP Solutions Architect advantageous.
  
Behaviours \& Soft Skills
  
Strategic thinker who can zoom in to debug a workflow and zoom out to present a 3\-year vision.
  
Location
  
Flexible / Any hub location. Willingness to travel for client meetings and operate across global time zones expected.
  
  

Overview
  
The Service Desk Solution Architect is a senior client facing role responsible for shaping and owning end to end ITSM and service desk solutions across large, commercially complex outsourcing and transformation engagements. Should be capable to lead 40M pursuits acting as the primary technical authority who translates client business problems into differentiated, AI powered service desk solutions.
  
The individual brings deep expertise across the ITSM platform landscape, automation tooling, agentic AI, and modern service desk ways of working. Can define solution strategy, shaping operating models, and building compelling business cases that resonate at CxO level.
  
The role demands a high calibre blend of technical and commercial capability owning the solution blueprint and roadmap, driving self service and deflection strategies, and transitioning winning solutions into delivery with full operational credibility. The individual will work across sales pursuit teams, delivery, commercial, and client stakeholders and will be a visible leader both internally and in the market.

 We were founded by cousins Anush Newman (Co\-founder \& CEO) and Leo Valan (Co\-founder \& CTO) and have grown rapidly since 2019\. In May 2023 we took a minority investment from Baird Capital and in January 2024 we opened an office in New York with the ambition of growing our US business to be as large as, if not bigger than, our European business by 2027\.
 



  





**Why work at JMAN:** 




 Our vision is to ensure JMAN Group is the passport to our team’s future. We want our team to go on a fast\-paced, high\-growth journey with us – when our people want to do something else, the skills, training, exposure, and values that JMAN has instilled in them should open doors all over the world.
 



 Current Benefits:

 − Market\-leading private health insurance
 



 − Regular company socials
 



 − Annual company away days

**Role Overview** 




 The GTM Architect will be the strategic bridge between JMAN product and delivery capabilities and our global client client partners (US/UK), driving sales enablement, value creation, and delivery alignment for the Private Equity and portfolio client ecosystem.
 



  





 While the primary focus is on sales enablement and value creation, this role will also oversee delivery management for active accounts to ensure solution promises translate into client outcomes.
 



  





 This position is ideal for senior professionals with technology presales experience with a MBA from a reputed Indian B\-School who can combine commercial acumen, solution storytelling, and operational discipline to scale our go\-to\-market efforts.
 



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* 5–10 years in technology presales, GTM, or solution consulting roles in tech services, consulting, or SaaS/product firms.

**Key Responsibilities** 




**Sales Enablement \& Solution Readiness
 *(Core Focus)***

title: Customer Relationship Executive (CRE))
description:
**Job Title:** Customer Relationship Executive (Professional Day\-Maker \& Problem Solver)  
**Are you the person your friends call when they need to complain, negotiate a refund, or figure out a complicated situation?**  
Most companies call this a "Customer Service" role. We call it the heartbeat of our business. At **\[BIG SECURITY NETWORKS]**, we are looking for a Customer Relationship Executive who has the patience of a kindergarten teacher, the empathy of a therapist, and the problem\-solving skills of an escape room champion.  
If you are tired of reading boring job descriptions with corporate buzzwords like "synergy" and "fast\-paced environment," keep reading. We promise not to tell you "we're a family here" (we're a team, and you don't get to choose your family, but you do get to choose where you work).  
**What You’ll Actually Be Doing:**

* **Turning Frowns Upside Down:** Transforming frustrated customers into raving fans through email, chat, and phone calls.
* **Building Genuine Connections:** You aren't just reading a script; you are having real human conversations. If a customer invites you to their wedding because you provided such great service, you’ve done it right (though you don't actually have to attend).
* **Being the Internal Megaphone:** Listening to customer feedback and loudly advocating for them to our product and marketing teams.
* **De\-escalation Ninja:** Navigating tricky situations with grace, calm, and a relentless focus on finding a fair solution.
* **Owning the Vibe:** Ensuring every single person who interacts with our brand walks away feeling heard, valued, and respected.

**Who We Are Looking For:**

**Manager, Channel Operations – Contracts \& Pricing Execution (AIN)**

**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**


At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.


Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.


Our award\-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

**What you will do**


As the Manager, Channel Operations – Contracts \& Pricing Execution (AIN), you will lead AIN\-based execution of U.S. Channel operations within the Contracts \& Pricing Execution function. This role is responsible for managing Channel Payments, Channel Analytics, contract update processing, CDP maintenance, GCPS administration, scorecard validation, payment package governance, product launch support, operational controls, reconciliations, reporting, documentation, and continuous improvement activities.


Reporting to the Senior Manager/Director, Contracts \& Pricing Execution, you will partner closely with ATO Channel SMEs, National Account Managers, Pricing, Market Access, Trade Operations, Finance, Information Systems, Commercial Operations, and AIN cross\-functional teams to ensure accurate, compliant, scalable, and audit\-ready Channel execution. The role will lead AIN Associates and Analysts to support Channel operations while preserving appropriate ATO oversight for strategic decisions, complex contract interpretation, customer\-facing engagement, approvals, and risk management.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Channel Operations Leadership*

* Lead end\-to\-end execution of Channel operations including contract update processing, CDP management, GCPS administration, scorecard generation, payment processing, waiver governance, analytics support, reconciliations, and payment package readiness.
* Manage workloads, operational calendars, payment cycles, quarter\-close deliverables, issue inventories, exception management, and execution readiness across Channel processes.
* Ensure repeatable and scalable execution of standard\-state activities transitioning to AIN while maintaining proper escalation pathways for complex decisions and approval requirements.
* Establish operational discipline through KPI management, workload balancing, service expectations, quality reviews, readiness gates, and issue escalation frameworks.

*CDP, Contract \& GCPS Governance*

* Oversee Monthly and Quarterly CDP Update processes, Conga review activities, contract amendment assessments, and operational implementation of approved contract changes.
* Lead GCPS setup, maintenance, strategy updates, tracker governance, and program configuration activities.
* Ensure CDP\-to\-GCPS alignment, execution quality, peer\-review effectiveness, and appropriate documentation retention.
* Partner with NAMs and retained ATO stakeholders on contract interpretation, amendment impact assessments, and complex operational decisions.

*Payments, Validation \& Financial Controls*

* Oversee scorecard generation, DOH validation, net sales reconciliation, payment package readiness, waiver processing, and payment calculation activities.
* Lead review of performance reports, scorecards, payment packages, trend reporting, and reconciliation outputs.
* Ensure SOX\-aligned controls, documentation standards, review evidence, decision logs, and audit readiness requirements are consistently maintained.
* Drive operational governance across payment approvals, exception resolution, reconciliation reviews, and control execution.

*Analytics, Reporting \& Operational Insights*

* Lead Channel analytics support including net sales reconciliations, inventory reporting, compliance reporting, DOH analysis, 852/867 validation activities, and operational dashboards.
* Review variances, trends, recurring exceptions, payment drivers, and operational metrics to improve execution quality and transparency.
* Ensure reporting outputs support decision\-making, payment approvals, audit requirements, and operational planning activities.
* Drive reporting standardization, KPI adoption, and analytics maturity across the Channel organization.

*Product Launch \& Continuous Improvement*

* Oversee AIN execution support for product launch readiness, MMDS activities, approved WAC maintenance activities, master data coordination, and launch documentation governance.
* Partner with ATO launch SMEs on transition planning, launch support activities, SOX documentation requirements, and process readiness.
* Drive automation, simplification, AI\-enabled opportunities, reporting improvements, issue reduction initiatives, and workflow optimization.
* Support system enhancements, UAT execution, defect management, access readiness, and digital transformation initiatives across Channel operations.

*People Leadership \& Transition Readiness*

* Lead, coach, and develop AIN\-based Medicaid Associates / Senior Associates supporting Medicaid operations and transition execution.
* Build a structured onboarding and KT model across learning, shadowing, reverse shadowing, supervised execution, and readiness sign\-off before independent ownership expands.
* Partner with ATO Medicaid SMEs to define skills, proficiency levels, QA standards, escalation rules, and readiness criteria for each Medicaid process step.
* Create a culture of accountability, compliance, quality, continuous improvement, stakeholder service, and One CPE collaboration across ATO and AIN.

*Compliance, Controls \& Audit Readiness*

* Ensure compliance with SOX controls, internal policies, pricing governance requirements, audit standards, and applicable pharmaceutical contracting regulations
* Maintain audit\-ready documentation, approval evidence, decision logs, dispute records, and process workpapers supporting operational compliance.
* Identify operational, compliance, financial, and data integrity risks and lead mitigation and remediation efforts.
* Support internal, external, and SOX audit activities and drive closure of audit observations.

**What We Expect of You**


We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The ideal candidate is a strong Medicaid / managed markets operations leader with experience in U.S. healthcare or pharmaceutical rebate operations, financial controls, systems enablement, and people leadership. This individual combines operational discipline, Medicaid domain knowledge, analytical rigor, stakeholder collaboration, and a continuous improvement mindset to build a scalable AIN Medicaid capability.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration, Economics, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Engineering, Analytics, or related discipline.
* 8 to 13 years of progressive experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, Gross\-to\-Net, Channel operations, revenue management, contract operations, commercial finance, analytics, or related areas.
* 3\+ years of experience leading people, operational teams, or complex cross\-functional delivery.
* Experience partnering with U.S.\-based stakeholders across Finance, Market Access, Pricing, Contracting, Commercial Operations, Compliance, IT, or Revenue Management organizations.
* Experience leading process execution, reporting, controls, documentation, reconciliations, or operational transformation initiative

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Deep understanding of Channel Payments, distributor agreements, fees and rebates, inventory management rebates, DOH methodologies, scorecards, net sales reconciliations, payment package governance, and Gross\-to\-Net operations.
* Experience with Model N GCPS, SAP, Conga, IntegriChain, Tableau, Qlik, Power BI, Power Query, Alteryx, SharePoint, and automation technologies.
* Experience supporting SOX controls, operational audits, access governance, issue management, UAT activities, and system enhancements.
* Demonstrated success leading transitions, KT programs, process standardization, automation, reporting modernization, and continuous improvement initiatives.

title: Account Executive
description:
Account Executive — SMB Market
 



**Mumbai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune \| In\-Office \| B2B SaaS \| Construction Tech** 




  





 About RDash
 



 Construction is a $13 trillion global industry — and one of the least digitised. Projects routinely overrun budgets and timelines because execution data lives in spreadsheets, WhatsApp groups, and the heads of site engineers. The cost of this opacity runs into millions on every project.
 



 RDash is an AI\-powered Construction Management System that gives construction and infrastructure companies real\-time control, visibility, and predictability over project execution.
 



**Backed by Y Combinator, Stellaris Venture Partners \& Zacua Ventures** 
 RICS SEA PropTech of the Year — 2024 \& 2025 \| ET Realty PropTech of the Year 2024 \& 2026 Reference Customers: Amazon (India \& UAE), JSW Homes, Danube, LivSpace, Semac Construction, Continuum Energy
 



  





 The Role
 



 We are hiring SMB \& Mid\-Market Account Executives across India to accelerate RDash's growth in the sub\-enterprise segment.
 



 This is a quota\-carrying, high\-velocity closing role built for professionals who thrive in shorter sales cycles, can manage a large active pipeline, and know how to drive urgency with mid\-sized buyers. You will own the full sales cycle — from outbound prospecting and discovery through demo, negotiation, and close — typically within a 2–6 week cycle.
 



 You will be engaging Operations Heads, Project Directors, Business Owners, and PMO leads at construction contractors, real estate developers, interior fit\-out firms, and infrastructure companies — and positioning RDash as the platform that replaces their spreadsheets and WhatsApp chaos with real\-time project control.
 



 You will be supported by an active inbound engine, SDR team, and marketing\-driven lead generation — but you are expected to build pipeline independently through outbound prospecting and referral networks as well.
 



  





 What You Will Own
 


* High\-velocity SMB sales cycles — from first demo to signed contract, typically in 2–6 weeks
* Pipeline development through outbound prospecting, referrals, and marketing\-sourced inbound leads
* Product demonstrations and consultative discovery with operations and business decision\-makers
* Commercial negotiation and deal closure at ACVs of ₹5–50 Lakh
* Consistent pipeline hygiene and CRM discipline — you own your forecast
* Market feedback from the field to inform product and GTM decisions



  





 Who Should Apply
 



**Must Have** 



* 2–5 years of B2B SaaS sales experience with a track record of quota overachievement
* Proven ability to run high\-velocity sales cycles — managing 20–40 active deals simultaneously
* Experience closing software deals of ₹5–50 Lakh ACV with Indian SMB and mid\-market buyers
* Comfort engaging Business Owners, Operations Heads, and Project Directors in consultative conversations
* Self\-starter with strong outbound instincts — you don't wait for leads to come to you
* Full\-cycle ownership — you prospect, demo, negotiate, and close independently



  





**Great to Have** 



* Prior exposure to construction, real estate, interior fit\-out, or infrastructure industries
* Experience at a vertical SaaS or construction tech company
* Familiarity with MEDDIC, Challenger, or similar sales frameworks



  





**Ideal Prior Backgrounds** 



* Construction Tech / PropTech / Infra SaaS (Powerplay, Procore, Autodesk, Wrench, BuildSupply)
* Vertical SaaS targeting field\-operations or asset\-heavy industries
* ERP or workflow software selling to SMBs and mid\-market companies
* High\-growth B2B SaaS with strong outbound and volume\-based sales motion



  





 What This Role Is Not
 


* This is not an SDR or lead generation role — you are expected to close deals, not just book meetings
* This is not a relationship management or farming role — you are hunting and closing new logos
* This is not remote — all positions are in\-office, Gurgaon
* This is not for someone whose experience is primarily in channel, affiliate, or inbound\-only sales



  





 Location
 



**Mumbai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune — In\-office** 




  





 Why RDash
 


* **High\-velocity, high\-reward** 
 — short cycles mean faster commissions and a faster feedback loop on your skills
* **Real domain, real buyers** 
 — you are selling into an industry that has a genuine problem, not creating artificial urgency
* **Category leadership** 
 — RDash is the leading AI\-powered construction management platform in India and the Middle East; you are not selling an unknown product
* **Direct founding team access** 
 — GTM decisions happen fast; your field intelligence shapes product and strategy
* **Uncapped incentives** 
 — designed to reward closers, not participants

title: Business Growth Specialist - Talent Management
description:
**Position Overview:** 




  





 We are looking for a dynamic, commercially driven Business Growth Specialist to join our Artist Management team. The role will be responsible for identifying and developing new business opportunities, building strong relationships with brands, agencies, corporates and event organisers, and creating revenue opportunities for the artists represented by the company.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of the entertainment, artist management, events, brand activation and corporate engagement ecosystem, along with excellent networking, pitching and negotiation skills.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**1\. Business Development \& Revenue Growth** 



* Identify and develop new business opportunities for artist bookings, performances, brand associations, endorsements and collaborations.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective clients, brands, agencies and corporate accounts.
* Generate leads through networking, market research, industry events, referrals and existing relationships.
* Drive business from lead generation through pitching, negotiation, closure and handover.
* Achieve agreed business development and revenue targets.



  





**2\. Artist \& Brand Partnerships** 



* Understand the company's artist portfolio and identify suitable commercial opportunities for each artist.
* Develop customised proposals for brand collaborations, corporate events, endorsements, appearances, performances and digital campaigns.
* Identify opportunities where artists can be integrated into brand campaigns and marketing initiatives.
* Work closely with the Artist Management team to ensure opportunities are commercially viable and aligned with the artist's positioning.



  





**3\. Client Acquisition \& Relationship Management** 



* Develop long\-term relationships with brand managers, marketing heads, event agencies, advertising agencies, corporate clients, media houses and entertainment stakeholders.
* Maintain regular engagement with existing clients to generate repeat business, upselling and cross\-selling opportunities.
* Understand client requirements and recommend appropriate artists, formats and commercial solutions.
* Ensure a high level of client servicing throughout the business development cycle.



  





**4\. Pitching \& Negotiation** 



* Prepare and present business proposals, artist profiles, commercial decks and partnership ideas.
* Lead commercial discussions and negotiate fees, deliverables, timelines and contractual terms in coordination with the relevant internal teams.
* Ensure commercial proposals are aligned with company revenue objectives and artist expectations.
* Track negotiations and follow up consistently to convert opportunities into confirmed business.



  





**5\. Market Intelligence** 



* Keep abreast of entertainment trends, emerging artists, brand marketing strategies, competitor activities and industry developments.
* Identify emerging categories, brands and markets that can generate new revenue opportunities.
* Maintain a database of prospective clients, agencies, brands and industry contacts.
* Provide regular market insights and business development reports to management.



  





**6\. Internal Coordination** 



* Coordinate with Artist Management, Operations, Finance, Legal, Marketing and other internal teams to ensure smooth execution of confirmed opportunities.
* Ensure all commercial commitments are clearly communicated and documented.
* Support the team in developing new business verticals and artist monetisation opportunities.



  





**Qualification \& Experience** 



* Graduate degree in Business Management, Marketing, Mass Communication, Events, Media, Entertainment or a related field.
* 3–7 years of experience in Business Development, Sales, Artist Management, Events, Entertainment, Brand Partnerships, Media or related industries.
* Experience in selling artist performances, entertainment solutions, brand collaborations, event solutions or celebrity associations will be an added advantage.
* Strong existing network among brands, advertising/event agencies, corporates and marketing professionals will be preferred.



  





**Preferred Candidate Profile** 




  





**The ideal candidate is someone who:** 



* Enjoys meeting people, networking and creating business opportunities.
* Can independently identify prospects and convert them into revenue.
* Has a strong understanding of how brands use artists, celebrities and entertainment for marketing and engagement.
* Is comfortable working with targets and commercial negotiations.
* Can balance a sales mindset with creative thinking.
* Has the confidence and maturity to interact with senior brand and agency stakeholders.
* Is passionate about the entertainment and artist management industry.

description:
**Job Description**
* Act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, consultants, contractors, and internal sales teams across mission\-critical environments like Data Centers.
* Drive consultative selling by translating business needs, operational risks, and technical requirements into integrated Honeywell Building Automation solutions.
* Influence specifications and solution architecture for Security and Fire systems, including access control, video surveillance, perimeter protection systems, identity\-driven workflows, integrations and applications, and related mission\-critical infrastructure systems.
* Support account teams in identifying, qualifying, and advancing strategic opportunities in mission\-critical environments like Data Centers by developing compelling technical value propositions.
* Collaborate with sales, product, engineering, estimation, and operations teams to develop technically sound, commercially viable, and customer\-centric proposals.
* Lead customer workshops, technical presentations, and consultant engagements as a Honeywell subject matter expert.
* Develop and deliver technical demonstrations, proof of concepts, pilot deployments, solution validations, and customer enablement sessions aligned with security use cases and operational needs.


**Responsibilities**
**Technical Solutioning for Mission\-Critical Environments**
* Develop integrated Security and Fire solution concepts for mission\-critical infrastructure, including access control, video surveillance, perimeter protection systems, command center integration, emergency communication, and integrated security management platforms.
* Apply domain knowledge of Security and Fire to create scalable, resilient, and maintainable architectures covering physical access control, cards, readers, controllers, supervisory platforms, CCTV and video management systems, IP cameras, NVRs, perimeter protection systems, intercom, emergency communication, and integrated security management platforms.
* Design security architectures that address zoning, credentialing strategy, camera coverage, recording and retention requirements, alarm prioritization, operator workflows, redundancy, cybersecurity readiness, and integration with building management and fire life safety systems.
* Define integration approaches across third\-party systems using relevant protocols, APIs, SDKs, middleware, databases, and IP networking fundamentals such as TCP/IP, routing, VLANs, PoE, ONVIF, Wiegand, OSDP, and RTSP.
* Support customers and consultants in defining operational security outcomes such as controlled access, incident response, auditability, situational awareness, regulatory alignment, business continuity, and lifecycle serviceability.
* Review customer specifications, drawings, sequence of operations, and tender documents to identify solution gaps, risks, optimization opportunities, and Honeywell differentiators.
* Define solution scope, system architecture, bill of materials guidance, integration approach, and technical assumptions for complex proposals in mission\-critical environments like Data Centers.
* Advise customers on operational outcomes such as uptime, redundancy, energy optimization, alarm management, fault detection, cybersecurity readiness, and lifecycle serviceability.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechanical, Building Automation, or a related technical field.
* 12\+ years of experience in application engineering, systems sales engineering, solution consulting, pre\-sales, or technical solutioning for building automation, mission\-critical environments like Data Centers, industrial controls, or critical infrastructure.
* Strong knowledge of Security and Fire systems, including access control systems, cards, readers, controllers, supervisory platforms, CCTV and video management platforms, IP cameras, NVRs, perimeter protection systems, command center operations, emergency communication, alarm management, system interoperability, and security integration architectures.
* Hands\-on understanding of security system design, deployment, commissioning, diagnostics, troubleshooting, product validation, and integration with enterprise integrations and applications.
* Experience reviewing technical specifications, designing solution architectures, supporting proposals, and influencing consultant or customer specifications.
* Proven ability to engage with end users, consultants, contractors, OEMs, and internal stakeholders in complex technical sales cycles.
* Willingness to travel for customer engagements, consultant meetings, site visits, workshops, and industry events.


**About Us**
 Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Senior Vice President, Asset Management, India
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

Senior Vice President, Asset Management, India
  
  

About JLL
  
  

**JLL (NYSE:** JLL) is a leading professional services firm that specializes in real estate and investment management. Our vision is to reimagine the world of real estate, creating rewarding opportunities and amazing spaces where people can achieve their ambitions. In doing so, we will build a better tomorrow for our clients, our people and our communities. JLL is a Fortune 500 company with annual revenue of $20 billion, operations in over 80 countries and a global workforce of more than 112,000 as of 2025\. JLL is the brand name, and a registered trademark, of Jones Lang LaSalle Incorporated.
  
  

**What this job involves:**  

JLL’s Hotels \& Hospitality division is a global business which partners with investors, owners and operators to support and shape investment strategies that deliver maximum value from commercial real estate. No other advisory or brokerage team in the world provides as broad a spectrum of services for hotel \& hospitality investors. A partnership with JLL gives our clients a single point of contact for support in: acquisition advice, asset management, financing, investment sales, project and development services, operator selection and contract negotiation, research consultancy, strategic advisory, valuations, and value recovery.
  
We are an agile, solution\-focused business whose primary aim is to exceed client expectations. We assemble teams of experts who deliver integrated services built on intuitive market foresight, sound research and relevant market knowledge. We attract, develop and reward the best people, challenging them to develop enduring client relationships built on quality service, collaboration, and trust.
  
We are currently seeking a Senior Vice President, Asset Management, India. This is a new role and is a permanent, full\-time position based in Mumbai or Gurgaon, reporting into the Managing Director, JLL Hotels India in New Delhi. JLL are the leading hotel asset manager in Asia Pacific and are now looking to launch its platform in India under the leadership of the successful candidate.
  
  

LEADERSHIP RESPONSIBILITIES
  
Successfully create, implement and monitor, value accretive hotel asset management strategies for clients in India.
  
Work with the highly regarded JLL Hotels team in India as well as the regional Hotel Asset Management leadership to establish JLL as the leading international hotel asset manager.
  
Lead the business development for asset management in India, including PR/communications, marketing, lead generation, pitching, engagement negotiation and closing.
  
Own the P\&L for the India asset management business, including setting and delivering annual revenue and profitability targets as the platform scales.
  
Lead a small, yet impactful, team of hotel specialists delivering on our asset management services to clients.
  
Recruit, develop and grow the India asset management team in line with portfolio growth, building bench strength for future leadership.
  
Drive thought leadership in asset management through collaboration with the JLL research team and the Hotels \& Hospitality AP research team.
  
Champion the adoption of data analytics and AI\-enabled tools in asset performance reporting and client deliverables, in line with JLL's broader technology and data agenda.
  
As a member of the extended hotels leadership team in India, contribute to the growth of the business across all service lines.
  
  

EXECUTION RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  

Meet with owners and hotel executive teams to review monthly and quarterly operating performance, review, evaluate and approve annually prepared business plans/budgets, including capital budgets and longer\-term strategic plans to provide cost reduction and revenue enhancement guidance.
  
For pre\-opening assignments, work with owners and hotel executive teams to review pre\-opening, OS\&E, IT and first operating budget including the commercial business plan and work through milestones and critical paths to target a successful hotel opening.
  
Travel to the properties as needed to inspect the facilities, meet with management and tour the market areas and competitive set of hotels.
  
Identify, analyse and implement opportunities for increased revenues and expense savings. Develop ownership and investment strategy for assigned hotels including identifying asset redevelopment, highest and best use, and repositioning opportunities designed to optimize value.
  
Establish operating profit expectations, monitoring performance, and working directly with the on\-site property teams to maximize and improve operating fundamentals.
  
Review, benchmark and analyse hotel\-and portfolio\-level financial data and keep informed of the dynamics of each market area to develop a strong understanding of the hotels and their respective markets.
  
From a capital structure perspective, including capex planning, major maintenance reserves, brand compliance, and portfolio optimization, have proactive oversight of the execution of the capital plans throughout the year, and monitoring of the capital expenditures for each hotel to include both major renovations and routine capital expenditures.
  
Analyse and track the return on investment for the assets as well as profit improving projects, either implemented or proposed.
  
Integrate sustainability and ESG considerations into asset strategies to future\-proof investments and strengthen brand value
  
Establish and maintain effective working relationship with internal and external constituencies such as property\-level managers, management company representatives, and senior leadership to maximize returns
  
Supervise contract compliance with respect to existing management \& franchise agreements. Review all proposed property\-related contracts for business content as well as potential conflicts with existing obligations
  
Undertake property or portfolio reviews with the objective to improve profitability and recommend asset enhancements
  
Collaborate and support other assignment and colleagues in other functions / departments / offices as required.
  
  

**Sound like you? To apply, you need to be:**  

Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, Finance, or a related discipline
  
12\-15\+ years working experience in hospitality operations, asset management or relevant consulting, with a proven track record in India and/or the broader Asia Pacific region.
  
Experiences in hotel operation department, finance department or revenue management department would be advantageous
  
Established network within the Indian hospitality investment and ownership community (institutional investors, family offices, private equity, and developers).
  
Task oriented and possesses a track record of meeting deadlines and delivering on goals
  
Detail\-oriented, with excellent written and oral communication skills with the ability to work with others to achieve a common goal.
  
Strong analytical and financial analysis skills, as well as comprehensive knowledge of hotel operations.
  
Team player, organized, and strong communication skills.
  
Self\-motivated and ability to multi\-task.
  
Comfort in working independently and as part of a diverse regional team
  
  

As a dedicated Hotels and Hospitality sector specialist you should possess strong analytical, communication and team\-working skills and be comfortable in dealing with people of all cultures and at different levels across Asia Pacific. You should enjoy working in a dynamic, multi\-national environment and be comfortable contributing innovative ideas, insights and suggestions on how to improve the way we conduct, present and communicate our expertise. You should embrace the latest available technology tools as a leverage to source, prepare and deliver up\-to\-date, world\-class data analytics to both internal and external stakeholders.
  
  

**What we can do for you:**  

At JLL, we foster an open and collaborative working environment. This environment, combined with the best minds in the business and supported by a platform of cutting\-edge research and new gen technology, ensures that you realise your full potential. If you harbour a passion for learning and are interested in new technologies, JLL will continuously provide you with platforms to enrich your technical domains. It’s no surprise that JLL has been recognized by the Ethisphere Institute as one of the 2025 World’s Most Ethical Companies for the 18th consecutive year.
  
  

Apply today!
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

description:

 This Position reports to:
   

  

 Sales Specialist
   

  

  

  

  

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 In this role, you will have the opportunity to be responsible for the sales of products/systems/services within a designated market/division, in line with the division strategy. Each day, you will achieve both qualitative and quantitative sales targets to ensure sustainable order growth, revenues, profitability, market share, and customer satisfaction. You will also showcase your expertise by identifying and developing new sales opportunities.
   

  

 The work model for the role is:
   

  

**This role is contributing to the Electrification business in Distribution Solution division at Pune, India.**
**You will be mainly accountable for:**
* Communicating to the customers about details related to delivery time, payments, and general terms and conditions, in line with ABB’s offering and strategy.
* Ensuring efficient marketing activities and communicates value proposition to customers.
* Identifying and driving the development of new market opportunities in the designated market.
* Managing administrative procedures in sales processes and supports cash collection and project management activities, when needed.


**Qualifications For The Role**
* Degree in Electrical Engineering (should be full\-time)
* Minimum 2 to 5 years of experience in Field Sales, Sales \& Marketing, and Business Development for MV Switchgear, handling direct end users and EPCs.
* Hands on experience in enquiry generation, offer submission, techno\-commercial negotiations, and sales execution, including product promotions, presentations, and customer engagement.
* Strong track record in order handling from a sales perspective, covering drawing submission, inspections, revenue monitoring, payment collections, and overdue management.
* In\-depth knowledge of MV Switchgear portfolio including AIS, GIS, RMU, CSS, and Circuit Breakers.
* Familiarity with tools and software such as SFDC and SAP (SAP experience preferred but not mandatory).
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and customer relationship skills, with the ability to drive business growth in competitive markets.


**More About Us**
 ABB's Distribution Solutions Division facilitates the efficient and reliable distribution, protection and control of power by improving electric power quality while strengthening the resilience of the grid. The Division offers segment\-specific products and solutions that largely serve utilities, industry and infrastructure segments, often providing the requisite medium\-voltage link between high\-voltage transmission systems and low\-voltage users. With ABB Ability™ enabled connected solutions at its core, the offering includes medium\-voltage air\- and gas\-insulated switchgear (1 to 66 kilovolts), indoor and outdoor circuit breakers, reclosers, fuses, contactors, relays, instrument transformers, sensors, motor control centers, as well as low\-voltage switchgear for the ANSI standard markets.
   

  

 Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

 \- Identify underpenetrated states and territories.
   

 \- Support international expansion of the category where required.
   

 \- Develop market\-entry plans for new countries.
   

  

 H. Marketing \& Category Communication
   

  

 Work with the Marketing team to build the Orthopedic Power Systems brand and category.
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Develop category positioning and messaging.
   

 \- Plan product launches and campaigns.
   

 \- Create clinical and technical marketing content.
   

 \- Develop brochures, catalogues, videos and digital content.
   

 \- Support exhibitions, conferences and workshops.
   

 \- Plan surgeon engagement activities.
   

 \- Develop product demonstrations and educational material.
   

 \- Measure marketing effectiveness and lead conversion.
   

  

 I. Demand Planning \& Inventory
   

  

 Work closely with Sales, Production and Supply Chain to ensure the right product availability.
   

  

 \- Prepare monthly and annual demand forecasts.
   

 \- Translate sales plans into SKU\-level forecasts.
   

 \- Monitor inventory levels and ageing.
   

 \- Identify slow\-moving and obsolete inventory.
   

 \- Coordinate production planning based on demand.
   

 \- Ensure availability of critical handpieces, attachments, batteries and consumables.
   

 \- Monitor forecast accuracy.
   

 \- Work towards improving inventory turns and working capital efficiency.
   

  

 J. Service \& Product Lifecycle Management
   

  

 Work closely with the Service team to improve customer experience and product lifecycle economics.
   

  

 \- Analyse field failures and service complaints.
   

 \- Identify recurring product issues.
   

 \- Coordinate corrective actions with Engineering and Quality.
   

 \- Monitor warranty claims.
   

 \- Develop AMC/service opportunities.
   

 \- Identify opportunities for refurbishment, upgrades and replacement sales.
   

 \- Track installed base and replacement cycles.
   

 \- Develop strategies for consumable and accessory attachment.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 3\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

 The Category Manager will be evaluated on measurable business outcomes including:
   

  

 Commercial
   

  

 \- Category revenue growth
   

 \- Unit sales growth
   

 \- Gross margin
   

 \- Average selling price
   

 \- Price realization
   

 \- Product mix
   

 \- New customer acquisition
   

  

 Market
   

  

 \- Market share growth
   

 \- Number of active hospitals
   

 \- Number of active surgeons/users
   

 \- Geographic penetration
   

 \- Dealer/distributor productivity
   

  

 Product
   

  

 \- New product launches
   

 \- Launch success
   

 \- Product adoption
   

 \- Product lifecycle management
   

 \- Customer satisfaction
   

 \- Product quality feedback
   

  

 Channel
   

  

 \- Active distributors/dealers
   

 \- Distributor sales
   

 \- Secondary sales
   

 \- Dealer productivity
   

 \- Channel inventory
   

  

 Operational
   

  

 \- Forecast accuracy
   

 \- Inventory turns
   

 \- Slow\-moving inventory
   

 \- Product availability
   

 \- Warranty/service performance
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 4\. Cross\-Functional Responsibilities
   

  

 The Category Manager will work closely with:
   

  

 Function\| Primary Interaction
   

 Sales\| Revenue, pipeline, product conversion
   

 Marketing\| Category positioning and campaigns
   

 R\&D / Engineering\| Product development and roadmap
   

 Production\| Costing, capacity and product availability
   

 Quality \& Regulatory\| Compliance and product approvals
   

 Service\| Installed base, failures and lifecycle
   

 Supply Chain\| Forecasting and inventory
   

 Finance\| Pricing, margins and profitability
   

 Management\| Category strategy and business reviews
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 5\. Candidate Profile
   

  

 Education
   

  

 Preferred:
   

  

 \- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Life Sciences, Pharmacy or a related discipline.
   

 \- MBA in Marketing, Product Management or Business Management will be an advantage.
   

  

 Experience
   

  

 5–10 years of relevant experience, preferably in:
   

  

 \- Orthopedic medical devices
   

 \- Surgical instruments
   

 \- Orthopedic power tools
   

 \- Neurosurgical power tools
   

 \- Surgical equipment
   

 \- Medical device product management
   

 \- Medical device sales/business development
   

  

 Candidates with strong experience in orthopedic power tools, surgical drills, saws, shavers or related capital equipment will be preferred.
   

  

 Required Skills
   

  

 \- Strong understanding of orthopedic surgical procedures and applications.
   

 \- Product management experience.
   

 \- Commercial and business\-development orientation.
   

 \- Strong analytical and market\-research capabilities.
   

 \- Understanding of medical\-device distribution.
   

 \- Pricing and margin management.
   

 \- Excellent presentation and communication skills.
   

 \- Ability to interact confidently with orthopedic surgeons.
   

 \- Ability to work with engineering and technical teams.
   

 \- Strong negotiation skills.
   

 \- Willingness to travel extensively.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 6\. Desired Personal Attributes
   

  

 The ideal candidate should be:
   

  

 \- Commercially aggressive but analytically driven
   

 \- Customer and surgeon focused
   

 \- Strong in ownership and execution
   

 \- Comfortable working with ambiguity
   

 \- Data driven
   

 \- Curious about technology
   

 \- Strong at cross\-functional coordination
   

 \- Able to understand both clinical and commercial requirements
   

 \- Comfortable presenting to senior management
   

 \- Willing to spend significant time in the field
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 7\. What Success Looks Like
   

  

 Within the first 12 months, the Category Manager should be able to:
   

  

 1\. Establish a clear strategy for the Orthopedic Power Systems category.
   

 2\. Build a comprehensive competitor and market map.
   

 3\. Define the product portfolio and product roadmap.
   

 4\. Establish SKU\-level sales and demand forecasts.
   

 5\. Improve sales\-team product capability.
   

 6\. Build a structured surgeon/KOL engagement program.
   

 7\. Improve product conversion and market penetration.
   

 8\. Identify new product and portfolio opportunities.
   

 9\. Improve category gross margins and price realization.
   

 10\. Establish a measurable category review system with monthly business dashboards.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 8\. Role Philosophy
   

  

 This is not a conventional Product Manager role.
   

  

 The Category Manager is expected to operate as the business owner of Orthopedic Power Systems, with responsibility extending beyond product specifications into revenue, profitability, market development, customer adoption and portfolio growth.
   

  

 The role requires an individual who can move seamlessly between a surgeon discussion in the morning, a product\-development meeting in the afternoon and a commercial/business review with management in the evening.

We offer the opportunity to make an impact, to drive innovation and to be an agent of positive change. Your deep understanding of the industries and coupled with AspenTech's broad product portfolio and value\-enablers will drive opportunities that deliver significant business value to our customers and AspenTech.
