title: Sales Marketing Manager
description:
**Role Purpose
 



  





 The Regional Manager \- HVAC \& Ventilation Systems will be responsible for developing KOHMER as a preferred air\-movement and ventilation solutions brand within the assigned territory.
 



 The position combines technical HVAC knowledge, specification selling, consultant engagement, OEM development and project\-based business development. The candidate will understand customer requirements involving airflow, static pressure, efficiency, acoustics, motor/control technology and application conditions, and work with KOHMER's engineering team to propose technically and commercially appropriate fan and ventilation solutions.
 



 The role supports KOHMER's portfolio across EC/AC fans, centrifugal and plenum solutions, industrial axial fans, cabinet plug fans, fan wheels and related air\-movement applications for HVAC, AHUs, data centres, industrial ventilation, cooling and process applications.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Regional Business Development
 



 • Develop and execute the regional business plan for KOHMER ventilation products.
 



 • Identify HVAC and industrial projects at concept, design, tender and execution stages and build a healthy opportunity pipeline.
 



 • Take ownership of lead generation, technical\-commercial proposals, negotiations, order conversion and account development.
 



 2\. Consultant \& Specification Development
 



 • Build strong relationships with MEP consultants, HVAC consultants, architects, PMC/EPC organizations and design engineers.
 



 • Conduct technical presentations, product demonstrations and design discussions to establish KOHMER products in consultant specifications, approved vendor lists and project schedules.
 



 • Track projects from initial specification through tendering, contractor selection and final order conversion.
 



 3\. HVAC OEM \& AHU Business
 



 • Develop strategic relationships with AHU manufacturers and OEMs, HVAC equipment manufacturers, system integrators, ventilation contractors, MEP contractors, data\-centre solution providers and industrial equipment manufacturers.
 



 • Identify opportunities for product standardization and recurring/OEM business rather than relying only on individual project sales.
 



 4\. Technical Solution Selling
 



 • Interpret project requirements including airflow, static pressure, fan efficiency, acoustic requirements, operating temperature, space limitations, motor/control requirements and installation configuration.
 



 • Coordinate with KOHMER engineering/application teams for fan selection, technical submittals, drawings and performance data.
 



 • Support commercial HVAC and industrial ventilation applications involving EC fans, plenum/plug fans, centrifugal/backward\-curved fans and industrial axial fans.
 



 5\. Project \& Application Development
 



 • Develop opportunities across commercial buildings, factories, warehouses, data centres, pharmaceutical facilities, food processing, hospitals, cleanrooms, industrial plants, cooling systems, railway/mobility applications and process ventilation.
 



 • Explore broader industrial applications including chemical, mining, textile, paper \& pulp, tunnel ventilation and air\-pollution\-control systems where relevant.
 



 6\. Key Account Management
 



 • Identify and develop strategic accounts with long\-term business potential.
 



 • Establish account plans for consultants, OEMs, contractors and major end users.
 



 • Maintain disciplined follow\-up from enquiry through technical approval, quotation, negotiation, purchase order, delivery and post\-sales coordination.
 



 7\. Commercial \& Revenue Responsibility
 



 • Own the assigned region's Order Intake, Revenue, Gross Margin, Collections and Pipeline.
 



 • Prepare monthly forecasts and maintain CRM\-based opportunity tracking.
 



 • Monitor pricing, competition and market trends while maintaining commercial discipline.
 



 8\. Market \& Competition Intelligence
 



 • Monitor competing fan and ventilation technologies, pricing, consultant preferences and emerging HVAC requirements.
 



 • Provide structured feedback to management regarding product gaps, new\-product opportunities, regional pricing and application trends.
 



 9\. Technical Marketing \& Brand Development
 



 • Represent KOHMER at ISHRAE/ASHRAE programs, HVAC conferences, exhibitions, technical seminars, consultant meets and industry forums.
 



 • Conduct technical sessions for consultants and customers on fan selection, EC/PM technology, energy\-efficient ventilation, acoustics and system optimization.
 



 10\. Site \& Project Coordination
 



 • Conduct project/site visits to understand installation conditions and coordinate technical requirements between customers, contractors and the factory/application engineering team.
 



 • Support troubleshooting and ensure effective technical\-commercial closure of project issues.
 



 Candidate Profile
 



 Education: BE/B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering preferred. Diploma Mechanical candidates with strong relevant HVAC/fan experience may also be considered. MBA/PGDM in Marketing or Sales will be an advantage.
 



 Experience: Ideally 5\-10 years in HVAC, ventilation, fans, AHUs, air movement, industrial ventilation or related engineered products.
 



 Market Exposure: Preference for candidates with demonstrated relationships among HVAC/MEP consultants, AHU manufacturers, contractors, OEMs and industrial customers.
 



 Essential Technical Knowledge
 



 Airflow (CMH/CFM) \| Static/Total Pressure \| Fan Curves \| Fan Selection \| Fan Efficiency \| System Resistance \| RPM \| Motor Power \| EC/PM/AC Motors \| VFD Controls \| Axial Fans \| Centrifugal/Backward\-Curved Fans \| Plenum/Plug Fans \| Acoustics/Noise \| AHU Applications \| Supply/Exhaust Ventilation
 



 Exposure to AMCA 210 / ISO 5801 fan\-performance concepts and testing practices will be particularly valuable.
 



 Key Competencies
 



 • Technical credibility combined with strong commercial drive.
 



 • Ability to discuss fan performance and system requirements confidently with HVAC consultants and design engineers.
 



 • Strong B2B project\-sales, negotiation, presentation and networking capability.
 



 • Disciplined project tracking, CRM usage, forecasting and reporting.
 



 • Independent working style with strong internal collaboration and ownership.
 



 • Willingness to travel frequently for consultant, customer, OEM and project/site meetings.**

title: Sr Appl/Sys Sales Engineer
description:
You will work with customers, consultants, contractors, OEMs, system integrators, and internal teams to shape architecture, influence specifications, and develop differentiated solutions that improve uptime, efficiency, resilience, safety, and lifecycle value.


  
**YOU MUST HAVE**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechanical, Building Automation, or a related technical field.
* 12\+ years of experience in application engineering, systems sales engineering, solution consulting, pre\-sales, or technical solutioning for building automation, mission\-critical environments like Data Centers, industrial controls, or critical infrastructure.
* Strong knowledge of Security and Fire systems, including access control systems, cards, readers, controllers, supervisory platforms, CCTV and video management platforms, IP cameras, NVRs, perimeter protection systems, command center operations, emergency communication, alarm management, system interoperability, and security integration architectures.
* Hands\-on understanding of security system design, deployment, commissioning, diagnostics, troubleshooting, product validation, and integration with enterprise integrations and applications.
* Experience reviewing technical specifications, designing solution architectures, supporting proposals, and influencing consultant or customer specifications.
* Proven ability to engage with end users, consultants, contractors, OEMs, and internal stakeholders in complex technical sales cycles.
Willingness to travel for customer engagements, consultant meetings, site visits, workshops, and industry events.  
* 

**WE VALUE**

* Strong executive presence and communication skills with the ability to influence without direct authority.
* Customer\-first mindset with strong commercial awareness, consultative selling discipline, and ability to connect technical value to business outcomes.
* Ability to work independently in a matrixed organization while collaborating effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Familiarity with emerging security trends such as video analytics, identity management, IoT\-enabled security, cloud\-based video platforms, analytics\-driven security operations, and integrated security ecosystems.

  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Consultative Selling and Business Influence**

* Act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, consultants, contractors, and internal sales teams across mission\-critical environments like Data Centers.
* Drive consultative selling by translating business needs, operational risks, and technical requirements into integrated Honeywell Building Automation solutions.
* Influence specifications and solution architecture for Security and Fire systems, including access control, video surveillance, perimeter protection systems, identity\-driven workflows, integrations and applications, and related mission\-critical infrastructure systems.
* Support account teams in identifying, qualifying, and advancing strategic opportunities in mission\-critical environments like Data Centers by developing compelling technical value propositions.
* Collaborate with sales, product, engineering, estimation, and operations teams to develop technically sound, commercially viable, and customer\-centric proposals.
* Lead customer workshops, technical presentations, and consultant engagements as a Honeywell subject matter expert.
* Develop and deliver technical demonstrations, proof of concepts, pilot deployments, solution validations, and customer enablement sessions aligned with security use cases and operational needs.

**Technical Solutioning for Mission\-Critical Environments**

* Develop integrated Security and Fire solution concepts for mission\-critical infrastructure, including access control, video surveillance, perimeter protection systems, command center integration, emergency communication, and integrated security management platforms.
* Apply domain knowledge of Security and Fire to create scalable, resilient, and maintainable architectures covering physical access control, cards, readers, controllers, supervisory platforms, CCTV and video management systems, IP cameras, NVRs, perimeter protection systems, intercom, emergency communication, and integrated security management platforms.
* Design security architectures that address zoning, credentialing strategy, camera coverage, recording and retention requirements, alarm prioritization, operator workflows, redundancy, cybersecurity readiness, and integration with building management and fire life safety systems.
* Define integration approaches across third\-party systems using relevant protocols, APIs, SDKs, middleware, databases, and IP networking fundamentals such as TCP/IP, routing, VLANs, PoE, ONVIF, Wiegand, OSDP, and RTSP.
* Support customers and consultants in defining operational security outcomes such as controlled access, incident response, auditability, situational awareness, regulatory alignment, business continuity, and lifecycle serviceability.
* Review customer specifications, drawings, sequence of operations, and tender documents to identify solution gaps, risks, optimization opportunities, and Honeywell differentiators.
* Define solution scope, system architecture, bill of materials guidance, integration approach, and technical assumptions for complex proposals in mission\-critical environments like Data Centers.
* Advise customers on operational outcomes such as uptime, redundancy, energy optimization, alarm management, fault detection, cybersecurity readiness, and lifecycle serviceability.

**Collaboration and Technical Influence**

* Influence stakeholders through technical credibility, structured discovery, persuasive solution positioning, and clear communication.
* Work with sales, engineering, product, service, operations, and commercial teams to translate requirements into executable solutions.

Support bid strategy, technical compliance, value engineering, and customer clarification responses during pre\-sales and proposal stages.


  
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Sr. Principal Solution Consultant
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.

**The Role**
------------


AspenTech is an AI\-powered software company helping the world’s leading energy, chemical and engineering companies succeed in their digital transformation, making their operations more efficient and reducing impact on the environment. At AspenTech, you will be part of a global market\-leading company with double\-digit growth and a blue\-chip customer base. We offer the opportunity to make an impact, to drive innovation and to be an agent of positive change. Our culture and vision have taken dramatic leaps forward over the past two years and we still have work to do. We need extraordinary individuals to pave the way ahead. We strive to make your story at AspenTech a great one.  

  

As a Sr. Principal Solution Consultant, you will collaborate closely with AspenTech sales teams to lead consultative discovery sessions, craft visionary solutions, and design strategies tailored to customer needs. Your deep understanding of the industries and coupled with AspenTech's broad product portfolio and value\-enablers will drive opportunities that deliver significant business value to our customers and AspenTech.  

In this customer\-facing role, you will leverage your technical domain expertise, industry knowledge, and business acumen to position AspenTech solutions effectively.**Your Impact**
---------------

* Leading and executing the technical qualification of solutions to a business outcome.
* Serving as a discipline/practice subject matter expert with a strong understanding of operational challenges, best practices, and industry trends.
* Learning the complete AspenTech product portfolio to identify and apply products that solve real customer business challenges, including the value of solving those challenges.
* Developing the messaging and materials necessary to position AspenTech solutions in the industry – making adaptations for regional or market differences.
* Partnering closely with Sales Account Managers throughout the sales cycle, from discovery and solution design to executive presentations and deal execution.
* Engaging the senior executive level of customer organisations to paint the vision of how AspenTech can be a partner in their digitalisation journey.
* Developing industry\-specific solutions, aligning technology with measurable business value.
* Providing market input to the Product Management teams to improve solution adoption.
* Identifying and leading sales campaigns to improve AspenTech’s reach, pipeline and awareness.
* Coaching and enabling Sales Account Managers and Solution Consultants on industry\-specific messaging, customer engagement strategies and solution positioning.
* Representing AspenTech at industry conferences, customer forums, webinars and trade events across the region.

**What You'll Need**
--------------------

* 14 \+ years of experience in industrial software, services, solution consulting, presales, technical sales or related customer\-facing technical roles.
* Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering or a related technical discipline (preferred).
* Proficiency in Industrial Data Platforms (Inmation), Historians (IP.21\), and Advanced Process Control (APC) \& Real Time Optimization (RTO) (DMC3, GDOT, Aspen Plus), or equivalent competitor technologies.
* Demonstrated successes in business development.
* Strong ability to bridge technology and business, articulating high\-level technical solutions and their differentiated value.
* Strong drive to convert opportunities into recognised value for customers, with exceptional problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Proficiency in English.
* Must be authorized to work in India without restriction/sponsorship.

**Nice\-to\-Have**

* Services or solution consulting exposure to industries such as Metals \& Mining, LNG, Specialty Chemicals, Pharmaceuticals, Polymers, Consumer Packaged Goods, Food \& Beverage, Pulp \& Paper, Power Generation, and Water \& Wastewater.
* Breadth across several AspenTech solution areas / well\-rounded across multiple disciplines.
* Knowledge of AI/ML solutions and their application in industry.
* Strong understanding of digital transformation initiatives within asset\-intensive industries.
* Working knowledge of Supply Chain/Production Planning \& Scheduling \- Aspen Plant Scheduler, Aspen Unified Planning, or equivalent competitor technologies.


Regional travel up to 35%.

 We are looking for a Technical Sales Executive who can independently drive sales in an assigned geography—from identifying new opportunities and developing customer relationships to preparing and negotiating offers and closing orders.
 



**The Role** 




 This is a hands\-on individual contributor sales role. The person will be responsible for executing the company’s sales strategy in the assigned region and building a strong pipeline of new and repeat business.
 



 The ideal candidate will be someone who is comfortable selling technical/engineering systems, can understand customer requirements, identify upcoming projects, engage with multiple stakeholders and take an opportunity through the complete sales cycle.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Business Development \& New Customer Acquisition** 



* Identify and develop new customers and business opportunities within the assigned region.
* Prospect through direct outreach, market mapping, references, industry networks, exhibitions, consultants and other channels.
* Meet customers, understand their requirements and identify opportunities where Pristine Water’s solutions can add value.
* Develop and maintain a healthy pipeline of prospective customers and projects.



**Project \& Market Tracking** 



* Identify and track new industrial, infrastructure, commercial and other relevant projects coming up in the region.
* Develop relationships with consultants, EPC companies, contractors, OEMs, project developers and other relevant stakeholders.
* Monitor project timelines, decision\-makers, technical requirements and procurement processes.
* Ensure that Pristine Water is introduced and considered early in relevant projects.



**Technical Sales** 



* Understand customer requirements and work with the technical team to identify appropriate solutions.
* Discuss technical requirements and system configurations with customers and consultants.
* Prepare and present commercial and technical proposals in coordination with the internal team.
* Explain the benefits, applications and commercial value of Pristine Water’s solutions to customers.



**Sales Closure** 



* Follow up systematically on enquiries, proposals and active opportunities.
* Negotiate commercial terms and offers with customers within company guidelines.
* Manage the sales process from initial enquiry through technical discussions, commercial negotiations and purchase order.
* Take ownership of achieving sales targets and converting the assigned pipeline into orders.



**Customer Relationship Management** 



* Maintain regular contact with existing customers and develop long\-term relationships.
* Identify repeat business, upgrades, expansions and additional opportunities within existing accounts.
* Ensure that customer requirements and commitments are communicated effectively to the internal team.
* Maintain accurate records of customers, opportunities, project status and follow\-ups.



**What We Are Looking For** 



* 4–6 years of experience in sales, preferably in technical sales of engineering systems, industrial equipment, water/wastewater treatment systems, process equipment, electrical/mechanical systems, or similar products.
* Experience selling B2B technical or engineered solutions will be strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to independently develop new customers and close sales.
* Ability to understand customer requirements and have meaningful technical discussions with customers and consultants.
* Strong follow\-up and negotiation skills.
* Good understanding of the complete sales cycle—from lead generation to order closure.
* Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned region for customer and project meetings.
* Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken, are essential.
* Should be confident interacting with customers, consultants, contractors and senior decision\-makers.
* Should be self\-driven, organized and comfortable working independently.

 The candidate must have:
 


* Completed schooling, and
* A graduate\-level qualification, diploma or equivalent professional qualification.



 A strong track record in technical sales will be valued more highly than the specific academic discipline or institution.

 We are looking for someone who:
 


* Is a hunter, not someone who waits for enquiries to come in.
* Enjoys meeting customers and developing relationships.
* Is comfortable understanding and selling technical products.
* Takes ownership of opportunities and follows them through to closure.
* Is persistent with follow\-ups without being overly aggressive.
* Can work independently and manage their own territory and pipeline.
* Is commercially minded and comfortable negotiating.
* Is curious about how engineering systems work and can learn new technologies quickly.
* Is accountable for results and sales numbers.



**What This Role Is Not** 




 This is
 *not a team\-management role* 
 . The position is for an individual contributor who will personally develop the market, manage customer relationships, track projects, build the sales pipeline and close business.
 



**Key Performance Indicators** 




 Success in this role will be measured through:
 


* New customers acquired
* Qualified sales pipeline developed
* New projects identified and converted
* Sales/orders achieved
* Conversion of enquiries and opportunities
* Repeat business from existing customers
* Customer and consultant relationships developed
* Timeliness and quality of opportunity follow\-up

title: Field Sales Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Aurassure is a climate intelligence company that helps governments, industries, and enterprises monitor and respond to environmental challenges using AI\-powered insights and hyperlocal data. Its integrated platform combines advanced IoT sensing, artificial intelligence, hyperlocal weather modeling, environmental analytics, and predictive forecasting to provide real\-time visibility into air quality, weather, heat stress, industrial emissions, flood risk, indoor environmental quality, and other climate parameters. Aurassure’s solutions support sectors such as Smart Cities, Manufacturing, Mining, Oil \& Gas, Construction, Transportation, Airports, Healthcare, Real Estate, Utilities, Education, and Climate Risk \& Insurance. With deployments in more than 350 cities across over 10 countries, the company processes billions of environmental data points to enable faster, data\-driven decisions. Aurassure is committed to using trusted data and climate intelligence to help organizations build safer, healthier, and more resilient communities while advancing global sustainability.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time Field Sales Engineer role based in New Delhi with a hybrid work arrangement, combining on\-site client engagement and limited work\-from\-home flexibility. The Field Sales Engineer will generate new business opportunities, manage the sales cycle, and support existing accounts by presenting Aurassure’s climate intelligence solutions to prospective and current clients. Daily responsibilities include conducting site visits and product demonstrations, understanding customer technical and operational needs, and proposing tailored solutions in collaboration with internal technical and product teams. The role also involves preparing proposals, coordinating pricing and negotiations, maintaining accurate sales and pipeline records, and ensuring timely follow\-up to drive conversions. The Field Sales Engineer will work closely with cross\-functional teams to support implementations, gather customer feedback, and contribute to market insights and sales strategy.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Candidates should possess strong Sales Engineering and Electrical Engineering skills to understand customer environments, interpret technical requirements, and translate Aurassure’s solutions into practical applications.
* Candidates should possess Sales and Sales Management skills to build pipelines, manage end\-to\-end sales cycles, and meet or exceed revenue and growth targets.
* Candidates should possess Account Management skills to maintain long\-term client relationships, support post\-sales engagement, and identify upsell and cross\-sell opportunities.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Apply by commenting on this IG Reel → https://www.instagram.com/p/DdT8eV8zZ7w
 




  





 Spur (https://spur.so) is an agentic CRM for businesses that sell to consumers over chat. 600\+ businesses across 50\+ countries run on Spur, around 5 million conversations a month: ecommerce brands first, and increasingly anyone whose customers message them on WhatsApp and Instagram, from real estate and travel to education, clinics and services. Every WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, email and live chat message lands in one inbox with AI handling most of it, and the same platform runs their campaigns, lead follow\-up, abandoned cart recovery and website conversion.
 



  





 We're bootstrapped and profitable. Zero external funding, zero marketing spend. Every customer we have today came from product quality, word of mouth, referrals and partnerships. We're 12 people: 2 founders, 3 engineers, 5 in customer success, 1 founding marketer, 1 AE.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 We have never had an SDR. New businesses sign up to Spur every single day, from D2C brands to real estate brokers and coaching institutes. Demo forms come in around the clock from India, the Gulf, Europe and the Americas. Our Instagram DMs fill up whenever the content does its job. Most of it goes cold, because nobody gets to it fast enough.
 



  





 That's this seat. You'll call the signups, the demo requests and the DMs, work out what they're actually trying to fix, and get them onto a demo. You'll call people who have already booked one to make sure they show up, because an AE sitting on an empty call is the most expensive thing we do. You'll call our own customers too: the ones who should be on an annual plan, the ones who have outgrown their tier, and the ones who are paying for Spur and using a tenth of it. And you'll build the automations that make next month faster than this one.
 



  





 This is a founding role in the real sense. There is no playbook to inherit and no manager above you running the process. You write it, and the first version will be wrong, which is fine as long as the second one is better.
 



  





**You'll probably be a fit if you** 



* Have worked inbound before and can tell us how many leads a day you handled and what share of them booked
* Get to a new lead in minutes, not tomorrow morning, and can explain how you made that possible
* Have moved a show\-up rate and know what actually did it
* Use AI daily and have built something, even a no\-code automation, to kill a repetitive task
* Write down what works, so the next person can run it without you in the room



  





**Bonus points** 



* You've sold to Shopify or D2C brands, or worked at a Shopify app
* You've called customers in the UK, Europe, the Middle East or South America. Half our customers are outside India
* You know the WhatsApp Business API world from the inside (ex\-BiteSpeed, AiSensy, Wati, Interakt, etc.)



  





**Logistics** 



* Five days a week in our Green Park, Delhi office
* You'll work with both founders, the AE who takes your demos, and the CS team who talk to customers all day
* Appraisals every 12 months. Our motto: if Spur grows, the team should be the first to benefit



  





**How to apply** 




 Apply by commenting on this IG Reel → https://www.instagram.com/p/DdT8eV8zZ7w
 



  





 The form asks which role you're applying for, so one link covers both. We read every response, and you'll hear back either way.

description:
**Job Title** : Account (Sales) Support Executive


**Location:** New Delhi


**About Springer Nature**

Springer Nature is one of the leading publishers of research in the world. We publish the largest number of journals and books and are a pioneer in open research. Through our leading brands, trusted for more than 180 years, we provide technology\-enabled products, platforms and services that help researchers to uncover new ideas and share their discoveries, health professionals to stay at the forefront of medical science, and educators to advance learning. We are proud to be part of progress, working together with the communities we serve to share knowledge and bring greater understanding to the world. For more information, please visit about.springernature.com and follow @SpringerNature.


**About the Brand** 

Springer is a leading global scientific, technical and medical portfolio, providing researchers in academia, scientific institutions and corporate R\&D departments with quality content through innovative information, products and services. Springer has one of the strongest STM and HSS eBook collections and archives, as well as a comprehensive range of hybrid and open access journals. Visit springer.com and follow @Springer1842


**About the Role**

This position will report to the **Account Support Manager, Sales Operations** . The Account Support Executive fulfils a central role within the company and works closely with the sales team the customers and other internal stakeholders to prepare subscription (license) agreements for new and renewal business for online products accurately and in line with established targets. In doing so, the goal is to achieve a high level of customer satisfaction in managing internal and external relationships.
  

The role of an Account Support Executive is vital to the business and has direct impact on customer satisfaction. The account support role is continuously enhanced by team training and by facilitating personal development.


**Job Responsibilities:**

* Generate reports and analysis on renewal sales progress for assigned region, leveraging Data Analytics / Quantitative Skills to provide insights and support informed decision\-making.
* Prepare renewals and planning (i.e. calculate journal licenses, calculate eBook quotes), demonstrating strong Action\-Oriented behavior and Drives Results focus to ensure timely renewal readiness.
* Prepare (in CRM/ERP system) the quote and contract to trigger invoicing, applying strong Product and Service Knowledge and attention to detail.
* Ensure accurate invoicing and documentation to customers, exercising sound Decision Quality and maintaining high standards of accuracy.
* Provide first\-level support to sales and customers on license agreement changes and amendments, using Consultative Selling skills and Product and Service Knowledge to address customer needs effectively.
* Be the first point of contact for customers regarding contract execution, fulfillment, and invoicing, demonstrating strong Collaboration and customer service capabilities.
* Coordinate all customer correspondence and agreements within the assigned region, utilizing Project Management, Collaboration, and Organizational Savvy to manage multiple stakeholders effectively.
* Proactively communicate with customers, align new contract terms and agreed fees, and obtain the customer’s signed license, applying Consultative Selling, Collaboration, and a strong customer\-focused approach.
* Manage customer requests and provide assistance on daily operations (i.e. engage with customers to enhance customer data quality, answer questions connected to contract data or invoicing data), demonstrating Action\-Oriented behavior and strong stakeholder management skills.
* Provide feedback and proposals to improve sales and support workflows (in systems) to work more effectively and efficiently, leveraging Marketing Performance \& Automatization, Data Analytics / Quantitative Skills, and a continuous improvement mindset.
* Maintain excellent knowledge of the Salesforce CRM system and safeguard data quality in CRM, utilizing Data Analytics / Quantitative Skills and strong operational discipline.
* Reporting: Work with Sales to plan, drive, and track quarterly and yearly renewal closures, including large renewal management, demonstrating Project Management, Drives Results, Collaboration, and Decision Quality.

**Skills, Experience and Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree with 2–7 years of experience in sales support or account support, preferably in the publishing industry.
* Strong attention to detail with excellent organizational and analytical skills.
* Good team player with strong interpersonal and communication skills.
* Comfortable managing customer expectations and coordinating across multiple stakeholders.
* Strong computer skills, including MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Good knowledge of Salesforce CRM and commitment to maintaining accurate data quality.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, customer\-focused environment.

At Springer Nature, we value the diversity of our teams and work to build an inclusive culture, where people are treated fairly and can bring their differences to work and thrive. We empower our colleagues and value their diverse perspectives as we strive to attract, nurture and develop the very best talent.
  

Springer Nature was awarded Diversity Team of the Year at the 2022 British Diversity Awards. Find out more about our DEI work here https://group.springernature.com/gp/group/taking\-responsibility/diversity\-equity\-inclusion
  

If you have any access needs related to disability, neurodivergence or a chronic condition, please contact us so we can make all necessary accommodations.

title: Business Development Executive (BDE)
description:
Digismiths is a
 **business systems and technology consulting company** 
 helping growing businesses improve how they sell, operate, and scale through
 **Zoho CRM, business automation, custom software, integrations, web applications, and applied AI** 
 .
   

  

 As a
 **Zoho Consulting Partner** 
 and winner of the
 **Zoho Developer Community Hackathon 2024** 
 , we combine consulting with strong technical execution to solve real operational problems for businesses in India and international markets.
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Business Development Executive (BDE)** 
 to help identify, engage, and develop new business opportunities for Digismiths.
   

  

 You will work closely with the founder, consultants, and technical team to connect with prospective customers, understand their business challenges, qualify opportunities, and move suitable prospects through the sales pipeline.
   

  

 This is a
 **consultative B2B technology sales role** 
 , not a script\-based telecalling position. The role requires someone who can research businesses, start meaningful conversations, understand customer requirements, follow up professionally, and develop long\-term relationships.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Research and identify potential B2B customers in target industries and markets.
* Generate leads through LinkedIn, email, networking, referrals, directories, and outbound channels.
* Initiate conversations with founders, business owners, managers, and other decision\-makers.
* Understand customer business processes, challenges, and technology requirements.
* Qualify opportunities based on business need, fit, urgency, and commercial potential.
* Schedule discovery calls and solution discussions.
* Coordinate with consultants and technical teams to develop suitable solutions.
* Prepare and follow up on proposals, quotations, presentations, and commercial discussions.
* Maintain accurate lead, opportunity, follow\-up, and activity information in CRM.
* Consistently nurture prospects and longer\-term opportunities.
* Develop relationships with referral partners and business partners.
* Support networking and other business\-development activities.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, IT, Commerce, Management, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in business development, B2B sales, IT sales, SaaS sales, software services, or technology consulting is preferred.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Comfortable speaking with business owners, managers, and senior decision\-makers.
* Ability to research companies and identify relevant sales opportunities.
* Good understanding of lead generation, prospecting, qualification, follow\-up, and sales pipelines.
* Ability to understand business processes and translate customer problems into solution requirements.
* Strong follow\-up discipline and ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
* Comfortable working with CRM, email, LinkedIn, spreadsheets, and modern sales tools.
* Self\-motivated, organised, target\-oriented, and willing to take ownership of opportunities.
* Interest in technology, CRM, automation, AI, SaaS, and business software.


**Preferred**
* Previous experience selling software development, CRM, ERP, SaaS, IT services, digital transformation, or consulting services.
* Familiarity with Zoho, CRM systems, automation platforms, or business applications.
* Experience with outbound prospecting and LinkedIn\-based B2B sales.
* Experience dealing with international prospects or customers.


**Benefits**
* Opportunity to build a career in consultative technology sales rather than transactional selling.
* Direct exposure to CRM, Zoho, automation, integrations, AI, SaaS, and custom software projects.
* Work closely with company leadership and experienced technology professionals.
* Exposure to both Indian and international business opportunities.
* Structured learning about business processes, solution selling, CRM, and technology consulting.
* Performance\-based incentives linked to business development results.
* Opportunity to participate in client discovery, solution discussions, proposals, and negotiations.
* Clear scope to grow into Senior Business Development, Account Management, Partnerships, or Solution Sales roles as the company grows.
* High degree of ownership and the opportunity to help build Digismiths' business\-development function from the ground up.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
**Apply here → https://forms.spurnow.com/sales\-hire** 




  





 Spur (https://spur.so) is an agentic CRM for businesses that sell to consumers over chat. 600\+ businesses across 50\+ countries run on Spur, around 5 million conversations a month: ecommerce brands first, and increasingly anyone whose customers message them on WhatsApp and Instagram, from real estate and travel to education, clinics and services. Every WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, email and live chat message lands in one inbox with AI handling most of it, and the same platform runs their campaigns, lead follow\-up, abandoned cart recovery and website conversion.
 



  





 We're bootstrapped and profitable. Zero external funding, zero marketing spend. Every customer we have today came from product quality, word of mouth, referrals and partnerships. We're 12 people: 2 founders, 3 engineers, 5 in customer success, 1 founding marketer, 1 sales lead.
 



  





**Role Description** 




  





 We have never had a BDR. Our sales lead closes more than 60% of the demos he takes, so everything after the demo is sorted. The gap is everything before it, and that's this seat.
 



  





 You'll own the outbound list: the brands and businesses we want on Spur, none of whom have heard of us yet. Most will be ecommerce, plenty will not be, and working out which is worth a call is part of the job. You research them, find the person who can say yes, call them, message them, follow up, and get them into a demo. You'll build the sequences and the automations that keep the list moving when you're not at your desk.
 



  





 This is a founding role in the real sense. There is no playbook to inherit, no manager above you running the process, and nobody to blame for a bad list. You write the playbook, and the first version of it will be wrong, which is fine as long as the second one is better.
 



  





**You'll probably be a fit if you** 




  




1. Have done outbound before and can tell us what your numbers were, including the months you missed
2. Build your own lists and your own tooling instead of waiting for someone to hand you either
3. Can talk to the founder of a brand or the owner of a business and sound like a peer, not a script
4. Use AI daily and have built something, even a no\-code automation, to kill a repetitive task
5. Write down what works, so the next person can run it without you in the room



  





**Bonus points** 




  




1. You've sold to Shopify or D2C brands, or worked at a Shopify app
2. You've done outbound into the UK, Europe, the Middle East or South America. Half our customers are outside India
3. You know the WhatsApp Business API world from the inside (ex\-BiteSpeed, AiSensy, Wati, Interakt, etc.)



  





**Logistics** 




  




1. Five days a week in our Green Park, Delhi office
2. You'll work with both founders, the sales lead who takes your demos, and the CS team who talk to customers all day
3. Appraisals every 12 months. Our motto: if Spur grows, the team should be the first to benefit



  





 How to apply
 



  





 Fill out our short application here → https://forms.spurnow.com/sales\-hire
 



  





 The form asks which role you're applying for, so one link covers both. We read every response, and you'll hear back either way.

description:
**About Mitti Money** 




 Mitti Money is a prop\-tech\-led fractional real estate co\-investment platform enabling investors to co\-own institutional\-grade Delhi NCR properties without buying an entire asset. Built on the vision “Premium land. Every hand,” the platform lets investors co\-invest from as little as ₹10 lakh, earning through quarterly rental distributions and potential capital appreciation, all backed by property\-level SPV structures, registered ownership documentation, and third\-party due diligence.
 



  





 At a glance: ₹200\+ Cr assets under management, 400\+ co\-owners onboarded, and a platform built around access, income, appreciation, and transparency for first\-time investors, working professionals, seasoned investors, and HNIs/family offices alike.
 



  





 As Mitti Money scales its marketing and brand\-building efforts over the next 6 months, we're building out the sales engine to match — converting the leads this push generates into onboarded, invested co\-owners, and driving revenue growth across the platform.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We're looking for a Sales Manager who will own the last mile of the investor journey — converting leads generated through digital campaigns, influencer content, events, and referrals into paying investors. You'll run the full sales cycle from first conversation to KYC/documentation to funds transfer, while building the relationships and follow\-up discipline needed to grow ticket sizes and repeat investment over time.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Lead Conversion \& Pipeline Management** 




 •     Own inbound leads generated through social media, influencer campaigns, webinars, events, and the website — respond promptly and manage them through a structured sales pipeline.
 



 •     Conduct investor consultations (call/video/in\-person) to understand investment goals, risk appetite, and ticket size, and match them to the right opportunity.
 



 •     Guide prospects through property details, structure (SPV/ownership), expected returns, and risk factors clearly and transparently.
 



 •     Maintain and update lead status, follow\-ups, and conversion data in the CRM; ensure no lead goes cold without a documented reason.
 



  





**Customer Acquisition \& Revenue Growth** 




 •     
 **Own monthly and quarterly investor acquisition and AUM growth targets** 
 — number of new co\-owners onboarded and capital deployed.
 



 •     Drive average ticket size upward through informed conversations, cross\-selling across multiple curated opportunities, and repeat investment from existing co\-owners.
 



 •     Coordinate KYC, documentation, and fund transfer processes with investors, ensuring a smooth and compliant onboarding experience.
 



 •     Build a referral pipeline — encourage satisfied investors to refer working professionals, HNIs, and family offices in their network.
 



  





**Events, Webinars \& On\-Ground Engagement** 




 •     Represent Mitti Money at investor meetups, webinars, corporate hub activations, and press/PR events, converting on\-ground interest into qualified leads.
 



 •     Work closely with the marketing team to close the loop — sharing lead quality feedback to sharpen targeting for future campaigns.
 



 •     Support community engagement (Discord/Telegram, AMAs) by fielding investor questions and nudging engaged members toward investment.
 



  





**Reporting \& Collaboration** 




 •     Track and report on lead\-to\-conversion rates, revenue generated, average ticket size, and investor retention/repeat\-investment rates.
 



 •     Share regular pipeline and forecast updates with founders/leadership.
 



 •     Provide structured feedback to marketing on which channels/campaigns are producing the highest\-quality, most convertible leads.
 



  





**What You'll Bring** 




 •     2–6 years of experience in sales, preferably in real estate, wealth management, fintech, or investment products.
 



 •     Track record of owning and hitting revenue/acquisition targets, not just lead generation — comfortable with the full close.
 



 •     Strong consultative selling skills — able to explain investment structures, risk, and returns clearly to non\-expert investors.
 



 •     Comfort with CRM tools and disciplined pipeline hygiene.
 



 •     Willingness to travel locally for events, meetups, and in\-person investor meetings across Delhi NCR.
 



 •     Bonus: existing network among HNIs, family offices, or working professionals in Tier\-1 cities; familiarity with SPV/fractional ownership structures.
 



  





**Success Metrics You'll Own** 




 •     Number of leads converted to onboarded investors (conversion rate).
 



 •     Revenue generated / capital deployed (AUM growth) per month and quarter.
 



 •     Average investment ticket size.
 



 •     Referral\-driven new investor acquisition.
 




 •     
 
 Investor retention and repeat\-investment rate

**Company Description** 
 Graphonix Infotech Pvt Ltd is a leading advertising and design company in India, headquartered in Meerut, with a strong presence across the National Capital Region. Founded in 2000, the company has grown rapidly and is recognized for high\-quality, award\-winning work acknowledged by organizations such as FESPA and ET Now. Graphonix operates as an integrated marketing and advertising agency, delivering innovative designs and digital solutions for clients seeking creativity and impactful branding. Each project is approached with tailored research and strategy, rejecting a “one size fits all” mindset. The company blends aesthetics with technology to create interactive media and business\-focused results.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Sales and Demo Executive role based in Meerut. The Sales and Demo Executive will be responsible for presenting and demonstrating Graphonix’s advertising, design, and digital solutions to prospective and existing clients, clearly communicating value, features, and benefits. The role includes identifying new business opportunities, generating and qualifying leads, and following up on inquiries through calls, emails, in\-person meetings, and events. The individual will support the entire sales cycle: preparing proposals and presentations, coordinating with design and technical teams, and ensuring smooth handover of confirmed projects. Day\-to\-day tasks also involve maintaining accurate records in CRM or tracking tools, collecting client feedback, monitoring market trends and competitors, and contributing to sales targets and revenue growth.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong sales skills, including lead generation, prospecting, negotiation, and closing, with a target\-driven mindset.
* Excellent presentation and demonstration abilities, with confidence in explaining creative and digital services to diverse stakeholders.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills in English and local languages, with professional client\-facing etiquette.
* Basic understanding of advertising, branding, and digital marketing concepts, with the ability to translate client needs into clear briefs.
* Good organizational and time\-management skills, including maintaining records, planning meetings, and managing multiple opportunities.
* Ability to collaborate with creative, design, and technical teams to prepare proposals, demos, and customized solutions.
* Comfort with using office productivity tools (e.g., spreadsheets, presentations, email, CRM or lead\-tracking software).
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Prior experience in sales, business development, or client servicing (experience in advertising, design, or digital agencies is an advantage).
* Self\-motivated, eager to learn, and open to field visits, client meetings, and occasional extended hours to meet deadlines or targets.

title: Computer Operator
description:
About the Role

MobiFit is seeking a detail\-oriented and highly organized Inventory \& Stock Executive to manage our mobile parts inventory, because mobile repair requires tracking hundreds of small model\-specific components (screens, batteries, IC chips, flex, cables), accurate stock management is the backbone of our business. In this role, you will take full ownership of tracking, updating, and reconciling our physical inventory using Microsoft Excel, ensuring we never run out of critical parts.

Key Responsibilities

Excel Database Management: Maintain and continuously update the master inventory spreadsheet tracking all mobile parts, tools, and accessories.

Inward/Outward Tracking: Accurately log all daily incoming shipments from suppliers and outward dispatch/sales to customers or repair technicians.

Reorder Management: Monitor stock levels and use Excel (formulas/conditional formatting) to identify and flag low\-stock items for immediate reordering.

SKU \& Variation Management: Organize parts logically by brand, model, and component type (e.g., separating Apple, Samsung, and Xiaomi LCDs, batteries, and charging ports).

Reconciliation \& Auditing: Conduct weekly and monthly physical stock counts to verify that the physical parts on the shelves match the data in the Excel sheets. Investigate and resolve any discrepancies.

Reporting: Generate daily and weekly summary reports on stock movement, fast\-moving items, and dead/aging stock for store management.

Required Qualifications \& Skills

Excel Proficiency: Strong hands\-on experience with MS Excel. Must be comfortable using basic to intermediate functions (e.g., SUM, VLOOKUP, COUNTIF, filtering, sorting, and conditional formatting) to manage large datasets.

Attention to Detail: Absolute precision in data entry. A single digit mistake can confuse an iPhone 13 Pro Max screen with an iPhone 13 Pro screen.

Inventory Experience: Prior experience in inventory management, data entry, or stock\-keeping is highly preferred.

Industry Knowledge: Basic familiarity with mobile phone brands, models, and internal repair parts is a significant advantage, though on\-the\-job training can be provided.

Organizational Skills: Ability to keep both digital records and physical workspaces clean, structured, and easy to navigate.

Reliability: Trustworthy and accountable, with a proactive approach to solving inventory discrepancies.

What We Offer

Competitive salary of 15k\-25k

Employee discounts on parts/repairs.

A stable, fast\-paced work environment with a supportive team.

Standard working hours: 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Monday \- Saturday

How to Apply

Please send your resume and a brief outline of your experience using Excel for data management to mymobifit@gmai.com or drop it off in person at MobiFit near metro pillar 846 Rohtak road Bahadurgarh.

We are seeking a strategic, analytically strong FP\&A professional to join our team as an Senior Analyst  

II – FP\&A, supporting Marketing mini\-CFO, in partnering with Cvent's Global Marketing organization —  

spanning Brand, Demand Generation, Events, Digital, Product Marketing, and Regional Field  

Marketing.  

This role sits at the intersection of Marketing and FP\&A. You will be supporting Marketing mini\-CFO to  

drive marketing efficiency and ROI analysis, but you must also deeply understand the \*bookings and  

pipeline world\* — how marketing activity converts into leads, MQLs, SQL, pipeline, and ultimately  

bookings. You will help Marketing and Finance leaders answer the core questions: “what is working,  

what is not working, and where should the next marketing dollar go.”  

In addition to this, the individual would also be required to drive core planning processes such as annual  

budgeting, monthly reforecasting, and cost tracking, while building and interpreting the full marketingto\-  

bookings funnel — website traffic, digital conversion, event conversion, leads, cost per lead, lead  

conversion by tactic, and marketing ROI by LoB. The ideal candidate combines strong financial acumen  

with genuine fluency in what a B2B marketing function should deliver, and the drive to translate data  

into clear recommendations for the Marketing organization and senior leaders.  

This role involves frequent interaction with senior leaders across Marketing, Sales, and Corporate  

Finance teams based in the U.S. and India.


In This Role, You Will::
* Marketing Finance Partnership \& RI (primary focus)


o Act as support to Marketing mini\-CFO to support to the Global Marketing organization,  

partnering with marketing leadership to translate growth strategies, campaign plans, and  

pipeline targets into annual budgets and rolling forecasts.  

o Build, own, and continuously improve the Marketing ROI financial model by LoB —  

connecting spend, activity and outcomes end to end.  

o Develop and track key Marketing efficiency metrics, including:  

* CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost)
* CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value)
* Cost per Lead/MQL (by LoB, by tactic)
* Lead Conversion Rates (by tactic / channel), CTR
* Marketing ROI


o Analyze the full funnel — website traffic, digital conversion, event conversion, leads, and cost  

per lead — and tie each stage to financial and pipeline outcomes.  

o Drive deep\-dive analytics on event ROI, digital campaigns, tradeshows, and content  

marketing performance.  

o Deliver a clear point of view on what's working and what's not working across marketing  

tactics and channels, with concrete, prioritized recommendations for the marketing  

organization.  

o Build and evaluate business cases for marketing initiatives — campaigns, media  

investments, Martech, and events — using ROI, CAC, payback to guide spend prioritization.  

o Support and advise on resource\-allocation decisions across marketing channels and  

geographies.  

* Bookings \& Pipeline Fluency


o Understand and work fluently with the sales forecasting and bookings process, connecting  

marketing funnel metrics (MQLs, pipeline, bookings influence) to bookings outcomes by LoB.  

o Partner on pipeline\-trend and funnel analysis — conversion rates, sales cycle length, and  

pipeline velocity — to assess how marketing feeds the bookings engine.  

o Align marketing investment views with bookings and pipeline targets so finance tells one  

consistent growth story.  

* Stakeholder \& Cross\-functional Work


o Partner with Sales, Marketing Ops, and Data/Analytics teams to ensure consistent, trusted  

measurement frameworks.  

o Create executive\-level dashboards, presentations, and financial insights to support strategic  

initiatives, and present them confidently to non\-financial and senior audiences.  

o Lead or support ad\-hoc strategic projects, including M\&A / acquisition integration and costoptimization  

initiatives.  

o Extract and analyze data using tools like Salesforce, Adaptive Insights, Excel, and other  

analytics platforms.
Here's What You Need::
* 7–10 years of experience in FP\&A, business finance, or a related field.
* Preferred background (either path works): experience in a B2B organization either (a) in


Marketing Data \& ROI Analytics, or (b) in Finance partnering with Marketing — with real  

exposure to marketing funnel dynamics and bookings/pipeline.  

* Deep understanding of B2B marketing funnel metrics, digital campaign dynamics,


channel/tactic\-level ROI, and a clear view of what a B2B marketing function should bring to the  

business.  

* Solid understanding of the bookings and pipeline world — sales forecasting, funnel/conversion


analysis, and how marketing influences bookings  

* Strong data\-driven mindset and the ability to structure and interpret large, imperfect datasets to


generate insights.  

* Expertise in financial modeling, forecasting, and metric development — including the ability to


think through a marketing ROI model from first principles.  

* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce CRM, Adaptive Insights or similar tools preferred.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to present insights to non\-financial and senior


stakeholders; proven ability to work closely with senior leaders is strongly preferred.  

* Strong drive, curiosity, and willingness to learn.
* MBA or CFA preferred

 TARA AI Labs / GoCredit \| Delhi NCR
 



  





 You understand how lenders buy. You have earned their trust. You know how to turn a complex conversation into a signed enterprise deal.
 



  





 We should talk.

 •
 **Win new enterprise accounts**

 •
 **Build relationships across the buying committee**

 **Lead consultative sales conversations**

 •
 **Move evaluations towards commercial decisions**

 •
 **Own negotiations and closure**

 •
 **Run a disciplined pipeline**

 •
 **Bring the market into the business.** 
 Share buyer feedback, competitive insights and emerging needs to strengthen our positioning and product direction.

 • A proven enterprise sales professional with a strong track record of personally selling products or technology solutions to banks and NBFCs.
 



  





 •
 **A fintech background is strongly preferred** 
 , particularly in lending technology, credit analytics, risk intelligence, decisioning, banking software, financial data or API\-based products.

 **Exceptional executive presence**

 • High ownership, sound judgment and the ability to create momentum independently.

 Your ability to explain the deals you have personally won: the buyer, the problem, the complexity, your role and the commercial outcome.
 



  





 We value trusted relationships, thoughtful selling and a consistent record of delivery.
 



  





**Why join us** 




  





 • Sell technology addressing consequential problems in lending: credit risk, underwriting and access to credit.

 .

title: Client Relationship Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 :Auraa Talents is a full\-time creative and model management agency representing Indian and international talent across the fashion and advertising industries. Established in 2008, the agency has collaborated with more than 1,000 brands and works with models from over 25 countries. Auraa Talents is known for showcasing India’s most diverse faces while maintaining strong global reach and industry connections. The agency emphasizes a safe and professional environment for young models, built on discipline, integrity, and ethical conduct. Team members join a collaborative setting that values creativity, respect, and long\-term partnerships.
 



  





**The Role:** 





 We're hiring a Client Relationship Executive to be the primary point of contact for our clients \- handling inbound and outbound calls, understanding what each client needs for their shoot or campaign, generating new business leads, and making sure every client's experience with us is a good one from first enquiry to post\-shoot feedback.
   






**What You'll Do:** 



* Call new and existing clients to understand their shoot/campaign requirements \- model type, budget, timeline, city, usage terms \- and translate that into a clear brief for the booking team.
* Proactively reach out to dormant or past clients to check in and generate repeat business.
* Own the client relationship end\-to\-end: keep them updated during the booking process, flag issues early, and be the person they call when something needs sorting out.
* Collect and log feedback after every shoot \- both what went well and what didn't \- and route it to the right internal team for action.
* Maintain accurate, up\-to\-date records of every client interaction, requirement, and outcome in our tracking sheets/CRM.
* Spot patterns worth escalating \- a client who's gone quiet, a recurring complaint, a brand that's ready for a bigger pitch.



**What We're Looking For:** 



* 2\-5 years in a client\-facing role \- inside sales, account management, client servicing, or a similarly phone\-heavy relationship role.
* Comfortable making a high volume of calls daily and confident having both easy and difficult conversations with clients.
* Strong spoken and written English and Hindi.
* Organized \- someone who logs everything and doesn't let a lead or a client go cold from lack of follow\-up.
* Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets and WhatsApp\-based client communication tools.
* A calm, solutions\-first attitude when handling complaints or last\-minute changes.

description:
**Job Title:** Associate Territory Manager**Function:** Commercial**Reports to:** Area Manager**Location:** Kolkata**Travel Required**:**25%****50%****þ****75%****About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**  


The Senior Business Development Executive/Associate Territory Manager is responsible for driving revenue growth within the assigned Area by effectively managing the sales process for all products, including Domestic Priority (DP), International, Retail, Cargo, and E\-Retail. The role will also focus on revenue enhancement through channel partners such as Regional Service Providers (RSPs), Consolidators, Franchise Collection Centres (FCCs), and One\-Stop Centres (OSCs). The incumbent will play a crucial role in customer acquisition, relationship management, and adherence to company sales policies.

**Job Purpose:**  


This role will focus on managing the end\-to\-end sales cycle, ensuring customer satisfaction, and driving sustained business development. It requires a highly motivated and target\-driven individual with a strong understanding of the logistics and courier industry.

 **Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**  

**Sales \& Revenue Growth**

* Monitor and drive Area revenue performance to achieve targeted sales growth and profitability.
* Evaluate the profitability of key accounts and take corrective measures to achieve profit targets.
* Track product\-wise yields regularly and develop action plans to meet set targets.
* Manage the end\-to\-end sales process for the Area, ensuring revenue growth for all products.

**Channel Partner \& Customer Management**

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing customers, ensuring revenue retention.
* Identify and drive new business opportunities through channel partners.
* Monitor and enhance channel partner performance in terms of revenue, sales, and profitability.
* Support sales capability\-building initiatives for sales teams and channel partners.

**Sales Operations \& Compliance**

* Ensure adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) among sales teams and channel partners.
* Implement sales and marketing strategies to enhance market share and profitability.
* Follow up and ensure closure of product\-specific sales leads received from telemarketing or other departments.
* Negotiate rates and service offerings with customers within set approval limits.
* Maintain and update prospect details in the Saffire system on a daily basis.
* Address and resolve customer service issues in coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
* Provide insights to the Branch Sales Head regarding modifications to existing product offerings to enhance revenue and profitability.

**Collection \& Remittance**

* Ensure achievement of collection targets within the set remittance cycle and Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) benchmarks.

**People Management**

* Guide and support the sales team to ensure high performance and goal alignment.
* Ensure optimal staffing levels within the Area sales team.

**Qualifications \& Experience:**  

**Education**:* Essential: Graduate degree in Business Administration, Sales, Marketing, or a related field.
* Preferred: An MBA or Postgraduate degree in Sales \& Marketing.

**Experience**:

* 1\-3 years of experience in sales, business development, or key account management in the logistics, courier, supply chain, or e\-commerce industry.
* Experience in B2B sales, managing channel partners, and driving revenue growth is an added advantage

**Skills \& Capabilities:**  

**Technical Skills:*** Strong understanding of sales processes, revenue management, and market expansion strategies.
* Experience in logistics, courier services, or supply chain management.
* Proficiency in using sales tracking tools like Saffire and Avature.
* Knowledge of data analytics and business intelligence tools for tracking sales trends and performance.

**Key Competencies:*** Result\-Oriented: Strong drive to achieve sales targets and revenue growth.
* Customer\-Centric: Ability to develop and maintain strong customer relationships.
* Analytical Thinking: Proactive approach to market analysis and business development.
* Negotiation \& Influence: Strong persuasion skills to drive sales and revenue enhancement.

**Key Performance Indicators:**  

**KRAs**

 **KPIs**

  

Growth in Area Revenues

  

% achievement of product\-wise and channel\-wise revenue targets


Achievement of yield targets (Yield per piece) for all products

  

Drive Market Growth

  

% increase in revenues from key industry segments (e.g., Automotive, Life Sciences, etc.) and key accounts

  

Enhance Revenues via Channel Partners

  

Revenue targets achieved through RSPs and other channel partners

  

Ensure Timely Collections

  

Achievement of Logic Remittance targets


Reduction in outstanding receivables (e.g., 60\-day, 90\-day, 150\-day buckets)

  

Drive Sales Capability, Productivity, and Process Adherence

  

Achievement of Sales KPIs and compliance with SOPs

  

New Product Development

  

Successful implementation of new products in the Area

  

Foster a Performance\-Driven Culture

  

Timely adherence to Performance Management System guidelines

  

Drive Employee Morale and Engagement

  

Employee retention and engagement metrics

  

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**  


When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths**across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.


This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

**Disclaimer:**  

At Blue Dart Express Limited, all recruitment is conducted through a fair, transparent, and merit\-based process aligned with our commitments to Human Rights and Diversity, Equity, Inclusion \& Belonging (DEIB).


Blue Dart does not request or accept any fees, deposits, or payments from candidates at any stage of the recruitment or onboarding process. Any such request is fraudulent and unauthorized.


Blue Dart shall not be responsible for any loss arising from such fraudulent activity. For verification, candidates may write to bdjobs@bluedart.com.
