title: Category Manager - Orthopedic Power Systems
description:
Category Manager \- Orthopedic Power Systems
   

 Location: Pune, Maharashtra
   

 Employment Type: Full\-time
   

 Travel: Extensive domestic travel; occasional international travel
   

  

 1\. Role Purpose
   

  

 The Category Manager – Orthopedic Power Systems will be responsible for building, managing, and growing Manman’s Orthopedic Power Systems business as an independent strategic category.
   

  

 The role will own the complete category lifecycle — from market intelligence, product strategy and portfolio planning to pricing, sales enablement, channel development, marketing, product launches, inventory planning and profitability.
   

  

 The individual will act as the central interface between R\&D, Engineering, Production, Quality \& Regulatory, Sales, Service, Marketing, Finance and Supply Chain, ensuring that the Orthopedic Power Systems portfolio remains clinically relevant, commercially competitive and financially successful.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should combine strong orthopedic product knowledge with commercial and business\-development capability.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 2\. Key Responsibilities
   

  

 A. Category Strategy \& Business Ownership
   

  

 \- Develop and execute the annual and long\-term strategy for the Orthopedic Power Systems category.
   

 \- Own category revenue, gross margin, market share and growth objectives.
   

 \- Develop annual business plans covering:
   

 \- Revenue
   

 \- Unit volumes
   

 \- ASP
   

 \- Gross margin
   

 \- Product mix
   

 \- Channel mix
   

 \- Geographic expansion
   

 \- Identify new market opportunities, customer segments and applications for orthopedic power systems.
   

 \- Develop category growth strategies for India and selected international markets.
   

 \- Track competitors, pricing, technology, product launches and market positioning.
   

 \- Identify gaps in Manman’s portfolio and recommend new products or product variants.
   

  

 B. Product Portfolio Management
   

  

 Own the complete Orthopedic Power Systems portfolio, including relevant:
   

  

 \- High\-speed drill systems
   

 \- Large\-bone systems
   

 \- Small\-bone systems
   

 \- Saw systems
   

 \- Oscillating/sagittal saws
   

 \- Reciprocating saws
   

 \- Shaver systems
   

 \- Endoscopic burr systems
   

 \- Attachments
   

 \- Handpieces
   

 \- Accessories
   

 \- Consumables
   

 \- Batteries and chargers
   

 \- Related service and AMC offerings
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Define product positioning and target customer for each product.
   

 \- Maintain the product portfolio and product lifecycle.
   

 \- Identify products requiring upgrades, replacement or discontinuation.
   

 \- Develop product roadmaps in coordination with R\&D and Engineering.
   

 \- Define product specifications based on market and clinical requirements.
   

 \- Gather voice\-of\-customer and surgeon feedback.
   

 \- Convert clinical requirements into clear product requirements for Engineering/R\&D.
   

  

 C. Product Development \& New Product Introduction
   

  

 \- Prepare Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) for new products.
   

 \- Work with Engineering/R\&D on product development priorities.
   

 \- Coordinate prototype evaluation with surgeons and key opinion leaders.
   

 \- Organize clinical/user evaluations and product trials.
   

 \- Coordinate with Quality \& Regulatory for required documentation and approvals.
   

 \- Develop launch plans for new products.
   

 \- Establish product readiness gates before commercial launch.
   

 \- Coordinate first production, field trials and commercial release.
   

  

 D. Pricing \& Commercial Management
   

  

 \- Develop product pricing strategy based on:
   

 \- Manufacturing cost
   

 \- Landed cost
   

 \- Competitor pricing
   

 \- Clinical value
   

 \- Channel margins
   

 \- Customer segment
   

 \- Market positioning
   

 \- Recommend MRP, distributor/dealer pricing and institutional pricing.
   

 \- Monitor discounting and price realization.
   

 \- Develop tender and institutional pricing frameworks.
   

 \- Identify opportunities to improve category gross margin.
   

 \- Monitor profitability by product, customer segment and channel.
   

  

 E. Sales Enablement
   

  

 Work closely with the Sales team to increase conversion and category penetration.
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Develop sales presentations and product literature.
   

 \- Create product comparison sheets.
   

 \- Develop competitive battle cards.
   

 \- Conduct regular product training for sales teams and distributors.
   

 \- Train sales personnel on clinical applications and product positioning.
   

 \- Support major customer meetings, product demonstrations and evaluations.
   

 \- Participate in important tenders and institutional negotiations.
   

 \- Support the sales team in converting strategic accounts.
   

  

 F. Surgeon \& Key Opinion Leader Engagement
   

  

 Build strong relationships with orthopedic surgeons, hospitals and clinical experts.
   

  

 \- Identify and develop Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs).
   

 \- Conduct surgeon feedback programs.
   

 \- Organize product demonstrations and workshops.
   

 \- Coordinate product evaluations at hospitals.
   

 \- Gather structured feedback on product performance and clinical usability.
   

 \- Identify emerging surgical techniques and applications.
   

 \- Develop surgeon advisory panels where appropriate.
   

 \- Convert clinical feedback into product\-development priorities.
   

  

 G. Channel \& Market Development
   

  

 \- Develop strategies for direct, dealer and distributor channels.
   

 \- Identify and onboard suitable channel partners.
   

 \- Define territory\-wise category opportunities.
   

 \- Develop distributor sales targets and business plans.
   

 \- Monitor distributor inventory and secondary sales.
   

 \- Identify underpenetrated states and territories.
   

 \- Support international expansion of the category where required.
   

 \- Develop market\-entry plans for new countries.
   

  

 H. Marketing \& Category Communication
   

  

 Work with the Marketing team to build the Orthopedic Power Systems brand and category.
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Develop category positioning and messaging.
   

 \- Plan product launches and campaigns.
   

 \- Create clinical and technical marketing content.
   

 \- Develop brochures, catalogues, videos and digital content.
   

 \- Support exhibitions, conferences and workshops.
   

 \- Plan surgeon engagement activities.
   

 \- Develop product demonstrations and educational material.
   

 \- Measure marketing effectiveness and lead conversion.
   

  

 I. Demand Planning \& Inventory
   

  

 Work closely with Sales, Production and Supply Chain to ensure the right product availability.
   

  

 \- Prepare monthly and annual demand forecasts.
   

 \- Translate sales plans into SKU\-level forecasts.
   

 \- Monitor inventory levels and ageing.
   

 \- Identify slow\-moving and obsolete inventory.
   

 \- Coordinate production planning based on demand.
   

 \- Ensure availability of critical handpieces, attachments, batteries and consumables.
   

 \- Monitor forecast accuracy.
   

 \- Work towards improving inventory turns and working capital efficiency.
   

  

 J. Service \& Product Lifecycle Management
   

  

 Work closely with the Service team to improve customer experience and product lifecycle economics.
   

  

 \- Analyse field failures and service complaints.
   

 \- Identify recurring product issues.
   

 \- Coordinate corrective actions with Engineering and Quality.
   

 \- Monitor warranty claims.
   

 \- Develop AMC/service opportunities.
   

 \- Identify opportunities for refurbishment, upgrades and replacement sales.
   

 \- Track installed base and replacement cycles.
   

 \- Develop strategies for consumable and accessory attachment.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 3\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

 The Category Manager will be evaluated on measurable business outcomes including:
   

  

 Commercial
   

  

 \- Category revenue growth
   

 \- Unit sales growth
   

 \- Gross margin
   

 \- Average selling price
   

 \- Price realization
   

 \- Product mix
   

 \- New customer acquisition
   

  

 Market
   

  

 \- Market share growth
   

 \- Number of active hospitals
   

 \- Number of active surgeons/users
   

 \- Geographic penetration
   

 \- Dealer/distributor productivity
   

  

 Product
   

  

 \- New product launches
   

 \- Launch success
   

 \- Product adoption
   

 \- Product lifecycle management
   

 \- Customer satisfaction
   

 \- Product quality feedback
   

  

 Channel
   

  

 \- Active distributors/dealers
   

 \- Distributor sales
   

 \- Secondary sales
   

 \- Dealer productivity
   

 \- Channel inventory
   

  

 Operational
   

  

 \- Forecast accuracy
   

 \- Inventory turns
   

 \- Slow\-moving inventory
   

 \- Product availability
   

 \- Warranty/service performance
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 4\. Cross\-Functional Responsibilities
   

  

 The Category Manager will work closely with:
   

  

 Function\| Primary Interaction
   

 Sales\| Revenue, pipeline, product conversion
   

 Marketing\| Category positioning and campaigns
   

 R\&D / Engineering\| Product development and roadmap
   

 Production\| Costing, capacity and product availability
   

 Quality \& Regulatory\| Compliance and product approvals
   

 Service\| Installed base, failures and lifecycle
   

 Supply Chain\| Forecasting and inventory
   

 Finance\| Pricing, margins and profitability
   

 Management\| Category strategy and business reviews
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 5\. Candidate Profile
   

  

 Education
   

  

 Preferred:
   

  

 \- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Life Sciences, Pharmacy or a related discipline.
   

 \- MBA in Marketing, Product Management or Business Management will be an advantage.
   

  

 Experience
   

  

 5–10 years of relevant experience, preferably in:
   

  

 \- Orthopedic medical devices
   

 \- Surgical instruments
   

 \- Orthopedic power tools
   

 \- Neurosurgical power tools
   

 \- Surgical equipment
   

 \- Medical device product management
   

 \- Medical device sales/business development
   

  

 Candidates with strong experience in orthopedic power tools, surgical drills, saws, shavers or related capital equipment will be preferred.
   

  

 Required Skills
   

  

 \- Strong understanding of orthopedic surgical procedures and applications.
   

 \- Product management experience.
   

 \- Commercial and business\-development orientation.
   

 \- Strong analytical and market\-research capabilities.
   

 \- Understanding of medical\-device distribution.
   

 \- Pricing and margin management.
   

 \- Excellent presentation and communication skills.
   

 \- Ability to interact confidently with orthopedic surgeons.
   

 \- Ability to work with engineering and technical teams.
   

 \- Strong negotiation skills.
   

 \- Willingness to travel extensively.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 6\. Desired Personal Attributes
   

  

 The ideal candidate should be:
   

  

 \- Commercially aggressive but analytically driven
   

 \- Customer and surgeon focused
   

 \- Strong in ownership and execution
   

 \- Comfortable working with ambiguity
   

 \- Data driven
   

 \- Curious about technology
   

 \- Strong at cross\-functional coordination
   

 \- Able to understand both clinical and commercial requirements
   

 \- Comfortable presenting to senior management
   

 \- Willing to spend significant time in the field
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 7\. What Success Looks Like
   

  

 Within the first 12 months, the Category Manager should be able to:
   

  

 1\. Establish a clear strategy for the Orthopedic Power Systems category.
   

 2\. Build a comprehensive competitor and market map.
   

 3\. Define the product portfolio and product roadmap.
   

 4\. Establish SKU\-level sales and demand forecasts.
   

 5\. Improve sales\-team product capability.
   

 6\. Build a structured surgeon/KOL engagement program.
   

 7\. Improve product conversion and market penetration.
   

 8\. Identify new product and portfolio opportunities.
   

 9\. Improve category gross margins and price realization.
   

 10\. Establish a measurable category review system with monthly business dashboards.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 8\. Role Philosophy
   

  

 This is not a conventional Product Manager role.
   

  

 The Category Manager is expected to operate as the business owner of Orthopedic Power Systems, with responsibility extending beyond product specifications into revenue, profitability, market development, customer adoption and portfolio growth.
   

  

 The role requires an individual who can move seamlessly between a surgeon discussion in the morning, a product\-development meeting in the afternoon and a commercial/business review with management in the evening.

title: Partnerships Manager
description:

You will be responsible for driving alliances that enable universities to launch and scale Allied Health Science programs through revenue\-sharing models, ensuring both academic excellence and sustainable business growth.

**B. Sector \& Market Expertise**

 ● Stay up to date with UGC guidelines, regulatory frameworks, and emerging trends in healthcare education.
 



 ● Monitor market movements and competitive landscape to identify new partnership opportunities and strategic directions.
 



**C. Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 




 ● Work closely with internal teams and partner universities to ensure seamless handover and successful program implementation.
 



 ● Collaborate with Partner Success and Academic teams to deliver exceptional outcomes for universities and students alike.
 



 ● Drive operational excellence and ensure partnerships deliver long\-term value.
 



  





**Experience \& Skills Requirements:** 




 ●
 **3\+ years of experience in B2B sales, strategic partnerships, or account management, preferably engaging with universities or large institutions.** 




 ● Proven success in managing C\-suite or senior academic relationships and closing large, consultative deals.
 



 ● Strong existing network within the higher education ecosystem is highly desirable.
 



 ● Exceptional communication, negotiation, and interpersonal abilities.
 



 ● Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
 



 ● Self\-driven, goal\-oriented, and capable of working independently while collaborating cross functionally.
 



  





**Why Join Us** 




 At Virohan, you’ll play a pivotal role in transforming India’s healthcare education landscape. You’ll work with passionate teams, visionary leaders, and a mission\-driven culture that rewards innovation, ownership, and real\-world impact.

title: Manager Inside Sales
description:
****About SKF****

 SKF started its operations in India in 1923\. Today, SKF provides industry leading automotive and industrial engineered solutions through its five technology\-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals, mechatronics, lubrication solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from being a pioneer ball bearing manufacturing company to a knowledge\-driven engineering company helping customers achieve sustainable and competitive business excellence.
   

  





 SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the automotive and industrial sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency, and equipment longevity and reliability. With a strong commitment to research\-based innovation, SKF India offers customized value\-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms.
   

  





 To know more, please visit : www.skf.com /in

 The industrial market in India is a dynamic and rapidly evolving sector that plays a crucial role in a company’s economic growth, with the manufacturing sector being the most diverse and promising. Industrial customers aim to improve operational efficiency while prioritising quality, reliability, and value collaborations that demonstrate a commitment to customer satisfaction and address their evolving needs.
   

  





 At SKF, we provide industry\-leading engineering solutions and technologies to industrial market that consistently deliver reliability and efficiency in their day\-to\-day operations. We cater to a range of industrial sectors, including heavy industries, wind, metals, railways, and general machinery, and help customers achieve their key objectives, depending on their specific application needs and challenges around the machines and equipment.

 Together, we re\-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.
   

  





 By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet

 Team Management
   

  





**Location:** 
 Pune

****Key Responsibilities****




**Business Growth**




* Deliver annual revenue, margin, and growth targets through the Inside Sales organization.
* Drive customer acquisition, retention, upselling, cross\-selling, and dormant customer activation.
* Expand market penetration across industrial segments and improve customer coverage.






**Sales Leadership**




* Build, lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing Inside Sales team.
* Drive a performance culture through clear KPIs, coaching, and capability development.
* Develop succession plans and strengthen sales leadership capabilities.






**Sales Excellence**




* Establish scalable inside sales processes, CRM discipline, pipeline management, and forecasting.
* Improve lead qualification, conversion rates, opportunity management, and sales productivity.
* Standardize customer engagement, account planning, and sales cadence.






**Customer \& Commercial Excellence**




* Strengthen customer relationships through proactive engagement and structured account management.
* Enhance customer experience by ensuring timely follow\-up, quotation management, and issue resolution.
* Leverage CRM, analytics, automation, and digital selling tools to improve sales effectiveness.






**Business Analytics \& Collaboration**




* Provide accurate sales forecasts, dashboards, and business insights to support decision\-making.
* Monitor pipeline health, sales performance, and customer trends to identify growth opportunities.
* Collaborate closely with Field Sales, Distribution Sales, Marketing, Customer Service, Product Management, and Supply Chain to drive business growth.






**Key Performance Indicators**




* Revenue \& Margin Achievement
* New Customer Acquisition \& Customer Retention
* Pipeline Coverage \& Forecast Accuracy
* Lead\-to\-Order \& Opportunity Win Rate
* Customer Engagement \& Satisfaction
* Team Productivity \& Capability Development






****Education \& Experience****




* Bachelor's degree in Engineering; MBA preferred.
* 8–18 years of experience in Industrial B2B Sales, Inside Sales, Business Development, or Commercial Excellence.
* Minimum 5 years of people leadership experience.
* Proven track record of delivering revenue growth and leading high\-performing sales teams.
* Experience with CRM platforms (Salesforce, Dynamics 365, SAP CRM, etc.) and digital selling practices preferred.






**Key Competencies**




* Strategic Sales Leadership
* Business \& Commercial Acumen
* Customer Relationship Management
* CRM \& Sales Analytics
* Pipeline \& Forecast Management
* Digital Selling \& Sales Transformation
* Data\-Driven Decision Making
* Coaching, Collaboration \& Change Leadership






**Interested candidates can share their resume to prachi.chourasia@skf.com**




****About SKF****




 SKF has been around for more than a century and today we are one of the world’s largest global suppliers of bearings and supporting solutions for rotating equipment. With more than 40,000 employees in around 130 countries, we are truly global. Our products are found everywhere in society. In fact, wherever there is movement, SKF’s solutions might be at work. This means that we are an important part of the everyday lives of people and companies around the world. See more, at www.skf.com.

title: Domain Consultant - Identity Security
description:
**Our Mission**
 At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
   

  

 We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
   

  

**Job Summary**
**Our Mission**
 At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:
   

  

 Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
   

  

 We have the vision of a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. These aren’t easy goals to accomplish – but we’re not here for easy. We’re here for better. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
   

  

 We’re changing the nature of work. Palo Alto Networks is evolving to meet the needs of our employees now and in the future through FLEXWORK, our approach to how we work. From benefits to learning, location to leadership, we’ve rethought and recreated every aspect of the employee experience at Palo Alto Networks. And because it FLEXes around each individual employee based on their individual choices, employees are empowered to push boundaries and help us all evolve, together.
   

  

**Your Career**
 As a
 **Domain Consultant for Identity Security Transformation** 
 , you will be the expert for our
 **Idira Identity Security Platform** 
 , a Next\-Gen AI\-powered identity protection and access management suite. You will play a key role in defining technical solutions that secure a customer’s key business imperatives while accelerating their Zero Trust journey. You will bridge business requirements with cutting\-edge technical architecture to defend modern enterprise identities across hybrid and cloud environments. By articulating the power of our unified
 **PAM, IAM, Secrets, Agentic AI, Governance, Identity Threat Detection \& Response, and Just\-In\-Time Access** 
 capabilities, you will drive customer transformation to Zero Standing Privileges and establish Idira as an indispensable strategic partner
   

  

**Your Impact**
* Design end\-to\-end identity security architectures integrating Privileged Access Management (PAM), Identity Governance \& Administration (IGA), Secrets Management, and Cloud Security Solutions into customer environments.
* Scope, manage, and execute hands\-on technical validation tests and PoVs to demonstrate technical superiority and secure customer buy\-in.
* Deliver compelling technical demonstrations and executive\-level presentations to stakeholders ranging from SecOps engineers to CISOs and CIOs.
* Advise customers on extending zero\-trust principles to non\-human identities, machine credentials, microservices pipelines, and emerging AI agents.
* Educate customers and prospects on the changing identity threat landscape, credential abuse prevention, and modern Zero Trust architecture.
* Work alongside channel partners and system integrators to scale product deployment knowledge and technical messaging.
* Collaborate with account teams to recommend and develop customer solutions within your assigned specialization area
* Present to customers as our expert at all levels in the customer hierarchy, from practitioner to senior leadership
* As the main technical point of contact for Cortex, you will assist and collaborate to respond effectively to RFIs/RFPs.
* Lead and support customer demonstrations that showcase our unique value proposition
* Scope and lead Proof of Value (PoV) projects for prospective customers and partners based on best practices to ensure technical win in your assigned opportunities
* Drive high technical validation and PoV win rates within your assigned specialization area
* Responsible for discussing and highlighting product alignment with customer requirements and differentiation
* Architect solutions that will help our customers strengthen and simplify their security posture
* Document High\-Level Design and Key Use Cases to ensure proper implementation and value realization of Palo Alto Networks Solutions
* Help our customers build and develop further their services around Cortex solutions
* Lead conversations about industry trends and emerging changes to the security landscape
* Discuss, with credibility, competitive offers in the marketplace and position ours as the best alternative
* Position Palo Alto Networks or Partner delivered services as appropriate to ensure proper implementation and value realization of Palo Alto Networks solutions
* Act as a conduit for customer feedback to Product Management, Technical Marketing, competitor intelligence, and R\&D to create requirements and deliver product features for our customers


**Qualifications**
**Your Experience**
* 3\+ years’ experience in pre\-sales within high\-tech sales environments, demonstrating a strong track record of success.
* Solid understanding of IAM frameworks, Directory Services (Active Directory, Azure AD/Entra ID), Single Sign\-On (SSO), MFA, and Federated Access Protocols (SAML, OIDC, OAuth).
* Hands\-on knowledge of public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and DevOps/CI\-CD automated pipeline security.
* Familiarity with Python, PowerShell, REST APIs, or Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform) for custom integration scenarios.
* Exceptional presentation and technical storytelling skills across both remote and face\-to\-face engagements.
* Strong technology aptitude with the ability to understand and articulate how identity security, cloud, or cybersecurity solutions solve business challenges.
* Solid knowledge of security frameworks and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Experience with LDAP directories and authentication methods.
* Familiarity with enterprise application authentication technologies such as .NET, Java, and CLI.
* Preferred skills in scripting and application development.
* Highly desirable certifications include CISSP, SANS, AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Google Cloud Architect
* This is a field sales position where travel requirements may be required to support in person customer meetings, please discuss with the recruiter on the specifics for this position.
* Proficient in English


**The Team**
 Our Domain Consultant team members work hand\-in\-hand with organizations around the world to keep their digital environments protected. We educate, inspire,and empower our potential clients in their journey to security.
   

  

 You are empowered with unmatched systems and tools and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. Our Solutions Consulting community is driven by the mission to be our customers’ cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting their digital way of life.
   

  

**Our Commitment**
 We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
   

  

 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
   

  

 Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
   

  

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: Senior Associate - Consumer & Retail Consulting
description:
**Job Title: Senior Associate \- Consumer \& Retail Consulting** 




  





 Location: Gurgaon, Haryana, India
 



 Experience: 4–8 years
 



  





**About the Company** 




 Alvarez \& Marsal is a global professional services firm helping organizations tackle complex business issues, improve operating performance and maximize stakeholder value. Founded in 1983, A\&M is known for practical, action\-oriented advisory, business performance improvement, turnaround management and interim leadership services across industries and geographies. Its professionals combine independent thinking, deep expertise and an operator mindset to deliver measurable results for clients. The India Global Capability Center partners with A\&M leadership and case teams across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, supporting end\-to\-end client delivery, thought leadership, digital enablement and analytics. The Consumer and Retail Group works with companies across consumer products and retail to address disruption, strengthen performance and create growth. A\&M’s culture is guided by integrity, quality, objectivity, fun, personal reward and inclusive diversity, with founding principles centered on leadership, action and results.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 As a Senior Associate in the Consumer \& Retail Group, you will own medium\-to\-complex workstreams across corporate transformation and performance improvement engagements. You will translate ambiguous client questions and operational data into fact\-based insights, practical recommendations and measurable actions across consumer products and retail. Working in a flat team with Managers, Directors and senior clients, you will lead analyses, manage key stakeholder relationships and help deliver outcomes across market assessment, growth strategy, supply chain, pricing, merchandising, store operations and financial performance. The role combines analytical depth with commercial judgment, clear communication and hands\-on execution. You will also contribute to pitches, thought leadership, capability building and mentoring, while working onsite from Gurgaon and remaining open to business travel and potential future relocation within the India capability center.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own medium\-to\-complex workstreams from problem definition through client\-ready output, using structured analysis to identify performance gaps and convert findings into practical transformation actions.
* Develop Consumer and Retail solutions across consumer products and retail sectors, connecting market, operational and financial metrics to growth strategy, value creation and improved client performance.
* Analyze and benchmark data across supply chain, inventory planning, pricing, merchandising, digital, brand assessment, G\&A and store operations to surface underperformance and prioritize interventions.
* Lead client and internal stakeholder interactions by clarifying requirements, communicating insights and explaining business impact to senior CRG clients, A\&M leaders and third parties.
* Build accurate models, dashboards and presentations using Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx or Python to support timely decisions and zero\-defect deliverables.
* Manage milestones, dependencies and competing priorities under pressure, while collaborating with team members to deliver agreed outputs and maintain momentum across projects.
* Support A\&M growth through pitch development, marketing, innovative offering development, recruiting, training and mentoring Analysts and Associates.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Strong Consumer Products and Retail expertise, including sector data and metrics across supply chain, inventory planning, pricing, merchandising, digital, brand assessment, G\&A and store operations.
* Demonstrated experience in strategy, analytics, operational consulting or transformation, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and deliver fact\-based recommendations that influence client decisions.
* Advanced Excel modelling and analytical skills, including organizing complex data to draw conclusions, test scenarios and support timely operational and financial decision\-making.
* Strong PowerPoint capability, with a track record of creating clear, persuasive and defect\-free presentations for senior clients, leadership teams and business development discussions.
* Working proficiency in Power BI or Tableau for data visualization and Alteryx or Python for data analysis, with the judgment to select appropriate tools for each problem.
* Excellent written, verbal, research and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate difficult messages with integrity and explain analytical impact to varied stakeholders.
* Practical leadership, prioritization and teamwork skills, including mentoring junior colleagues, motivating teams and delivering high\-quality work in pressured environments.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Experience across multiple Consumer Products or Retail subsectors, such as Food and Beverage, Personal Care, Household Goods, Health and Wellness, Electronics, Grocery, Apparel or E\-Commerce.
* Exposure to corporate transformation, performance improvement, operating model change or financial enhancement programs in a consulting or industry setting.
* Interest in developing thought leadership, new offerings and client relationships within a growing global Consumer and Retail practice.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* A graduate degree from a strong institution and 4–8 years of relevant experience, including 3–6 years of post\-MBA experience in strategy, analytics, operational consulting or a comparable transformation environment.
* A commercially minded Consumer and Retail problem solver who understands how industry metrics connect across growth, operations, customer experience and financial performance.
* An entrepreneurial, self\-starting approach: you are comfortable with ambiguity, require limited direction, challenge the status quo and take ownership through to measurable client outcomes.
* The communication, judgment and integrity to lead workstreams, mentor Analysts and Associates, influence senior stakeholders and deliver messages clearly even when they are difficult to hear.



  





**Why Join Us** 




 You will join a rapidly growing Consumer and Retail team where your work directly shapes high\-impact transformation programs for global clients. The role offers exposure across the full project life cycle, from market analysis and growth strategy through operational improvement and financial performance enhancement. You will work closely with Managers, Directors and senior client stakeholders in a flat structure that rewards ownership, sound judgment and practical execution. A\&M’s entrepreneurial culture gives high\-performing professionals early responsibility and the opportunity to influence both client outcomes and the growth of the practice. You will deepen your expertise across consumer products and retail subsectors while contributing to pitches, thought leadership, new offerings and capability building. The India Global Capability Center connects you to colleagues and case teams across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, creating a genuinely global platform for learning and impact. Development is supported through mentorship, formal training, performance feedback, on\-the\-job learning and internal mobility. Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits accompany a culture that values integrity, inclusion, personal growth and results.
 



  





**What We Offer** 



* Direct exposure to senior A\&M leaders, global case teams and client stakeholders, with meaningful ownership of workstreams and visible influence on transformation outcomes.
* Structured professional development through mentorship, performance feedback, formal training, on\-the\-job learning and opportunities to build expertise across Consumer and Retail sectors.
* A collaborative, entrepreneurial environment with competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, well\-being resources, inclusive diversity initiatives and opportunities to contribute beyond client delivery.

title: Senior Manager
description:
**Title: Subject Matter Expert** 




**Location \- Noida** 




  





**About Paytm Group:** 
 Paytm is India’s leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid \- Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks’ financial instruments. To further enhance merchants’ business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.
 



**About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):** 
 PPSL enables thousands of online merchants to offer world class frictionless payment experience to their customers. We are present across large enterprises and startups including well known unicorns alike. We strive to take payments beyond an enabler and an instrument to drive revenue and user growth for our merchants. Online Payment Gateway is Paytm’s B2B Business regulated by RBI as it allows only authorized entities to conduct PA PG (Payment Aggregator Payment Gateway) business. This team is responsible for growing the penetration of Paytm’s PA PG business in the Indian merchants.
 



  





**About the role:** 
 We are looking for highly driven and customer\-focused professionals to join our Enterprise Payments team as a Subject Matter Expert (SME). The role requires working closely with Sales, Product, and Business teams to drive merchant acquisition, solution consulting, and adoption of Paytm’s payment products. The SME will play a critical role in enabling enterprise sales by providing deep domain expertise in card payments, payment workflows, and digital payment solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of the payments ecosystem, excellent stakeholder management skills, and the ability to translate complex payment solutions into business value for enterprise merchants.
 



  





**Expectations / Requirements :** 




 ● Partner closely with enterprise sales teams to drive merchant acquisition and revenue growth by acting as a payments domain expert during client discussions and solution presentations.
 



 ● Engage with CXOs, payment heads, product teams, and business stakeholders to understand merchant requirements and recommend suitable payment solutions.
 



 ● Support sales teams in pitching Paytm’s payment suite including Card Payments, Tokenisation, International Card Payments, Pre\-auth \& Capture, Payment Gateway solutions, UPI, and value\-added payment products.
 



 ● Act as a trusted advisor for merchants by providing consultative solutioning aligned with their business models, payment flows, and customer experience goals.
 



 ● Work with Product and Technology teams to identify market requirements, product gaps, and opportunities for enhancing payment offerings.
 



 ● Contribute towards product ideation, competitive benchmarking, and feedback\-driven improvements to strengthen Paytm’s market positioning.
 



 ● Drive product adoption and merchant penetration by enabling successful onboarding, training, and solution implementation.
 



 ● Lead merchant\-facing discussions for new product launches, feature enhancements, and payment optimization initiatives.
 



 ● Prepare Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), use cases, and workflow recommendations to support product enhancements and digital\-first customer journeys.
 



 ● Coordinate with cross\-functional teams including Product, Compliance, Finance, Operations, Legal, and Technology to ensure seamless execution and faster resolution of merchant requirements.
 



 ● Track industry trends, competitor offerings, and emerging technologies within the payments and fintech ecosystem to strengthen sales strategy and customer engagement.
 



  





**Superpowers / Skills that will help you succeed in this role :** 




 ● Minimum 5 years of experience in Payments, Fintech, Product Consulting, Solution Engineering, or Business Product Management with strong exposure to enterprise sales.
 



 ● Strong understanding of the card payments ecosystem including Card Processing, Tokenisation, Pre\-auth \& Capture, Payment Gateway flows, International Card Payments, and online/offline payment solutions.
 



 ● Ability to drive consultative and solution\-led sales conversations with enterprise merchants and senior stakeholders.
 



 ● Strong presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to simplify complex payment concepts for business audiences.
 



 ● Experience working closely with cross\-functional teams and driving alignment between Sales, Product, and Technology teams.
 



 ● Proven ability to support GTM initiatives, product adoption strategies, and customer success programs.
 



 ● Strong analytical mindset with the ability to leverage data, customer insights, and market intelligence to influence business decisions.
 



 ● A self\-starter who thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-growth, and dynamic fintech environment.
 



 ● Prior experience in fintech, payment gateways, banking, consulting, or enterprise solutioning roles will be an added advantage.
 



  





**Why join us:** 
 We give immense opportunities to make a difference and have a great time doing that. You are challenged and encouraged here to do meaningful work for yourself and customers/clients. We are successful, and our successes are rooted in our people's collective energy and unwavering focus on the customer, and how it will always be.
 



**Compensation:** 
 If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With enviable 500 mn\+ registered users, 21 mn\+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers \& merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

title: Account Executive
description:
**About Trademo** 




 Trademo is the AI and data infrastructure platform for global trade, helping enterprises manage trade compliance, supplier risk, sourcing, and trade prospecting from a single platform.
 



 At its core is one of the world's most comprehensive proprietary trade data foundations comprising tariff schedules, customs rulings, duties, taxes, FTAs, import\-export controls, ECN schedules, export licenses from 140\+ countries; 675 sanctions and PEP lists, UBO, OFAC/EU/UK/BIS 50 relationships, global entity identifiers and corporate registry data; AIS datafeed connectivity; 3\.5 billion shipment records from more than 35 countries and more. This data powers TrademoKG, Trademo's proprietary knowledge graph.
 



 Built on top of this foundation, purpose\-built AI agents automate critical trade workflows. Prism digitizes and extracts data from trade documents, Clara streamlines sanctions adjudication, dedicated agents accelerate HS and ECCN classification, and Hermes helps enterprises discover suppliers, identify buyers, and uncover new trade opportunities. Together, they transform complex trade data into actionable decisions in minutes instead of days.
 



 Founded in 2020 by third\-time entrepreneur Shalabh Singhal, an alumnus of IIT BHU, the CFA Institute, and Stanford GSB Seed, Trademo has raised $12\.5 million in seed funding from Amit Singhal (former SVP, Google), Sridhar Ramaswamy (CEO, Snowflake), Neeraj Arora (former Chief Business Officer, WhatsApp), and Saama Capital.
 



 Trademo's vision is to enable enterprises to source smarter, win new business, stay compliant with evolving regulations, and build resilient supply chains in an increasingly complex world.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
**Location: India\-Bangalore or Delhi (Remote)**
**Big Ideas. Real People.**
 At Orca, in the right environment and with the right team, talent has no boundaries. This team spirit, together with our drive to always aim high, has quickly earned us unicorn status and turned us into a global cloud security innovation leader. So if you're ready to join an amazing team of people who inspire each other every day, now is the time to find your place in our pod.
   

  

 We're looking for driven and talented people like you to join our CS team and our mission to change the future of cloud security.
 **Ready to dive in and swim with our pod?**
**Highlights:**
* **High\-growth:** 
 Over the past seven years, we've consistently achieved milestones that take other companies a decade or more. During this time, we've significantly grown our employee base, expanded our customer reach, and rapidly advanced our product capabilities.
* **Disruptive innovation:** 
 Our founders saw that traditional security didn't work for the cloud, so they set out to carve a new path. We're relentless pioneers who invented agentless technology and continue to be the most comprehensive and innovative cloud security company.
* **Well\-capitalized:** 
 With a valuation of $1\.8 billion, Orca is a cybersecurity unicorn dominating the cloud security space. We're backed by an impressive team of investors such as Capital G, ICONIQ, GGV, and SVCI, a syndicate of CISOs who invest their own money after conducting their due diligence.
* **Respectful and transparent culture:** 
 Our executives pride themselves on being accessible to everyone and believe in sharing knowledge with the employees. Each employee has a place in shaping the future of our industry.


**About the Role:**
 We are looking for a highly\-motivated, business\-focused, demonstrated team\-player to join us as a Customer Success Manager. In this role, you will be responsible for partnering with Customers to meet their security objectives, adopt our solution, understand the value of their investment, and expand their product footprint.
   

  

**What You'll Do:**
* Managing the entire Customer Journey for an assigned portfolio of Customers.
* Partner with Customer Success Engineers to identify and drive customer objectives, operationalization, outcomes and value. Ensuring that technical enablement ties to customer goals and helps them achieve their own business KPIs.
* Define and execute Customer Success Plans that drive both adoption and value.
* Be a trusted advisor for customers, communicating upcoming product changes, enhancements, and serving as an internal voice of the customer.
* Work with customer stakeholders, executive sponsors, and partners to drive business value and expansion. Build strong relationships within all levels of the organization from the practitioner level all the way up to the C\-suite. Proactively reach out to other BUs and executives to expand Orca's footprint.
* Identify risks, manage escalations, and collaborate cross\-functionally within Orca.
* Lead Executive Business Reviews (EBRS) \& Quarterly Business Review (QBRs).
* Own Customer renewal opportunities and partner with Account Executives on Customer Expansion opportunities.
* Contribute to defining and bringing maturity Customer Success Playbooks, Journeys, and Best Practices.
* Become proficient in CS and Sales tools required to perform the role: e.g. Salesforce, Clari, ChurnZero, Google Workspace, Slack, etc.
* In your day to day with customers, you are the owner of the relationship, meaning that you understand your customer use cases, business outcomes, feature requests, escalation points, and key players at all times.


**What We're Looking For:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.
* 5\+ years experience in customer success, account management, engagement management, or pre\-sales roles related to driving positive customer outcomes and adoption.
* 5\+ years of experience working with Cloud Security, CyberSecurity, or SaaS products.
* Ability to communicate, operate and communicate in various organizational levels both internally and externally.
* Knowledge of modern Cloud Infrastructure providers such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud.
* Knowledge of and experience working in the Cloud Security industry.
* Familiarity with cloud technology and environments, along with the benefits and security challenges of working in the cloud.
* Thrive in a fast pace, dynamic environment.
* Excellent written, verbal communication skills, \& problem\-solving skills.
* A passion for creating and maintaining relationships, while working in a tight\-knit community culture.
* Ability to manage competing priorities.
* Passion for driving customer success that results in renewals, upside, and retention.
* AI proficiency.
* Ability to travel 30%

description:
****Job Req ID: 29011****
**About Supermicro**
 Supermicro® is a Top Tier provider of advanced server, storage, and networking solutions for Data Center, Cloud Computing, Enterprise IT, Hadoop/ Big Data, Hyperscale, HPC and IoT/Embedded customers worldwide. We are the \#5 fastest growing company among the Silicon Valley Top 50 technology firms. Our unprecedented global expansion has provided us with the opportunity to offer a large number of new positions to the technology community. We seek talented, passionate, and committed engineers, technologists, and business leaders to join us.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
* Partner with sales, marketing, and cross\-functional engineering teams to engage with C\-level clients in pre\-sales meetings and conferences. Represent the corporate brand and lead the promotion of Data Center Solutions to capture CSP, NCP, and enterprise cloud business.
* Collaborate closely with customers to define and enhance next\-generation AI/HPC server specifications. Bridge the gap between external clients and internal R\&D/engineering to ensure product roadmaps align with market expectations and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) optimization.
* Recruit, build, and lead high\-performing FAE teams. Mentor and coach team members, guiding their transition into strategic Solution Architects capable of adapting to a fast\-paced, high\-pressure, and ever\-changing environment.
* Serve as the ultimate technical authority in the field. Manage and lead teams during the investigation and root cause analysis (RCA) of complex system issues.
* Develop, review, and optimize system solutions, technical bid responses (RFx), and technical presentations. Ensure the successful delivery a proven/ optimized proposal that meet or exceeds customer business requirements.
* Deep solution architect knowledge in AI, HPC, GPU Clusters, and Data Center\-centric applications.
* Highly technical problem solver who understands system architecture, hardware and software interaction
* Comprehensive understanding of the interaction between firmware, drivers, OS, and applications, with the ability to swiftly identify and resolve system\-level bottlenecks.
* Highly technical problem solver with the ability to map end\-user business and partner requirements into the most optimized, TCO\-efficient technical solutions.
* Possess foundational hardware debug skills. Capable of leading and performing hands\-on activities, enabling solution integration, and providing support for on\-site data center audits and site surveys.
* Some travel required (up to 30%)


**Qualifications**
 Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering discipline; computer science, computer engineering or electrical engineering is preferred
   

  

* Good to Strong experience with data center infrastructure and comprehensive knowledge of data center facilities
* Strong experience in networking topology and architecture is preferred
* Excellent communication skills and business sense required
* Minimum 16 years related experience with Compute/Storage Server or Data Center or IT Infrastructure experience desired
* Strong background and experience with x86, HPC, Cloud and/or GPU\-based server architecture is highly preferred
* Proven ability to autonomously architect comprehensive technical solution proposals, translating complex AI/HPC requirements into a precise, integration\-ready hardware proposal. This requires ensuring seamless interoperability across core subsystems while optimizing solution is highly preferred
* Solid HW system expertise and diagnostics skills
* Familiarity with Firmware, Linux, Windows and virtualization platforms is a plus
* Strong technical communication and leadership skills to lead investigations with engineers of multiple disciplines
* Individuals must be able to work effectively in a high\-pressure environment

title: Sizing Analyst
description:
**Department:** 
 Sales
 



**Location:** 
 Kolkata / Gurgaon
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Salary:** 
 10\-12 LPA
 



  





**About Triphos** 




 Triphos Power is a full\-stack battery\-as\-a\-service company focused on commercial and industrial (C\&I) customers. We finance, own, deploy, operate, and maintain battery storage systems, backed by our own in\-house Energy Management System (EMS) — putting us at the intersection of system integration, battery portfolio management, and technology. Our target is 100 MWh across 30–40 C\&I sites in Year 1, scaling to a gigawatt\-hour\-plus portfolio within three years. We're backed by the promoter family of Rupa \& Co. and Neo Metaliks, giving us capital strength, distribution expertise, and a warm C\&I customer pipeline from day one.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Every Triphos proposal starts with a number: how much battery a site actually needs, and what it saves the customer. The Sizing Analyst owns that number. You'll work directly with C\&I clients to pull the load, tariff, and consumption data we need, clean it into something usable, and run the sizing and feasibility analysis behind every deal. Your output is the package the customer decides on — a full sizing report, a savings analysis, and a financial model with a clear ROI case. As we push toward 100 MWh across 30–40 sites in Year 1, this analysis is what separates a deal that closes and performs from one that doesn't.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the client data pipeline end to end — work through the data questionnaire with C\&I clients, understand exactly what's needed from each site, and follow up until it lands
* Clean, structure, and validate large, messy client datasets into analysis\-ready inputs
* Run sizing and optimization analysis to determine the right battery configuration for each site
* Determine which use case fits each client best — peak shaving, time\-of\-day arbitrage, renewable integration — based on what the data actually shows
* Research and interpret state tariff orders, electricity bills, penalty structures, and open access regulations to ground every analysis in real numbers
* Build savings analyses that quantify what the customer actually stands to gain
* Produce the full BESS feasibility analysis report for each site
* Communicate directly with clients throughout — chasing data, clarifying assumptions, and keeping the process moving
* Contribute to automating and streamlining the analysis process as we scale



  





**Key Requirements / Skills** 



* 0–3 years of experience
* BSc or higher in Operations Management, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, or a related quantitative field
* Strong expertise in Excel, Python, SQL, or similar analytical tools
* Strong with numbers, with a solid grounding in optimization, statistics, and sharp problem\-solving instincts
* Basic electrical knowledge, or willingness to pick it up quickly



  





**Who We're Looking For** 




 Your analysis drives real investment decisions on both sides, so we want someone who feels that weight and checks their work accordingly.
 


* Meticulous — you go through data line by line because you know what rides on it
* Mathematically sharp, with the instinct to spot a number that looks wrong
* A clear communicator who builds rapport with clients and gets the data you need fast
* Comfortable working directly with C\&I customers
* High ownership and hands\-on, in a small, fast\-moving team



  





**How to Apply** 



* Send your resume and a note under 200 words on why you think you are the right fit to hr@triphospower.com.

title: Specification Manager - Luxury Interiors & Projects
description:
**JSB is looking for someone who sells a premium material to architects, designers, developers and discerning homeowners — and wants a better one to sell them.** 




  





**About** 




  





 Founded in Kishangarh in 1993, JSB is one of India's largest importers and processors of natural marble. We buy blocks directly at the quarry across more than 40 countries, process them at our own facility, and hold over 400 colours in live inventory — Statuario, Calacatta, Brazilian quartzite, onyx, travertine and exotic stones.
 



  





 Architects, designers, developers and homeowners travel from across India to our Kishangarh Experience Centre to select their slabs personally.
 



  





 We deal in imported marble only. No Indian marble. No granite.
 



  





**The role** 




  





 We are opening Ahmedabad, and we are looking for the person who will own Gujarat.
 



  





 This is specification work. There is no dealer network to appoint and no monthly order book to service. Your job is to make JSB the material that gets specified — the name reached for when a project calls for something extraordinary underfoot.
 



  





 Your clientele is the full top end of the market:
 



  





 • Architects and design studios
 



 • Interior designers and turnkey interior firms
 



 • Luxury residential and hospitality developers
 



 • Project management consultants on premium projects
 



 • HNI homeowners building or renovating privately
 



  





 You will get JSB specified at design stage, hold the relationship through material selection, and bring your client to Kishangarh to choose their stone with their own eyes.
 



  





**What you will do** 




  





 • Build a specification map of Gujarat's top end — studio by studio, developer by developer, principal by principal — starting in Ahmedabad and extending through Gandhinagar, Vadodara, Surat and Rajkot
 



 • Get JSB specified at design stage on luxury residences, villas and farmhouses, high\-end apartment projects, hospitality, premium retail and flagship corporate interiors
 



 • Work both sides of a project: the design studio that specifies the material, and the developer, PMC or homeowner who signs for it
 



 • Run material presentations, place samples, and establish JSB inside design studio material libraries
 



 • Bring clients to Kishangarh. Marble is chosen with the eye. Your project becomes real when your client is standing in our slab yard, looking at the block.
 



 • Guide clients through selection: colour, veining, book\-matching, finish, and how a slab will read in the space it is going into
 



 • Own the project from selection through to delivery coordination with HQ
 



 • Maintain a disciplined pipeline: project, area in sq ft, stage, decision maker
 



  





**Who we are looking for** 




  





 You are most likely doing something close to this today at a luxury interiors or premium surfaces brand — Kohler, TOTO, Duravit, Grohe, Hansgrohe, Roca, Villeroy \& Boch, Artize, Cosentino, Caesarstone, Laminam, Häfele, Hettich, Asian Paints Beautiful Homes, Saint\-Gobain, Greenlam, or a premium lighting or decorative finishes brand.
 



  





 What matters more than the logo on your card:
 



  





 • 6 to 12 years selling a premium or luxury interior product into design studios and high\-end projects, with Ahmedabad and Gujarat as your working territory
 



 • A live relationship map you personally own — architects, interior designers, luxury developers, PMCs and HNI clients
 



 • You have sold a premium material against a cheaper alternative and won on design and value, not on discount
 



 • You can hold your own in a design conversation. You understand that when an architect chooses a material, they are choosing how a room will feel — and you can talk about it that way.
 



 • You can also hold your own in a commercial conversation with a developer or PMC on rate, quantity and delivery
 



 • You are comfortable in premium rooms: design studios, owner\-side site meetings, HNI drawing rooms
 



 • Fluent in Gujarati, Hindi and English
 



 • Graduate. A B.Arch or interior design background is a genuine advantage. MBA optional.
 



  





**Straight talk before you apply** 




  





 We would rather lose you at the advert than at month three.
 



  





 • There is no regional office or showroom in Ahmedabad. You work from the field, out of design studios and client sites. Telecalling, back office, inventory and processing all sit at Kishangarh HQ.
 



 • There is no dedicated company vehicle. Travel is reimbursed against actuals.
 



 • Clients buy by seeing the slab. A meaningful part of your performance is how many qualified clients you bring to Kishangarh.
 



 • The first 90 days are field\-first. Personal meetings, personally done.
 



 • Compensation is part fixed and part performance. The variable is uncapped and tiered by project value band, so specifying higher\-value stone pays you materially more.
 



  





 If you want a showroom to sit in and a dealer network to service, this is not your role. If you want to build a territory in your own name, for a house that buys its own blocks at the quarry and processes them itself, it is.
 



  





**What we offer** 




  





 • Fixed salary of 5\-6 LPA, based on experience and the strength of your existing network
 



 • Uncapped tiered incentive on project value, paid above threshold
 



 • Travel reimbursed at actuals, plus mobile allowance
 



 • A material with genuine range. Over 400 colours in live inventory, so you are rarely the one saying no.
 



 • Direct access to principal\-level decision making. We own the buying, the inventory and the processing, so you are never waiting on a third party to quote.
 



  





**To apply** 




  





 Email keshav.bangur@jsbstonex.com with the subject line: Specification Manager – Ahmedabad – \[Your Name]
 



  





 Answer these three questions in your email. Applications that do not answer them are not reviewed.
 



  





 1\. Name three architecture, design or developer clients in Ahmedabad you have personally worked with, and the person you deal with at each.
 



 2\. What is the largest single project you have personally specified? Project type and approximate area or value.
 



 3\. Your current fixed CTC and notice period.
 



  





 Applications are reviewed personally. If you are shortlisted, you will hear from us within five working days.

title: Tender Executive
description:

**Position Title:** 
 Tender Executive
   




**Department:** 
 Tender
   

**Minimum Qualification:** 
 B.Tech / Diploma / Master’s Degree
   

**Minimum Work Experience:** 
 0–4 years in E\-Tendering, GEM (bidding and price matching), and Tender Management
   

  

 Role Overview
   


 The Tender Executive is responsible for the comprehensive management of the tender process, from initial inquiry to final order acceptance and post\-tender activities. This role demands strong knowledge of tender procedures, market dynamics, and efficient data management to ensure competitive bidding and successful contract awards.
   

  




 Key Responsibilities
   

* **Tender Identification \& Sorting** 
  




	+ Screen and sort tenders / GEM enquiries.
	+ Share relevant opportunities with concerned departments/personnel.
* **Bidding \& Auction Participation** 
  




	+ Actively participate in tender and reverse auction processes.
	+ Identify and apply relevant GEM filters to optimize search and participation.
* **Order Processing \& Price Management** 
  




	+ Process accepted orders efficiently and accurately.
	+ Perform detailed price calculations and workouts to ensure profitability and compliance.
* **Bid Management** 
  




	+ Manage the entire bidding process, including reverse auctions (RA).
	+ Ensure seller information and updates are current and accurate.
* **Data Analysis \& Competitive Review** 
  




	+ Conduct thorough analysis of comparison data.
	+ Identify competitive advantages and areas for improvement in future bids.
* **Catalogue \& Product Management** 
  




	+ Maintain and update product catalogues.
	+ Apply appropriate filters for Level 1 (L1\) comparisons and strategic bidding.
* **Portal Management** 
  




	+ Ensure real\-time updates of stock availability and pricing on the GEM Portal.


 Skills \& Competencies
   

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Proficiency in GEM portal operations and tender management systems.
* Attention to detail with excellent organizational skills.
* Ability to work under deadlines and manage multiple tenders simultaneously.
* Effective communication and coordination skills across departments.


 Requirements
   

  

 \- Conduct continuous research on tender opportunities, industry trends, and competitor activities to identify and evaluate potential avenues for business growth.
   

 \- Maintain comprehensive and accurate records of all tender\-related documentation, ensuring strict compliance with company policies, legal regulations, and tender specifications.
   

 \- Collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams (e.g., sales, technical, finance, logistics) to gather essential information and facilitate seamless tender execution.

title: FAAS -Global Treasury Services -Manager

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* CFA designation (or CFA candidate)
* Consulting experience on complex projects

You’ll have the ability to prioritize when working on multiple engagements, as well as the ability to communicate complex information simply and effectively to audiences from all backgrounds. title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:

 Performance Marketing \& Campaign Management
 


* Plan, execute, and optimize performance marketing campaigns across platforms including Google Ads, Meta Ads, Programmatic, and OTT.
* Drive user acquisition through app installs and lead generation campaigns with a strong focus on ROI.
* Manage budgets effectively to maximize reach, efficiency, and conversion outcomes.



 Funnel Optimization \& Growth
 


* Optimize the full marketing funnel—from awareness to conversion—ensuring minimal drop\-offs and improved conversion rates.
* Drive improvements in CAC, CPL, CPI, and overall marketing efficiency.
* Develop and implement A/B testing strategies across creatives, landing pages, and targeting.

* Track, measure, and analyze campaign performance using Martech tools such as MoEngage, CleverTap, Appsflyer, Google Analytics, and Tag Manager.
* Build actionable insights from data to continuously refine targeting, creatives, and bidding strategies.
* Work closely with product and analytics teams to improve attribution and user journey tracking.



 Audience \& Lifecycle Management
 


* Leverage first\-party data and audience segmentation to improve targeting and personalization.
* Collaborate on CLM (Customer Lifecycle Marketing) initiatives including remarketing, engagement, and retention campaigns.
* Drive high\-intent audience creation and scale remarketing pools.



 Innovation \& Experimentation
 


* Stay updated with emerging trends in digital marketing, ad tech, and fintech growth strategies.

 Internal Stakeholders
 


* CEO/CXOs
* Product Team
* Business Development/Sales
* Central Operations
* Central Marketing Team



 External Stakeholders
 


* External Agencies
* Content distribution platforms

* Ability to work independently in a high\-ownership, fast\-paced environment.
* Experience in fintech, lending, or financial services industry.
* Familiarity with attribution models and MMP tools.
* Basic understanding of SQL or data analysis tools is a plus.

title: Founding Marketing Member
description:
Founding Marketing Member
 
  





**HSR Layout · On\-site · Full\-time · Reports to the founders** 

 ·
 
**₹5–6 LPA \+ life changing equity** 




**Track to Head of Marketing** 




  





 Consumer business, home services. We sell to parents in Bangalore. Just raised. Right now marketing is the founders doing it between everything else, and that stops working next month. You're the first marketing hire.
   




 The job
 
 You own all things marketing. Paid, organic, content, community, partnerships, brand. If it brings a parent or a caregiver to us, it's yours.
 



  





 You run it with your own hands. Google Ads and Meta Ads are yours from day one. You set up the campaigns, write the copy, make the creatives, manage the budget, read the numbers every morning, and kill what isn't working before it eats the month.
 



  





 Around that: landing pages, WhatsApp funnels, referrals, apartment and parent communities, content, partnerships. We sell to parents and we also recruit caregivers, so you'll run acquisition on both sides of the business.
 



  





 You'll have the freedom to bring in interns and freelancers when the work needs more hands, and you'll decide who and when.
 



  





 What you'll be measured on is simple. Cost per lead, cost per customer, and how many of those customers stay.
 



  





 High ownership, high agency. The wins are yours and so are the misses. As the team grows, this role is built to become Head of Marketing.
 



  




 You'll do well here if
 
  




* Your English writing is in the top 1%. Every ad, landing page, and WhatsApp message you write will be read by parents deciding who looks after their child. Sloppy copy costs us trust.
* You communicate clearly and briefly, in writing and in person.
* You've spent real money in Google Ads Manager and Meta Ads Manager yourself, and can tell us what your CPL was and what you did to move it.
* 1 to 4 years in. Performance marketing at a startup, a D2C brand, an agency where you actually ran the accounts, or your own side project.
* You can ship a decent creative in Canva or CapCut by lunch without waiting on a designer.
* You're comfortable in a spreadsheet and can build a funnel report on your own.
* Hindi or Kannada alongside English is a plus.



  




 How to apply
 
 Email
 **aashu@urbanparents.club** 
 , subject line "Founding Marketing".
 



 Send two things:
 


1. Three to four lines on who you are and why this role.
2. Something you've created or written that you're proud of. A campaign, an ad, a landing page, a post, an essay. Link or attachment, either works.



 We'll read every word. Those four lines are your writing sample.

**Job Description**
**About Datahash**
 Datahash is a privacy\-centric first\-party data platform. Our core product, Datahash Signals, gives marketers low\-code, no\-code integrations between web, app, e\-commerce, CRM, marketing automation and data warehouses on one side and the major ad channels on the other: Meta, Google, TikTok, Snap, Amazon and more. We are one of a handful of badged integration partners across these channels and work with them directly on first\-party data adoption programmes, where advertisers are moving to server\-side integrations, conversions APIs and privacy\-safe measurement. We are bootstrapped, profitable, and run across Dubai, Bangalore, Mumbai and London with clients in EMEA, India, Africa, APAC and the US.
   

  

**The role**
 Marketing at Datahash runs agent\-first: a marketing head agent plans, content and page agents produce, an inbound agent qualifies, and named humans approve. This seat is for the person who directs that machine: an operator who owns the voice, the partner\-marketing relationships with Meta, Google, Snap and TikTok, and the demand numbers, and who directs the agents rather than replacing them. You will not be asked to build the machine; it exists. You will be asked to make it produce leads and to make Datahash sound like one company.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Own the number. Marketing\-qualified leads from 25 to 100 a month across eight engines, with the segment, journey and content calendar the agents run reviewed by you weekly.
* Own the voice. Every external asset sounds like Datahash: you set the standard, the agents produce to it, and you are the final human read on anything public.
* Own the partner marketing. Co\-marketing programmes and MDF with the channel partners, from claim to campaign, in partnership with the Growth Manager (Channel Partnerships).
* Direct the agents. Brief them, correct them, measure them: acceptance rate, cost per accepted output and the override log are your management tools.
* Launch. Run the SYNAPSE launch communications and the design\-partner programme to the existing base.


**What Success Looks Like**
* MQL ramp on plan with source and quality tracked.
* Case studies shipping monthly with consent, in the three registers we use.
* Partner co\-marketing live with at least one channel per quarter.
* Agent acceptance rates rising quarter on quarter under your direction.


**How We Hire**
 We move fast and we are transparent about how we decide. Every decision about a person is made by a person.
   

  

 Step 1: a short structured screen within two working days of applying. Step 2: a 50\-minute conversation with the hiring manager. Step 3: a small case exercise close to the real work, which you present to two or three of us. Step 4: fit and terms with our VP Delivery or Head of Sales and Partnerships, and for senior roles the founder. We aim to give you a decision within five working days of the final conversation.
   

  

 We evaluate evidence rather than claims, the quality of your questions, how you handle ambiguity, and how naturally you already use AI in your own work.
   

  

**Requirements**
**What we need from you**
* Five to eight years in B2B marketing for SaaS, adtech or martech with demand and content ownership.
* You have worked with platform partner marketing teams (Google, Meta or similar) and know how co\-marketing funds actually get spent.
* A strong editorial eye and a plain writing style; you can tell AI cadence from a human sentence and fix it.
* Daily, expert use of AI tools; you have already directed AI\-produced content at volume.
* Comfort with analytics: GA4, CRM reporting, attribution.


**Nice to have**
* Experience launching a product to an installed base.
* Experience in a company below 100 people where you were the whole marketing function.


**Probably not a fit if**
* You want a team of humans to manage; the team is mostly agents.
* You would rather write everything yourself than direct production.


**Benefits**
* A startup environment backed by a stable, bootstrapped, profitable business.
* Competitive compensation and one of the most employee\-friendly ESOP programmes in the industry.
* Work from anywhere, on your hours; coworking access when you want a change from home.
* Health cover for you and your family.
* Real international exposure: clients and partners across the Gulf, Europe, Africa, India, APAC and the US.
* A yearly offsite that we take seriously, and a culture that does not.


 Datahash is an equal\-opportunity employer. We hire on evidence and fit for the work and do not ask for salary history. Compensation is discussed at the fit\-and\-terms stage.
