title: Marketing Manager
description:
**About RenewCO2**




 RenewCO2 makes carbon\-negative chemicals and fuels. Our electrocatalytic CO2 utilization technology runs on electricity, water, and waste CO2, and the product drops straight into existing industrial supply chains. Because the process is energy\-efficient, our cost structure competes with fossil\-derived incumbents rather than relying on a green premium.
 



  





 We are venture\-backed with grant funding from the U.S. Department of Energy, NSF, DARPA, the New Jersey Commission on Science, Innovation and Technology, and Breakthrough Energy. The technology is demonstrated at pilot scale with customers, and we are now building toward commercial scale. R\&D is based in the United States; product development and manufacturing happen in India. Our customers are chemical, fuel, and materials producers across Asia, Europe, and North and Latin America.
 



  





 This role is based in Chikkaballapur, Karnataka, at Ohmium International, which builds green hydrogen electrolyzers at a gigafactory there. RenewCO2 has a joint development agreement with Ohmium: working beside a partner that already makes electrochemical stacks at volume shortens our path to manufacturing at scale.
 



  





**The role**




 You will be our first marketing hire in India, owning marketing execution: what we say, where we say it, and whether the market takes us seriously. This is a build job — no playbook, no large budget, no agency doing the thinking.
 



  





 Our buyers are chemical producers, fuel producers, industrial gas companies, EPC contractors, and licensors. They make eight\-figure decisions slowly, with a technical committee in the room. Your job is to make RenewCO2 legible to that audience and make a small team read as the serious technology company it is. You will work with a Brand \& Marketing Designer, hiring in parallel, and directly with technical and commercial leadership in the U.S.
 



  





**What you will do**




*Positioning and messaging* 



* Own the messaging architecture: what RenewCO2 is, what each product line solves, why our approach wins on cost and energy efficiency, and what we can and cannot claim today.
* Turn technical and techno\-economic material into arguments that hold up in front of a process engineer and a CFO in the same meeting.
* Track adjacent CO2 conversion, power\-to\-X, and low\-carbon chemical players, and feed that back into positioning and commercial strategy.



  





*Content* 



* Run the content calendar: technical posts, bylined articles, case notes, explainers, LinkedIn, newsletters.
* Write and place bylines and interviews in the trade press our buyers actually read — chemicals, energy, hydrogen, aviation fuel, and polymers.
* Write and submit award applications; handle analyst and industry\-database relationships.



  





*Website and digital* 



* Run the website as a commercial asset: information architecture, copy, publishing cadence, on\-page SEO, conversion paths. You publish in the CMS directly with the designer.
* Run LinkedIn as our main organic and paid channel, plus targeted email.
* Set up the measurement layer: GA4, CRM hygiene, UTM discipline. Report on what produces qualified conversations.



  





*Events and conferences* 



* Own the conference program: which events, abstract and speaking submissions, booth briefs, pre\-show outreach, meeting scheduling, follow\-up, and cost reporting.
* Prepare spokespeople with slides, talk tracks, likely questions, and clear boundaries on what is public.



  





*Commercial and investor support* 



* Build what the commercial team needs: capability decks, one\-pagers, technical FAQs, objection handling, customer\-specific pitch versions.
* Support fundraising and partner diligence with investor\-grade material, working with the CEO and CTO.
* Coordinate joint communications with partners, including anything tied to the Ohmium joint development agreement, with written approval on both sides.



  





*Team, vendors, and budget* 



* Manage and art\-direct the Brand \& Marketing Designer. Brief and manage outside vendors: PR support, translators, printers, exhibit builders, videographers.
* Own the marketing budget and report on spend and return each quarter.



  





**Required qualifications**



* Five to seven years in B2B marketing, at least three marketing something technical: process technology, capital equipment, specialty chemicals, energy, or industrial hardware.
* You work straight from technical source material — hand you a conference abstract, a techno\-economic analysis, or a process flow diagram and you produce accurate copy without an engineer rewriting it. Bring an example.
* Comfortable with the units our buyers live in: tonnes of CO2 per year, cost per tonne, kWh per kilogram, capacity factor, carbon intensity, life cycle assessment, technology readiness level. You do not need to be an electrochemist. You do need to never publish a wrong number.
* Experience marketing to industrial buyers — procurement, sustainability, corporate development, process engineering — through a sales cycle measured in years.
* You have run a B2B conference program: abstracts and speaking submissions against hard deadlines, booth planning, pre\-show meeting generation, and post\-show reporting. Familiarity with the chemicals, hydrogen, carbon management, sustainable aviation fuel, or polyester and packaging circuits helps.
* Hands\-on with LinkedIn organic and paid, a CRM or marketing automation platform (HubSpot, Salesforce, or Marketo), GA4, and a CMS you can publish in yourself.
* Publication\-quality written English. Your press releases, bylines, and website copy have to convince a chemical engineer and a journalist at once.
* Judgment about claims and confidentiality. Performance data does not go out before a patent is filed. Overstated environmental claims create real legal exposure — we treat this as non\-negotiable.
* Willingness to hold a standing evening overlap with our U.S. team in Eastern Time. Bachelor's degree; chemistry, chemical engineering, materials, or environmental engineering counts for a lot.



  





**Strongly preferred**



* Time at a hard\-tech or climate\-tech company between pilot and first plant — you know the difference between marketing a product that exists and marketing a credible plan to build one.
* Experience on fundraising or diligence material: investor decks, data rooms.
* Exposure to government\-funded program communications: DOE, MNRE and the National Green Hydrogen Mission, DST, or state clean energy programs.
* Working knowledge of what drives our customers' purchasing: ISCC PLUS and mass balance chemistry, CORSIA, RED III, EU ETS and CBAM, 45Q and 45V.
* Experience hiring or art\-directing a designer and holding vendors to a budget.
* Kannada or Hindi alongside English, for local partner, vendor, and press work.



  





**What success looks like in six months**



* One agreed messaging framework in use across the website, decks, and commercial conversations, with claim boundaries written down and respected.
* A rebuilt website our commercial team sends to prospects without being asked, updatable in hours.
* A published event and speaking calendar four quarters out, submissions in, booths budgeted.
* A working content cadence and measurement baseline that shows which activity produces qualified conversations.



  





**This role is probably not for you if...** 



* You need an established brand, a real budget, or a team underneath you to be effective.
* You would rather hand technical content to someone else than get inside it.
* Saying "we do not have that data yet" to a colleague, a journalist, or a prospect makes you uncomfortable.



  





**Location, working pattern, and compensation**




 Hybrid: two days a week on site in Chikkaballapur, the rest wherever you work best. A company shuttle runs from Bengaluru.
 



 Compensation: ₹17–20 lakh fixed CTC, plus equity and benefits. A standing overlap with Eastern Time usually costs part of your evening rather than a full shift.
 



  





**What to submit**




 We read work samples closely and CV formatting barely at all. Send three to five pieces, each with a line or two of context and a clear statement of what you did versus what a team or agency did.
 


* Something technical you wrote from primary source material: a byline, white paper, application note, or technical post.
* A positioning document, one\-pager, or deck narrative you authored. We are reading the argument, not the design.
* One campaign or conference program you ran — objective, what you did, the result. Include one that underperformed and what you changed.
* A website or landing page you owned, with a live link and a note on what you changed and why.
* Optional: a press release, award submission, or placement you landed.



  





 Do not send anything under NDA. Redact figures, customer names, and unpublished data, or just describe the work — we will take your description at face value and ask about it in the interview.
 



  





**How to apply**




 Apply at https://www.renewco2\.com/careers?bzid\=6764731291dc.
 



  





*RenewCO2 is an equal opportunity employer. We judge candidates on what they have done and what they can do, and we welcome applicants of every background. If you need an accommodation at any stage, tell us and we will arrange it.*

title: Marketing Technology Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced and solutions\-driven Marketing Technology Engineer to join our marketing technology team. This role will focus on developing, implementing and optimizing marketing automation solutions in
 **Braze** 
 and across our connected tech stack Segment, Qualtrics, Sprig, and other internal tools.
 



**Responsibilities** 



* Collaborate with marketing teams, functional leads, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable marketing automation programs using
 **Braze** 
 .
* Design, build, and maintain end\-to\-end campaigns, including batch sends, triggered workflows, and lifecycle automations, from QA through deployment.
* Implement and optimize Canvas, Campaigns, and API\-triggered programs to support behavioral and transactional use cases.
* Own segmentation strategy, hygiene, suppression logic, and complex audience builds to ensure accurate targeting and personalization.
* Write and optimize Liquid logic for dynamic content rendering across email, SMS, in\-app, and push channels.
* Customize templates, content blocks, and reusable components within
 **Braze** 
 .
* Build, maintain, and optimize survey programs in
 **Qualtrics** 
 and
 **Sprig** 
 , including NPS, CSAT, MSAT, and targeted feedback initiatives.
* Integrate survey triggers with
 **Braze** 
 campaigns and customer journeys to enable closed\-loop feedback and follow\-up workflows.
* Partner with Product, CX, and Analytics teams to operationalize survey insights into lifecycle messaging and experience improvements.
* QA campaigns, templates, canvases, and surveys to ensure accuracy, compliance, and performance.
* Execute A/B tests and continuous optimization across campaigns and workflows.
* Generate audience and campaign performance reports; analyze results and provide actionable insights to improve engagement and conversion.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to Liquid logic, campaign configuration, surveys, integrations, and data flows.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure compliance with CAN\-SPAM, GDPR, CCPA, and internal governance standards.
* Stay current on MarTech platform features, best practices, and industry trends.



**Qualifications:** 



* 4\+ years of hands\-on experience implementing marketing automation solutions using
 **Braze** 
 or similar platforms.
* Deep expertise in segmentation, lifecycle orchestration, and personalization strategies.
* Strong hands\-on experience with HTML, CSS, and working knowledge of Python or Go for logic and integrations.
* Experience writing code\-based personalization logic (e.g., Liquid).
* Familiarity with REST APIs and SDKs for web and mobile integrations.
* Experience building and managing surveys in
 **Qualtrics** 
 and/or
 **Sprig** 
 .
* Experience with CRM systems and integrating them with marketing automation tools.
* Strong analytical skills with experience in campaign reporting, experimentation, and optimization.
* Solid understanding of data privacy regulations and marketing compliance best practices.
* Good communication and collaboration skills across technical and non\-technical teams.



**Preferred Qualifications:** 



* Certification in
 **Braze** 
 or other marketing automation platforms.
* Experience with marketing automation platforms such as
 **Braze** 
 , Marketo, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Sailthru or Iterable.
* Experience with
 **Qualtrics** 
 ,
 **Sprig** 
 or other survey platforms.
* Knowledge of SQL for data manipulation and extraction.

title: Content Marketing Intern
description:
**Content Marketing Intern** 

*6\-month paid internship with a pathway to full\-time employment, contingent on performance.* 




  




**About Zenskar** 


 Zenskar is an AI\-native revenue automation platform built to handle real\-world complexity. It sits between your CRM and ERP, automating everything in between: billing, revenue recognition, collections, usage metering, and analytics — across any pricing model, any entity structure, any currency.
 




**Our vision: Zero\-Touch Finance.** 

 Agents execute. Humans supervise. Finance teams set the rules. Zenskar runs them.
 





 Founded by Apurv Bansal and Saurabh Agarwal — second\-time founders whose previous startups were acquired by Snapdeal and Gaana. The team brings experience from Google, Deutsche Bank, Elevation Capital, IIT Bombay, IIT Delhi, and Harvard Business School.
 





 We have 5x'd revenue in the past year and are default alive.
 




**Funding:** 

 We raised $15M in Series A funding in April 2026, led by Susquehanna Venture Capital, Bessemer Venture Partners, Shine Capital, and Rho, with participation from Rocketship, J\-Ventures, Future Back Ventures by Bain \& Company, and Converge.
 




  




**What Customers Say** 

*"We're saving 200\+ hours/quarter on invoicing and receivables by completely automating our recurring billing."* 




**— Noy Kalansky, Finance Controller, Pontera** 




*"Zenskar automates revenue recognition accurately for our value\-based billing: agents reducing manual hours by 70%."* 




**— Matt Barnard, VP Finance, Vertice** 




*"Zenskar's agents automated 90% of our billing, integrated with our CRM, and accelerated revenue collection by a month."* 




**— Ming Lui, VP Finance, Yembo** 




*"We launched our product 4 months faster instead of building an in\-house system for our usage\-based pricing."* 




**— Kshitij Gupta, CEO, 100ms** 




  




**About This Role** 


 We're looking for an AI GTM Intern to own end\-to\-end SEO and content marketing workflows, automation, and analytics. This is a Bangalore\-based hybrid role where you'll work closely with the content marketing lead to streamline ops at an early\-stage, fast\-moving startup.
 





 The internship runs for 3 months, with a pathway to full\-time employment, contingent on performance.
 




  






 If you thrive on ownership, rapid experimentation, and turning chaos into scalable systems, this is your chance to shape Zenskar's growth engine from the inside.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 

 GTM Engineering (50% of the role)
 
* Build and maintain automation workflows using tools like Claude Code and Cursor to connect HubSpot, Webflow, MailerLite, and other tools in the content marketing stack.
* Experiment with AI agents and LLM\-powered workflows to automate repetitive GTM tasks, including content brief creation, Reddit and community distribution, and organic backlink acquisition.
* Automate weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting on organic traffic, social traffic, demos booked, pipeline, and revenue attribution.
* Build a self\-improving product knowledge base using Claude.
* Build content automation workflows that turn ICP insights into high\-converting content.
* Automate keyword research and SEO content briefs.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and build solutions to improve efficiency.



 Core Content Marketing Ops (50% of the role)
 
* Maintain and update the website (Webflow), including content updates, landing pages, SEO changes, forms, and pop\-ups.
* Coordinate content distribution across channels like Reddit and LinkedIn, and identify opportunities to improve social reach, engagement, and referral traffic.
* Build, manage, and optimize campaigns and newsletters in MailerLite and HubSpot.
* Drive customer reviews on G2, Capterra, and SourceForge to build credibility.
* Drive organic backlinks through outreach and partnerships.
* Own and close monthly technical SEO issues and escalations.
* Assist with writing and publishing high\-quality blogs and other SEO\-led content aligned with Zenskar’s ICP and content strategy.



  




**What You Can Expect** 
* Ownership from Day 1: Run content marketing ops like your own startup within Zenskar.
* Growth opportunity: Meaningful work with a clear path to full\-time based on what you build.
* High learning curve: Master ops execution and analytics in a high\-impact, high\-visibility role.
* Cross\-functional exposure: Partner with field, growth, product marketing, and sales teams.



  




**Key Qualifications** 
* 1 year of experience interning running content marketing ops end\-to\-end.
* Content writing experience with a portfolio of SEO\-led content.
* Familiarity with GTM engineering: building automations, integrations, or lightweight AI pipelines is a strong differentiator.
* Proven ownership: Takes full accountability and proactively fixes issues before being asked.
* Ops proficiency: Familiar with (or fast to learn) HubSpot, MailerLite, Webflow, Looker Studio.
* Strong analytics mindset: Tracks metrics like conversion rates, pipeline impact, and review volume — and presents findings clearly.
* Not taking yourself too seriously :)



  




**Location** 
* Bangalore (or willing to relocate to Bangalore once you convert to a full\-time hire). The internship itself can be remote.
* Hybrid — 2\-3 days per week
* Office: Indiranagar, Bengaluru — 3rd Floor, A Wing, No. 1, Carlton Towers, HAL Old Airport Rd, HAL 2nd Stage, Bengaluru 560008\.



  




**Interview Process** 


 Our interview process is designed to be structured and efficient.

title: Social media executive
description:
Social Media Executive – Content \& Creative
   

  

 Company: BookMyPoojaLocation: Bengaluru
   

 Employment Type: Full\-Time \| Work From Office
   

 Working Days: 6 Days a Week
   

 Working Hours: 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM
   

 Compensation: ₹3 LPA \+ Performance\-Based Incentives
   

  

 About BookMyPooja
   

  

 BookMyPooja is a technology\-enabled platform connecting families with verified pandits and traditional Hindu puja services across India.
   

  

 We are looking for a creative and hands\-on Social Media Executive who can turn real pujas, rituals, temples, festivals, and cultural moments into engaging digital content.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who enjoys shooting videos, editing, brainstorming ideas, travelling to puja locations, and understanding Indian/Hindu traditions.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 🎥 Video Shooting \& Cinematic Content
   

  

 \* Shoot high\-quality videos and reels at puja ceremonies, homes, temples, events and other locations.
   

 \* Capture cinematic shots of rituals, pandits, decorations, samagri and important moments.
   

 \* Plan shots, angles, sequences and storytelling before and during shoots.
   

 \* Create short\-form content for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and other social platforms.
   

 \* Travel to different puja locations, customer homes, temples and events for content creation.
   

  

 ✂️ Video Editing
   

  

 \* Independently edit engaging short\-form videos and reels.
   

 \* Add music, transitions, subtitles, voiceovers, sound effects and storytelling elements.
   

 \* Create content that feels authentic, premium and culturally appropriate.
   

 \* Repurpose long\-form footage into multiple social media assets.
   

 \* Maintain consistent visual quality and brand identity.
   

  

 💡 Content \& Brainstorming
   

  

 \* Generate new and creative content ideas around:
   

  

 \* Hindu rituals \& traditions
   

 \* Pujas and festivals
   

 \* Hindu mythology
   

 \* Pandit stories and experiences
   

 \* Behind\-the\-scenes content
   

 \* Customer experiences
   

 \* Temple and cultural content
   

 \* Educational/religious content
   

 \* Research trending formats, sounds and content styles and adapt them appropriately.
   

 \* Participate actively in weekly content brainstorming sessions.
   

 \* Develop concepts from idea → shoot → edit → publish.
   

 🎨 Designing \& Social Media
   

  

 \* Create basic social media creatives, thumbnails, posters and stories.
   

 \* Design content using tools such as Canva, Photoshop or similar software.
   

 \* Assist with maintaining BookMyPooja's social media calendar.
   

 \* Write basic captions, hooks and content copy.
   

 \* Monitor content performance and use insights to improve future content.
   

  

  

 🛕 Cultural \& Religious Understanding
   

  

 The candidate should have a genuine interest in Hindu rituals, traditions and Indian culture.
   

  

 You should be comfortable understanding and correctly representing:
   

  

 \* Different Hindu pujas and rituals
   

 \* Festival traditions
   

 \* Basic Sanskrit/Hindu terminology
   

 \* Regional variations in rituals and customs
   

 \* Temple etiquette and cultural sensitivities
   

  

 Prior experience in religious/cultural content is an advantage.
   

  

  

 🚗 Travel \& On\-Site Work
   

  

 This is not a desk\-only social media role.
   

  

 You will regularly travel to:
   

  

 \* Customer homes
   

 \* Puja locations
   

 \* Temples
   

 \* Apartment societies
   

 \* Religious events
   

 \* Festivals
   

 \* BookMyPooja events
   

  

 You should enjoy being on the ground, meeting people, carrying out shoots and finding interesting stories.
   

  

 Local travel for shoots will be part of the role.
   

  

 Required Skills
   

  

 Must Have
   

  

 \* Strong video shooting skills
   

 \* Strong video editing skills
   

 \* Good understanding of Instagram Reels \& YouTube Shorts
   

 \* Creative thinking and brainstorming ability
   

 \* Good sense of framing, composition and storytelling
   

 \* Basic graphic designing skills
   

 \* Ability to shoot using a smartphone/camera
   

 \* Understanding of social media trends
   

 \* Willingness to travel for shoots
   

 \* Interest in Hindu culture and rituals
   

 \* Ability to work independently from concept to final content
   

  

 Software / Tools
   

  

 Experience with one or more of:
   

  

 \* Adobe Premiere Pro
   

 \* After Effects
   

 \* DaVinci Resolve
   

 \* CapCut
   

 \* Canva
   

 \* Photoshop
   

 \* Lightroom
   

  

 Strong editing and shooting ability is more important than knowing every software tool
   

  

 Who We Are Looking For
   

  

 We are looking for someone who:
   

  

 \* Thinks like a content creator, not just a social media manager.
   

 \* Can take an ordinary puja and turn it into an engaging story.
   

 \* Is comfortable approaching people and shooting real moments.
   

 \* Has a strong eye for cinematic visuals.
   

 \* Can come up with ideas independently.
   

 \* Is comfortable travelling for shoots.
   

 \* Understands that religious content requires respect, accuracy and sensitivity.
   

 \* Takes ownership of the complete content process.
   

 \* Is energetic, curious and willing to experiment.
   

  

 Performance \& KPIs
   

  

 The role will include performance\-based incentives linked to measurable KPIs such as:
   

  

 \* Quality and consistency of content produced
   

 \* Number of reels/videos delivered
   

 \* Content engagement and reach
   

 \* Growth in social media followers
   

 \* Video views and watch time
   

 \* Creative campaign performance
   

 \* Timely execution of the content calendar
   

 \* Lead/enquiry contribution from social media
   

 \* Successful execution of on\-ground shoots and campaigns
   

  

 Salary: ₹3,00,000 per annum
   

 Additional:Performance\-based incentives linked to agreed KPIs.
   

  

  

 Experience
   

  

 Experience:1–3 years preferred.
   

  

 Freshers with an exceptional portfolio in video editing, cinematic shooting, content creation or social media may also be considered.
   

  

 Portfolio Required
   

  

 Candidates should share examples of:
   

  

 \* Reels/videos edited by them
   

 \* Videos they have personally shot
   

 \* Cinematic/creative work
   

 \* Social media campaigns or pages handled
   

 \* Graphic designs, if available
   

  

 Portfolio quality will be given significant importance.
   

  

 Why Join BookMyPooja?
   

  

 \* Work at the intersection of technology, culture and spirituality
   

 \* Shoot real pujas and cultural experiences
   

 \* Travel to different locations for content
   

 \* Build a strong portfolio in a unique content category
   

 \* Work directly with the creative and marketing team
   

 \* Opportunity to experiment with new content formats
   

 \* Performance\-based incentives for results

title: UGC Creative Strategist
description:
About 755\.
 




  






 755 is built for a world where brands need to create more content, for more audiences, across more platforms without treating every piece of content like a traditional advertising campaign.
 





 We work at the intersection of creative, creators, culture and performance.
 





 Our UGC practice is focused on building creator\-led content systems that help brands communicate naturally, test rapidly and learn continuously.
 




  






 We’re looking for a
 
**UGC Creative Strategist** 

 who can sit at the centre of that system.
 





 Someone who understands people, platforms and persuasion and can turn those insights into creator content that actually works.
 




  





**Role** 



* This is not a social media copywriting role.
* And it isn’t simply about writing scripts for influencers.
* As a UGC Creative Strategist, you will be responsible for figuring out what we should say, who should say it, how they should say it, and why someone should care.
* You will research brands, products, customers, competitors and platform behaviour to develop creative hypotheses and translate them into UGC concepts, scripts and creator briefs.
* You will then work with creators and production teams to bring those ideas to life and with performance teams to understand what worked, what didn’t, and what we should test next.
* The job is ultimately about building a repeatable creative learning loop:
* Research → Insight → Angle → Hook → Script → Creator → Content → Performance → Learning → Next Iteration



  





**What you will do?** 




  





**Find the Insight** 





 Before writing anything, understand the problem.
 





 You will:
 



* Understand the product, category and competitive landscape.
* Study customer reviews, comments, Reddit threads, marketplaces, social conversations and other sources of consumer language.
* Identify customer pain points, motivations, objections, anxieties and purchase triggers.
* Analyse competitor advertising and creator content.
* Identify emerging formats, behaviours and cultural conversations across Instagram, YouTube and other relevant platforms.
* Turn research into clear creative opportunities.



  





**Develop Creative Angles** 





 You will develop:
 



* Consumer problems
* Product truths
* Benefits and RTBs
* Emotional motivations
* Objection\-handling angles
* Use cases
* Comparisons
* Demonstrations
* Testimonials
* Founder/expert narratives
* Cultural and contextual angles



  





**Build Hooks \& Concepts** 



* You should understand that the first few seconds can determine whether the rest of the content gets watched at all.
* You will develop multiple hooks and creative routes around each strategic angle.
* These could include:
* Pattern interrupts.Questions.Confessions.Contrarian opinions.Product demonstrations. Problem → solution narratives. POVs. Reviews. Stories. Challenges. Before/after structures. Native platform formats. And occasionally something we haven’t seen before.
* We don’t want someone who simply copies trending formats.
* We want someone who understands why a format works and knows when to use it.



  





**Write UGC Scripts** 





 You should be comfortable writing:
 



* 15–60 second performance ads
* Organic\-style UGC
* Testimonials
* Product demonstrations
* Problem/solution videos
* Founder/expert\-led content
* Creator storytelling
* Direct\-response ads
* Multiple hook and CTA variations



  





**Brief Creators** 





 You will create creator briefs that clearly communicate:
 



* The objective
* The audience
* The insight
* The angle
* The hook
* The narrative
* Product information
* Mandatory messaging
* Visual direction
* B\-roll requirements
* References
* Dos and don’ts
* CTA




 You will work with creators to ensure they understand the idea without making every creator sound like the same person.
 




  





**Review \& Improve Content** 





 Your responsibility doesn’t end when the script is approved.
 





 You will review creator submissions and identify:
 



* Weak hooks
* Unnatural delivery
* Poor pacing
* Missing product moments
* Weak demonstrations
* Unnecessary exposition
* Better edit opportunities
* Stronger CTAs
* Opportunities for additional variations



  





**Learn From Performance** 





 You will work closely with performance teams to understand signals such as:
 



* Thumb\-stop / hook performance
* Watch time and retention
* CTR
* Engagement
* Conversion
* CPA / CAC
* ROAS
* Creative fatigue




 But we don’t expect you to become a media buyer.
 





 We expect you to ask:
 





 Why did this creative work?
 





 And more importantly:
 





 What should we make next because of it?
 




  





**What We’re Looking For** 





 We care more about how you think than the title you’ve previously held.
 





 You could come from:
 



* Creative strategy
* Performance creative
* Copywriting
* Content strategy
* Social media
* Creator marketing
* Influencer marketing
* Advertising
* D2C / ecommerce




 But you should have a strong understanding of internet\-native content and consumer behaviour.
 




  






 You should be someone who:
 



* Can spend an hour researching before writing a single line.
* Understands the difference between an insight and an observation.
* Can generate 10 genuinely different angles instead of rewriting the same idea 10 times.
* Is fluent in both Hindi and English, with the ability to write and speak naturally in both languages.
* Writes dialogue that sounds like something a human being would actually say.
* Understands how Instagram, YouTube and creator ecosystems behave.
* Can distinguish between content designed for entertainment and content designed to persuade.
* Is comfortable looking at performance data.
* Can take feedback without becoming precious about an idea.
* Is naturally curious about brands, advertising, creators and internet culture.
* Consumes an unreasonable amount of content and can explain why something caught their attention.

title: SEO / AEO Specialist
description:
Candescent is a forward\-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in\-person channels.
   

  

 Our Experience\-Led, Intelligence\-Driven approach combines human\-centered design with data, automation, and cloud\-based innovation. Built on an API\-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.
   

  

**Job Summary**
*Role Purpose*
 Candescent is seeking an analytical, detail\-oriented SEO / AEO Specialist to grow our organic search visibility and traffic from one of our India office locations. You will own hands\-on execution across keyword research, on\-page and technical optimisation, and content collaboration, while tracking performance and translating data into clear recommendations.
   

  

 This is an execution\-focused role. The Web Strategy Manager sets overall search direction and priorities; you own the day\-to\-day work that delivers against them. You will work closely with content, web development, and demand generation teams to ensure our site is discoverable, fast, and well\-structured for both traditional search engines and emerging AI\-driven answer experiences.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities And Deliverables**
*What you will be responsible for and what you will do*
**Technical \& On\-Page SEO**
* Perform technical SEO audits covering site speed, crawlability, indexation, site architecture, structured data, and mobile usability, and partner with the web development team to resolve issues.
* Optimise existing pages and new content for on\-page best practices including titles, meta descriptions, headers, internal linking, and schema markup.
* Partner with the web team to ensure site changes and new page launches follow SEO best practices before they go live.


**Research, Content \& AEO**
* Conduct keyword research and competitive analysis to identify growth opportunities and content gaps.
* Collaborate with content and marketing teams to plan and brief search\-friendly content that aligns with search intent.
* Apply emerging Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) practices to improve visibility in AI\-driven search surfaces such as Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Perplexity.
* Support backlink and digital PR efforts that build domain authority.


**Measurement \& Reporting**
* Monitor and report on organic performance using Google Analytics (GA4\), Google Search Console, and SEO tooling.
* Track rankings, traffic, and conversion trends, and translate data into actionable recommendations.
* Present regular performance reporting and insight to stakeholders.


**Collaboration \& Ways of Working**
* Work to the direction and priorities set by the Web Strategy Manager, flagging trade\-offs and opportunities as they arise.
* Partner with web development, design, content, and demand generation teams to get recommendations implemented.
* Stay current on search engine algorithm updates and evolving discoverability practices.
* Maintain a working schedule with sufficient overlap with US business hours on at least a few days each week to enable live collaboration, reviews, and handoffs.


**Experience**
*Demonstrated skills, competencies, and required experience*
* 6–9 years of experience in SEO, digital marketing, or a related role.
* Strong understanding of technical SEO, on\-page optimisation, and content strategy.
* Hands\-on experience with Google Analytics (GA4\) and Google Search Console.
* Proficiency with SEO tooling such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, or Screaming Frog.
* Familiarity with emerging AEO concepts and how AI\-driven search surfaces are changing discoverability.
* Basic understanding of HTML and CSS and how site structure impacts search performance.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Excellent written communication skills, and comfort briefing content teams and writing optimised copy.
* Detail\-oriented and organised, with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.


**Qualifications \& Preferred Distinctions**
*Additional accomplishments*
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
* Experience with Webflow or other content management platforms is preferred.
* Experience with structured data and schema markup implementation is preferred.
* Familiarity with A/B testing and conversion rate optimisation is a plus.
* Experience supporting financial services, technology, B2B, SaaS, or enterprise software brands is preferred.
* Experience collaborating across geographies and time zones is helpful.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Consistent quarter\-over\-quarter growth in organic traffic and keyword rankings.
* Improved site health scores and a reducing backlog of technical SEO issues.
* Content that ranks well and genuinely satisfies search intent.
* Growing visibility in AI\-driven answer experiences.
* Clear, data\-backed reporting that informs content and web strategy decisions.


**What Will Make You Successful**
* Persistence in chasing fixes through to implementation rather than stopping at the recommendation.
* Curiosity about how search is changing, and willingness to test new approaches.
* Strong attention to detail and a high standard of craft and quality.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and shifting priorities without losing momentum.
* Clear, proactive communication with stakeholders across geographies and time zones.
* A collaborative, low\-ego working style and a genuine willingness to give and receive feedback.
* Strong organisation, follow\-through, and accountability in a global, fast\-paced environment.


**Statement to Third Party Agencies**
 To ALL recruitment agencies: Candescent only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.

title: Sr. Designer, Brand & Communications
description:
Candescent is a forward\-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in\-person channels.
   

  

 Our Experience\-Led, Intelligence\-Driven approach combines human\-centered design with data, automation, and cloud\-based innovation. Built on an API\-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.
   

  

**Job Summary**
*Role Purpose*
 Candescent is seeking a highly skilled Senior Designer to join our Brand \& Communications team from one of our India office locations. This role will help bring the Candescent brand to life across internal, client\-facing, executive, event, digital, and sales enablement materials. The ideal candidate combines strong design craft, production discipline, visual problem\-solving, and brand stewardship with the ability to move quickly across a wide range of requests.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on design role, not a review\-only or coordination role. The Senior Designer will personally create, refine, and finalize high\-quality work while partnering closely with brand, communications, marketing, product marketing, sales, events, and executive stakeholders. Success requires excellent judgment, strong typography and layout skills, comfort with content\-heavy materials, and the ability to maintain a consistent visual standard across every touchpoint.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities and Deliverables
   

  

*What you will be responsible for and what you will do*

Striking a perfect balance between creativity and analytical thinking, the content marketing team for APAC ensures to bring forth InMobi's voice to advertisers and marketers in the region with thoughtful marketing campaigns. **Additional Skills We Would Love to Have**


* Great presentation skills with a flair for narration and storytelling
* Strong research and analytical skills

At InMobi, culture isn't a buzzword; it's an ethos woven by every InMobian, reflecting our diverse backgrounds and experiences.

title: Marketing Operations Manager
description:
**About SuperOps** 




 SuperOps is building the AI\-native platform for modern IT management unifying PSA and RMM into a single, agent\-first system that enables IT teams and MSPs to run and scale their operations with dramatically less manual effort. We are backed by Addition Partners, March Capital, Matrix Partners India, Elevation Capital, and Tanglin Venture Partners
 



  





 SuperOps is looking for a Marketing Operations Manager to own the full marketing infrastructure \- from the systems and automation that power our campaigns to the data and attribution layer that tells us what's working. This is a high\-ownership role that sits at the intersection of strategy, execution, and technology.
 



 You will own everything: HubSpot infrastructure, lead lifecycle and scoring, multi\-touch attribution, AI\-native workflows, campaign operations, SDR enablement, and the reporting systems that keep the revenue team aligned. You won't just manage tools \- you'll build systems that diagnose problems, surface insights, and keep the pipeline moving.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




**Marketing Operations Strategy and Operating Model** 



* Build and own the Marketing Operations roadmap, operating model and quarterly priorities.
* Create a clear intake and prioritisation process so the function focuses on work with measurable pipeline or efficiency impact.
* Establish documentation, change\-management and continuity standards for critical systems and workflows.
* Partner with Marketing, RevOps, SDR leadership and Finance on shared definitions, processes and service\-level agreements.



**Marketing Systems and Lifecycle** 



* Own and continuously improve HubSpot's marketing architecture, including properties, workflows, segmentation, campaign structures, lifecycle automation and integrations.
* Define and maintain lifecycle stages, qualification criteria, lead and account scoring, nurture paths, routing and SDR handoffs in partnership with RevOps.
* Improve data quality through reliable enrichment, deduplication, field standards, governance and exception monitoring across contact and company records.
* Create documentation, change\-control practices and service\-level agreements that make critical processes reliable and easy to operate.
* Monitor routing performance and SLA adherence, using SDR feedback to improve lead and account quality over time.



**GTM Intelligence and Market Research** 



* Build and maintain the target\-account universe for IT and mid\-market segments, with clear ICP tiers, verticals, regions, use cases and buying groups.
* Run the Marketing Research Engine (MRE) as a repeatable intelligence process that produces campaign\-ready and SDR\-ready audiences not one\-off lists.
* Combine fit, engagement, intent and timing sign signals to prioritise accounts and recommend the appropriate nurture, campaign or SDR action.
* Use campaign outcomes and SDR feedback to improve data sources, segments, scoring models and targeting decisions over time.
* Evaluate enrichment and intelligence tools based on coverage, accuracy, cost and measurable impact on pipeline generation.



**Measurement, Attribution and Planning** 



* Own Marketing's metrics layer and data dictionary, including lifecycle definitions, sourcing, influence and pipeline contribution.
* Build practical attribution and reporting across inbound, outbound, paid, events, partners and account\-based programs.
* Translate funnel, campaign, channel and account performance into recommendations on audience, investment and next\-best action.
* Partner with Growth, RevOps and Finance on trusted dashboards, budget\-versus\-actual reporting, forecasting and data\-quality controls.



**Campaign Operations and Enablement** 



* Turn audience and campaign strategy into scalable, measurable programs with Growth, Segment Marketing and Demand Generation.
* Standardise campaign setup, taxonomy, UTMs, lists, forms, nurture, routing, QA and post\-campaign reporting.

* Deep hands\-on HubSpot expertise across workflows, lifecycle management, segmentation, scoring, reporting and integrations.

**Strong Advantage** 



* Experience supporting an SMB\-to\-mid\-market transition, account\-based programs or complex B2B buying journeys.

title: Creative Technologist

For more information, visit WPP.com.
   

  

 What Does a Creative Technologist Do at WPP Production?
   

  

 A Creative Technologist at WPP Production operates at the intersection of creativity, technology, and generative AI to design and deliver AI\-powered creative solutions at scale. The role collaborates with creative, production, technology, and strategy teams to develop intelligent workflows that combine multimodal AI, automation, and human creativity to produce high\-quality marketing content across digital channels.

* Collaborate with creative, strategy, production, and technology teams to design AI\-powered creative solutions for marketing campaigns.

* Prototype and evaluate emerging AI tools, models, and technologies to enhance creative production capabilities.
* Ensure AI\-generated content aligns with brand guidelines, creative quality standards, and campaign objectives.
* Support the development of reusable prompt libraries, templates, workflows, and best practices for scalable content production.
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams to integrate AI capabilities into existing creative and production processes.
* Present AI\-powered creative solutions, demonstrations, and recommendations to internal stakeholders and clients.
* Identify opportunities to improve production efficiency through automation, workflow optimization, and AI innovation.
* Stay up to date with advancements in Generative AI, multimodal models, creative technologies, and industry trends.


**Requirements**
* 3\+ years of experience in Creative Technology, Digital Production, Creative Development, Design Technology, Innovation, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of Generative AI technologies, prompt engineering, and multimodal content generation (image, video, text, and audio).

* Ability to balance creative thinking with technical execution in a fast\-paced production environment.

* Knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and multimodal AI systems.

* Experience developing AI playbooks, prompt libraries, or scalable creative automation frameworks.
* Certifications in Generative AI, Machine Learning, Cloud AI Platforms, or related technologies are an added advantage.


**Why work here:**
 At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world\-class talent, cutting\-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next\-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

title: Principal Product Marketing Manager - India
description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.** 



  

 About JumpCloud®
   


 JumpCloud® is the AI\-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.
 


  


  
 


  

**JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.** 
  





  




**Role Overview** 
  


  

 The Principal Product Manager (Marketing) exists to drive JumpCloud's market presence, packaging, and competitive positioning to accelerate global growth. In this high\-impact role, you will lead the strategic alignment of our pricing and packaging models while enabling our global sales team with the tools, positioning, and competitive insights they need to win. Serving as a key evangelist, you will translate complex platform capabilities into compelling market narratives and lead cross\-functional initiatives across sales, product, and go\-to\-market teams. Ultimately, you will solve critical business problems by elevating our thought leadership and scaling our market reach.
 




  




**Employee Value Proposition (EVP)** 
  

  
* **Purpose:** 
 You will shape how the world perceives and adopts JumpCloud’s open directory platform, directly influencing our market share and driving modern identity infrastructure solutions.
  
* **Growth:** 
 You will own major strategic pricing and packaging initiatives, expand your influence across executive\-level steering committees, and establish yourself as a premier industry speaker and evangelist.

 Work autonomously at a high\-velocity, tech\-forward company where you can leverage cutting\-edge AI tools to build processes and drive sales acceleration assets that directly impact revenue.

 Within the first 6 months, fully integrate into the marketing and product teams to deliver at least 3 high\-value assets and incorporate JumpCloud's thought leadership and positioning across key marketing channels.
  
* **Pricing \& Packaging Strategy:** 
 Within 9 months, analyze, optimize, and roll out an updated pricing and packaging strategy that simplifies customer onboarding and maximizes average contract value (ACV).
  
* **Sales Enablement \& Competitive Differentiation:** 
 By month 12, equip the global sales organization with comprehensive competitive differentiators and positioning assets, resulting in increased win rates against key competitors.
  
* **Platform Evangelism \& Thought Leadership:** 
 Establish yourself as a core external speaker for JumpCloud within 12 months, delivering at least 4 public demos or presentations across multiple platform feature sets.
  
* **AI\-Driven Process Optimization:** 
 Within 12 months, build out and scale at least 2 AI\-leveraged processes or tools to support the marketing team’s execution, while collaborating with the AI steering committee to deploy sales\-driven assets that accelerate deal velocity.
  

  


  


  




**Critical Subtasks:** 
  


 Supporting activities to achieve objectives:
 


  

  
2. **Collaborate** 
 with product management, sales, and executive leadership to audit and refine current pricing and packaging models.
  
4. **Conduct** 
 deep\-dive competitive intelligence research to identify clear market differentiators and map out the competitive landscape.
  
6. **Author** 
 and deliver high\-impact enablement assets (such as pitch decks, battlecards, and demo scripts) for the global sales team.

 with the AI steering committee to identify, develop, and deploy AI\-driven assets and workflows that accelerate sales deal cycles.
  
10. **Master** 
 the JumpCloud platform to effortlessly deliver comprehensive, multi\-feature technical demos to customers, partners, and industry analysts.

 JumpCloud as a speaker and thought leader at industry events, webinars, and executive briefings.
  


  


  




**Required Skills and Experience:**

	+ Strong cross\-functional collaboration and relationship\-building across sales, product, and GTM teams
	  
	+ High degree of autonomy, strategic thinking, and process\-building capability
  

  


  





  




  


  





**Where you’ll be working/Location:** 



  



 JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.
 



  


  
 


  



**This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role.** 




  


  
 


  


**Language:** 



  



 JumpCloud® has teams in 15\+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.  Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.
 



  


  
 


  


**Why JumpCloud?** 

  
 



  



 If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS\-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you!  One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." \- Rajat Bhargava, CEO

 JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"

title: POD Manager
company: Digital Mojo - Branding and Digital Marketing Agency in Hyderabad
description:
**Company Description** 





 Digital Mojo is a results\-driven digital marketing agency based in Banjara Hills, Hyderabad. Since 2016, we have been helping brands scale through performance\-focused digital strategies, storytelling, lead generation, branding, and high\-impact marketing campaigns.
 




  





**Role Description** 




**We are looking for a highly ownership\-driven Pod Manager with 5\-7 years of agency experience to lead a pod of clients end\-to\-end.** 





 The Pod Manager is not a delivery coordinator. They are the business head of their pod. They own the P\&L of their accounts, drive client growth strategy, lead the pod team, and are the last point of escalation before it reaches the CEO. Every commercial decision, every retention risk, every growth opportunity within the pod runs through them.
 





 If something goes wrong in the pod, the Pod Manager owns it. If something goes right, the Pod Manager drove it.
 




**What This Role Is Not** 



* Not a senior Account Manager with a fancier title
* Not someone who only reviews reports and attends calls
* Not someone who escalates client problems to the CEO without first attempting resolution
* Not a task manager or execution coordinator
* Not someone who waits for strategy to come from above



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Pod P\&L Ownership** 



* Own the revenue, profitability, and commercial health of all accounts within the pod
* Track pod\-level billing, scope utilization, and team bandwidth against revenue
* Identify accounts where the agency is over\-servicing and course\-correct scope or pricing
* Protect agency margins by managing team allocation and delivery efficiency
* Flag accounts at commercial risk to the Founder with a clear plan, not just a problem
* Identify upsell and cross\-sell opportunities and close them in coordination with the Founder
* Own monthly pod revenue targets and report against them with clarity



**2\. Client Growth Strategy** 



* Go beyond delivery. Actively think about what is next for each client's business
* Develop quarterly growth plans for key accounts covering new campaigns, channels, and opportunities
* Proactively bring ideas to clients before they ask. Be the strategic voice in every client relationship
* Identify gaps in a client's current marketing mix and recommend solutions backed by data
* Lead strategic review meetings with clients, not just performance catch\-up calls
* Connect client business goals to marketing strategy and keep both aligned as the business evolves
* Be the person a client calls when they want a fresh perspective, not just a status update



**3\. Escalation Leadership** 



* Serve as the final internal escalation point before the CEO for all pod\-level issues
* Handle client escalations, conflicts, and difficult conversations directly and with confidence
* Resolve delivery failures, team gaps, and quality issues at the pod level without pushing them upward
* Make judgment calls on scope disputes, pricing conversations, and client dissatisfaction independently
* Know when to involve the Founder and walk in with context, options, and a recommendation
* Protect the Founder's bandwidth by resolving 90% of pod issues at the pod level



**4\. Team Leadership and Pod Management** 



* Lead and manage Account Managers, Social Media Managers, Performance Marketers, and SEO Specialists within the pod
* Set clear expectations, review output quality, and hold team members accountable
* Run pod reviews, identify underperformance early, and address it directly
* Build a culture of ownership, speed, and quality within the pod
* Identify training or skill gaps in the team and flag them to the Founder
* Ensure Account Managers are handling day\-to\-day client communication so the Pod Manager can focus on strategy and commercial outcomes



**5\. Delivery and Quality Oversight** 



* Own the quality of everything that leaves the pod, from reports to creatives to campaign performance
* Ensure all client deliverables across social media, SEO, and performance marketing are on time and to standard
* Review monthly performance reports before they reach the client
* Maintain SLA adherence across the pod and flag risks before they impact delivery
* Coordinate with centralized teams including design, SEO, website, and automation for seamless execution



**6\. Performance and Campaign Strategy**

title: Brand Communications and Content Strategist
description:
**Company Overview**
 At Sid’s Farm, we are a dedicated D2C brand committed to delivering 100% pure dairy products of the highest quality. Every drop of milk and product we offer embodies our promise of purity, quality, and safety. Founded in 2013 and named after our founder’s son, Sid, our company reflects a father’s commitment to providing the best for families and future generations. What began as a service to a few families has grown into a proud community, now serving over 25,000 families.
   

  

 Our employees are our greatest Cheerleaders and Assets, and we are committed to fostering a culture of Growth and Development. We provide ample opportunities for professional advancement, ongoing training, and mentorship to help our team members reach their full potential. At Sid’s Farm, we are passionate about ensuring that every product we produce meets the highest standards for you and your loved ones, while also creating a workplace where our employees can thrive and contribute meaningfully.
   

  

 We are growing like never before, expanding our horizons in Hyderabad, Bangalore, and a few more locations soon. We are a solid family of 500\+ employees and we are looking forward to more Culture Champions to enable every individual’s growth story.
   

  

**Location: Hyderabad**
**Experience: 3–6 years**
**Function: Brand \& Marketing**
**About The Role**
**We’re looking for someone who can own how the brand shows up in the world.**
**Someone who understands that great brand communication isn't just about putting out content**
**regularly. It’s about finding interesting ideas, knowing what the brand should sound like, and**
**turning those ideas into communication that people actually want to see, read and share.**
**You’ll work closely with the brand and creative teams to take ideas from strategy → concept →**
**execution → communication, and will work with designers, video editors and other creative**
**partners to bring them to life.**
**What You’ll Do**
* Own the brand’s day\-to\-day communication across social, digital and other relevant


**touchpoints.**
* Translate brand strategy into fresh, relevant and engaging content ideas.
* Ideate campaigns, social content, videos, topical content, brand stories and other


**communication formats.**
* Develop strong creative concepts and briefs for designers, video editors and creative


**partners.**
* Work closely with the creative team to ensure the final execution stays true to the


**original idea and brand.**
* Build and manage the content/communication calendar.
* Develop and maintain a strong brand tone of voice across every piece of


**communication.**
* Spot interesting cultural moments, conversations and trends that the brand can


**participate in authentically.**
* Write or help shape copy, scripts, headlines and messaging when required.
* Collaborate with marketing, design, product and other teams to bring communication


**ideas to life.**
* Review content before publishing and ensure consistency in brand voice, visual


**language and messaging.**
* Keep looking for new ways to make the brand’s communication more distinctive,


**interesting and memorable.**
* Track what is working and use those learnings to improve future communication.


**Who We’re Looking For**
**You’re probably someone who:**
* Has a great creative instinct and naturally comes up with ideas.
* Understands what makes content interesting—not just what makes it “correct.”
* Has a strong understanding of brands, storytelling and tone of voice.
* Can move comfortably between strategy and execution.
* Can take a vague thought and turn it into a clear creative idea.
* Is equally comfortable brainstorming with a designer and writing a brief for a video


**editor.**
* Has strong communication and writing skills.
* Has a good understanding of social media and contemporary content formats.
* Is curious about culture, people, trends and what is happening around them.
* Has strong attention to detail and cares about the final output.
* Can work independently and take ownership, rather than waiting for briefs.
* Knows when to follow a trend and, more importantly, when not to.


**Experience \& Education**
* 3–6 years of experience in brand marketing, content, marketing communications,


**creative strategy, social media or a similar role.**
* Experience working with a consumer\-facing brand, creative agency, digital agency


**Or D2C/FMCG Brand Is Preferred.**
* Bachelor's degree in Mass Communication, Advertising, Marketing,


**Communications, Journalism, English, Design or a related field.**
* A strong portfolio of work is more important than the exact educational


**background.**
**A good fit for this role would be someone who has**
**Thought of the idea → written the brief → worked with the designer/video editor →**
 Reviewed The Execution → Published It → Looked At What Worked.
   

  

**We’re looking for someone who wants to own the communication, not just make content.**
**Why Sid’s Farm?**
 Working at a Farm is fun and not quite literally though. But here we go with all the reasons that will help you choose Sid’s Farm as your preferred workplace.
   

  

* Innovative Culture \- With a commitment to quality and innovation, you’ll be part of a forward\-thinking team that values fresh ideas and approaches with a new vision to act upon. If you’re passionate about high\-quality dairy products and ideas, working at Sid's Farm allows you to be part of a team that shares that commitment and creativity.
* Sustainability Focus: Sid's Farm prioritizes sustainable practices, allowing employees to contribute to environmentally friendly initiatives and feel good about their impact. Visit our Farm to gain a deeper understanding of what we do.
* Growth Opportunities \- As a growing company, there are ample chances for career advancement and professional development, allowing you to evolve alongside the business as you would be handling every nerve of the business. Working in a growing D2C Brand just elevates your learning curve by leaps and bounds.
* Community Engagement \- Sid's Farm actively engages with local communities, providing employees with opportunities to participate in outreach programs and make a difference.
* Strong Values \- The company emphasizes transparency, integrity, and customer satisfaction, fostering a positive and ethical work environment.
* Doing what you Love \- Here you will always end up doing what you love and in a more liberal way. Ideas and actions have no boundaries here as long as you have figured it all out.


**How to Apply?**
 If this role excites you to join our Evolving Journey at Sid’s Farm, we look forward to your addition to our Sid’s Farm family. Let us create some magic together.
   

  

 Do send us your updated resume to careers@sidsfarm.com
   

  

 In the meantime, we invite you to dive into our world by following us on Instagram and LinkedIn.There, you can explore our vibrant community, get a behind\-the\-scenes look at our farm, and stay updated on all the exciting things happening at Sid's Farm.
   

  

 Stay updated by checking out our exciting Career Opportunities.

* Analyze pipeline velocity, lead quality, campaign contribution and marketing\-sourced / marketing\-influenced pipeline.
* Develop analytical frameworks to evaluate the effectiveness of marketing programs and initiatives.
* Partner with Marketing, Sales and Revenue Operations teams to identify opportunities to improve funnel performance.
* Marketing Reporting, Dashboards \& Insights
* Build and maintain executive\-ready dashboards and reporting frameworks using Tableau, Power BI, Salesforce and other data sources.
* Develop recurring and ad\-hoc reporting for Marketing, Sales and leadership stakeholders.
* Establish consistent definitions and reporting methodologies for key marketing metrics.
* Ensure data accuracy, consistency and reconciliation across CRM, marketing automation and BI platforms.
* Turn complex datasets into clear insights, recommendations and actionable business narratives.
* Data Analysis, SQL \& Data Lake Querying
* Write and optimize complex SQL queries to extract, transform and analyze large datasets.
* Use CQL / data\-lake query languages and related query environments to retrieve and analyze marketing datasets.
* Perform segmentation, cohort analysis, funnel analysis and campaign performance analysis.
* Combine data from multiple martech systems and data sources to create meaningful business insights.
* Investigate data discrepancies, perform root\-cause analysis and work with technical teams to resolve data issues.
* Develop reusable queries, datasets and analytical frameworks to reduce manual reporting effort.
* Salesforce \& Martech Systems
* Work extensively with Salesforce data, including Leads, Contacts, Accounts, Campaigns, Opportunities and related marketing objects.
* Understand CRM data structures, lifecycle stages, campaign membership, lead routing and funnel progression.
* Partner with Marketing Operations and Sales / Revenue Operations teams to improve CRM data quality and reporting.
* Support the design and optimization of marketing processes, workflows and data models.
* Monitor data integrity and identify opportunities to improve CRM governance.
* Marketing Technology \& Automation
* Work with marketing automation and Martech platforms such as Adobe Marketo Engage, Salesforce and other platforms.
* Support integrations and data flows between marketing automation, CRM, enrichment, analytics and other systems.
* Identify repetitive or manual processes and develop scalable automation solutions.
* Collaborate with Marketing Operations and IT / Business Systems teams on system enhancements, integrations and troubleshooting.
* Evaluate new technologies and AI / automation capabilities that can improve marketing efficiency.
* Campaign, Channel \& Market Analytics
* Measure performance across campaigns, programs, events, webinars, digital channels and other marketing initiatives.
* Analyze campaign engagement, conversion, pipeline contribution and ROI.
* Support segmentation and targeting using firmographic, behavioral, engagement and CRM data.
* Develop insights that help Marketing teams optimize audience targeting, campaign execution and investment.
* Data Quality \& Governance
* Monitor and improve data quality across Martech platforms.
* Identify duplicate, incomplete, inconsistent or inaccurate records and develop solutions to address root causes.
* Establish and maintain data definitions, business rules and documentation.
* Partner with stakeholders to ensure consistent lifecycle, campaign, attribution and funnel definitions.
* Cross\-Functional Partnership
* Work closely with Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, IT and Data teams.
* Translate business requirements into analytical, technical and operational solutions.
* Communicate findings clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Act as a subject matter expert for marketing data, analytics and reporting.
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve marketing processes rather than simply responding to reporting requests.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 4–7 years of experience in Marketing Analytics, Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Analytics, martech Engineering or a related analytical / technical role.
* Strong hands\-on experience with SQL \- mandatory.
* Hands\-on experience with CQL / data\-lake querying \- mandatory.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Salesforce \- mandatory, including understanding of CRM data structures, campaigns, leads, contacts, accounts and opportunities.
* Hands\-on experience with BI / visualization platforms, with strong preference for Tableau and Power BI.
* Strong understanding of B2B marketing and sales funnels, including Lead → MQL → SAL/SQL → Opportunity → Pipeline → Revenue.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to investigate data and identify root causes.
* Ability to translate business questions into data requirements, analysis and actionable recommendations.
* Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills, including advanced formulas, pivot tables and data analysis.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively with global stakeholders across different time zones.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist

Company: Worktable

 Employment Type: Full\-Time
 



 Salary: ₹20,000–₹30,000 per month, depending on experience and skills
 



 About Worktable
 



 Worktable is a coworking and managed workspace business focused on helping businesses find flexible office and workspace solutions.
 



 We are looking for a hands\-on Digital Marketing \& SEO Executive who can take ownership of Worktable's complete online presence, generate quality leads and continuously improve our digital visibility and website conversions.
 



 This is an execution\-focused role. The person should be able to plan, execute, monitor and improve digital marketing activities independently.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Social Media Management
 



 • Manage Worktable's LinkedIn, Instagram and Facebook pages.
 



 • Create and maintain a monthly social media content calendar.
 



 • Plan and publish posts, reels, carousels, stories and other relevant content.
 



 • Improve followers, reach, engagement and overall brand visibility.
 



 • Research trending topics and relevant coworking/office\-space content.
 



 • Coordinate with designers/content creators wherever required.
 



 • Maintain consistent branding across all social platforms.
 



 • Track social media performance and suggest improvements.
 



 2\. Google Business Profile (GMB)
 



 • Manage and optimize Google Business Profiles for Worktable locations.
 



 • Ensure correct business name, address, phone number, website, categories and business information.
 



 • Add/update photos, services, descriptions and other relevant information.

 • Monitor customer reviews and coordinate responses.
