 • Track GMB performance and generate reports.
 



 • Work on local keywords for coworking, managed office, private office, meeting rooms, etc.
 



 3\. SEO \& Keyword Management
 



 • Conduct keyword research for coworking, managed offices, private offices, meeting rooms and related services.
 



 • Identify high\-intent and location\-based keywords.
 



 • Conduct competitor SEO research.
 



 • Implement on\-page SEO.
 



 • Manage Meta Titles, Meta Descriptions and relevant Meta Tags.
 



 • Optimize H1, H2 and other heading structures.
 



 • Optimize URLs, internal linking and anchor text.
 



 • Optimize image ALT tags and file names.
 



 • Identify keyword gaps and ranking opportunities.
 



 • Plan and optimize website content around relevant keywords.
 



 • Monitor keyword rankings and organic traffic.
 



 4\. Website SEO \& Optimization
 



 • Manage basic SEO activities directly on the Worktable website.
 



 • Update page titles, descriptions, headings, keywords and content.
 



 • Optimize landing pages for search engines and lead generation.
 



 • Identify broken links, indexing issues, duplicate content and other basic SEO issues.
 



 • Coordinate with the website developer for technical SEO changes.
 



 • Ensure new website pages are properly optimized before publishing.
 



 • Suggest new landing pages based on search demand.
 



 • Improve website structure, navigation and internal linking.
 



 • Ensure important pages are properly indexed by Google.
 



 • Basic knowledge of WordPress/CMS will be preferred.
 



 5\. Lead Generation
 



 The candidate will be responsible for generating qualified business leads, not just website traffic.
 



 • Plan and execute lead\-generation campaigns.
 



 • Generate leads through Google, Meta, LinkedIn, GMB, SEO and other relevant channels.
 



 • Understand the difference between traffic, enquiries and qualified leads.
 



 • Create and optimize lead\-generation landing pages.
 



 • Set up and optimize lead forms.
 



 • Track lead source and campaign performance.
 



 • Monitor CPL (Cost Per Lead), number of leads and lead quality.
 



 • Work with the sales team to understand lead quality and improve campaigns accordingly.
 



 • Maintain proper lead tracking and reporting.
 



 • Identify new digital channels and opportunities for lead generation.
 



 6\. Website Forms \& Lead Capture
 



 The candidate should understand how website enquiries are captured and routed.
 



 • Create/maintain enquiry forms on the website.
 



 • Forms may include:
 



 o Name
 



 o Mobile Number
 



 o Email
 



 o Requirement – Coworking / Managed Office
 



 o Number of Seats
 



 o Preferred Location
 



 o Move\-in Requirement / Timeline
 



 o Any other relevant requirement
 



 • Ensure form submissions are successfully received by the relevant team.
 



 • Test forms regularly to ensure there are no missed enquiries.
 



 • Set up proper thank\-you/confirmation messages where required.
 



 • Track form submissions and conversion rates.
 



 • Coordinate with the developer for form, API, tracking or technical requirements.
 



 7\. Website Conversion \& CRO
 



 The candidate should also understand how to convert website visitors into enquiries.
 



 • Add/optimize WhatsApp, Call and Email CTA buttons.
 



 • Suggest suitable enquiry buttons at relevant places on the website.
 



 • Create/optimize enquiry pop\-ups.
 



 • Suggest lead\-capture forms based on visitor intent.
 



 • Improve landing\-page conversion.
 



 • Test different CTA text, forms and placement.
 



 • Track website enquiries and conversion rates.
 



 • Identify pages receiving traffic but generating fewer leads and recommend improvements.
 



 8\. Meta Marketing \& Advertising
 



 • Manage Meta Business Suite.
 



 • Plan and publish content on Facebook and Instagram.
 



 • Create and monitor Meta Ads campaigns.
 



 • Run lead\-generation campaigns where required.
 



 • Set up audiences and basic retargeting campaigns.
 



 • Monitor budget, CPL, leads and campaign performance.
 



 • Optimize campaigns based on results.
 



 • Coordinate creatives and ad copies with the team.
 



 9\. Google Ads
 



 Basic hands\-on knowledge of Google Ads will be preferred.
 



 • Search campaign setup and management.
 



 • Keyword research.
 



 • Negative keyword management.
 



 • Ad copy optimization.
 



 • Location and audience targeting.
 



 • Lead conversion tracking.
 



 • Monitoring CPC, CPL and conversion rate.
 



 • Basic campaign optimization.
 



 10\. Google Search Console \& Analytics
 



 • Manage Google Search Console.
 



 • Monitor indexing and search performance.
 



 • Track clicks, impressions, CTR and average position.
 



 • Identify search queries and ranking opportunities.
 



 • Monitor website traffic through Google Analytics.
 



 • Track important website conversions and enquiry sources.
 



 • Prepare regular performance reports.
 



 11\. Content \& Local SEO
 



 • Identify topics based on customer search behaviour.
 



 • Create content briefs for blogs and landing pages.
 



 • Optimize existing website content.
 



 • Work on location\-based pages for different Worktable centres/markets.
 



 • Build local SEO visibility.
 



 • Suggest content that can generate organic enquiries.
 



 12\. Tracking \& Analytics
 



 Candidate should understand basic digital marketing tracking, including:
 



 • Google Analytics
 



 • Google Search Console
 



 • Meta Pixel
 



 • Conversion tracking
 



 • UTM parameters
 



 • Lead\-source tracking
 



 • Website form tracking
 



 • Call/WhatsApp enquiry tracking
 



 • Campaign performance tracking
 



 13\. Reporting \& MIS
 



 Prepare weekly/monthly reports covering:
 



 • Website traffic
 



 • Organic traffic
 



 • Keyword rankings
 



 • GMB performance
 



 • Social media growth
 



 • Social media engagement
 



 • Leads generated
 



 • Qualified leads
 



 • Cost per lead
 



 • Meta Ads performance
 



 • Google Ads performance
 



 • Website enquiries
 



 • Conversion rate
 



 The person should not only provide numbers but also highlight what is working, what is not working and what should be done next.
 



 Required Skills
 



 • Digital Marketing
 



 • SEO
 



 • Keyword Research
 



 • On\-Page SEO
 



 • Local SEO
 



 • Google Business Profile (GMB)
 



 • Social Media Marketing
 



 • Meta Business Suite
 



 • Meta Ads
 



 • Google Ads – basic to intermediate
 



 • Google Analytics
 



 • Google Search Console
 



 • Website SEO
 



 • WordPress/CMS – preferred
 



 • Lead Generation
 



 • Landing Page Optimization
 



 • Conversion Rate Optimization
 



 • Basic HTML/website understanding – preferred
 



 • Basic understanding of tracking pixels, forms and conversion tracking
 



 • Good content\-writing and communication skills
 



 Preferred Experience
 



 Experience in any of the following industries will be an advantage:
 



 • Coworking
 



 • Managed Offices
 



 • Commercial Real Estate
 



 • Real Estate
 



 • B2B
 



 • SaaS
 



 • Lead Generation
 



 • Local Businesses
 



 What We Are Looking For
 



 We are not looking for someone who only manages social media posts.
 



 We need a hands\-on all\-round digital marketer who can take ownership of:
 



 Social Media \+ SEO \+ GMB \+ Website SEO \+ Keywords \+ Meta Tags \+ Lead Generation \+ Meta Ads \+ Google Ads \+ Website Forms \+ Conversion Optimization \+ Analytics \+ Reporting.
 



 The candidate should be comfortable doing the work themselves, while coordinating with the website developer wherever coding or technical changes are required.
 



 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 



 Performance will primarily be evaluated on:
 



 • Growth in organic website traffic

 • Google Maps/GMB visibility
 



 • Website enquiries
 



 • Qualified leads generated
 



 • Cost per lead
 



 • Social media growth and engagement

MARKETING \& CONTENT CREATION EXECUTIVEGuzaarish \& Bon Heur
 
**Location:** 
 Delhi
 



**Employment Type:**

**Working Days:** 
 6 Days a Week
 



**Weekly Off:** 
 Wednesday
 



**Salary:** 
 ₹30,000 – ₹40,000 per month
 



**Experience:** 
 1\-2 years preferred
 


 ABOUT THE ROLE
 
 We are looking for an
 **experienced, creative and strategically minded Marketing \& Content Creation professional** 
 to join Guzaarish \& Bon Heur.
 



 This is a hands\-on role combining
 **marketing strategy, social media management, content creation and brand building** 
 .
 



 The ideal candidate should be able to understand the business objectives of both brands, develop
 **marketing strategies and campaigns around those objectives, and then independently execute them** 
 through content, social media and other marketing initiatives.
 



 We are looking for someone with a
 **strong aesthetic sense** 
 , excellent creative instincts and the technical ability to independently
 **ideate, shoot, edit and publish content.** 




**The candidate will be responsible for managing the social media and digital marketing presence of both brands while working closely with the founders and internal team.** 



 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES1\. Marketing Strategy \& Execution
 * Develop
 **monthly, quarterly and seasonal marketing strategies** 
 for Guzaarish and Bon Heur.
* Understand the business objectives, target audience and positioning of each brand and translate them into actionable marketing plans.
* Develop marketing campaigns for key business periods including
 **Diwali, weddings, festive occasions, corporate gifting, Valentine's Day, Christmas, launches and new collections.**
* **Build campaign concepts from the initial idea through to execution.**
* **Plan the objective, target audience, messaging, content, platforms, timelines and execution** 
 for each campaign.
* Execute the strategies independently and ensure campaigns are delivered on time.
* Track campaign performance and identify what is working and what needs to change.
* Continuously develop new ideas to increase
 **brand awareness, engagement, enquiries, footfall and sales.**
* **Research competitors, market trends, consumer behaviour and emerging content formats.**
* **Work closely with the founders to align marketing activity with the overall business direction.**


 2\. Social Media Strategy \& Management
 * Take complete ownership of the social media presence of
 **both Guzaarish and Bon Heur** 
 .
* Develop individual social media strategies for each brand.
* Create monthly content calendars and ensure consistent execution.
* Plan and manage
 **Reels, Stories, posts, carousels and other social media formats.**
* **Monitor engagement, reach, views, enquiries and other relevant metrics.**
* **Analyse content performance and continuously optimise the strategy.**
* **Stay updated with Instagram trends, formats, sounds and emerging content opportunities.**
* **Build a strong and recognisable digital identity for both brands.**


 3\. Content Ideation
 * Develop original and creative content concepts for both brands.
* Conceptualise Reels, campaigns, product stories, behind\-the\-scenes content, educational content, lifestyle content and brand storytelling.
* Create content that is not simply trend\-based but has a
 **clear purpose and connection to the brand or marketing objective.**
* **Think creatively about how products, people, spaces and everyday business activity can be converted into engaging content.**


 4\. Shooting \& Production
 * Independently shoot high\-quality
 **photo and video content** 
 for social media.
* Handle product shoots, lifestyle shoots, showroom content, behind\-the\-scenes content and campaign shoots.
* Understand lighting, framing, composition and visual storytelling.
* Coordinate shoots with models, team members and other stakeholders when required.
* Take ownership of the complete content\-production process.


 5\. Video Editing \& Creative Execution
 * Independently edit Reels and short\-form videos.
* Handle transitions, pacing, music, text, effects and storytelling.
* Edit photographs and prepare social media creatives.
* Ensure every piece of content maintains a
 **premium, aesthetic and consistent visual language.**
* **Take an idea from concept → shoot → edit → final execution.**


 6\. Brand Building
 * Build and strengthen the digital identity of both brands.
* Ensure consistency in the visual language, tone and positioning of each brand.
* Develop content that communicates the premium nature of Guzaarish and Bon Heur.
* Constantly identify opportunities to make the brands more distinctive and memorable.
* Contribute ideas beyond social media that can strengthen overall brand awareness and customer engagement.


 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 
 We are
 **not looking for a traditional social media executive whose primary responsibility is posting content.** 




**We are looking for someone who can think like a marketer, creator and brand builder.** 




**The ideal candidate should be able to:** 




**Understand the business → Build the strategy → Develop the campaign → Create the content → Execute it → Analyse the results → Improve it.** 



 Must Have
 * 2–5 years of relevant experience in
 **marketing, content creation and social media management** 
 .
* Strong portfolio of previous work.
* Demonstrated experience in developing and executing marketing campaigns.
* Excellent understanding of Instagram and digital content.
* Strong aesthetic sense.
* Excellent photography and videography skills.
* Strong video editing skills.
* Ability to independently ideate and execute content.
* Understanding of social media analytics and performance metrics.
* Strong communication and organisational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines.
* Proactive approach with strong ownership of work.


 AESTHETIC SENSE IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT
 
 We are looking for someone with an
 **exceptionally strong eye for aesthetics.** 




**You should understand:** 



* Luxury visual presentation
* Product styling
* Photography and composition
* Lighting
* Colour and visual consistency
* Reels and short\-form storytelling
* Premium brand communication
* Current social media trends
* What makes people stop scrolling



 You should be able to look at a product, showroom, person or situation and immediately identify
 **how it could become interesting content.** 



 IDEAL CANDIDATE
 
 You are someone who doesn't need to be told what to post every day.
 



 You can identify an opportunity, develop an idea around it, turn that idea into a marketing campaign, create the content yourself and execute it.
 



 You are equally comfortable discussing:
 



**"What should our Diwali marketing strategy be?"** 




**as you are with:** 




**"Let's shoot this Reel right now."** 




**You are creative enough to generate ideas, strategic enough to understand** 
*why* 
 you're creating them, and hands\-on enough to execute them yourself.
 


 COMPENSATION \& WORKING STRUCTURE
 
**Salary:** 
 ₹30,000 – ₹40,000 per month, depending on experience and portfolio.
 



**Working:** 
 6 days a week
 



**Weekly Off:** 
 Wednesday
 



**Employment:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Work Location:** 
 Office\-based, Delhi
 



**Portfolio is mandatory.** 




**Candidates should share their CV \+ portfolio \+ Instagram/previous work** 
 while applying.
 


* We are looking for someone who wants to
 **build brands, not just manage social media accounts.**

description:
Role Overview
 



 As the Full\-Time Affiliate Marketing Specialist/Manager, you will be responsible for building, optimizing, and scaling Jebelz’s affiliate program across the UAE and the broader GCC region. You will identify, recruit, and manage strategic partnerships with affiliate networks, publishers, coupon/deal portals, cashback websites, media houses, and content creators to drive traffic, acquire new customers, and maximize e\-commerce revenue.

 1\. Program Strategy \& Execution
 


* Design, build, and execute Jebelz’s end\-to\-end affiliate marketing strategy aligned with business revenue targets.
* Define competitive commission structures, incentive tiers, and payout models (CPA, CPL, CPS) for different partner segments.



 2\. Partner Recruitment \& Relationship Management
 


* Actively recruit, onboard, and retain top\-tier affiliates, publishers, influencer networks, price\-comparison engines, and deal/cashback platforms across the MENA region.
* Maintain strong, long\-term relationships with key affiliates through proactive communication, weekly newsletters, and tailored promotional offers.



 3\. Campaign \& Promotions Management
 


* Plan and run exclusive affiliate campaigns tied to key shopping seasons (e.g., White/Yellow Friday, Ramadan, Eid, UAE National Day, Back\-to\-School).
* Provide affiliates with optimized creative assets, tracking links, banners, product feeds, and exclusive promo codes.



 4\. Network \& Platform Optimization
 


* Manage affiliate platforms and tracking networks (e.g., Impact, Admitad, ArabyAds, CJ Affiliate, or custom software solutions).
* Ensure seamless tracking, attribution accuracy, fraud prevention, and timely partner payouts.



 5\. Performance Analysis \& Reporting
 


* Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly performance KPIs, including sales volume, Conversion Rate (CR), Average Order Value (AOV), Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), and Cost Per Acquisition (CPA).
* Analyze affiliate channel profitability and optimize underperforming partnerships.
* Prepare clear performance dashboards and reports for leadership.



  





 Requirements \& Qualifications
 



  




* **Experience:** 
 3–5 years of dedicated full\-time experience managing e\-commerce affiliate programs in the UAE or GCC region.
* **Network Knowledge:** 
 Established relationships with key MENA publishers, deal/cashback platforms, content sites, and affiliate networks (e.g., Admitad, ArabyAds, Impact, ArabClicks).
* **Technical Skills:** 
 Hands\-on experience with affiliate tracking software, deep linking, product feed management (XML/CSV), and web analytics tools (Google Analytics 4\).
* **Analytical Mindset:** 
 Strong data analysis skills to evaluate campaign performance, ROI, and partner attribution.
* **Commercial Acumen:** 
 Outstanding negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills.

* **Seamless Campaign Operations:** 
 Smooth coordination of end\-to\-end campaign logistics, from product seeding to content publishing and on\-time deliverable tracking.

 Cultivating and maintaining positive, professional relationships with influencers and external agency partners.



  





**Work Experience:** 



* 3–4 years of experience in influencer marketing, social content collaboration, or agency/brand campaign management.



  





**Working Days \& Location:** 




 Monday – Friday
 



**Location**

Here you will learn how to maximise the potential of your available resources. You will get the opportunity to do work that helps you master a variety of transferable skills, or skills that are relevant across roles and departments. You will be feeling appreciated and valued for the work you delivered. We are creating a unique company culture that embodies respect and honesty, which will create more loyal employees than a company that simply shells out cash.  Nutrabay is the largest health \& nutrition store in India. About Cvent:
 



 Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,500\+ employees and \~30,000 customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500\. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.
 



  





 Headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia, Cvent (formerly NYSE: CVT) was acquired by Blackstone and Vista for $4\.6B in 2023\.
 



  





 Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.
 



*Cvent is redefining the meetings and events industry through technology that advances human connection.* 




  





**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future** 




 Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI\-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.
 



  





 Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI\-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.
 



  





***Recruitment Scam Notice:***
*Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as “
 
 name@cvent.com
 
 ” email address. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.* 









*If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at
 
 recruitingindia@cvent.com
 
 .* 









*For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice.
 
 https://www.cvent.com/en/notice\-recruitment\-fraud
 
 .* 




  





**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




  





 The Head of Data Strategy \& Operations is a senior leadership role responsible for building and leading the unified data function across Cvent's primary clouds: Enterprise Corporates (EC) and Hospitality (HC). This is a strategic and operational role — you will set the vision for how Cvent acquires, enriches, governs, and activates its marketing database, while managing a team of \~40 across three distinct functions.
 



  





 This is a newly created role designed to consolidate previously fragmented data functions into a single, accountable team with unified strategy, cloud\-specific ownership, and a modern AI\-native operating model. You will report into the VP, Global Demand Center and partner closely with IT, Sales, Product Marketing, and Analytics.
 



  





**What you will Be doing:** 




  





**Strategic Leadership** 



* Own the end\-to\-end data strategy for Cvent's marketing database — acquisition, enrichment, governance, and activation — across EC and HC
* Define and maintain ICP, TAM/SAM, and persona frameworks in partnership with Product Marketing and Sales
* Build and drive cloud\-specific scorecards that create clear accountability for EC and HC data quality, coverage, and campaign readiness
* Serve as the single accountable leader for the ADI function; act as the primary liaison to the VP of GDC, CMO, and cross\-functional partners



  





**Team \& Org Leadership** 



* Lead three functional sub\-teams — Audience Strategy \& Intelligence, Data Acquisition \& Activation, and Data Infrastructure \& Governance
* Develop and retain strong team leads; build career paths and capability plans within each function
* Drive a unified operating model that eliminates duplication across previously siloed teams and enables scale without proportional headcount growth



  





**Data Operations \& Quality** 



* Ensure the marketing database meets and exceeds quality thresholds: Account accuracy ≥80%, Contact accuracy ≥85%, SAM coverage \>80%
* Oversee database normalization, deduplication, governance, and data validation across both clouds
* Own vendor relationships (ZoomInfo, Clearbit, Clay and others) — qualification, contracts, budget, and performance accountability
* Ensure compliance with global privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) in coordination with Legal and Security



  





**AI, Automation \& IT Partnership** 



* Partner with Cvent's IT and AI Center of Excellence to build an AI\-native acquisition and enrichment operating model — agent development, workflow automation, and Snowflake pipeline integration
* Drive a unified AI roadmap for the ADI function in partnership with IT; identify and implement automation opportunities across all three sub\-functions
* Own the DB/AI Management function's IT dotted\-line relationship — translate business data needs into infrastructure requirements
* Lead adoption of AI\-assisted workflows that improve turnaround time, data accuracy, and team capacity



  





**GTM Enablement** 



* Partner with Sales and Revenue Marketing to ensure the database directly enables pipeline: right accounts, right contacts, right timing
* Ensure list pull and delivery SLAs are met for all campaign programs — including email, events, nurture, and paid digital
* Produce and maintain data scorecards and dashboards that give GDC, Sales, and Finance visibility into data health, coverage gaps, and trend



  





**What you need for this position:** 




  





**Required** 



* 20\+ years of experience in B2B marketing data, database management, or audience strategy — with at least 5 years leading multi\-functional teams of 20\+ across geographies
* Demonstrated success owning a full\-funnel data operation: strategy, acquisition, enrichment, governance, and GTM activation
* Experience managing across verticals or market segments — ability to hold EC and HC accountable simultaneously rather than specializing in one
* Strong command of SFDC — data governance, object structure, reporting, and quality management
* Experience with AI\-assisted workflows and automation tooling; comfort building and executing an AI adoption roadmap for a data team
* Proven cross\-functional partnership with IT, Sales, and Analytics — this role requires influence without authority across multiple organizations
* Track record of building and scaling teams through process improvement and technology, not just headcount



  





**Preferred** 



* Experience with Snowflake or similar cloud data warehouse; comfort partnering with engineering/IT on pipeline architecture
* Familiarity with marketing automation platforms (Marketo or equivalent) and how database feeds program execution
* Background in TAM/SAM/ICP modeling and persona framework development
* Experience with vendor management and procurement for data enrichment tools (ZoomInfo, Clearbit, or equivalents)
* MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred

title: Manager - Commerce
description:
****About WPP Media****
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world\-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

**MANAGER, COMMERCE**
****About WPP Media****
 WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.
   

  

 WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com
   

  

 At WPP Media, We Believe In The Power Of Our Culture And Our People. It’s What Elevates Us To Deliver Exceptional Experiences For Both Our Clients And Each Other. In This Role It Will Be Critical To Embrace WPP \& WPP Media’s Shared Core Values:
   

  

* Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
* Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
* Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.


****Role Summary And Impact****
 As part of the
 **Global Operations Centre (GOC)** 
 , you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high\-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for Manager \- E commerce who will:
   

  

* The Manager, Commerce role will have a deep interest and appreciation for the uniqueness of retail and marketplaces and use their retail expertise to deliver excellence in biddable retail media channels: search and programmatic. In this role, you will manage a team overseeing the end\-to\-end campaign process beginning with competitive research through to tactical optimization and performance reporting.


****Job Responsibilities:****
* Manage a team of 2\-5 direct reports and their career development.
* Interact effectively with regional teams internally (Europe, North America, Asia) and be a strong communicator.
* Oversee search and programmatic media activations across several retailer media networks, including but not limited to Amazon, CitrusAd, Criteo, The Trade Desk, Walmart, etc.
* Execute campaign setup, bid recommendations, and budgeting to ensure overall client goal attainment, including the use of retail bid management technologies where applicable such as Pacvue, Skai, and Epsilo
* Maintain excellent relationships with key account stakeholders to influence and maximize promotional opportunities.
* Ensure on\-going campaign compliance to GroupM established guidelines and best practices.
* Prepare campaign performance reports on a weekly, monthly, and quarterly basis.
* Synthesize key data points, identify trends, and recommend activities to maximize business results and deliver an optimal customer experience.
* Address technical issues with media campaign serving.
* Manage reconciliation, invoicing/billing, trafficking, and mapping data to our internal media campaign management platform.


****Minimum Requirements:****
* At least 4 years of experience in biddable performance media execution, with a strong preference for retail media execution.
* Experience managing a team of direct reports.
* Proficient in English.
* Experience across the Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* Deep understanding of retail commercial elements such as profit margin, inventory levels, forecasting, and demand planning to inform media decisions.
* Deep understanding of how different media channels work together and how retail media fits within the wider ecosystem.
* Strong drive to understand the retail landscape and latest trends in commerce media.
* Experience with retail bid management platforms, such as Pacvue or Skai.
* Experience in campaign management and optimization across multiple retail platforms (Amazon, Instacart, Walmart, Target, Kroger, Criteo, Google, Meta, etc.).
* Ability to collaborate and work effectively with internal teams and external partners.
* A self\-starter attitude that thrives in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent project\-management skills; able to coordinate projects across multiple teams and functions.


****Life At WPP Media \& Benefits****
 Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media \& WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in\-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include access to internal learning platforms, certifications, and training sessions, life insurance, wellness programs, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, employee mental health awareness day, and more.
   

  

 Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds often don't apply for roles if they don't meet all the criteria. At WPP Media, we strongly encourage you to apply if you’re interested, we'd love to know how you can positively impact our team with your experience!
   

  

 As an Equal Opportunities Employer, we believe that diversity is vital and positively influences the environment in which we operate. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment that is free of discrimination, harassment or bullying. Race, colour, ancestry, religion, gender, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status have no bearing on our hiring decisions, and we encourage all applicants.
   

  

 We view everyone as an individual and we understand that inclusion is more than just diversity – it’s about belonging. We celebrate the fact that everyone is unique and that’s what makes us so good at what we do. We pride ourselves on being a company that embraces difference and truly represents the global clients we work with.
   

  

 We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
   

  

 Please read our Privacy Notice (
 **https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy\-policy** 
 ) for more information on how we process the information you provide.
   

  

 While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.
   

  

 Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

* High ownership mindset, you care about results, not just output

title: Manager Events and Executive Client Engagement
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
 **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
 The Channel Specialist \- Events \& Executive Client Engagement is the execution backbone for priority events and executive interactions. Reporting to the offshore Channel Lead \- Events \& Executive Client Engagement, this role produces, governs, and readies all event and executive\-facing assets, ensuring accuracy, compliance, accessibility, and reuse across conferences, client summits, advisory boards, and virtual programs. The Specialist operates primarily asynchronously with structured overlap for reviews and approvals, enabling US on\-ground teams to deliver high\-impact, measurable experiences.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Execute the event content plan by developing and managing brochures, one\-pagers, booth screens, session slides, demo narratives, videos, and digital assets for in\-person and virtual events
* Build and maintain content toolkits (templates, modules, messaging snippets) with metadata, tagging, and version control to enable efficient reuse and consistency
* Support executive client engagement materials (briefing books, tailored case studies, follow\-up emails) and coordinate approvals with brand, legal, and compliance
* Partner with creative teams and agencies on copy, design, video edits, and motion assets, ensuring brand consistency, accessibility, and quality standards
* Coordinate logistics inputs for content (specs, deadlines, run\-of\-show, print/digital delivery) and own checklists/QA to ensure assets are show\-ready
* Use AI tools to draft abstracts, session descriptions, recap summaries, and asset variants within established governance; apply human review to ensure accuracy and compliance
* Track engagement metrics (asset downloads, QR scans, session attendance, booth interactions) and prepare clean reports/insight summaries for optimization
* Maintain audit trails and documentation required for regulatory compliance and internal governance processes
* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so


**Required Qualifications**
* Overall, 8\+ years of experience with 7\+ years of experience in event content production, marketing communications, sales enablement, or related roles within complex/regulated environments
* Hands\-on proficiency with presentation tools (e.g., PowerPoint), event platforms, digital asset management, and basic video workflows
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted content creation and comfort adopting new tools and standardized workflows
* Demonstrated solid writing and editing skills with attention to detail for accuracy, accessibility (e.g., alt text, contrast), and brand voice
* Demonstrated solid project management and collaboration skills; ability to manage multiple events, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously


*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*
 \#NJP

title: Revenue Manager
description:
**About The Opportunity**
**Role:** 
 Revenue Management
   

  

**Level:** 
 Deputy Manager /Manager
   

  

**Reporting To:** 
 Associate Director \- Revenue Management
   

  

**Location:** 
 Gurgaon
   

  

**About The Function**
 Being the largest online travel aggregator in India, MMT witnesses a sizeable number of users visiting the app and transacting every day.
   

  

 The Ground Transport(GT) business offers an unmatched booking experience to this vast user base, with the widest range of Bus, Rail, and Cab booking options—also playing a crucial role in acquiring new users, especially from Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities across India.
   

  

 This is further complemented by a world\-class post\-booking experience—whether it's through the app's numerous self\-help features or our hand\-picked executives who strive to deliver customer delight at every step. The Ground Transport SBU embraces a strong innovation mindset and has consistently launched industry\-first features that make the booking experience truly seamless and delightful.
   

  

 At MMT, the Ground Transport unit takes immense pride in its team members who work tirelessly to champion the best possible experience for our users. An orchestra of product managers, tech developers, designers, researchers, and revenue managers comes together to ensure we continue to lead and differentiate ourselves in the industry.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As part of the GT Online Revenue function, you will join a whip\-smart team responsible for managing revenue, driving growth, and increasing profitability. You will embody our values of consumer focus, commitment to results, and continuous improvement by developing innovative solutions that raise challenging questions and demand both creative and practical answers.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is an independent, self\-starting, quick\-witted, entrepreneurial, and intellectually curious individual. This person must excel at cross\-functional collaboration, blend creativity with strong organizational skills, manage deliverables under tight deadlines, and consistently produce high\-quality work under pressure.
   

  

**What Will You Be Doing**
**P\&L and Revenue Management**
* Own and manage the business P\&L, working with internal stakeholders to devise strategies aimed at achieving revenue goals.
* Closely monitor performance parameters, ensuring tight control over key business KPIs such as conversions, transactions, and margins.
* Conduct deep dives into competitor pricing data and use insights to inform category pricing strategies.
* Adjust pricing strategies based on demand signals and market conditions to maintain competitiveness and maximize revenue.


**Growth Strategy Development**
* Define annual and quarterly plans based on short\- and long\-term growth strategies, influencing key cross\-functional teams to align on common objectives.
* Develop and implement initiatives focused on customer acquisition.
* Analyze demand signals and traffic data to understand business and marketing trends.
* Use these insights to shape business and marketing strategies, driving greater engagement and higher conversion rates.


**Customer Engagement \& Marketing Collaboration**
* Work closely with the marketing team to develop and execute customer engagement strategies and campaigns that maximize customer lifetime value.
* Lead tactical initiatives around active revenue drivers such as pricing, seasonal trends, and topical promotions using relevant marketing channels.
* Collaborate with various marketing functions to maximize order volumes while maintaining a healthy ROAS.


**Collaboration with Product \& Operations Stakeholders**
* Partner with product teams to develop first\-class, customer\-centric experiences.
* Work with operations teams to streamline processes that drive strong NPS and CSAT scores.


**Data Analysis \& Reporting**
* Create and maintain rich, interactive visualizations through effective data interpretation and analysis.
* Integrate reporting components from multiple data sources to provide actionable insights to stakeholders.
* Apply statistical methods to analyze data and answer key business questions, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and performance.


**Qualification \& Experience**
* MBA from a reputed institute with 4–6 years of experience in a revenue or category management role within a consumer\-facing, technology\-enabled business—preferably in the e\-commerce industry.
* Proven track record of working in high\-growth, data\-driven environments with a strong understanding of business levers and consumer behavior.
* Advanced proficiency inMS Excel and MS PowerPointfor data analysis and business storytelling.
* Sound understanding of SQL and Python is mandatory to independently work on data extraction, modeling, and analysis.


**Key Success Factors For The Role**
* A mindset that consistently focuses on return on investment, business outcomes, and revenue growth.
* High energy, team\-oriented, and brings a positive, can\-do attitude.
* Strong understanding of data analysis, with hands\-on experience in data\-driven decision\-making.
* Proven track record of driving business growth through both tactical and strategic initiatives.
* Excellent communication skills and strong stakeholder management capabilities.
* Exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple proj ects simultaneously.

title: UAV Design Engineer (CFD & FEA Specialist)
description:
**Position: UAV Design Engineer (CFD \& FEA Specialist)** 




**Location:** 
 Manesar, Haryana
 



**Experience:** 
 3\-6 years
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a hands\-on Design Engineer to join our core engineering team and drive the design, development, testing, and optimization of next\-generation drone and UAV systems.
 



  





 The ideal candidate is a practical, field\-tested engineer with strong expertise in
 **mechanical design, UAV structures, aerodynamics, CFD, materials, and manufacturing** 
 \- someone who has independently taken UAV components or complete systems from concept through
 **CAD, analysis, prototyping, manufacturing, testing, and real\-world field deployment** 
 , not just theoretical or simulation work.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**UAV \& Mechanical Design** 




 • Independently design UAV/drone airframes, structural components, and mechanical sub\-assemblies.
 



 • Develop production\-ready 3D models and 2D engineering drawings (SolidWorks, Fusion 360, AutoCAD, or equivalent).
 



 • Own designs end\-to\-end — from concept through prototyping, manufacturing, and field deployment.
 



 • Balance weight, strength, stability, durability, and manufacturability in every design decision.
 



 • Partner with electronics, flight\-control, and systems teams on integration and weight distribution.
 



 • Reverse engineering capabilities to scan a model and prepare the design with required modification.
 



**Aerodynamics \& CFD** 




 • Apply practical aerodynamics and fluid mechanics knowledge to real UAV flight scenarios.
 



 • Run CFD simulations (ANSYS Fluent/CFX or equivalent) to optimize lift, drag, stability, and efficiency.
 



 • Translate simulation results into concrete design changes.
 



 • Diagnose and resolve aerodynamic issues that surface during actual flight testing, not just on paper.
 



**Manufacturing \& Materials** 




 • Select materials (carbon\-fiber composites, high\-strength polymers, lightweight alloys, aerospace\-grade materials) based on strength, weight, cost, and durability requirements.
 



 • Apply design\-for\-manufacturing (DFM) principles to keep designs production\-ready and repeatable.
 



 • Coordinate with fabrication teams on CNC machining, 3D printing, and composite molding.
 **Testing \& Field Validation** 




 • Validate designs through prototyping, ground testing, and flight testing.
 



 • Use field feedback and test data to drive continuous design iteration.
 



 • Demonstrate a track record of designs that are personally developed and currently operating in the field \- not shelved prototypes.
 



**Documentation \& Compliance** 




 • Produce detailed engineering drawings, specifications, and BOMs.
 



 • Ensure designs meet applicable engineering, safety, and regulatory standards.
 



 • Maintain configuration control and documentation throughout the product lifecycle.
 



**Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 




 • Work closely with flight\-control, electronics, manufacturing, and operations teams to resolve design and performance issues.
 



 • Support fast design iteration cycles based on test data and operational needs.
 



  





**Required Qualifications \& Skills** 




 • Education Bachelor's or Master's degree in Aerospace, Aeronautical, Mechanical, or Mechanical Design Engineering, or a related field.
 



 • Proven, independent ownership of UAV/drone mechanical and structural designs — not just design support.
 



 • Demonstrable experience with UAV components or systems that have been manufactured, tested, and deployed in the field.
 



 • Strong practical grounding in aerodynamics, fluid mechanics, and UAV structural design.
 



 • Proficiency in SolidWorks, Fusion 360, AutoCAD, or equivalent CAD tools.
 



 • Hands\-on CFD analysis experience using ANSYS Fluent/CFX or equivalent.
 



 • Working knowledge of composite materials, lightweight structures, CNC machining, and additive manufacturing.
 



 • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to turn theory into flight ready hardware.
 



  





**Preferred** 




 • FEA/structural and multi\-physics simulation experience.

**Job Title :** **Stay in Compliance Lead \- DWES**

  


**Job Summary:**

  



The Stay In Compliance Lead within Digital Workplace \& Experience Services (DWES) is responsible for defining, governing, and driving the digital workplace compliance strategy to ensure endpoints, collaboration platforms, and Microsoft 365 services remain current, secure, and aligned with supported hardware and software standards. The role is responsible for maintaining the software and hardware currency of the digital workplace estate across Windows and macOS endpoints, mobile devices, virtual solutions, Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, Power Platform, and related M365 platforms by leading regular software upgrades, security patching, hardware refresh governance, and configuration remediation activities.

  



The position proactively identifies and mitigates security risks by leveraging OEM tools, vulnerability intelligence platforms (including MSRC advisories and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint), and security advisories to assess the exposure of the digital workplace estate to emerging threats and vulnerabilities. Working closely with I\&O Stay in Compliance (SIC), Business Relationship Managers (BRMs), OSTS, Endpoint Management, Collaboration \& Platforms, M365 Foundation Services, Ops \& Engineering, Product Owners, and vendor partners, the role drives DWES enterprise\-wide compliance initiatives, ensures timely execution of remediation activities, and strengthens the organization's overall digital workplace security posture. The Stay In Compliance Lead serves as the central authority for endpoint and platform lifecycle governance, vulnerability management, compliance reporting, and risk reduction across the global digital workplace estate.

  


**Job Description**

  


* Own and lead the Digital Workplace \& Experience Services (DWES) vulnerability management program, ensuring identification, assessment, prioritisation, remediation, and reporting of security vulnerabilities across the entire DWES product portfolio.
* Develop and maintain a comprehensive vulnerability remediation and risk management roadmap, leveraging data\-driven insights, analytics, and risk\-based prioritisation to reduce overall security exposure.
* Establish and execute Global Vulnerability Management compliance plans across Windows and macOS endpoints, mobile devices, virtual solutions, Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, Power Platform, and associated Microsoft 365 platforms.
* Drive end\-to\-end remediation governance for critical, high, and medium\-risk vulnerabilities, ensuring timely closure or approved risk exceptions in accordance with business and security requirements.
* Maintain accountability for compliance against remediation SLAs and security standards established by Information Security, tracking progress, ageing, and compliance performance across the DWES estate.
* Partner with Information Security, Product Owners, Endpoint Management, Collaboration \& Platforms, Ops \& Engineering, Service Management, OSTS, BRMs, and other stakeholders to ensure effective execution of security remediation activities.
* Define, implement, and continuously enhance policies, standards, processes, and procedures governing vulnerability management, software currency, hardware lifecycle compliance, and security remediation activities.
* Establish and maintain a robust controls framework that ensures effective governance, auditability, compliance monitoring, and risk management across DWES services.
* Collaborate closely with Information Security and Enterprise Technology stakeholders to lead DWES participation in Critical Vulnerability Response Plan (CVRP) exercises and enterprise\-wide cyber response activities.
* Continuously monitor OEM advisories, MSRC and vulnerability intelligence feeds, security bulletins, and threat intelligence platforms to identify risks impacting DWES infrastructure and services.
* Partner with vendors and OEMs to assess the impact of emerging security threats, recommended mitigations, software defects, and lifecycle\-related risks.
* Drive execution of critical security patching, emergency remediation activities, and infrastructure upgrades to reduce organisational risk exposure.
* Act as the primary DWES representative within the Intelligent Operations Center (IOC) for security vulnerability management, remediation coordination, and risk response activities.
* Review, challenge, and validate risk exception requests, ensuring technical justification, compensating controls, and business impact assessments are appropriately documented before approval.
* Provide technical guidance and risk advisory support to leadership teams, product owners, and business stakeholders regarding vulnerability remediation strategies and compliance obligations.
* Develop, maintain, and publish executive dashboards, scorecards, and management reports covering vulnerability exposure, remediation progress, security compliance, software currency, hardware currency, and risk posture across DWES.
* Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), risk indicators (KRIs), remediation targets, and compliance metrics to measure programme effectiveness.
* Drive automation and continuous process improvement initiatives across vulnerability assessment, remediation tracking, software upgrades, patch management, compliance reporting, and IOC operational activities.
* Partner with Service Management teams to ensure all security remediation activities adhere to established governance, change management, ITSM, and operational compliance requirements.
* Own stakeholder communications related to security vulnerabilities, remediation plans, compliance risks, maintenance activities, and risk mitigation strategies.
* Lead incident\-related vulnerability remediation activities, ensuring effective coordination across technical teams and timely communication to stakeholders.

title: Software Engineering Manager — Funded Development
description:
* Permanent \- Full Time
* Ahmedabad/GiftCity

We are looking for a hands\-on Software Engineering Manager to lead the Funded Development (Services / NRR) POD — the cross\-functional team accountable for delivering customer\-funded enhancements and bespoke solutions on top of our trading platform. The role sits at the intersection of engineering delivery and commercial commitment and is measured on how predictably the POD ships committed customer work on time, at the quality bar our clients expect, across multiple concurrent engagements.
This is a working manager role: you are expected to stay close to the code — reviewing designs, code and stepping in on the hardest problems — while primarily driving delivery for the POD. The POD’s core surface is Order Routing and the Market Data ecosystem, with regular contributions into Risk, FIX services, trading UI enhancements and other backend systems as customer commitments require.

  

##### **Key Responsibilities**


* **Delivery \& stakeholder ownership** — Own end\-to\-end delivery of customer\-funded projects across multiple concurrent engagements. Run the daily cadence (standups, sprint reviews, hand\-offs) and act as the primary engineering point of contact for Product and Project Management on requirements, estimation, capacity planning, project tracking, CR workflows, and risk. Surface schedule and scope of risk early with credible mitigations, and provide honest, timely status to Client Services, Sales, Platform, Release Engineering, and senior leadership.
* **Hands\-on technical leadership \& design** — Stay close to one or more components across the TT platform (Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, trading UI). Author tech design documents for non\-trivial customer\-funded features and review designs produced by the team — ensuring correctness, performance, blast radius on shared components, rollout / rollback, observability, and long\-term supportability. Set the quality bar through architecture, design, and code reviews in modern C\+\+, and be the escalation\-of\-last\-resort on hard issues.
* **Cross\-component versatility \& engineering excellence** — Deliver across a broad surface — Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, and trading UI enhancements — as customer commitments evolve. Drive engineering best practices across the POD: modern C\+\+ standards, multithreading and concurrency correctness, performance tuning, automated testing, and CI hygiene. Treat customer\-funded work as first\-class product code, not throwaway one\-offs, and build a POD that can flex across components without becoming shallow on any of them.
* **AI\-assisted engineering** — Champion the adoption of AI coding assistants and agentic tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, and internal AI tooling) across the POD to accelerate delivery, code review, test authoring, design exploration, and production diagnostics. Set the bar for responsible use — quality, security, IP protection, and human accountability for shipped code — and share patterns that work back into the wider engineering org.
* **SE \+ SQE leadership** — Lead a cross\-functional POD of Software Engineers and Software Quality Engineers. Foster a shared ownership model where quality is designed in, not bolted on, and where SQEs are equal partners in scoping, automation, and release readiness.
* **People management \& culture** — Line\-manage the POD: 1:1s, feedback, growth plans, hiring, and calibration. Build a fair, sustainable delivery culture that can absorb context switching and shifting priorities without burning people out or letting quality slip.
  

##### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**


**Essential Skills \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience), with 10 to 12 years of software engineering experience and 2\+ years managing a mid\-sized engineering team, including line management of engineers.
* Expert\-level hands\-on proficiency in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+11 through C\+\+20\) — able to review and write production\-grade code, and to lead deep technical discussions on architecture, multithreading, concurrency, and performance.
* Deep experience delivering software for electronic trading, capital markets, or other high\-performance, mission\-critical, low\-latency systems, with strong working knowledge of trading\-system fundamentals: order lifecycle, exchange gateways, FIX / exchange protocols, market data, price generation, and risk checks.
* Proven track record delivering complex, customer\-committed software projects in an Agile environment — working closely with Product and Project Management on estimation, planning, and CR workflows — and managing multiple concurrent engagements with changing priorities, aggressive timelines, and frequent context switching, while still meeting commitments.
* Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants and/or agentic developer tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or equivalents) in real delivery — with a clear point of view on where they add leverage, where they don’t, and how to keep quality, security, and IP under control.
* Proficient with Linux, production diagnostics, and debugging / profiling tools (GDB, Address Sanitizer, perf, and similar).
* Demonstrated success as a people manager — growing engineers and SQEs, hiring, calibrating, and handling difficult conversations — with excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills across engineering, Product, Project Management, Client Services, and customers.

**Desirable Skills \& Experience**

Maharshi Industries Pvt. Ltd. (MIPL) is looking for a highly organized and execution\-focused Project Executive to work closely with the Founder and Management.

The role involves management coordination, tendering, administration, compliance tracking, recruitment support, project follow\-ups and cross\-functional coordination. The role is ideal for someone who is proactive, dependable, detail\-oriented and strong at follow\-ups, with an interest in gaining broad exposure to the operations of a growing technology and defence company.

title: AI Engineer (Agents & Systems)
description:
**About The Role:** We are seeking a highly skilled and communicative AI Engineer to lead the design, development, and deployment of intelligent AI agents and enterprise applications. This is a hybrid role that demands deep technical expertise in modern AI ecosystems alongside exceptional communication skills. You will not only build complex, production\-ready AI systems but also serve as a key technical liaison—translating complex AI concepts for clients, gathering requirements, and producing crystal\-clear technical documentation.

If you are just as comfortable writing complex orchestration logic for LLMs as you are leading a client presentation in flawless English, this role is for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technical Development \& Engineering:**

* Design, develop, and deploy autonomous AI agents, multi\-agent systems, and generative AI applications from scratch.
* Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) and build Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines tailored to specific business use cases.
* Optimize AI model performance, latency, and cost within production environments.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to integrate AI capabilities into existing enterprise software and workflows.

**Communication \& Client Facing:**

* Act as the primary technical point of contact for clients, leading meetings to gather requirements, scope projects, and present technical solutions clearly and confidently.
* Translate business needs into actionable technical architectures and explain complex AI mechanics to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Collaborate effectively with internal product managers, developers, and leadership to ensure alignment on project goals.

**Documentation \& Process:**

* Create and maintain comprehensive, high\-quality technical documentation, including system architectures, API specifications, and user manuals.
* Draft clear client proposals, progress reports, and post\-deployment handover documents.
* Establish best practices for code quality, testing, and system documentation within the AI engineering team.

**Required Qualifications**

**Technical Skills:**

* **Experience:** 4\+ years in Software Engineering with at least 1\-2\+ years of hands\-on, proven experience building and deploying AI applications, LLM integrations, or AI agents in production.
* **Programming:** Advanced proficiency in Python and familiarity with Node.js or TypeScript.
* **AI Frameworks:** Hands\-on experience with modern AI orchestration tools (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel).
* **Models \& APIs:** Deep understanding of commercial and open\-source LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Llama, Mistral) and vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus).
* **Cloud \& Deployment:** Experience deploying scalable applications on AWS, GCP, or Azure, utilizing Docker and CI/CD pipelines.

**Communication \& Soft Skills:**

* **Language:** Exceptional proficiency in written and spoken English. Must be able to articulate complex ideas smoothly and professionally.
* **Client\-Facing Experience:** Proven track record of interacting directly with clients, managing expectations, and delivering technical presentations.
* **Documentation:** Strong technical writing skills with a portfolio of past documentation (system designs, readmes, whitepapers, or client briefs).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* A portfolio or GitHub repository showcasing personal or open\-source contributions to AI agent frameworks.
* Experience with UI/UX prototyping tools (Streamlit, Gradio, or Next.js) to build quick proof\-of\-concepts for clients.
* Previous experience in a consulting, agency, or fast\-paced startup environment.

Pay: ₹1,200,000\.00 \- ₹1,800,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Deployment Engineer
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
   

  

**The Team**
 Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business\-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business\-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI\-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go\-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long\-term success of our customers.
   

  

**The Role**
 As a Senior Deployment Engineer, you are the backbone of Celonis delivery. You lead the hands\-on implementation of Celonis solutions for enterprise customers, combining platform expertise with AI\-augmented workflows to deliver high\-quality outcomes, fast. You use Celonis’s AI deployment tools as your primary instruments \- directing agents to build data models, generate analyses, and configure operational solutions, while applying your own judgment to validate outputs, adapt to customer context, and ensure business relevance.
   

  

 This is not a traditional consulting role where you build everything manually. You are an AI\-augmented delivery professional: you specify what needs to be built, direct AI agents to execute wherever possible, validate the results, and iterate with the customer.
 **You generate value by understanding the customer’s business, translating their needs into technical specifications and solutions, and ensuring the platform delivers measurable impact.**
**The Work You’ll Do**
**Initiate and Connect**
* Conduct business discovery workshops to translate customers’ strategic objectives into high\-impact Celonis use cases
* Collaborate with the customer’s IT and business stakeholders to define project scope, data requirements, and success criteria
* Ensure data connectivity and extraction pipelines are properly configured, working with specialist resources if required


**Build \& Value**
* Direct AI deployment agents (Apollo) to build data models, process analyses, KPIs, and dashboards \- writing clear specifications and validating agent outputs against business requirements
* Build and configure Celonis solutions across the platform: Process Intelligence Graph, data transformations, process analysis, operational solutions, and AI\-powered insights
* Identify process inefficiencies and root causes using Celonis technology, always in close collaboration with the customer
* Validate AI\-generated outputs for accuracy, business relevance, and alignment with customer context \- applying domain knowledge where the AI cannot
* Lead value creation workshops and define measures to improve process inefficiencies
* Define and build KPIs measuring the customer’s success and quantify business impact
* Design and build operational solutions to drive value, adoption and improve process conformance


**Rollout, Adoption, and Handover**
* Enable key customer users to use and extend the solution independently, setting the foundation for long\-term adoption
* Manage project outcomes against timelines, scope, and customer expectations
* Train and demonstrate to customer users, guiding them on the path to sustained value
* Document solution design decisions and configurations for future reference and handoff


**Domain \& Industry Depth**
* Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, IT Service Management) or industry verticals
* Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage
* Proactively identify and standardize high\-value use cases within your domain, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap


**What Makes This Role Different In The AI Era**
* You work with AI agents as your primary tools \- your job is to direct, validate, and refine their output, not to write every line of code or build every analysis manually
* You need strong specification and context engineering skills \- the ability to translate a customer’s ambiguous business need into a precise instruction that an AI agent can execute correctly
* You are expected to continuously learn and adapt as AI capabilities evolve, experimenting with new approaches and sharing what works with your peers
* You balance speed with quality \- AI accelerates execution, but you own the judgment calls on whether the output is right for this customer
* You think in sustainable software solutions. While AI agents will generate first results quickly, you need to ensure that the operational solutions you build in Celonis are robust, user friendly, maintainable, and scalable


**The Qualifications You Need**
* Experience: 4\+ years in Management or IT consulting, data/solution consulting, or process improvement consulting within software vendors, consulting firms, or system integrators. For Senior DE: 6\+ years with demonstrated project leadership.
* Platform skills: Ability to build and configure solutions on the Celonis platform, including data modeling, process analysis, KPI definition, and automation. Proficiency in PQL, SQL, and Python.
* AI fluency: Comfort working with AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.). Ability to write clear specifications, evaluate AI\-generated outputs, and iterate effectively. Experience with prompt engineering or context engineering is a strong plus.
* Business and process domain expertise : Strong understanding /deep expertise (based on seniority level) of enterprise business processes and financial metrics. Knowledge of standard ERPs (SAP, Oracle) and process areas (Inventory Management, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Accounts Payable) is a strong plus.
* Consulting skills: Ability to steer customer workshops, present findings to management, manage stakeholder expectations, and deliver outcomes in the face of adversity and ambiguity. Comfortable working with both technical and business audiences.
* Analytical mindset: Excellent problem\-solving skills with a value\-driven orientation. Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and quantify business impact.
* Learning agility: Willingness to continuously develop expertise through experimentation. Comfort with ambiguity and evolving tools.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Technology Management, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a comparable field.
* Languages: Fluency in English required. Additional languages are a plus.
* Travel: Willingness to travel to customer location up to 50%, according to customer requirement and project delivery phases.


**What Celonis can offer you:**
* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI\-driven business operations.
* Ownership from Day 1: Every full\-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit\-based refresh grants.
* Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.

EndPoint Infrastructure Patching \& Vulnerability Management Administrator


**Role Title**


EndPoint Infrastructure Patching \& Vulnerability Management Administrator

  

**Function / Portfolio**

Digital Workplace Enablement Services (DWES) – EndPoint Management

  

**Scope**



Patching \& vulnerability remediation of the \~450 on\-prem SCCM/APPPROXY infrastructure servers (CAS, Primary Sites, SQL site databases and supporting server roles)

  



**Job Description Summary**



Maintain and secure the Endpoint Management infrastructure (approximately 450 SCCM and AppProxy servers) by ensuring systems remain patched, hardened, and free of known vulnerabilities. Own the end\-to\-end server patching and remediation lifecycle, including monitoring, validation, deployment coordination, post\-patch verification, and driving vulnerability findings to closure.



The successful candidate will operate the patching lifecycle end to end: monitoring for released fixes, validating them, sequencing and executing patching in coordination with the SCCM and Approxy engineering team, restarting/validating servers, and driving vulnerability findings to closure.



The estate is split across non\-production and production environments and includes the Central Administration Site (CAS), Primary Sites and their SQL site databases, which are the true single point of failure for a site. Work is executed against an accelerated cadence and, when required, under an Emergency/Zero\-Day change model. The role is hands\-on, evidence\-driven and governed by EY change management (RFC / eCAB).

  

**Key Responsibilities**



**Server Patching \& Maintenance**


* Execute monthly, accelerated and emergency patching across the \~450 SCCM/AppProxy servers (non\-production first, then production), following the confirmed environment sequence.
* Sequence patching correctly so Windows/SQL work completes before SCCM/APPPROXY patching in each environment; perform and validate server restarts within the agreed windows.
* Apply Microsoft SCCM/APPPROXY hotfixes and SQL Server cumulative updates (CU/GDR) as prerequisites for a healthy SCCM/APPPROXY platform, coordinating carefully around SQL site databases to avoid taking a whole site down.
* Support High\-Availability failover patching (patch passive node/SQL replica, switch active/passive, patch former active) to minimize outage windows.

  


**Vulnerability Management \& Remediation**


* Own the remediation of vulnerabilities flagged against the SCCM/APPPROXY server estate (e.g. GVM / scanner findings from tools such as Qualys / Tenable), tracking each item to closure within SLA.
* Triage and prioritize findings by criticality (CVSS), separating in\-scope SCCM/APPPROXY/SQL items from those owned by other teams and re\-assigning out\-of\-scope items correctly (accurate CMDB ownership).
* Validate that deployed fixes actually mitigate the reported vulnerability, remove flagged/unnecessary software, and capture evidence for audit and closure.
* Maintain and report remediation status, backlog reduction and platform health metrics to the SCCM/APPPROXY lead and stakeholders.

  


**Coordination, Change \& War Room Operations**


* Liaise daily with the core SCCM/APPPROXY engineering team, SQL/DBA, platform, and service management to plan and execute patch windows.
* Raise and manage changes through EY change management (RFC / eCAB), including emergency/zero\-day changes, respecting change freezes and approvals.
* Provide War Room coverage during patch surges and zero\-day events: readiness checks, live execution, validation, rollback if thresholds are exceeded, and clear stakeholder communication.
* Produce concise, evidence\-based status updates and closure reports for leadership.

  


**Required Skills \& Experience**


* Hands\-on experience administering and patching SCCM/APPPROXY server infrastructure (CAS, Primary Sites, site system roles) in a large enterprise estate.
* Strong Windows Server administration skills (multi\-domain Active Directory) including patching, restart sequencing and post\-patch validation.
* Working knowledge of SQL Server as an SCCM/APPPROXY prerequisite — applying CU/GDR updates and understanding site\-database criticality and Always On / HA concepts.
* Solid understanding of enterprise change management (RFC / CAB / eCAB) and evidence/audit discipline.
* Ability to work under pressure in a War Room / on\-call model across accelerated and emergency patch cycles.

  


**Out of Scope**



To keep the role focused, the following are explicitly not the primary responsibility of this position:


* Day\-to\-day administration of the SCCM/APPPROXY application layer — application packaging/deployment, collections/targeting, task sequences, client health and end\-user device compliance.
* Operating\-system patching governance owned by other platform teams (the role executes/sequences server patching but does not own OS patch policy).
